2044༄ga /dpal gnod gnas kyi mdor bsdus pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs ①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī rdza ②bha la su saṃ k+ṣip+ta sā ①dha rgo/ bod skad du/ dpal gnod gnas kyi mdor bsdus pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs/ dpal gnod gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngar bstan pa'i cho gas snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su dpal gnod gnas bugasum pa'i sa bon ni mdog ser ba stong pa'i lhas mnan pa zla ba phyed pas rnam par brgyan pa/ de nyid las rdzogs pa'i dpal gnod gnas kha dog ser po phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pa'i phyag na bī dza pū ⑤ra ka /g.yon pa'i phyag na rin po che'i char rab tu 'bebs bzhin pa'i ne'u le rjo'adzin pa sangs rgyas lnga'i cod pan can zhabs gnyis kyis dung gi ⑦tshogs dang / pad+ma'i tshogs kyi gter chen po mnan pa/ ut+pal sngon po'i ⑧phreng ba 'dzin pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis ⑨brgyan pa/ rdza bha la'i ⑩gzugs su bdag nyid bsgom par bya'o/ /rang gi khyim du yang rin po che sna tshogs la 40—154

sogs pa'i char rab tu 'bab par 'gyur bar ①bdag nyid bsam par bya'o/ /de nas phyag rgya bcing bar bya ste/ lag pa gnyis khu tshur bcings te ⑤gung mo dag ni dbu ma'i tshigs gsum pa bkug pa ni rdza ①bha la'i phyag rgya zhes bya'o/ /oṃ dze+e bha la dza len drwa ya swā hā/ sngags 'di nyid kyis burje btsun la chu gtor ba brgya rtsa brgyad dbul bar bya'o/ /phyi nas mchod pa bya ste sngags bzla bar bya'o/ /de nas dngos grub ni sbyin pa chen por 'gyur te ⑤the tshom med do/ /dpal dze+e bha la'i sgrub pa'i thabs mdor bsdus pa'ome/ /slob dpon badz+ra ⑦tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang / khams pa lo tsā skeb dge slong ba ris bsgyur cing zhus pa'o// //40—155

༄ga /un+d+rasma jo bha la'i sgrub pa'i thabs/7 ༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ uṣ+ṭha dze+e snyebha la sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/ u0 dze+e ④bha la'i sgrub pa'i thabs/ bcom ldan 'das rdza bha la la ④phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ ābyuzhes bya bas phab ste/ rang gi snying gar a yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su hūṃ las rdo rje rtse dgu pa'i dbus su dbang po sbas pa lta bu'i hūṃ yig go/ /sngon du bstan pa ⑤'be+ebs pa'i sngags kyis phab la—/ dze+e bubha la mgon po ⑦rang gi snying gar rab tu bcug khyapas/ u0 ⑨mi'u thung gi gzugs rna ba ma phug pa mdog nag pa/ skra kham pa gyen du bsgreng ngob/lus thung bar byed cing khro gnyer can/ mche ba dang ldan pa rin chen /nyu'abyung ldan gyi dbu rgyan can/ klu chen po brgyad kyi ⑩rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i ⑫g.yon pa'i phyag na rin po che la sogs pa sgyugs ④pa'i sre mo bsnams pa/ g.yas na ④khrag gis bkang ba'i thod pa bsnams pa'o/ /mgo g.yas phyogs su bstan pa'i gser 40—157

gyi mdog can/ rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa'i nor sbyin 'gyel ba la zhabs gnyis kyis mnan pas ①rin po che'i snye ma la sogs pa skyugs lapar byed pa'o/ /'od 'phro ba'i phreng ①ba 'khrigs pa'i bdag nyid du bsams la/ uli'i ༷g.yas pa'i phyag tu saṃ ⑤las skyes pa gru gsum pa sa ka ṭa rjobasam mo baṃ las skyes pa'i bum pa bzang po 'bo bzhin pa'o⑦/ /lag pa'i dbus su rdza ngo / / sdigs mdzub ⑧la bha'o/ /gung mo la la'o/ /srin lag la dza'/ /mthe'u chung ⑨la len no/ /mtheb chen la dru'o/ /mkhrig ⑩mgul du ya'o/ /de nas swā hā zhes pa ni logs gnyis la'o/ /sngags dgod pa bsgom pa'i rim ⑫pa'o/ /kha mngon par bsngags la chu sbyin sbyin ⑫par bya'o/ /oṃ zlo ⑫swā hā/ chu khyer ba nas sbyin pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ in+d+ra ṇi mu khaṃ ④blu ma ri swā hā/ lag pa nas kha/kha nas lag pa/ de nas zhal du sbyin par bya'o/ /de ltar snying rjes sems can dbul ba'i sdug bsngal bcad pa'i don du rdza ⑫bha la bsgom pa ni dze+e ⑩bha la nyid du 'gyur ro/ /uli rdza ⑫bha la'i sgrub pa'i thabs rnal 'byor pa dga' ba sbyin spyogyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang / khams pa lo tsā ⑪ba dge slong ba ris bsgyur cing zhus pa'o// //40—158

sngag /lha mo nor rgyun gyi sgrub thabs/①༄gro/ /rgya gar skad du/ ba sun+d+ra rā sā ⑤dha rna/ bod skad du/ lha mo nor rgyun gyi sgrub thabs/ lha mo nor kyi rgyun ①la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhan yang nor rgyun ma sgom rjopar 'dod pas/ de la sngon rjobazhin du thams cad de ltar bya'o/ /'on kyang drug pa'i gsum pa'i sa bon la zla phyed dang thig les brgyan pa ste/ de nyid la rdzogs pa'i nor sbyin ma mdog ser ba 'bras kyi snye ma dang / rin po che sna tshogs kyi char 'bab bzhin pa'i bum pa ni g.yon pa'i phyag na'o / /g.yas pa mchog sbyin pa rgyan rjothams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mdza' ba'i 3 skye 'gro rnams kyis yongs su bskor ba bsgom par bya'o/ /bdag nyid nor rgyun ma'o zhes bya'orjo/ /lag pa gnyis kyi ⑨khu tshur bcings te/ gung mo gnyis kyi tshigs gsum pa bcag pa ni nor rgyun ma'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nas bzlas pa bya ste/oṃ shrī ba sun+t+ra na k+ṣe tre ⑩swā hā/ nor rgyun ma'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //40byed160

paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang / khams pa lo tsā ①ba dge slong ba ris bsgyur cing zhus pa'o// //bsdur mchan/16 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉skurnya ra sna/ 〈〈snar 〉〉sku ta ra sa/ ①〈'dir 〉〉spyon ma/ 0〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasgom/ 'chi〈〈snar 〉〉pangon/ ༅〈〈snar 〉thargyan/⑦〈〈snar 〉stagadzad pa'i/ ⑧〈〈snar 〉〉wazhes bya'o/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈'dir 〉bokyi/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉kyid+dha na k+ṣe te/〈〈snar 〉〉su ni dha na k+ṣe te/161 ①〈〈pe 〉〉lo tsa/ 〈〈snar 〉〉thats+tsha/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1973)40wa 161

༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ z-i ⑤ku ṭī sā snyedha dz+wa/ bod skad du/ khro gnyer can gyi sgrub pa'i ④thabs/ 'phags ma khro gnyer can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngon du bstan pa'i cho gas rang gi snying gar zla ba'i dbus su sa bon drug pa'i bzhi pa dang po'i brgyad pas bkang ba'o/ /stong pa'i lhas mnan cing zla phyed kyis dbu brgyan pa'o/ /de nyid las yongs su rdzogs pa'i khro gnyer can mdog ser mo phyag bzhi pa/ ral pa'i cod pan 'chang zhing zhi ba/ g.yas pa na mchog sbyin pa dang phreng ba 'chang ba/ g.yon pa na dbyig pa dang ril ba spyi blugs bsnams pa'o/ /pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs pa ⑤bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas phyag rgya bcing bar bya ste/ lag pa gnyis brkyang ste mtheb chen gyis mthe'u pyachung gi sen mo mnan te/ lhag ma so sor byas pa ni rdo rje'i mtshan nyid do—/ /'di ni khro gnyer can gyi phyag rgya'o/ /phyi nas sngags bzlas par bya ste/40—162

skyes r+bha swā hā/ khro gnyer can gyi sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang / khams pa lo tsā ①ba dge slong ba ris bsgyur cing zhus pa'o// //bsdur mchan/162 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉ste// ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba/ du〈〈pe〉〉〈snar 〉to/pa'i/ 0〈〈pe 〉〉4ra/ 0〈〈snar 〉7) mthe/163 ①〈〈pe 〉〉pho tsa/ 〈〈snar 〉〉thats+tsha/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1974)40wa 163

sngag /byams pa'i sgrub thabs/①༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ mi tri ya sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/ byams pa'i sgrub zuthabs/ rgyal ba byams pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngon du bstan pa thams cad nyid byas ( te/ 'on kyang mi gi buyi ge yongs su rdzogs pa yi/ /thub pa skyes mchog byams pa ni/ /zhal gsum srun rjogasum gyis brgyan pa/ /de yi 'og tu pad+ma ste/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ /phyag bzhi dag gis rnam par mdzes/ /chos ston pa yi phyag rgya yis/ /phyag gnyis dag ni rnam par /hūṃbargyan/ /g.yas pa'i phyag ni gnyis pa na/ /mchog sbyin sems can skyong ba'o/ /g.yon na lha rdzas yal ga ni/ /klu shing me tog bcas pa'o/ /sangs rgyas sprin ni rab spro zhing / /byang chub sems dpa' de bzhin 'bar/ /zla ba'i gdan dang dkyil 'khor yang / /dngos grub mgon po bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas phyag rgya bcing ④byas la/ /mnyam par bzhag pas sngags bzlas bya/ /40byed164

lag gnyis so so dag tu bya/ /khu tshur bcings te sdigs mdzub ①gnyis/ /mthe bo'i dbus su gzhag bya ste/ /me tog sna tshogs mchod par bya/ /phyag rgya'o②/ /skyes mo mi tri ya swā hā/ byams pa'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang / khams pa lo tsā ①ba dge slong ba ris bsgyur ba'o0// //bsdur mchan/164 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉༄ga /byams pa dang shes rab kyi pha rol phyin ma'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// ②〈〈snar 〉〉〉pa'i/ ①〈'dir 〉stunams la/ ④〈〈pe〉tshomi gyis/ 〈'dir 〉stab gi/ 0〈〈snar 〉45ga ①〈〈snar 〉ra bar/ ⑦〈〈snar 〉thacings/165 ①〈'ar 〉tharigs 'dzub/ ②〈〈pe 〉thaca'o/ 〈〈snar 〉thaca' ba bya'o/ ①〈〈pe 〉m+wa tsa/ 〈po ra 〉glots+tsha/①〈po ra 〉〉ཿnga zhus so/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1975)40wa 165

༄ga /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i sgrub thabs/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ pradzñā pā ra mi tā ①sā dha rna/ bod skad du/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i sgrub thabs/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gis bsgoms pa tsam gyis ni/ /shes rab pha rol phyin bskyed ④cing / /gzhan rtsod kun las durgyal 'gyur ba/ /de ni rjoyang dag bshad par bya/ /zhal gcig phyag ni gnyis pa ste/ /mdog ni dkar po yid du 'ong / /phyed phyed 'khyil pa'i dbu skra dang / /pad+ma dkar por yang dag gnas—/ / g.yas kyi ④phyag na pad+ma ste/ /g.yon na shes rab pha rol phyin/ /mdog dmar rnam par bsgom par bya/ /rdo rje skyil krung yang dag gnas/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis ⑦yan lag brgyan/ /lte ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /saṃ yig ye shes las byung ba/ /mchog dang dga' bar ⑧byed pa mo/ /dam tshig sems dpa' rdzogs byas la/ /ye shes sems dpa' bsgom par bya/ /zla 40byed166

drug bsgoms pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /shes rab pha rol phyin mar 'gyur/ /nub bdun bar du ①sbyor ba yis/ /bstan bcos kun la 'jigs pa med/ /'bum phrag bzlas pa sbyor ba yis/ /nyin re tshigs bcad brgya brgya ni/ /'bad pa med par rab tu byed/ /gzhung ni brgya ni 'dzin par 'gyur/ /de la sngags kyi tshig ni 'di yin te/ oṃ pi tsu pi tsu pradzñā badzña ni dz+wa la dz+wa la me dhā bar dhā ②ni/ dhi ri dhi ri bu dhi ①bar dha ni swā hā/ bya rog gi sgra mi grag par sngags 'dis ma bslangs par rang sgyur ④la/ lan bdun du khrubasngags la—/ ji srid zla ba drug gi bar du 'thungs na de'i shes rab skye bar 'gyur ro//shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i sgrub ⑥pa'i thabs sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa sdogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang / khams pa lo tsā meb dge slong ba ris bsgyur cing zhus pa'o⑤// //40—167

༄spro/ /rgya gar skad du/ pradzñā pā ra mi tā sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i sgrub thabs/ bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngon du bstan pa'i cho gas rang gi snying gar pad+ma dkar po dang / zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la pre dkar po bkod nas sngon du bstan pa bzhin du thams cad byas la/ pre dang pad+ma yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das ma zhal gcig ma/ phyag gnyis ma dkar mo/ lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid rin po che'i dbu rgyan 'chang ba/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i po tis mtshan pa'i pad+ma gnyis g.yon dang g.yas kyi logs kyi nang du longs ②kyin yang dag par bsnams shing bzung byeba'i phyag gnyis kyis chos bshad pa'i phyag rgya kun nas bcings te/ pad+ma dkar po dang zla ba la rdo rje skyil krung can ma/ lang tsho gsar phyol bab cing bdo ba/ sna tshogs kyi na bza' 40byed169

dang rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i rab tu snang ba tsam mo/ /sna tshogs kyi 'od zer rab tu 'phros pa'i tshogs kyis nam mkha' bkang ste/ mar me'i phreng ba lta bu thogs pa med pas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma ①mang po 'phro zhing bsdu ba'i sbyor bas thams cad gcig gi rang bzhin du lhag par mos pas yang skeji srid du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma ④mngon du ma gyur pa de srid du bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas gal te dgod par byung bar gyur na/ de la pad+ma dkar po sna'i rtse mor sran tsa na ka'i ghu tshad tsam bris pa lta bu rnam par bsgoms la/ de la gnas pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma shin tu phra ba brjod pa'i gzugs rtse gcig pa'i yid kyis yang dang yang du mngon du bya zhing bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas bskyed rjopa'i rim pa'i phyogs kyi sngags ni/ oṃ pre swā hā/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i phyogs kyi sngags med de/ don dam pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rnal 'byor pa gdams ngag thob pas so/ /dge 'dun sbyin gyi rjobu yis ni/ /rigs kyi ming gis 'bad pa yis/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi rgyur/ /sgrub thabs gsal po 'di bris so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i sgrub thabs/ slob dpon dge 'dun sbyin gyi sras kyis ⑦mdzad pa rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang / khams pa lo tsā skeb dge slong ba ris bsgyur cing zhus pa'o// //40—170

bsdur mchan/169 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉pangs ③〈〈pe 〉〉〈'dir 〉stanazung / du〈〈pe 〉lda rje'i/ 〈'dir 〉rda rje'i/ 0〈〈pe 〉po〈snar 〉〉bar/17 ①〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉pa/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wayang / ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa/ 0〈'dir 〉〉sga'i/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉skyed/ rjo〈〈pe 〉stanan gyis/ 〈〈snar 〉stanan gyi/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉7)/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉tsa/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1977)40wa 171

༄/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i sgrub thabs/①༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ pradzñā pā ra mi tā sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i sgrub thabs/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yid mthun gnas ni kha cig tu/ /bde ba'i gdan la 'dug nas su/ /rnal 'byor byams dang snying rjer ②ldan/ /sngags 'di lan gsum brjod par bya/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā 1dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā ba ā kolha ④haṃ/ zhes byas brtan dang g.yo ba'i dngos/ /bdag nyid lus dang thams cad du/ /sems kyis 3stong nyid bsgom par bya/ /rmi lam rmi lam mtshungs pa ru/ /paṃ yig las ni yongs rdzogs pa'i/ /pad+ma zla ba'i gdan gnas pa/ /ser po dhīḥni dgod byas te/ /de yi bdag nyid bcom ldan ma/ /phyag gnyis shes rab pha rol phyin//sna tshogs gos 'chang sna tshogs brgyan/byu/ /chos 'chad phyag rgya mnyam ldan phyag /sgeg pa gcig pu nyams ldan zhing / /rdo rje spyil krung yang dag gnas/ /po 40—172

tis mtshan pa'i pad sdong ni/ /g.yon gyi logs su bsnams pa'o/ /spyi bo mgrin pa snying gnas pa'i1/ /zla ba la gnas de nyid gsum/ /oṃ yi hūṃ/e aḥngag gi dbus su ni/ /zla ba dhīḥ ni 'od zer ser/ /de nas gzugs ser rnam par bsgom/ /kun rdzob kyi ni rnal 'byor gyis/ /shes rab mchod pa bsgom par bya/ /don dam par ni rtogs /pa'i gzugs/ /shes rab bdag nyid che brjod bya/ /gang gis byang chub nges thob pa'i/ /rim pas 4sbyor bas 'gro bar 'gyur/ /ston ka'i 5zla ba lta bu'i 'od/ /dkar po'i sems ni rnam par bsgom/ /sna tshogs g.yo dang mi g.yo ba/ /de bzhin phyis ni 6nam mkha' mnyam/ /ma lus rtope /sa pas stong pa yi/ /rang nyid gzugs med stong par yang / /gzugs sgra dri dang ro dang ni/ /reg bya la sogs gzung dang 'dzin—/ /rtog pas yongs su ma gos pa/ /bsam mi khyab pa'i rkyen bskyed / pa/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub don/ /kun mkhyen sems kyi go 'phang ngo / /de la 'di bzlas pa'i sngags te/ oṃ pradzñā ma hā pradzñā shu ti ⑧smṛ ti bi dza spuye dhīḥswā hā/ shes rab pha rol phyin bsgoms ⑩pa'i/ /bdag gi bsod nams gang thob des/ /de yis 'jig rten ma lus kun/ /shes rab pha rol phyin gzhol shog /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i sgrub pa'i thabs rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang / khams pa lo tsā ⑪ba dge slong ba ris bsgyur cing zhus pa'o// //40—173

bsdur mchan/172 6)mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉rje/ ③〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ta/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wa3/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉kyi/ dhi〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉spyan/173 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉〉/ ③〈〈snar 〉〉rtog ④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉pa'i/ ⑤〈〈snar 〉〉kaskyo 〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉 de yang / ⑦〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉skyed/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉tha do/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉gi⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsgom/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tsa/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1978)40wa 174

༄ga /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i sgrub thabs/① ༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ pradzñā pā ①ra mi tā sā dha rna/ bod skad du/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i sgrub thabs/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngon du bstan pa'i cho gas stong pa nyid bsgoms snopa'i rjes la/a las skyes pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ mdog ser po'i yi ge ④dhīḥyongs su gyur pa las sna tshogs kyi pad+ma la ha ser po a la sogs pa ⑤dbyangs yig bcu drug gis yongs su bskor ba/ de nas ka la sogs pa'i yi ge sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis yongs su bskor ba/ de las sgeg mo dang / phreng ba ma dang / gar ma dang / glu ma dang /rjo me tog ma dang / bdug spos ma dang / mar me ma (dza dang / dri ma ste/ rnal 'byor ma brgyad do/ /'di thams cad yongs su gyur pa las ye shes zla ba las byung ba'i 'od gsal ba'o/ /de'i steng du pad+ma'o/ /de'i steng du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i po ti'o/ /de'i steng du zla ba'i 40—175

dkyil 'khor gnyis pa'o/ /①'di thams cad yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma mdog ser mo zhal gcig ma/ phyag gnyis ma de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i dbu rgyan can/ chos 'chad pa'i phyag rgya dang ldan pa sna tshogs kyi pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ rgyan thams cad dang / na bza' dang ldan pa/ g.yon pa dang g.yas pa'i logs su ut+pa la la gnas pa'i 3shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i po ti 'chang ba'o/ /sngags ni oṃ snyadhīḥ hūṃ swā hā/ hūṃ ser po ni dpral bar ro/ /udakar po ni mgrin pa'ophya / /dhīḥser po ni snying gar ro/ /hūṃ nag po ni lte bar ro zhes bya'o/ /bzlas pa'i dus su skad cig ma bzhi rjes su bsam par bya'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang / khams pa lo tsā 0ba dge slong ba ris bsgyur cing zhus pa'o// //40—176

bsdur mchan/175 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bsgom/ ④〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉wayi ge/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wa.a lasogs pa/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉྾po ra 〉mi glu ma dang / ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wam/176 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉〉de'i steng du po ti gnyis pa'o// ②〈〈snar 〉skanugs/ ②〈〈pe 〉dze'adir 〉〉waganas pa'i/0〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉waḥ/ 0〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉par ro/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉〉〈'dir 〉〉tsa/bsdur 'bras re'u migasgro/da/ (1979)40wa 177

༄ga /mdor bsdus pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i sgrub thabs/①༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ saṃ k+ṣip+ta pratshwa pā ra mi ta sā dha rgo/ bod skad du—/ mdor bsdus pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i ②sgrub thabs/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /①sngon du bstan pa'i cho gas stong pa nyid bsgoms pa'i rjes su pad+ma dmar po dang zla ba la gnas pa'i dhīḥser po yongs su gyur pa las/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma ser mo/ mi bskyod pa ④dbus su gnas pa'i ral pa'i cod pan can ⑤ma/ chos 'chad pa'i phyag rgya 'chang ma/ po ti dang bcas pa'i ut+pa la sngon po g.yon logs su 'dzin ma/gos kyi stod g.yogs dang / na bza' dmar pos brgyan ma zhes bya ba/ de ltar bsams la/ oṃ dhīḥshu ti smṛ ti bi dza rjoye swā hā/ zhes bya ba'i sngags bzlas pa'o/ /mdor bsdus pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i ⑦sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //40—178

paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang / khams pa lo tsā ①ba dge slong ba ris bsgyur cing zhus pa'o// //bsdur mchan/178 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〈snar 〉7'i/ ②〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉to/shesarab — 'tshal lo// 0〈〈pe 〉lo'adir 〉7sa/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉lo〈snar 〉〉wacan/ 0〈〈pe 〉po'ar 〉7pa/⑦〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉pa'i/179 ①〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉tsa/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1980)40wa 179

༄ga /mi g.yo ba'i sgrub thabs/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ a tsa la sā dha ②dz+wa/ bod skad du/ mi g.yo ba'i sgrub thabs/ 'phags pa mi g.yo ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /pus mo'i lha nga sar btsugs pa/ /g.yas pa'i phyag na ral gri bsnams/ /de yi cig shos phyag na ni/ /khu tshur sdigs mdzub zhags pa bsnams/ /sku lus mkhrang zhing grims pa la/ /gtum zhing 'bar ba gtum pa'i spyan/ /bgegs 'joms mi g.yo ba yis ni/ /srid pa'i bgegs rnams zhi bar mdzod/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i gtso bo rnams/ /de la rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i/ /me tog la sogs blos mchod bya/ /sdug bsngal rnams las bskyab pa'i phyir/ /bdag nyid lus ni dbul bar bgyi/ /sngags pas dge ba spel ba'i phyir/ /sdig pa rnams ni bshags par bgyi/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang sems tshogs/ /slob dang mi slob sems can gyi/ /40—180

bsod nams rang bzhin ma lus pa/ /de la rjes su yi rang bya/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub nges par bsten①/ /tshangs pa yi ni gnas bzhi po/ /rim pa ji bzhin bsgom par bya/ /mtshan nyid bang ②bral stong pa nyid/ /rgyu dang bral bas mtshan ma med/ /smon lam las kyang rnam grol ba'i/ /rang bzhin nyid du dngos po bsgom/ /sna tshogs pad+ma nyi dkyil du/ /yi ge hūṃ byung bzhugs par blta/ /dpa' bo spyan gsum ①dmar ba ste/ /phyag gnyis rin chen cod pan can/ /mgon po sdig pa mod la spong / /ji ltar 'dod pa yongs su skong ④/ /zar ma'i me tog lta bu'i mdog /sangs rgyas dri med 'od zer 'gyed/ /ya sos ma mchu rnam par btsir—/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /dpal ldan khro bo gtum po che/ /phyag na drag shul ral gris byel/ /g.yon na sdigs mdzub zhags pa ste//g.yon pa'i pus mo sa la btsugs/ /'jigs pa chen po zur mig 5༄gzigs/ /'jigs pa yang ni 'jigs par mdzad/ /ye shes sems dpa' gzi phyibarjid che/ /dam tshig sems dpa' 'dra bar lta/ /de nyid thugs kar sngags pa yis sa bon mtshan mar yang dag ldan/ /ji srid mi skyo'i bar du'o/ /bsam gtan skyo na lha yi ni/ /rnal 'byor ldan pas bzlas pa bya/ /de nas gsungs pa'i dngos grub ni/ /the tshom med pa kho nar thobadu / /de la sngags kyi rgyal po di 'di yin te/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ sngags kyi rgyal po ni lan cig bzlas pas sdig pa thams cad bsreg par 'gyur zhing thams cad srung 3bar byed par 'gyur ro/ /'byung po la sogs pa'i gdon gyi ⑨'jigs pa la/ yungs kar gyis bdegs pas gdon thams cad 'byer bar byed do/ /kham phor la rdo 40—181

rgyus kyis bris nas sgo ltag la btags na/ byes pa gsar du btsas pa srung ①bar byed do/ /spra tshil gyis ⑤gzugs sor bzhi pa'i tshad du byas nas de'i snying gar bsgrub ④bya'i ming dang bcas pa gro ga la mngon par bris te btsugs dunas/de'i kha la tsher mas btsugs na phyir rgol ba'i kha phur bus btab par 'gyur ro/ /rkang pa la btsugs na 'gro ba dang 'ong ba rengs par 'gyur ro/ /snying gar btsugs na khros pa zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /mi'i rje ngar gyi phur bu'am lcags kyi phur bus rjogang dag gi ming nas smos te de'i lus la btab na de 'jig par 'gyur ro/ /dgra bo'i sgo khar sbas na brlag par 'gyur ro/ /dur khrod kyi thal ba la mngon par bsngags nas dgra bo'i sgo glegs rjol btags na sgod par 'gyur ro/ /ral gri la mngon par bsngags nas g.yul du zhugs na rgyal bar 'gyur⑦rka/ bya ba gang la 'jug pa ni gtor ma btab ste ⑧'grub par 'gyur ro// sngags pa gang dge ba dang mi dge ba'i las gang 'dod pa bzlas pas 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /⑨bdag gis bris las gang 'thob ⑩pa'i/ /bsod nams byang chub sgrub byed pa/ /de ⑪'dir 'jig rten ma lus pa/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sgrub byed shog /⑫mi g.yo ba'i sgrub thabs pra bha kā ra tīrtis ⑫mdzad pa rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang / khams pa lo tsā ④ba dge slong ba ris bsgyur cing zhus pa'o⑩// //40—182

bsdur mchan/18 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉ga / /mi g.yo ba'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ca/181 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bstan/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉tongang / ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉gnyis/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bskong /⑤〈〈pe 〉〉dmig 〈〈snar 〉〉dmigs/ du〈〈snar 〉〉gzigs/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉torathob/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bsrung / po)〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7)sa/182 ①〈〈pe 〉〉krung / 〈〈snar 〉〉bsrung / ②〈〈snar 〉nya)/ ③〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉sgrub/ rjo〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉btsug⑤〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉wabu'am lcags kyi phur bus/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉〉bam/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉 ro// ⑧〈〈pe〉〉〈'dir 〉〉btang te/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉wasngagasapa — 'gyur ro// ⑩〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉thob/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉des/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉 gtum po chen po/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ka ra kirtis/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tsa/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stab/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1981)40wa 183

༄ga /gtum po chen po'i sgrub pa'i thabs ①༄tsho/ /rgya gar skad du/ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa sā dha dz+wa/ bod skad du/gtum po chen po'i sgrub pa'i thabs/ bcom ldan 'das gtum po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngon du gsungs pa'i cho gas stong pa nyid bsgoms pa'i rjes su pad+ma dkar po'i steng na nyi ma la hūṃ yig nag po de yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das gtum po ④chen po khros pa/ zar ma'i me tog lta bu/ ming gzhan gyis ④mi g.yo ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ mi g.yo ba mi mnyam pa'i spyan/ mche ba gshigs pa/ mi bzad ④pa'i zhal chen po/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan can mche bas ma mchu mnan pa/ mgo bo'i phreng ba'i dbu rgyan ⑤can/ spyan gnyis dkar zhing dmar ba/ g.yas na ral gri 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa'i phyag gis zhags pa dang sdigs mdzub thugs kar rjobasnams pa'o/ /sbrul dkar po mchod phyir thogs pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can rin po che 40—184

sna tshogs kyis rnam par spras pa/ zhabs g.yon pa sa la ma reg pa/ zhabs g.yas pa cung zhig bteg pa/ nyi ma'i 'od kyi phreng ba can gyi ①bdag nyid rnam par bsam par bya'o/ /dam tshig sems dpa' dang ye shes sems dpa' bsgom pa sngon du 'gro bas mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par bsam par bya'o/ /de nas bzlas pa ni oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa ②rgyu phaṭa/ gtum po chen po'i sgrub thababasdo :rdob/sa cas// //paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang / khams pa lo tsā ba dge slong ba ris bsgyur cing zhus pa'o// //bsdur mchan/184 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉7/ ③〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉8/ 0〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tshod/ ⑤〈〈snar 〉ṅkargyan/ khya〈〈pe 〉posnar 〉8nga gar/185 ①〈〈pe〉po'adir 〉〉wagyi/ ②〈〈pe 〉tod/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1982)40wa 185

༄ga /rdo rje bye mdzad kyi sgrub pa'i thabs/①༄ na /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra hūṃ kā ④ra sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi sgrub pa'i thabs/ rdo rje hūṃ mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngon du bstan pa'i cho gas stong pa nyid bsgoms ①pa'i rjes la/ nam mkha'i khams su ram̐ las skyes/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od 'bar brjo/ /bskal pa'i me ltar shin tu drag /mdog nag 'od chen 'bar ba ste/ /de las skyes pa'i drag chen po—/ /rdo rje hūṃ mdzad zhes bya ba/ /dgod pa brgyad kyis drag chen morjo/ /khams gsum ma lus gnon pa'o/ /rdo rje dril bu sbyor ba yis/ /phyag gnyis kyis ni phyag rgya bcing / /g.yon brkyang ba yi zhabs kyis ni/ /'jigs byed mnan cing 'jigs par byed/ /oṃ ābyuhūṃ gi yi ge gsum/ /snying ga mgrin pa spyi bor dgod/ /dbang bskur ba yi cho ga yis/ /thugs kyi rdo rje rgyas btab bya—/ /sngags ni oṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi sgrub pa'i thabs 40—186

rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang / khams pa lo tsā ①ba dge slong ba ris bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //bsdur mchan/186 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉ka ①〈〈snar 〉〉bsgom/ rjo〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ba'o/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stapo/187 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉tsa/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1983)40wa 187

༄ga /ri khrod lo ma can gyi sgrub thabs/①༄7/ / rgya gar skad du/ par+ṇa sha ba ri sā dha dz+wa/ bod skad du/ ri khrod lo ma can gyi sgrub thabs/④ 'phags ma ri khrod ma lo ma can la phyag 'tshal lo / /ri khrod ma lo ma can gyi sgrub pa'i thabs brjod par bya ste/ sngon bzhin du thams cad byas la rang gi snying gar pad+ma dkar po dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la ①paṃ ser po las skyes pa'i rdo rje'i ④lte ba la paṃ ngo ⑤/ /de thams cad yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das ma sku mdog ser ba zhal gsum pa/ spyan gsum pa/phyag drug pa'o/ /zhal dang po gser gyi mdog lta bu'o/ /g.yas pa dkar ba/g.yon dmar ba/ 'gying zhing dgod pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis mdzes pa/shing lo rtse mo gshibs pa'i sham thabs can lang tsho gsar la bdo rjozhing grims pa'o//g.yas kyi phyag rnams na rdo rje dang dgra sta dang / mda' rnams so/ /g.yon gyi ⑦phyag tu sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang / shing lo'i chun po 40—188

dang / gzhu bsnams pa'o/ /me tog gis bcings pa'i ral pa'i cod pan la mi bskyod pa 'chang ba'o/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor can ma/ 'og tu bgegs bsgyel ba la pad+ma dkar po dang / zla ba'i gdan la g.yon brkyang ba'i zhabs kyis gnas ①pa/ g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyis sdigs mdzub byas pa ni/ 'og gi bgegs kyi tshogs skrag par byed pa/ g.yas pa'i khu tshur gyis rdo rje 'phyar ba'i tshul gyis bsnams pa ste/ phyag rgya 'di yis snying ga la sogs par bsams pas rgyas gdab pa'o/ /rang gi 'od zer gyis ye shes sems dpa' gzhug pa la sogs pa bskyed dze+el/ nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad 'joms par byed ma ( bsam par bya'o/ /de nas sngags bzlas par bya'o/ /oṃ pi shā tsi par+ṇa sha ba ri sarba mā ra pra sha ma rjonī swā hā/ de nas ji lta ba bzhin du gshegs su gsol la/ ji ltar bde bas rjoganas par bya'o/ /ri khrod lo ma can gyi sgrub pa'i thabs rdzogs so—/ / //paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang / khams pa lo tsā pyab dge slong ba ris bsgyur cing zhus so⑦// //40—189

bsdur mchan/188 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉gag /ri khrod ma lo ma can gyi sgrub thabs bzhugs so// ②〈〈pe 〉po'adir 〉〉wargyagar — sgrub thabs/ ③〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉sgor/rjo〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉garje/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pam mo/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stabade/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉pa'i/189 ①〈〈pe 〉stananan/ 〈〈snar 〉〉panan/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈'dir 〉〉skyed/ ③〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉7/0〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉stab/⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bsam/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉tsa/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa'o/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1984)40wa 190

bsdur mchan/191 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i rdzogs byang las blangs te bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa i ma ③〈〈pe 〉〉〈'dir 〉〉paḥ/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉steḥ/ dhi〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ka ⑥〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉 ཿ/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgyu/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ta/ ⑨〈〈snar 〉〉ka ⑩〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ka ya/ ba ma na/ 67〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〉/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stob tī/ pi shwa/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉tā ni/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉〉da pa ju te lhasakā ciji ra ya/ lha'ikā ci'i ra yo/ zhwasatī cirnyi ta yo/ e ge tsi du spa yā sna/ ye ke ci'i skyo di ma/ka bhā yā/ me ke midu/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ba ma ba pā/ ut+pa bye te/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉ba ba te pā/ 〈〈snar 〉mis be te pā/ ⑩〈〈pe mi'i〈snar 〉staṅgeṣ+pe traṃ te/ na pa ṇa ḍa ta taḥta da ne/ 8〈〈pe 〉po〈snar 〉stanan/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉8/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉skosnar 〉ring man tra/192 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉btwa nān tsa/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉rdza/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈'dir 〉〉sha sra pa pa ra hā/ ④〈〈pe〉〉〈'dir 〉tog ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾po ra 〉snam ka ni/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉nga/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉wad ku ni〈〈pe 〉〉〈'dir 〉ring/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉sko'adir 〉〉za rda/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉pa ba / ⑩〈〈pe 〉sko'adir 〉8 rī/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stan ta cha'ipi to ga 'angami ta/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉mo sba te/ asba sge/ mā mtha/ 〈〈snar 〉ga sba te/ asbasaṅge/ma ma / ⑫〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉shārnyi/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉zhu/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ṇi/ ⑩〈〈snar 〉〉〉na/⑫〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉brnya ri/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉dri/ sh+yi〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉mego/ 0〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉stan/ kye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉smug blu〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ta/ ④〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa sha ma ri tī ha/ bla〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉shabasdur 'bras re'u mig da/ (1985)40wa 193

༄ga /'phags ma rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i sgrub pa'i thabs ①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya badz+ra swa ra swa tī ②sā n+d+ra rna/ bod skad du—/ 'phags ma rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i sgrub pa'i thabs/ 'phags ma rdo rje dbyangs can ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi gsung gter yon tan rang bzhin rdo rje dbyangs can la btud nas/ /rang la mnyes byed phan mdzad mdzes pa'i rol ldan spro zhing rtsod pas thub par dka' mdzad ma//de geni yang dag mnyes byed phan phyir srid pa byed cing mi bzad mi shes mun pa 'joms—/ /blo ngan dag gi ④ched du sems can phan phyir legs par gsungs pa'i cho ga brjod par bya/ /dang por snga bar kha la sogs pa dag pa'i rang bzhin snying rje dang ldan bzod ldan pas/ /sngags pas gtsang ma'i stan la byams pa'i dga' bas myos shing gang zhig dga' ba dag gis ni/ /yid dang mthun pa'i dben pa'i gnas su yang ni dga' bas rang gi snying gar pad+ma blta/ /40byed194

de 'dir sprul par brjod pa'i ri bong 'dzin pa la ni yang dag bsgom bya de 7la yang / /de nas doḥyi 'od zer gyis ni 'di nas kyang ni phyogs gzhan kun ni yongs su bkang / /sangs rgyas tshogs ni kun du bltas la mchod pa la sogs 'di ni bsgom par rab tu bya/ /me tog la sogs de nas phyag byas 'dir ni sdig pa bshags pa de bzhin rab tu bya④/ /sngags rig pas ni bsod nams rjes su yi rang skyabs gsum yang dag rab tu 'gro bar bya/ /shes bya la sogs smon lam legs snebatab de yis bdag nyid kyis ni dmigs par ④rab tu bya/ /gcig dang du ma dang bral lta bur yongs brjod bden zhing dag par shes rtogs pas—/ /de nas sna tshogs thams cad rnam rtog dra ba ma lus stong pa nyid du bsgom par bya/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na ⑤badz+ra swa bhā ba a kopho/pe haṃ/ stong nyid las byung pad+ma dang ni zla ba la gnas yang ni doḥyig dmar po ste/ /sna tshogs dag gi 'od zer tshogs ni shin tu mdzes par gyur pa'i pad+ma 'dab brgyad pa/ /de las dmar zhing 'od zer chen po dang ldan bcom ldan 'das ma bzang po'i rgyan gyis brgyan/ /g.yon brkyang ba yi zhabs kyis yang dag gnas shing zhal gsum phyag drug dag gis rab brgyan pa/ /g.yas pa'i zhal ni sngo zhing phyag na pad+ma ral gri gri gug rab tu bsnams pa ste/ /zhal g.yon dkar zhing lhung bzed dang bcas de bzhin rin chen 'khor lor rab tu ldan pa'i phyag /snying gar pad+ma la gnas zla ba'i dbus su gnas pa'i 'bar ba'i doḥyig de dang ni/ /sna tshogs mi shes mun pa 'joms pa'i 'od zer gyis ni 'gro ba 'um lus rab tu 'gengs / /yang dag bsdus la rang gi snying gar zla bar gnas pa'i sa bon la gnas bltas la yang rgo spro/ /de nyid yang dang yang du rgyun du snyom spulas med 40byed196

par nyin re bsam par rab byas te①/ /bsam gtan skyo na sdes bon mnyam ① skyes bsdus la sngags 'di yi ④ni bzlas pa rab tu bya/ /do shal g.yo zhing gsal ba'i rim pas 'byung bas yid bzhin du ni sngags kyi bzlas pa bya/ /oṃ pi tsu pi tsu pradzñā wasnya ni dz+wa la dz+wa ⑤la me dhā bsnya ④ni/ dhi ri dhi ri/ burnyi war dha ⑦ni swā hā/ thun mtshams thams cad du ni lha mo'i gzugs la yid kyis rtag par shin tu rab dga' bas/ /yang dag gsungs pa'i cho gas sems can don gyi rgyur ni sngags 'di yongs su bzlas pa bya/ /bsod nams bsngo bya dgos pas byed na bsam gtan rtse gcig nges par gnas pas bskyang skebya ste/ /ji srid 'bum phrag yongs su ma rdzogs pa ni rdzogs 'gyur nas ni las kyi rim bzhin bya/ /rnam pa thams cad du ni mi mthun ⑨phyogs su nye bar song yang de nyid bsam gtan byed/ /dkar po'i tshes ⑩gcig nyid nas shin tu mdzes pa'i yid kyis ji srid zla ba gnas pa'i bar/ /de snyed sbyar ba'i skad cig nub re bzhin du ji snyed zla ba nya ba'i bar du bya/ /de nyid kyi ni nub mo thub par dka' ba'i tshigs bcad mkhan gyi ⑪dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /gang zhig dpal ldan nag po'i rgyal pos ⑫dpal ldan gshin rje gshed kyi rgyud du gnas byas pa/ /dpal dang ldan pa'i rdo rje dbyangs can bcom ldan 'das ma de ni yang dag mnyes pa'i thabs/ /sems can rnams la phan pa'i don du bdag gis byas pa'i bsod nams yang dag gyur pa des/ /des ni 'gro kun nag po lta bur thub par dka' ba'i tshigs bcad mkhan ni grub par shog /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor dpal 'dzin kyis/ /dpal ldan rdo rje dbyangs can gyi/ /'joms byed mthar ni byed pa yi/ /sgrub pa'i thabs ni 'di byas so/ /rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i sgrub 40—196

pa'i thabs/ slob dpon dpal 'dzin ①gyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang / khams pa lo tsā ba dge slong ba ris bsgyur cing zhus pa'o②// //bsdur mchan/194 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉ga /'phags ma rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// ②〈〈pe 〉྾po ra 〉〉ba ra sā te/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ /da/0〈snar 〉ṅkani/195 ①〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉skorabyung bar doḥ/ ②〈〈snar 〉〉3sa/ ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉pas/ ④〈'dir 〉〉pa/ ④〈〈pe〉〉〈'dir 〉〉wan/ du〈〈pe〉྾'dir 〉〉wa3/ ⑦〈〈pe〉snga〈snar 〉〉〉pa/ ⑧〈〈pe〉〉〈snar 〉mi 'gro ba/ 'a 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tu snyoms/196 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉gra ste/ ②〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉stanas/ ③〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉snomam/ (ge〈〈pe〉dze〈snar 〉〉wa'adi yi/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉po〈snar 〉7 ra dha ni dz+wa la dz+wa/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉〉pa ra dhā/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉pradzñā brda/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉gsud/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉 pa'i/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉9po tshe tuskre〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7)sa/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pos rgyal po/197 ①〈〈pe 〉dzepo ra 〉〉wa'adzin/ ②〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉stab/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1986)40wa 197

༄ga /bgegs bskrad pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs/①༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ bispyon+ta ka ④sā dha rna/ bod skad du/bgegs bskrad pa'i sgrub pa'i ④thabs/ bcom ldan 'das bgegs mthar byed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang po ④re zhig sgrub pa po bde ba'i ⑤gdan la 'dug ste/rang gi dze+esnying gar e dmar po las skyes pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bsgoms la/de'i steng du hūṃ sngon po rnam par bsams nas/ hūṃ gi 'od las skyes pa'i bgegs mthar byed dang / bla ma dang / sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' dmigs la/ me tog la sogs pas yang dag par mchod de/ phyag 'tshal ba dang gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba la sogs pa byas nas stong pa nyid bsgom par bya'o—/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa ā kolha⑦haṃ/ de nas saṃ dmar po las skyes pa'i nyi ma'i ④dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ ngo / /de yongs su gyur pa las—/ rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa bsgom par bya'o/ /hūṃ gi ⑨'od kyis bskul 40—198

ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bzhugs pa'i ①sngon du 'gro bas de thams cad yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid bgegs dgra bsgom par bya ste/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yon pa ⑦brkyang ba'i zhabs kyis gnas pa/ mdog sngo ba phyag g.yon na sdigs mdzub dang zhags pa/ g.yas pa na rdo rje 'phyar ①zhing 'jigs par byed pa/ skra kham pa gyen du bsgreng ba'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kar hūṃ yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa'o/ /de lta bur gyur pa'i bgegs dgra spro ba dang bsdu ba'i gzugs sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng du nyi ma la gnas pa bsgom par bya'o/ /dam tshig la sogs pa'i cho ga sngon du 'gro bas 'di ltar thun mtshadas gnyis dang gsum dang bzhi la sogs par bsgom par bya'o / /oṃ āXbispyon+ta kṛta hūṃ phaṭarjo/ bgegs dgra'i sgrub pa'i thabs rdzogs so—/ / //paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang / khams pa lo tsā ⑤ba dge slong ba ris bsgyur cing zhus so// //40—199

༄ga /ral gcig ma'i sgrub pa'i thabs/①༄ga /rgya gar skad du/ e ka dzā ṭī sā dha dz+wa/ bod skad du/ ral gcig ma'i sgrub pa'i thabs/ 'phags ma ral gcig ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngon du bstan pa'i cho gas stong pa nyid bsgoms pa'i rjes su sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng du ṭ+wāṃ yongs su gyur pa las/ thod pa'i dbus su hūṃ sngon po spro ba dang bsdu ba sngon du 'gro bas/ de yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das ma ral gcig ma yan lag thams cad gnag ②pa/ phyag bzhi ma/ zhal gcig makye/spyan dkar zhing dmar ba'o/ /spyan gsum pa stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/thod pa'i phreng bas dbu brgyan ④pa'o/ /skra kham pa gyen du bgreng ⑤ba/ mche ba gcigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ gsus pa 'phyang ba/ sngon po'i sbrul gyis sna tshogs brgyan pa'o/ /brgyad gnyis lon pa/ 'o ma 'dzin pa'i nu ma rgyas shing mtho rjobar langs pa/ do shal dang dbu rgyan dang / g.yer kha dang / me 40—201

tog gi phreng bas ma lus pa'i yan lag la tshom bu ①byas pa'o/ /g.yas pa'i phyag gnyis na ral gri dang gri gug bsnams pa/ g.yon pa'i phyag gnyis na ut+pa la dang thod pa bsnams pa'i bdag nyid du skad cig gis bskyed la sngags ②bzlas par bya'o/ /oṃ hrīḥdzā hūṃ phaṭa zhes bya'o/ /ral gcig ma'i sgrub thabs cardogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang / khams pa lo tsā ③ba dge slong ba ris bsgyur cing zhus pa'odu// //bsdur mchan/2༷1 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉gag /ral gcig ma'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// ②〈〈pe 〉lo'ar 〉rag ③〈〈pe 〉lo'ar 〉mi/ rjo〈po ra 〉mun+t+ran/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thagreng / ⑥〈〈pe 〉lo'ar 〉thabor/202 ①〈〈pe 〉losnar 〉khu6da du/ ②〈〈pe 〉lo'ar 〉thasngags/ ③〈〈pe 〉lo'ar 〉〉tsa/ 0〈〈snar 〉gtsu/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyad/ (1988)40wa 202

༄ga /'phags ma dug sel ba'i sgrub thabs/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya dzāṅga ④lī sā dha dz+wa/ bod skad du/'phags ma dug sel ba'i ①sgrub thabs/ 'phags ma dug sel ma la phyag 'tshal lo—/ /sngon du bstan pa'i cho ga nyid/ /rang snying dmar po dkyil 'khor la/ /dzā gi ye shes las rdzogs pa'i/ /dug sel zhes pa'i rig ma dhini/ /ser po'i gdengs ka bdun gdengs shing / /'bar zhing g.yo ba'i nor bus brgyan/ /zhal gsum dang ni spyan ⑤gsum ste/ /gzhon nu ma yi phyag gsum 'bar/ /khros pa dang bcas dgod pa nyid/ /sbrul gyi rgyan gyis ske rjorags byas/ /phyag drug rol pas gnon pa ste/ /mi bskyod dbu la nye bar bzhugs/ /g.yas kyi phyag na rdo rje ste/ /gnyis pa dag ni ral gri 'phyar/ /gsum pa gar tshul mda' bsnams pa/ /g.yon na sdigs mdzub zhags pa ste/ /gnyis pa dag ni ⑦me tog go/ /gsum pa'i phyag na gzhu bsnams so/ /me tog gis 40—203

brgyan ska rags te/ /pad+ma'i gdan gnas gser gyi mdog /'od ni dmar po'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /dbang po'i gzhu ni 'phro zhing sbrul/ /'bar bas yongs bskor gos kyis g.yogs/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni 'phro ba ste/ /zla bum rang gi phyag na'o/ /dug gis brgyal ba dbang bskur zhing / /rdzu gis kha ni brgyan par bsgoms①/ /dug ni med na sku gsum gyis②/ /dug sel rtag tu bsgom par bya/ /de ltar 'di yis bsgoms bzhin pa/ /ring po ④mi thogs byang chub 'thob/ /lag pa gnyis kyis sbrul gyi gdengs ka'i rnam pa yis spyi bor gdengs ka gdugs lta bur byas pa ni dug sel ma'i phyag rgya ste/ rjobazlas pa bya'o—/ /oṃ na maḥsha gyeb ra ku mā rī ye tsur tsa tsā la ya tsur tsā bul ya/ saṃ gha ṭa ni mat+ta ma tai gi a hang bidhe ⑦a he/ saṃ dzaḥswā hā/ 'phags pa dug sel ma'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //40—204

2༷ ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉mdzang gu/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉staba'i/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bya'i rim pa/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉phyag ⑥〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉gag/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈'ar 〉ra/2 4 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa bsgom/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉sta)/ ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stapor/ du〈〈pe 〉dze'adir 〉ri sngags/⑤〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉〉ra/ 0〈〈pe〉྾'dir 〉〉spyortsa/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉sko'adir 〉7) ha rtse/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1989)40wa 205

༄ga /'phags ma dug sel ma'i gzungs/①༄4/ /i li mid te ti li mid te i ti li mid te/ dum be dum bā li me—/ dusme dusma le ye/ tar ke tar ka ra rte/ mar me mar mar be+e/ kasme re ka sgru ra mu ga te/ ā ghi a gha ne+e/ ā gha ④na gha ne+e/ i li i li e mi lnga ces ཿ/ li/ ཿ/ mi mi lnga ④ces/ yi/ga kha yis ces/ yi/ byā yis ces/ swe te shwe tat+ta r+ṇa rjoḍi/ a na nu rag te swā hā/ dge slong bdag gi rig pa 'di thams cad du dkar ba sbyin par 'os pa rig pa 'di lan cig mnyan pas lo bdun du sbrul gyis 'dzin par mi 'gyur ro/ / de'i lus la yang dug gis 'go bar mi 'gyur ro/ /⑤gang zhig rig pa 'di dge slong dag gis du'adzin par gyur na/ ji srid 'tsho'i ⑦bar du sbrul gyis 'dzin par mi 'gyur ro/ /su la yang 'dir dug gis 'chi bar mi 'gyur ro/ /gal te yang sbrul gyis bzung ⑧na de rnam pa bdun du mgo 'gas 0par 'gyur te⑩/ ardza ka'i dog pa bzhin no/ /40—206

'phags ma dug sel ma'i gzungs rdzogs so // //paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang / khams pa lo tsā ①ba dge slong ba ris bsgyur ②ba'o// //bsdur mchan/2 6 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i rdzogs byang las blangs te bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉snam gha/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈po ra 〉〉gli 0〈〈pe 〉po'ar 〉〉ṇa/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉bode'ilusalayang — 'gyur ro// du〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉—dag gis/ ⑦〈'dir 〉stapo'i/ ni〈〈snar 〉stanazung / ⑨〈〈snar 〉stanags/ ⑩〈〈snar 〉stab//2༷7 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉g.yots+tsha/ ②〈po ra 〉〉ri sgyur/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyu/da/ (199༷)40—207

༄ga /lha mo rigs byed ma'i sgrub pa'i thabs/①༄ga /rgya gar skad du/ ku ru kukhre sā dha rna/ bod skad du/ lha mo rigs byed ma'i sgrub pa'i ④thabs/ lha mo rigs ④byed ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang por bde ba'i gdan la 'dug ste/ rigs rjobyed ma'i gzugs su ⑤byas nas sems can ma lus pa dbang du bya ba brtsam rjopar bya'o/ /rang gi snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /de'i steng du t+t+waṃ dmar po'o/ /de nas 'od zer rnam pa lnga byung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams yang dag par mchod la/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas sdig pa bshags pa la ⑦sogs pa byas la/ stong pa nyid kyi sgernam pa bsgoms la/ phyis ni ut+pa la dmar po/ de'i steng du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de'i steng du saṃ dmar po/'di thams cad yongs su gyur pa las rigs ⑨byed ma rje btsun mdog dkar zhing dmar ba phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas pa'i phyag na mda' dang mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i 40—208

phyag go/ /g.yon pa na gzhu dang ut+pal bsnams pa'o/ /rdo rje skyil mo krung gis gnas shing sha 'gag dmar po dang / stod g.yogs dmar po can gyi rnam par bsgom ①par bya'o/ /'og tu 'dod pa'i lha chung ma dang bcas pa bsams te / phyi ②nas bsgom pa dang ldan pas sngags kyi bzlas pa bya'o/ /oṃ ku ru kul+le swā hā/ rigs ③byed ma'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang / khams pa lo tsā ④ba dge slong ba ris bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/2 8 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈snar 〉bopa'i/ zhu)0〈〈snar 〉〉rig ⑤〈po ra 〉〉wasu/ 0〈'dir 〉〉brtsams/ ⑦〈〈snar 〉〉wasogs pas rig pa bshags pa la/ ⑧〈〈snar 〉〉kyis/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉stanag2༷9 ①〈0rdor 〉ste)sa rnam/ ②〈'dir 〉〉phyin/ ①〈〈pe 〉stanag ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉stayots+tsha/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1991)40wa 209

— zhe —byad ma' sgrub pa' thabs ①༄ ga /rgya gar skad du/ kal pok+ta ma ku ru kul+la ⑧sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/ rtog ①pa las gsungs pa'i lha mo rigs byed ma'i rjosgrub pa'i thabs/'phags ma rigs ⑤byed ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig dran pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha dang lha min mir bcas pa/ /nges par ci bgyi dhibyed pa yi/ /sgol ma de la phyag 'tshal nas/ /dang po ⑦re zhig sngags pas yid dang rjes su mthun tshu pa'i gnas su/ bud med kyi skye bo dang tshogs pa la sogs pas dben par nang par stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ rang gi snying gar dbyangs yig dang po yongs su gyur pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du 'od zer dang bcas pa'i yi ge tweḥs bon las byung ba'i 'od zer dmar po'i tshogs kyis 'gro ba gsal bar byas pa'i sngon ⑨du 'gro ba'i rigs ⑩byed ma'i ri la ⑪gnas pa'i rigs ⑫byed ma/ bcom ldan 'das ma bskul nas spyan drangs nas mdun gyi nam mkha' la yang dag par 40—210

bltas te/ snying ga'i sa bon ①las sprul pa'i me tog dang spos la sogs pa'i mchod pa sna tshogs kyis mchod par bya'o/ /de'i rjes la phyag btsal ②ba dang /sdig pa bshags pa dang / bsod nams la rjes su yi rang ba dang / bsngo ba dang / gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang / byang chub tu sems bskyed pa sngon du 'gro bas/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor ④bshags/ /'gro ba'i bsod nams rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung / /zhes dulan gsum gyi ⑤bar du brjod do/ /de nas tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom pa sngon du 'gro bas chos thams cad stong pa nyid rjornam par bsgom ⑦par bya'o/ /de nas byen gyis mebarlab pa'i sngags brjod par bya'o/ /oṃ shu rgya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa ā kolhahaṃ ⑨zhes so/ /de nas 'go ba sdug bsngal mtha' dag ⑩snying rje bsgoms la/ rang gi sems sa bon gyi ⑪gzugs su bltas te/ de yongs su gyur pa las ut+pa la dmar po'i steng du dbyangs yig dang po ⑫yongs su gyur pa'i zla ba la gnas pa'i sa bon gyi ⑫'od zer rnams kyis sngon bzhin du 'gro ba snang bar bya ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa bye ba dpag tu med pa rnams bskul te/ spyan drangs la ④bstem par bya ste/ de la ut+pal ⑫la sogs pa yongs su gyur pa las sku mdog dmar po pad+ma dmar po dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs ⑩pa/ na bza' dmar pos stod g.yogs byas pa/ 'od zer dmar po dang ldan pa/ rin po che'i rna rgyan ⑩dang ldan pa/ dbu rgyan ⑫dang ldan pa/ phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas pas mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa/ gnyis pa ⑩mda' 'gengs pa/ g.yon pas rin po che'i gzhu 'dzin pa—/ gnyis pas ut+pal ⑩dmar po 'dzin pa/ 'od dpag ⑥med pa'i dbu 40—211

rgyan can/ rigs ①byed ma'i ri phug na gnas pa'i sgra gcan gyi mgo bo ②la gnas pa'i chung ma dang bcas pa'i 'dod pa'i lha'i steng na gnas pa/ sgeg pa la sogs pa'i nyams 'phel ba'i dbang ①dang ldan pa/ dang po'i lang tsho dang ldan pa'i rigs byed mar bsgom par bya'o/ /de ltar dam tshig rjosems dpa' bskyed nas slar yang skad cig tsam gyis ⑤ye shes sems dpa' mdun du bkug la yang dag par ( stemachod de/ dam tshig gi ⑦phyag rgyas zhal nas gzhug ⑧par bya'o—/ /de la dam tshig gi phyag rgya ni 'di yin te/ thal mo sbyar la gung mo gnyis rtse mor byas la srin lag gnyis nang du gzhug /mdzub ⑨mo gnyis gung mo'i rgyab tu sbyar la/ mtheb chen gnyis spyo'og tu byas pa ⑪de lta bu'i rnam pa'i ut+pa ཿla'i phyag rgya'o/ /de'i rjes su/ byang chub rdo rjes ⑫sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar cher byin pa/ /bdag la bsrung ④ba'i don gyi phyir/ /nam mkha' rdo rje bdag la byed⑩/ /zhes gsol ba btab la/ dbang bskur ⑩rdo rje chen po ni/ /khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas kun kyi ⑩ gsang gsum kyispyo/ /gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya/ /'di ltar brjod pa rnams kyis sangs rgyas kyi bkas sbyan ma la sogs pas dbang bskur bas/ dbu rgyan du snang ba mtha' yas bsam ⑩par bya'o/ /de ltar bsgoms la bzlas pa byas te/ don par ma yin/ bul bar ma yin/ mi gsal bar ma yin/phyi mo dman par ma yin/ yang dag pa ma yin pa'i rtog pa spangs te/ oṃ ku ru kul+le s+thāḥhūṃ swā hā/ de ltar thun mabyedas gsum gyi rim ⑦pas/ khur ba dang /sha ka ra la sogs pa'i gtor ma sbyin pa sngon du 'gro bas/ gus pas yun ring por bsam pa ⑪brtan pos zla ba drug tu bsgom ⑫par byas na ⑫grub pa'i mtshan ma 40—212

'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas zla ba dang po la nad la sogs pa'i gnod pa brgya nye bar 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa la ston mo yid du 'ong ba ma bslangs par rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa la gos sna tshogs rnyed pa dang /bzhi pa la sna tshogs kyi so rtsi rgyun mi 'chad par rnyed par 'gyur ba dang / lnga pa la rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i gzugs la sogs pa'i yon tan gyis brgyan pa'i bud med kyi tshogs dang phrad pa rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /①drug pa la lha dang 1klu dang dri za la sogs pa ⑦bud med mdzes ma dang phrad par 'gyur ro/ /phal cher bcom ldan 'das ma bsgoms rjon bud med rnams kyis 'tsho ⑤bar byed do/ /de la bdud kyi las 'di rnams spangs te/ bcom ldan 'das ma sgom ⑦par byed pa la dngos su'am/ rmi lam du ston par 'gyur te/ ral gri dang /mig ⑦sman dang / rkang pa byug pa dang / mi snang ba dang / ril bu dang /dngul chu dang / bcud kyis len pa ⑧dang / mkha' spyod dang / sa 'og la sogs pa'i dngos grub la sogs pa ⑨'dod pa rnams grub par byed do/ /gal te bstan par ma gyur na sngar brjod pa'i phyag rgya bcing ste⑩/ mchod pa dang /gtor ma sngon du 'gro bas/ zla ba drug gi ⑪bar du nya'i nub mo thog thag tu bzlas pa bya'o/ /de nas phyag rgya 'bar te ⑫'grub par 'gyur ro/ /phyag rgya des tshangs pa dang / dbang po dang / nye ba'i dbang po dang / drag po dang /sred med kyi bu la sogs pa bkug nas 'ongs te/ pho nyar gyur nas sgrub ⑫pa po'i 'dod pa rdzogs par byed do/ /de nas bzung ste skye ba dang / rgas pa dang / na ba dang /④ 'chi ba dang bral te 'jig rten rmi ⑫khams gzhan du song ⑩nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams mthong ste/ sa dang gzungs ⑩la sogs 40—213
⑫〈'dir 〉stanazugs/214 ①〈〈pe 〉〉spya'i sgrub/ 〈〈snar 〉〉ku grub/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉tha tsa/〈〈snar 〉skospots+tsha/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1992)40—215

༄ga /lha mo rigs byed ma'i sgrub pa'i thabs/①༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ ku ru kul+le sā dha ②rna/ bod skad du/ lha mo rigs ①byed ma'i sgrub pa'i thabs/ 'phags ma rigs ④byed ma la phyag 'tshal lo—/ /rang gi snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la byā⑤ཿyig las skyes pa'i ut+pa rjol dmar po'i spyodabus su tweḥs mtshan par ④bsams la/ de yongs su gyur pa las 'phags ma rigs ⑨byed ma mdog ⑩dmar po ⑪zla ba'i gdan la ⑩'od kyi dkyil 'khor dmar po'o⑫/ /sna tshogs ④dmar po'i na bza'i stod g.yogs can ma/ 'od dpag med pas dbu brgyan cing / phyag bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis na ut+pa la dmar po'i mde'us ⑫rnam par mdzes pa dang ldan pa'i mda' rna ba'i bar du bkang ba'i me tog gi gzhu bsnams pa'o/ /g.yon pa na ⑫sdong bu dang bcas shing kha bye ba'i ut+pa ⑩la dmar po bsnams shing g.yas pa na mchog sbyin pa'o/ /sgeg pa'i ro chen po dang ldan par bltas skel ye shes sems dpa' 40byed216

dang gcig tu byas la/ rang gi lus kyi 'od dmar po'i lcags kyus bkug pa'i lha dang lha ma yin dang / bya khyung dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'bye chen po dang / gnod sbyin dang / skyes pa dang / bud med brgya stong la sogs pa'i tshogs shin tu gus pas lus btud cing mchog tu dbang du 'gyur bar phyogs bcur yang dag par blta bar bya'o/ /oṃ ku ru kul+le tweḥ①swā hā/zhes bya ba'i sngags kyi bzlas pa 'bum phrag gcig ④nas brtsams te/ ji srid bcom ldan 'das ma mngon ④du gyur gyi ④bar du bya'o/ /gzhan yang kha cig tu dbang du byed par 'dod na ji skad gsungs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi rjocho gas 'bum phrag gcig dubyas la gus shing btud pa'i lha dang / lha ma yin la sogs pa'i dbus su gnas pa'i rang gi ⑦lus kyi 'od zer lcags kyus bsgrub zu bya bkug la mdun du yang dag par bzhag pa ⑨la rang gi snying gar ut+pa ⑫la dmar po 'dab ma bcu drug pa/ de'i snying gar rnam par bsams la/ 'phags pa yan lag med pa'i rdo rjes gsungs pa'i rim ⑪pas bung ba lcags kyu lta bur bsgoms la/de'i ming gi yi ge rang gi snying ga'i sngags kyis dang por mnan ⑫nas de bzhin du mda' nyid kyis ⑫snying ga phug pas 'dod chags chen pos brgyal zhing yang sdong bus rkang pa gnyis bcings/ ut+pa la'i zhags pas thukyang ske 8nas bcings te—/ yang dag par bkug ⑩la rang gi rkang pa gnyis su lhung ba'o/ /gal te skyes pa ⑩yin na lcags kyus snying ga 'bugs 6pa'o/ /bud med yin na 7chos 'byung nas ⑩so/ /oṃ ku ru kur+pā che ge mo'am/ che ge mo ā ⑫kar+ṣa ya byāḥ 3swā hā zhes bya ba'i sngags bzlas pa bya'o/ / bsgrub bya khugs 5nas sngags de nyid gtan ⑪du gnas pa'i ched du'o/ /ba sha ma na ya zhes bya ba dang / spel zhing 40—217

bzlas pa bya'o/ /brgya bzlas pas thun mong gi ①skyes pa dang bud med kyi tshogs dang / rgyal po dang / blon po dbang du 'gyur ro/ /khri bzlas na 'jig rten tha mal pa rnams so/ /'bum phrag gis ④rgyal po'o/ /'bum phrag bdun gyis lha dang lha ma yin gyi bu mo'o①/ /bye bas ni bya khyung dang glang po che la sogs pa'i bzang po'i 0phyugs dang thun mong gi ⑤phyugs rnams kyang ngo / /gus pas rgyun ma chad par dus ring por 0dpag tu med pa bzlas na sa gsum po ⑦dbang du byed do/ /lha mo rigs byed ma'i sgrub pa'i ④thabs rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang / khams pa lo tsā ⑨ba dge slong ba ris bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/216 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉sngag /lha mo rigs byed ma'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// ②〈〈snar 〉d+ku/ ①④〈〈snar 〉'ag du〈'ar 〉〉dze+e bu〈shar 〉〉ud pa/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉la/ ④〈〈pe 〉shāḥs bon/ 〈'ar 〉〉tri:sa bon/ ⑨〈'ar 〉'ag ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7dmar ba pad+ma/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉7dang / ⑫〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉rang / ⑫〈'ar 〉mi'o/8〈〈pe〉7saṃ/ spyo〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉zode'u yis/ ⑩〈〈snar 〉7na/ ⑩〈'ar 〉rasad pa/ ⑫〈〈pe〉7 bltas na/ 〈〈snar 〉rab/ bltas pa/217 ①〈〈snar 〉〉—:/ ④〈shar 〉theg ④〈〈pe 〉mas/ ④⑤〈sar 〉7)sa/ ⑦〈sar 〉theg ⑦〈〈pe 〉skotsār 〉〉—gi/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉sgrub/ ⑨2〈snar 〉ra ga ⑩〈'ar 〉rasad pa/ ⑪〈'ar 〉'am/ ⑫rteshar 〉7 dmar por gnan/ ⑫〈〈snar 〉tha/ ④〈〈pe 〉7༅ la'i zhabs/ 〈'ar 〉76da pa la'i zhabs pas/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈'ar 〉7pa/ ⑫〈'ar 〉7pa/ bya〈rtepe 〉snga'ar 〉༄/ ⑫〈'ar 〉rabugs/ ⑪〈dz+wape 〉sko'ar 〉7ni/du〈shar 〉gnas/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉rag ⑫〈shar 〉༅ཿ/ du〈'ar 〉〉sgrub bya khug bla〈〈pe 〉〉〈'ar 〉thastan/218 ①〈〈snar 〉yogs/ ④〈〈pe 〉8/ ⑧rjocha 〉sko' ra 〉stab/ ④〈dz+wape 〉sko' ra 〉ya'o// ⑤〈'a ra 〉8sa/40—218

— —ma' sgrub pa' thabs ①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ o ⑤ḍi yā na bi ni ra ga ta ku ru kul+le sā dha rgo/bod skad du/ o ḍi yā na ①nas byung ba'i rigs rjobyed ma'i sgrub pa'i ⑤thabs/'phags ma rigs byed ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang por re zhig bsgom pa'i dang por tso dri zhim po rnam pa lngas sa'i phyogs cig ④byugs la/ brtul ⑫zhugs dang ldan pas dga' ba'i sems kyis mnyam par bzhag pas 'jam pa'i gdan la nye bar gnas la/ de nas phyis ni rang gi snying gar ram̐ yongs su gyur pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od 'bar ba'i phreng ba'i rnam pa 'khrugs ⑩pa'o/ /de'i lte bar spyoḥ⑪dmar po rnam par bsam mo/ /de nas byāḥ⑫las nges par 'byung ba'i 'od zer kyi dra bas phyogs bcu na nye bar gnas pa'i sems can gyi ⑫khams gsal bar bya ste④/ dpal rigs ⑫byed ma'i gzugs su nye bar gnas par byas la/ yang 'od zer de nyid phyir 'ongs te/ de nyid la zhugs pas 40—220

'od zer gyi dra ba rnam par bsgom ①par bya'o/ /de nas phyis ni mdun gyi nam mkha' la brgyad gnyis lon pa'i rnam ②pa mgo skyes kham snepa gyen du 'greng ④ba/thod pa rnam pa lnga dbu la 'chang ba/ ro la zhon pa mgo'i phreng bas do shal byas shing skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis gnas pa cung zhig rjomache ba gdags pa'i zhal—/ ljags rjo'adril ba/ 'khor lo dang / rna cha dang / mgul rgyan ⑦dang / dpung rgyan ④dang / ska rags dang / rkang rgyan ⑨gyis brgyan ⑩pa/stag gi pags ⑪pa'i sham thabs can/ g.yon du byas pa'i spyan gsum ⑫ni rlum zhing dmar la g.yo ba'o⑫/ /'od dpag med pa'i dbu rgyan ④can/ phyag bzhi pa/ rna ba'i bar du bkang ba/ byed la dmar po⑫/ mde'u can gyi mda' dang ⑩/ me tog dmar po'i gzhu bkang zhing bsnams pa'o/ /phyag lhag ma gnyis na me tog dmar po las byas pa'i lcags kyu dang / ut+pal dmar po bsnams pa'i rnam pa bsam ⑩par bya'o/ /'di nyid mchod pa'i don ⑫du rang gi snying ga'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa s+thā⑪ཿlas byung ba'i mchod pa rnam pa lnga—/ me tog dang / bdug pa dang / mar me dang / dri dang / lha bshos la sogs pa rnams kyis mchod par bya'o/ /mchod nas mchog gi snying rje chen po'i rnal 'byor pas gus pas btud cing lus la sogs pas ⑫phyag bya'o/ /de nas gang zhig sdog pa ⑥byed du bcug pa dang / bdag gis bgyis pa dang /rjes su yi rang ba ⑫'di dag bcom ldan 'das ma la ⑫mngon sum du bshags par chabya'o/ /de'i rjes su 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor lhung ba'i sems can gyi khams bsgral ⑪ba'i ngo bo nyid⑩/ byang chub kyi sems rnam par gzung ⑦ngo / /de nas tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom par bya'o/ /de'i rjes su ⑥stong pa nyid 40—221

bsgoms te/ sngags 'dis sems tsam ①du lhag par gnas par ②bya'o/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā ④tshwa na badz+ra swa bhā wa da kolhahaṃrjo/ zhes bya bas sems byin kyis brlabs la| de'i rjes su nam mkha'i phyogs su re yongs su gyur pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'bar ba brtan ⑤pa'i rnam par bsgom bupar bya'o/ /de'i steng du hūṃ nag po yongs su gyur pa las sna tshogs ⑦rdo rje'o/ /ra ba dang / gur bcing ba ⑧dang / rdo rje'i sa gzhi bsgom ⑨par bya'o zhes pa ni srung ⑩ba'i 'khor lo'o/ /de nas dbus su e'i rnam par byed pa'i lha rdzas kyi ⑪chos 'byung gi ye shes mdog dkar ba'i ⑫rnam par bsgom par bya'o/ /de'i dbus su byāḥ⑫dmar po las byung ba'i pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'o/ /de'i steng gi ze'u ④'bru la ram̐ yongs su gyur pa las nyi ma'o/ /de'i steng du ro'o⑫/ /yang de'i steng du a ⑩ yongs su rdzogs pa'i zla ba dkar po/ mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi bdag nyid do//de'i steng du yang ⑩nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i spyongo bo nyid kha dog dmar po'o/ /de nyid kyi ⑪dbus su s+thā⑩ཿdmar po ⑪yongs su gyur pa las ut+pa la dmar po'i mde'u can gyi mda' ⑫la rang sems zhugs ⑫par rnam par bsgom ④par bya'o/ /phyis ni zla ba dang nyi ma dang / mda' gcig tu gyur pa las de nyid du ⑫sngon bzhin gyi ⑪bdag nyid rigs ⑩byed ma'i gzugs su rnam par bsgom snyepar bya'o/ /rnam par bsgoms nas rang gi snying gar ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i lte ba la yang byāḥyig bsgom ⑥par bya'o/ /de las byung ba'i 'od zer gyis mgon po 'od dpag med pa bkug cing spyan drangs ⑥la/gsang ba dang cig shos kyi mchod pas yang dag ⑥par mchod la/ dbang bskur bar gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /de la 'di ni gsol ba ste/ mgon po 'od 40—222

dpag med pa khyed kyis ①bdag la dbang bskur du gsol zhes pa'o/ /de nas mgon po 'od dpag med pa des ②rang gi snying ga las bdud rtsi rnam pa lngas gang ba'i bum pa lnga spros pa'i rnam par bsgom ①par bya'o/ /de nas bdud rtsi rnam pa lngas dugang ba'i bum pa des mngon par khyakhrus bya'o/ /khrus byas nas rang gi snying gar bum pa gzhug go/ /de la zhugs rjonas rnal 'byor pa'i mgo la ⑦mgon po 'od dpag med pa bsgom par bya'o/ /thun mtshalas ⑧gsum du bsgom zhing bzlas pa bya'o/ /de nas ⑨sngags ni oṃ ku ru kul+le dī⑩ཿswā hā tsan+dan dmar po'i ched ⑪du bzlas par ⑫bya'o/ /oṃ byedahūṃ ⑫zhes bya bas kha byin kyis brlab pa ni dgos pa'o/ /gzhan yang sngags pas skyes pa'am bud med dbang du bya bar 'dod pas/ dkar po'i phyogs kyi ④tshes gcig nas brtsams te/ thun mtshams ⑫gsum du khri tsho gcig nyi ma re re zhing bcom ldan 'das ma'i gzugs dmigs la gos dmar pos ro smad dang / lus la dkris la de'i rjes su rang gi snying gar nyi ma la gnas pa'i tweḥ⑩dmar po yongs su gyur pa ⑫las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa/ skye spyoganas kyi bar du son pa'i sdong bu'i rnam pa shwe/ bsgom par bya'o/ /de'i 'dab ma rnams su bung ba brgyad brgyad pa'i mtha'i mtha' dbyangs yig de yongs su gyur pa las bung ba brgyad do/ /shin tu dga' ba dang rgyas pa dang / khros shing chags pa ni go rims bzhin du yongs su brjod do/ /rang gi sna'i rlung gis bskul te/ 'phur nas g.yas pa las gzhan cig shos kyi sna'i khung bu nas byung ste/ bsgrub ༄7bya'i g.yas pa'i sna bug nas zhugs nas/ dga' bas dum bur gtub ⑪cing nyams par byas dbyangs yig dang po la sogs pa brgyad cung zhig dmar ba dang ldan pa'i 'dab 40—223

ma bzhi ①par bya'o/ /'di ltar lta bar byed pa ni ④rnal 'byor pas/ phyi nas ④rna ba'i bar du bkang ba'i ut+pa ⑦la'i mde'u dang ldan pa'i mda' 'chang ba la lta ba dang ldan pa'i sngags pas/ ze'u 'bru ⑤so sor rtog par bya'o/ /de nas bung ba de dbugs kyis bskul te/ g.yon pa'i sna'i bu 0ga nas byung nas dbyangs yig ⑦re blangs shing khyer nas/ rnal 'byor pa'i sna ④bug g.yas pa nas zhugs te/ rang gi snying gar rang dang gzhan gyi ye shes gcig pa'i ngo bo nyid du bya'o/ /de nas ut+pa las ⑨ske ba nas bcings te/ ske nas lcags kyus phug ⑩cing mda'i dra ba'i rnam par bsams na ⑪dbang du 'gyur ro / /mgal me'i 'khor lo la ⑫gnas pa'i bsgrub bya bsam ⑫par bya'o/ /sgrub pa po ni sngags gzugs kyis/ /gdams ⑫ngag dag ni nges byas la/ /rtag tu dga' bas sngags bzlas bya/ /oṃ ku ru kul+le tweḥ.a mu spyok+ṣiṃ me ba sha ma nā ya tshuswā hā/ ma lus par 'di yang nyin dang mtshan du bya'o/ /de nas stsos par —gyur nas 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /sngags kyis bskul spyonas skra grol ba gos spyomed pa 'dod pa spyod 'dod byepas non pa/ de thob nas rang gi lhag pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor kyis dkyil 'khor mchod par bya'o/ /dngos grub rgya chen po gang gis gzhom par mi nus pa'i o ḍi yā na nas byung gyeba'i lha mo rigs byed ma'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang / khams pa lo tsā ⑫ba dge slong ba ris bsgyur ba'o/// 3 //40—224

༄ga /khams gsum dbang du byed pa'i spran ras gzigs dbang phyug gi sgrub pa'i thabs/①༄pha /rgya gar skad du/ tre+e lokya ba shaṃ ka ra lo ke 1shwa ra sā dha rna/ bod skad du/ khams gsum dbang du byed pa'i spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi thusgrub pa'i thabs/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo//dang po dure zhig yid dang mthun ⑤pa'i gnas su rnal 'byor pas thang sku bkram ste/de'i mdun du dbang chen gyi dkyil 'khor kyi dbus su gur gum gyis du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rlum po sngags ⑦'dis bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra re khe hūṃḥ kyedzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/zhes bya ba'i sngags 'dis phab la dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su khams gsum dbang du byed pa'i rje btsun spyan ras gzigs sngags 'dis mchod par bya'o/ /oṃ tre+e lokya ba ⑨shaṃ ka ra ya badz+ra puṣ+pe hūṃ pra tīts+tsha ⑩swā hā/ oṃ mu ne+e badz+ra muḥ'adi ni bsdu ba'i ⑪sngags so/ /phyis ni rang gi snying gar s+t+waṃ yig bsam par bya ste/rkye de yongs su gyur pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs par bya'o/ /de'i steng du nus ⑫40—227

pa'i sa bon nyi ma shar ba lta bu'i 'od bltas la/ de'i ①'od zer gyis 'od dpag (5/med pa mchod nas/ sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa byas te①/ yang rang gi lus la gzhug go/ /de thams cad yongs su gyur pa las skad cig gis pad+ma'i steng du rdo rje skyil mo krung gis gnas pa phye ba'i spyan gsum pa ral pa'i dbu rgyan 'chang ba/ mdog dmar ba rdo rjes mtshan pa'i zhags pa dang / lcags kyu phyag na'o/ /sa gsum gyi rang bzhin lug gnyis zhags pas bcings pa/ de'i steng du bzhugs ④pa sna tshogs pa'i sprul pa 'chang zhing rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis dbang bskur ba rab tu sbyin pa/ de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' rgyan sna tshogs dang ldan pas mchod par byed pa/ rig pa 'dzin pa dang / khyab 'jug dang / bde byed dang / tshangs pa dang / sna tshogs pa'i rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyis gar dang brdung ④dkrol la sogs pa rjobyed pa sna tshogs kyi ⑦'byung po'i tshogs (sngel sogs pas/ sna tshogs kyi ⑨mi mgo dang keng rus la sogs pas brgyan pa de bzhin du sna tshogs kyi gdugs ⑩dang / rnga yab la sogs pa blta bar bya'o/ /de lta bu'i dus su de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med pa spyi bor blta bar bya ste/ 'di lta bu'i ⑪bdag nyid bsam ⑫par bya'o/ /phyis ni lte ba'i steng du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor kyi 'od kyi ⑫rang bzhin bsams la/de'i steng du g.yon phyogs su nus pa'i sa bon snying gar khro bo'i sa bon dbyangs yig as rkebargyan pa zhes bya ba ni bsgom ⑫pa'i sngags so/ /'di thams cad bsams nas rdo rje'i bdag nyid kyi sngags brjod par byas la/ de'i ⑩bdag nyid du bsam par bya'o/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā ⑫dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa a kophohaṃ⑫/ rdo rje'i bdag nyid kyi sngags so/ /'di la ⑪yang goms pa'i sbyor bas 'dar ba 40—228

dang / g.yo bas dbab par byas la①/ gnyis su med pa'i ye shes skye bar 'gyur ro/ /'di lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa ⑤ni glang po che smyon pa ①ltar myos byed kyi chu yis stsos pa bzhin du rigs lnga la longs spyod ④do/ /gal te rigs lnga la mi spyod pa de'i tshe de'i lus la 'dar ba dang g.yo ba la sogs pa ⑤'bab pa dang /gnyis su med pa'i ye shes mi gnas so/ /de ltar rtogs par ⑦byas nas rigs /lnga la longs spyod ⑨de des ni 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /grub par gyur nas gzhan gye lus la yang g.yo ba dang 'dar bas dbab par ⑫byas la 'dod chags dang /zhe sdang la sogs pa dgag par mi bya'o/ /de ⑪ltar grub pa'i dngul chus phug pa'i zangs ma'i nag po spangs pa ⑫bzhin du lus po nyid gnyis med kyi ro yis 7phug na 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang la sogs pa spong bar thu'agyur ro/ /tweḥ hūṃ aḥbazlas pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ byā⑩ཿaḥha ri ti ya k+ṣe shwa ri ⑫swā hā/ 'phrog ma'i sngags so/ /spyo.oṃ e kre s+thā sa ⑪ka la ga ṇa smi de bī rī shwa ri t+t+waṃ ༄ sna pa ri ka 5 1re a a a ba ta ra a ba ta ra a ba ta ran+tu ⑫da sha dig lo ka pā la du1i rda ba lo kṛṇ+ḍi kṛṇ+ḍi hūṃ phaṭa ④swā hā/ gtor ma'i sngags so/ /khams gsum dbang du byed pa'i spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs slob dpon sa ra has —mdzad pa rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang / khams pa lo tsā ⑩ba dge slong ba ris bsgyur ⑫ba'o// //40—229

brtsar mchan/227 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉sngag /khams gsum dbang du byed pa'i spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub pa'i thabs bzhugs so// ②〈〈pe 〉〉te/ ④〈'ar 〉lkes/④〈snar 〉yar/ ⑤rtesnar 〉thathun/ du〈'ar 〉7/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉d+kugs/ 〈'ar 〉d+kugs te/ ⑧dz+wa'ar 〉〉ke hūṃ/ ⑨〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉tits+tsha/ 〈〈snar 〉〉tits+tsha hūṃ/ ⑪〈〈snar 〉7sdus pa'i/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉masayig bsam par bya ste/ 〈snar 〉the yig bsams par bya'o// ⑫〈〈snar 〉d+kub/22/ ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉rdzas la/ 'di yi/ ④〈〈snar 〉rapag tu/ ①〈'ar 〉7 ste/ ⑦rte'ar 〉ra zhugs/⑤〈〈snar 〉jung / du〈〈snar 〉mis/ ⑦〈〈snar 〉thas/ ④〈〈pe 〉dze'ar 〉7pa/ ⑨〈'ar 〉thas/⑩〈〈snar 〉d+kus gdug ⑪〈'ar 〉tha'i/ ⑫〈po ra 〉thasams/ ⑫〈'ar 〉skord kyis/ ④〈〈pe 〉ma sa/〈snar 〉phro:sa/ spyo〈〈snar 〉thasgoms/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉ra rje'i/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉7 5 ta/ 〈'ar 〉7 rgya sne/⑩〈〈pe 〉rdza ba sa ko haṃ/ 〈〈snar 〉rdza bā ad ma ko haṃ/ ⑪〈'ar 〉7la/229 tu)〈〈snar 〉7la/ ①〈〈snar 〉7pa/ ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7da/ rjo〈〈snar 〉langs spyad/ rjo〈'ar 〉7dang / ⑥〈〈snar 〉7dang / ⑦rte'ar 〉mi/ ④〈'ar 〉ṅkapa/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉skor/ ⑩〈'ar 〉7/⑩〈'ar 〉༅/ ⑫〈'ar 〉7ngas/ ⑫〈snar 〉thas ro ka ⑫〈'ar 〉ltong bar/ ⑫dz+wa'ar 〉〉be+e ⑩〈〈snar 〉〉hri/ ⑩〈〈snar 〉ra re/ ⑫〈'ar 〉7'phrog — ma'i sngags so// ⑩〈〈snar 〉〉hri saṃ/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉zhwa dā bī ri shwa ri shā/ 〈〈snar 〉8 da bī rī shī / ⑫〈〈snar 〉rga/ ⑫rte〈pe 〉tha a ba ta ra skyo/ 〈'ar 〉lkem tu/ ⑫〈〈snar 〉ra / ④〈'a ra 〉tsāsna byu / ⑫〈'a ra 〉thās/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉〉tha tsa/ 〈po ra 〉glots+tsha/ ⑦〈〈snar 〉〉sgyur/40—230
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1995)40wa 231

ra༅/ /dpal gnod gnas kyi sgrub pa'i thabs/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī dze+e ①bha la sā ①dha rna/ bod skad du/dpal gnod gnas kyi dusgrub pa'i thabs/ phun sum tshogs pa ma lus pa ster ba'i dpal gnod gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang por re zhig phyi rol kyi ⑤don thams cad dang rang gi bulus kyang stong pa nyid du rnam par bsams la/ de'i rjes su cung zhig dmar ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor thabs dang shes rab kyi bdag nyid do/ /de nyid ④gnod sbyin gyi sa ka ṭaṃ ⑧pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i rnam pa'o//de'i dbus su baṃ gyis ⑨lha mo nor rgyun ma mdog ser ba/ 'bras kyi snye ma dang /mchog sbyin pa phyag na rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ gnod sbyin mo brgyad kyis bskor ba ni 'di lta ste/ bzang mo dang /⑩ rab tu bzang mo dang /sbas ⑪ma dang / rab tu sbas ma dang / lha mo dang / dbyangs can ma dang /'phags ma dang / zla shel can no/ /'di rnams kyis ⑫yongs su bskor ba'i 40—232

lha mo chen mo de'i bha ga'i dbus su rdza gis ①bdag nyid sangs rgyas rnam pa lnga'i dbu rgyan can g.yas pa'i phyag na sa bon gyis gang ba'i shing thog② /g.yon pa na sre mong bsnams pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa lngas kyang rin po che la sogs pa'i char rab tu 'be+ebs bzhin pa/ zhabs gnyis na dung gi mgo dang / pad+ma'i mgo'i ⑦gter chen po durin po che la sogs pa'i char rab tu 'be+ebs bzhin pa rang gi khyim gyi phyogs gcig tu ⑤rnam par bsam bupar bya'o/ /mdog ser po ut+pal ⑦sngon po'i phreng ba 'chang barbo/ dpal gnod gnas mgon po nor rgyun ma la 'khyud stipa/ byang chub kyi sems phyir spros pa las skyes pa'i rin po che'i tshogs kyis nam mkha' ma lus par khyab pa'i rnam pa bsgom par bya'o/ /dbab ⑩pa'i dus su shar phyogs su mdog sngon po'i gang ba bzang po'o⑪/ /lho'i phyogs su mdog ser po'i rnam thos so/ /nub phyogs su mdog dmar po'i gnod sbyin no/ /byang gi phyogs su mdog ser po'i nor bu bzang po'o me'i phyogs su mdog dmar po'i tsi pi ⑫kuṇ+ḍa li'o/ /srin po ru sngon po ke li mā ⑫li rgo ngo / /rlung du ser po tsa ren+d+ra'o⑫/ /dbang ldan du ser po myu khen+d+ra'o⑫/ /de thams cad kyang gnod ⑫sbyin mo'i bha ga'i dbus su gnas pa'i rin po che'i char 'be+ebs bzhin pa gnod gnas dang 'dra ba bsgom par bya'o/ /shar gyi ⑫ sgo ru nor sbyin dang / nor sbyin chen mo ⑫gnyis gcer bu dbang po 'phyang ba rin po che'i ⑪char rab tu 'be+ebs pa'o/ /lho'i sgo ru pad+ma dang pad+ma chen po'o/ /nub kyi sgo ru ki li dang rteki li chen po'o/ /byang gi sgo ru gang ba dang gang ba bzang po'o/ /'di rnams kyang gcer bu dbang po 'phyang ba'o/ /mgon po gnod gnas la go rims bzhin du sngags kyi ⑫yi ge dgod par bya'o/ /oṃ ni spyi 40—233

bor ro/ /rdza rgo kha la'o/ /bha la dhini lag pa gnyis la'o/ /dza ni snying gar ro//len ni lte bar ro/ /dra ye ni brla ④gnyis la'o/ /swā hā ni ngar gdong gnyis la'o zhes bya'o/ /spyi bor ni nor bu bzang po ste/ mig gnyis la rgo rnam thos so / /de bzhin du mu khen dra ①ni kha la gnas/ /gang ba bzang po nu ma'i bar—/ lte bar gnod sbyin nor sbyin ④no/ /brla gnyis ki li mi li'orjo /rkang gnyis tsi pi kuṇ+ḍa lirjo/ /yan lag thams cad dza len+d+ra⑦/ /gnod gnas mgon po'i bdag nyid du de ltar bsams la/ da ni yi ge dgod par bya'o/ /oṃ ni spyi bor ro/ /lja ni dpral bar ro/ /phroṃ ni rna ba gnyis la'o/ /saḥni mgo bo'i (shergyab tu dgod par bya'o/ /da ni lag pa la dgod pa ⑨brjod par bya ste/ dngos su lha ⑩ni yi ge ste/ oṃ ni mkhrig mgul ⑪du'o/ /lcu ni ⑫lag pa'i dbus su'o/ /bye ni sen ⑫mo thams cad kyi rtse mo la'o/ /sa ཿni sor ⑫mo thams cad kyi rtsa bar ro/ /oṃ dze+e bha la dza len+d+ra ye swā hā/ zhes bya bas rab tu gnas par bya'o/ /sdigs mdzub la ni ⑫nor bu bzang po ste/ gang ba bzang po gung mo'o/ /srin lag la ni nor sbyin dgod/ /de bzhin mthe'u ⑩chung rnam thos so/ /mu khen+d+ra ⑩ni lag pa'i logs/ / mkhrig mgul spyoke ni mā lī ⑩ni/ /mtheb chen tsi pi kuṇ+ḍa li/ / sdigs mdzub ⑩mthe bo gnyis kyis ⑥ni/ /bar du dza len+d+ra ka'o/ /lag pa'i dbus su ⑪rdza bha la dza len+d+ra'o/ /rdo rje chu la sogs pa bdud rtsi lnga sbyin no/ /de med na rdo rje'i chu tsam yang chu dang bsres nas⑫/khyor bas 'thungs te/ khyor ba brgya rtsa brgyad thun gsum du sbyin par bya'o/ /ring por mi thogs pa nyid du gnod gnas dang 'dra bar 'gyur ro/ /gser dang nor la sogs pa yang dag par 'bebs bzhin pa ④sa gzhi rdzas kyis gang 40—234

bar byed do/ /oṃ dzño bye ①swā hā/ saḥ④zhes bya ba brjod cing khyor bas sbyin par bya'o/ /ma grub par gyur na dpal rdo rje hūṃ mdzad du bdag nyid bsgoms ( la gnod gnas kyi rjosku gzugs la dug dang ske tshe dang / nim pa'i lo ma dang /dha ⑤du ra dang / dur khrod kyi rjosol bas rab tu byugs la/ bsro shing skem ⑦par bya'o/ /phyis ni dur khrod kyi ⑧me la khros pas gdung bar byas na nges par 'grub par ⑨'gyur ro/ /dpal gnod gnas kyi ⑩sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang khams pa lo tsā ⑪ba dge slong ba ris bsgyur ⑫ba'oske/ / //bsdur mchan/232 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉ga /gnod gnas kyi sgrub thabs bzhugs so// ②〈〈snar 〉sa / 1〈shar 〉d+ku/ ④〈〈snar 〉7sa/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈'ar 〉7phyi rol gyi/ du〈〈snar 〉8sa/ ⑦〈snar 〉7gnyid/ 2〈'ar 〉〉ṭi/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉dz+ra gis/〈'ar 〉d+ku dbang gi/ ⑩〈'ar 〉7bzang mo dang / ⑪〈'ar 〉rdza/ ⑫dz+wa'ar 〉tha/233 ①〈〈pe 〉tha/ 〈'ar 〉rga/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉tog 〈'ar 〉lkeg 1〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉zogo bo'i/ ④〈'ar 〉7po/⑤〈〈pe 〉7) phyogs su/ 〈〈snar 〉7)sa phyogs gcig tu/ pya 〈'ar 〉thasams/ ⑦〈〈snar 〉ra da pa la/⑧〈snar 〉7dang / ⑨('ar 〉glokhyud/ ⑩〈'ar 〉mobab/ ⑪〈'ar 〉༅'i/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉la'i pi tsi/〈〈snar 〉tha'i tsotha/ ⑫〈〈snar 〉7/ ④〈〈pe 〉ṭha ren dre ngo / 〈shar 〉tsha ren dram po/ 8〈〈pe 〉〉〈'ar 〉'an da'o/ ⑩〈'ar 〉〉sgod/ ⑩〈'ar 〉7sa/ ⑫〈〈snar 〉༅/ ⑪〈〈snar 〉༅ra/ ⑫〈〈snar 〉〉—ki li dang / ⑥〈shar 〉thas/234 ①〈'ar 〉ra ②〈〈pe 〉7 na brla/ 〈〈snar 〉tha ni brlab pa/ 1〈〈pe 〉'an dra/ 〈snar 〉ṭhan da ba/ rjo〈'ar 〉7nor sbyin/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉skoshar 〉8 la ni/ du〈〈pe 〉༅ stsakurtse li/ 〈〈snar 〉〉mipi kuṇa ṭa dze+e ⑦〈〈pe 〉jo lan+d+ra/ 〈snar 〉〉tsilen dra/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉zogo'i/ 〈'ar 〉gho'i/ spu/〈'ar 〉7ra/40byed235

༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā ṭī na ④kra ma tā rā snesā dha rgo/ bod skad du/ rgya nag po'i rim pa'i dusgol ma'i sgrub ⑤thabs/ bcom ldan 'das ma rjosgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /g.yon pa brkyang ba'i zhabs kyis ro yi snying ga mnan cing mi bzad ha has dgod pa'i mchog /phyag na ral gri ut+pal ⑦gri gug bsnams shing hūṃ gi sa bon las ni rab tu byung / /mi'u thung sngo zhing yangs la ral pa ser po cod pan bcings shing mchog gi klu dang ldan/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mi shes thod pa la bkod 'joms shing drag po'i sgol ma rang nyid do/ /sgrol ma ⑧'jig rten gsum sgrol ma/ /rgya nag rim ⑨'ongs la btud de/ /bla ma'i man ngag ji lta bar/ /de yi sgrub thabs bdag gis brjod/ /rtags gcig gam ⑩ni dur khrod dang / /khyim stong dag rgo thams cad du/ /srid gsum mthar byed rig pa ni/ /der gnas rnal 'byor pas bsgrub ⑪bya/ /40—237

'jam pa'i nang tshangs can gnas shing / /gzhan yang 'jam pa dag la ni/ /shing stan la sogs mnyam gnas la/ /dngos grub mchog ni sgrub par byed①/ /skad cig rnam pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /legs mnyam bzhag pas rdo rje gsum/ /gnas gsum du ni bsam par bya/ /de nas 'od zer rnam par spros/ /srid gsum spyod ge/pa'i sems can rnams/ /yang ni gsal bar byas nas su/ /basbus te yang ni sna tshogs kun/ /stong pa nyid du bsam par bya/ /de nas rgyal ba'i sngags brjod do/ /oṃ shu n+ya 4la sogs ④rang bzhin no/ /de nas bar snang dag la bsam/ /a skyes pad+ma dmar po'o/ /de yi steng du bsam bya ba / /t+t+waṃ srelas pad+ma'i steng du ni/ /yang ni de dbus bsam bya ba ④/ /hūṃ yig sngon po dra ba'i 'od/ /de nas hūṃ skyes blta bya ba/ /gri gug sa bon gyis brgyan pa'i/ /gri gug yongs gyur ⑦bsam pa ni/ /bdag nyid sgol ma dang mnyam pa/ /mi bzad g.yon brkyang ba yi zhabs/ /mgo bo'i phreng ba ⑧'phyang ba ste/ /thung zhing gsus pa 'phyang la ⑨'jigs/ /pad+ma sngon pos brgyan pa ste//bzang mo zhal gcig spyan gsum ma/ /mi bzad ha ha'i rnam pa'i 'od/ /rab tu dgyes pas ro ⑩la zhon/ /klu brgyad kyis ni rnam par brgyan/ /spyan ni dmar zhing zlum pa ste/ /stag gi pags pas rked pa dkris⑪/ /lang tsho gsar pa ⑫phun sum tshogs/ /phyag rgya lnga yis rnam par brgyan/ /ljags 'dril mche gcigs 'jigs par byed/ /phyag g.yas ral gri gri gug ste/ /g.yon du ut+pal thod pa 'chang/ / kham pa gyen 'greng ⑫ral gcig ma/ /dbu rgyan mi bskyod brgyan pa bsam/ /bsgoms ④pa'i stobs ni rdzogs pa na/ /rnal 'byor tshigs bcad mkhan cher 'gyur/ /gal te blun zhing rmongs pas kyang / /40—238

bsgoms pa'i ri la ched ①byed na/ /de yis 'jam pa'i dbyangs thob 'gyur/ /'bum phrag gcig ni bzlas pa bya/ /yi ge gsum kyi sngags chen po/ /phaṭa ni mtha' ru snying gar gnas/ /'od zer lnga dang mnyam par ldan/ /mi shes bud shing bsregs ②pa'o/ /rnal 'byor spyod pa'i rjes 'brangs nas/ /de yi bsdu ba'i cho ga brjod/ /dang po sa yi phar phyogs sbyin/ /dbyangs yig bzhi pa chornam par brgyan/ /ro ④la zhon zhing 'phro ba'i 'od/ /thig le zla tshes yang dag ldan—/ /de nas yi ge tram̐ sbyin bya/ /bzhi pa nyid kyis rnam par brgyan/ /ring po dag dang yang dag ldan/ /hūṃ yig yang phyeni sbyar bar bya/ /phaṭa kyi yi ge de nas sbyin/ /yongs durdzogs grub pa'i sngags nyid do/ /mkhas pas ral gri gnas su ni/ /mi yi rus pa'i phreng ba bsam/ /spro dang bsdu ba'i sbyor ba yis—/ /sngags mchog yang dag bzlas par bya/ /brtan pa'i sems kyis rtogs gyur na/ /tshigs bcad mkhan ni ston pa ru/ /rtag tu bsgom pa goms pa yis⑦/ /de nyid the tshom med par 'gyur/ /sgol ma'i sgrub thabs byas pa las—/ /bdag gis dge ba gang bsags pa/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa'i ston pa ru—/ /de yis srog chags thams cad shog /de 'dir blo don sgrub pa'i thabs//rtag pa'i rdo rjes byas pa la/ /mkhas pa zab mo 'di la ni/ /sgrub thabs la ni bzod par rigs/ /rgya nag po'i rim pa'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs slob dpon rtag pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang / khams pa lo tsā ④ba dge slong ba ris bsgyur cing zhus so⑨// //40—239

237 lamatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉mi nag po'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// ②〈〈pe 〉〉〉 ṇa/ 〈〈snar 〉〉cin ṇa/ ③〈0rdor 〉〉ta dā/ du〈〈pe 〉〉warimapa'i/〈〈snar 〉'ams pa'i/ ⑤〈〈snar 〉〉wasgrub/ 0〈snar 〉bom/ ⑦〈'dir 〉〉skud pa la/ ⑧〈'ar 〉〉mas/ ⑨〈〈snar 〉〉rims/ ⑩〈〈snar 〉〉cig lam/ ⑪〈〈snar 〉〉sgrub/238 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉zo'i mchog ②〈'dir 〉stanacad/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉de/ /chashu n+ya/ 〈'dir 〉〉de/ /r+shashu n+ya tā tshwa na badz+ra swa bha ba ad ma ko haṃ/ 0〈'ar 〉〉〉pa'i/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉ḍi/ 〈'ar 〉lī/ 0〈〈pe 〉snga'ar 〉75/⑦〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉toragyur/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉stabo'i phreng bas/ 〈〈snar 〉stabo phreng bas/ ⑨〈'dir 〉〉pa/ ⑩〈〈snar 〉〉nga/⑪〈〈snar 〉〉bkris/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pas/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉skabams pa gyen bgreng / 〈〈snar 〉skabams gyen bgreng /⑫〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bsgom/239 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉bsgom pa'i ro la che/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bsreg ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉4sa rjo〈〈pe〉〉〈'dir 〉ring/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉lo〈snar 〉stanang / du〈〈pe 〉〉〉su/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉rna/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stayots+tsha/⑨〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉staba'o/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1997)40wa 240

༄ga /rdo rje sgol ma'i sgrub thabs/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra tā rā ②sā dha dz+wa/ bod skad du/ rdo rje sgrol ma'i sgrub ①thabs/ bcom ldan 'das sgol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sbyin sreg 0las kyi cho ga yis/ /'dod pa'i don kun sgrub byed pa'i/ /rdo rje sgol ma ⑤sgrub pa'i thabs/ /de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /de la sngags kyi tshig ni 'di yin te/ 'di lta ste/ na ma rjo.ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa dze+erā ya/bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ⑧ya/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ tā re tuṭ+wā re tu re ma ma kṛ ⑨te sarba duṭ+wāṃ pra duṣ+ṭṛ ⑩dzam+bha ya/ stam+bha ya/ mo ha ⑪ya/brnya ya/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ sarba duṣ+ṭṛ ⑫s+t+waṃ bha ni tā re swā hā/ de la dang po ⑫re zhig rang gi snying gar zla ba la sa bon t+t+waṃ bsam ste⑫/ de'i 'od kyis bla ma dang / sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' spyan drangs te/mchod pa rnam pa sna tshogs kyis yang dag par mchod la/ sdig pa bshags pa la 40—241

sogs pa bya zhing lco7/ gsum la ⑤skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshigs bcad brjod par bya'o—/ /de nas tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgoms la/ oṃ shu rgya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa a kopho haṃ zhes bya ba'i sngags brjod par bya'o/ /de nas paṃ las skyes pa'i pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du yang t+t+waṃ ④gi sa bon yang bsams te/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ ma mo'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas pa'i/ /lha mo sgol ma bsgom par bya/ /zhal bzhi ma la phyag brgyad ma/ /rgyan rnams kyis ni brgyan pa yi/ /gser gyi mdog can bsgom par bya/ /gzhon nu ma yi mtshan nyid 'bar/ /sna tshogs pad+ma'i gdan gnas pa'i/ /zla ba'i gdan la yang dag bzhugs/ /ser dang nag dang dkar dang dmar/ /g.yas skor phyedu ni zhal bzhi'o/ /srun gsum rdo rje skyil krung gnas/ /'od dmar sangs rgyas bzhi yi dbu rgyan can—/ /rdo rje mda' dang dung dang mchog sbyin ni/ /g.yas kyi phyag na bsnams pa'o/ /ut+pal gzhu dang rdo rje lcags kyu zhags/ /sdigs mdzub g.yon pa'i phyag rnams 'chang ba'o/ /rdo rje skyil krung rnal 'byor gyis/ /sa gsum po yang bsgrub par bya/ /de'i mdun du me tog sgol ma ni/ /mdog ni dkar zhing yid 'ong ma/ /oṃ yig las ni yang dag rdzogs/ /me tog phreng ba phyag na bsnams/ /zhal gcig phyag ni gnyis pa ste/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan pa'o/ /lho phyogs bdug spos sgol ma ni/ /gzugs mdzes mdog ni nag po ste/ /bdug spos snod ni phyag bsnams dze+eshing / /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /nub phyogs mar me sgrol ma yang / /mdog ni ser zhing yid 'phrog ma/ /bzang mo ④mar me snod bsnams shing / /gser gyi rna cha rab tu g.yo/ /byang phyogs dri yi sgol ma ni/ /dri yi dung chos phyag na bsnams/ /40—242

lha mo mdog ni dmar 'dra ba/ /snying po dkyil 'khor la bsgom bya/ /'di kun zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /rgyan rnams kyis ni rnam par brgyan/ /rdo rje skyil mo krung gis so/ /lha mo drug po 'di kun ni/ /cung zad zhal ni gcigs pa ste/ /'gying bag bcas pas yang dag gnas/ /'di dag dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo/ / bsams la ①shar sgor bsam pa ni/ /rdo rje lcags kyu 'od 'bar ma/ /phyag na rdo rje lcags kyus mtshan/ /yid 'ong ma yi bdag nyid do/ /lho sgor rdo rje zhags pa ma/ /nag cing shin tu 'dod la dga'/ /bzang po rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i lus/ /rdo rje zhags pa 'chang ba'i mchog /rdo rje lcags sgog mdog ser ma/ /rdo rje lcags sgrog phyag bsnams shing / /sna tshogs rgyan gyis brgyan pa ni/ /nub kyi sgo ru bsam par bya/ /byang sgor rdo rje dril bu ma/ /rdo rje dril bu rab bsnams pa'i/ /mdog dmar bzang po yi ni gzugs/ /dge zhing rtag par blta bar bya/ /steng du gtsug tor rnam rgyal ma/ /gzugs bzang mdog ni ser ba ste/ /byang chub 'bras bu sbyin byed bsam/ /de nas sngags pas 'khor lo 'chang / /snying po dkyil 'khor 'og tu ni/ /dge zhing 'od 'bar ba yi gzugs/ /klu yi zhags pa phyag na bsnams/ /zhal gcig phyag ni gnyis pa ①ste/ /thams cad mkhyen pa yid 'ong ma/ /mdog nag rnam par bsgom par bya/ /yi ge bcu po 'di yis ni/ /①lha mo bcu ni rnam par sprul—/ /pha rol phyin bcu dag pa ste/ /chos kun rab tu 'grub par byed/ /de la yi ge bcu pa ④ni/ /oṃ tā re tut+ta re tu re swā hā/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis ye shes kyi ⑤'khor lo spyan drangs te/ dzaḥ hūṃ baṃ pyahoḥzhes bya ba'i sngags kyis ⑦dgug pa la sogs pa bya'o/ /de bzhin du sku gsung thugs 40—243
