tsa—/ oṃ mā ①rī byi māṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ snying po'i sngags so/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ bsgom pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ badz+ra be+e tā lī dze+ehūṃ phaṭa bzlas pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ mā rī stso oṃ rmā hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa gnyis pa'i bzlas pa'i sngags so/ /de'i rjes su thun mtshams bzhir gtor ma'i sngags ni oṃ ā ra l+li dze+eho dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ.oṃ badz+ra ḍā tī nī rjos ma ya s+t+waṃ dṛ rjobyu hoḥkha kha khā hi khā hi sarba yak+ṣa rāk+ṣa sa khyu rjota pre ta pi shā tsa u da a pa smra ro ḍā ki t+yā ⑦da ya i rda ba lo griṇ+ḍi ⑧thā pi pa ⑨thā mā ti kra ma thā ma hā su kha bi bṛdha ⑩ye ma ma sa hā yi kabha ba tha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa ⑪swā hā/ zas la sogs pa la yang tweḥ⑫yig gam hūṃ yig la sogs pas yang dag par sbyangs la spyad par bya'o/ /sku mdog dmar mo phyag bcu gnyis pa'i o ⑫ḍi yā na'i rang byin ④gyis brlab pa'i rim pa'i ⑩'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //40—810

bsdur mchan//༷8 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉po〈snar 〉〉ṅgākhyu/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rje rnams/ me〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉garje/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stanag lhag du〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉 kyi/ ⑦〈〈snar 〉〉gnon/8༷9 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉sgril/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉warnam par/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dag dze/ rjo〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉sno)sa/⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉7)/ du〈〈pe 〉〉duṣ+ṭa na/ 〈〈snar 〉〉duṣ+ṭa ṇa/81༷ ①〈〈snar 〉〉gli/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stan/ ①〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉snam ra li/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉gi ni/ 〈〈snar 〉〉sna ki ni/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉tri/ du〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉ca/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉skun mān+ta pa'i ḍa ḍā ki n+ya/ 〈〈snar 〉〉skun mān+ta a pasmra ḍa ḍa ki n+ya/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉pi groṇ+ḍi/ 〈〈snar 〉〉tā groṇ+ḍi/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉rba/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉stan dha/ 〈〈snar 〉stogo dha/⑩〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉waphaṭa/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉waḥ/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉pa'i can 〈〈snar 〉〉pa'i sa/ 〈〈co 〉stananyis pa'i skye/④〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉bzhin/ ④〈〈pe 〉snga'adir 〉to/rimapa'i/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2154)40wa 811

snyo /mya ngan med pa'i shing gi 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs/sti༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ a shwa kā kan+ta sdemā rī me+e sā dha rna/ bod skad du / mya ngan med pa'i shing gi 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs/ 'phags ma 'od zer can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang gi snying gar sna tshogs pad+ma la zla ba'i steng du saṃ zhuyig ser po rnam par bkod la/ de bzhin du thams cad so sor snang ba tsam gyi bdag nyid du brtags nas oṃ swa bhā ba shudha④ཿsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shusgo3④haṃ zhes brjod par bya'o/ /de nas de'i saṃ rjoyig yongs su gyur pa las mya ngan med pa'i shing slar yang saṃ yig de yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das ma sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig pa phyag gnyis pa/ dbu'i cha la rnam par snang mdzad kyis nye bar mdzes pa/ rin po che'i cod pan can/ 'akying bag dang ④bcas pa/ gser gyi mdog lta bu/ phag gi steng na sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba la rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ lang tsho gzhon pa/ mtho ④zhing steng du 40—812

gnas pa/ phyag g.yon pas mya ngan med pa'i shing gi yal ga bsnams pa/ g.yas pas mchog sbyin pa/ sku la do shal la sogs pas rnam par brgyan pa/ na bza' dkar po mnabs pa/ rang gi snying gar mo ①yig las dpag tu med pa'i phag gi rnam pa 'od zer 'phro bas gdug pa can rnams 'dul bar bsam par bya'o/ /oṃ mā rī stso māṃ ②swā hā/ de nas ji lta ba bzhin du gshegs nas ci bder gnas par bya'o/ /yul gzhan du 'jug par 'dod ①na sngags 'dis bdag nyid kyi stod g.yogs kyi sna bzung nas lan bdun yongs su bzlas te lhan cig tu gos kyi mtha' bzung nas ji lta ba bzhin du mdud pa byas te 'gro bar bya'o//chom po la sogs pa'i 'jigs bupa las ma grol gyi bar du'o/ /mngon par 'dod pa'i yul job nas mdud pa dgrol bar bya'o zhes pa ni man ngag go/ /④ji lta ba bzhin du mdud pa byas te zhes pa ni lan bdun mngon par bsngags nas de la stod g.yogs kyi sna nas bzung rjonas phyogs bcur rnam par bltas te gdug pa can rnams kyi mig bcing bar bya'o zhes bsams te/ dbugs gcig la gtam gyis ⑦bar ma chod par bzlas par byas te lam bcing bar bya'o zhes so/ / mya ngan med pa'i shing gi 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //ske40—813

bsdur mchan/812 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ka na tā/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tā/ du〈〈snar 〉〉zhurtse/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉walha/ rjo〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉gli/ ⑦〈〈snar 〉〉par/⑧〈〈snar 〉〉pathong /812 ①〈〈pe 〉snga'ar 〉sto// ②〈〈pe 〉snga'ar 〉〉wamāṃ/ ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wapar 'dod/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wapa'i 'jigs/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〉mya ngan med pa'i shing gi 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs rdzogs so// // du〈〈snar 〉〉gzung / ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stan ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉sgom ngan — rdzogs so// //bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2155)40wa 814

༄ga /rtog pa las gsungs pa'i 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs/①༄ga /rgya gar skad du/ kaspok+ta mā rī rtsu sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/rtog pa las gsungs pa'i 'od zer can kyi sgrub thabs/ 'phags ma 'od zer can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par snang mdzad rigs byung ba'i/ /'od zer can la yang dag 'dud④/ /rtog pa las gsungs cho ga yis/ /de yi sgrub thabs rim pa bshad/ /de la re zhig dpal 'od zer can gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i sngags pas rang gi dam tshig dang sdom pa yongs su bskyang zhing dag pa'i sems kyis sems can thams cad gdon pa'i bsam pas oṃ phaṭa ces brjod pas khro bo'i ④khu tshur gyis snying ga dang / mdzod sru dang / mgo bo rnams su bkod nas zhal bsang ba la sogs pa byas nas/ lha'i khang par rab tu zhugs te/ bris sku la sogs pa'i dubacom ldan 'das ma'i sku bkram nas 'od zer can gyi sngags yongs su bzlas pa'i dri'i chus bgegs bskrad nas 40byed815

de bzhin du nyer spyod lnga la sogs pa rab tu sbyar te/ de la bgegs sgod pa'i sngags ni 'di'o/ /oṃ mā rī me+e hūṃ sarba bispyo ①nud sā rā ya hūṃ phaṭa/ de nas rang gi snying ga'i dang po'i yi ges mtshan pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la e bsams nas/ de'i steng du dang po'i bcu gsum pa'i sa bon la zla phyed dang thig les brgyan pa la tsha zhing 'od zer can gyi 'od dang ldan pa / de las 'od zer sna tshogs 'phros te 'od zer rnams rdzogs pa las bcom ldan 'das ma'i sku dang bla ma dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyang dmigs nas mchod cing phyag btsal ④nas sngags 'di'o/ /oṃ mā rī byi puṣ+pe pra ṭīts+tsha 3swā hā/ oṃ mā rī byi dhū ④paṃ pra tīts+tsha ⑤swā hā/ oṃ mā rī byi swā te t+yar r+ghaṃ pa ri dza su/ oṃ mā rī byi ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ dngos po med na bsam gtan gyis kyang ngo / /de nas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung ④/ /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la//byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi/ /rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub ④phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bdag gis bskyed⑧/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas/ /sems can thams cad mgron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog spyad par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas shog /ces pa lan gsum brjod nas smon lam sngon du 'gro bas bdag med pa bsgom par bya ste/ sngags 'dis oṃ shu ⑨n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma kopho⑩haṃ zhes brjod nas ⑪sa bon sgyu ma'i dpe rnams bsams te// khams gsum ma lus pa yang bltas pa dang / reg pa thams cad ⑫dper na sgyu ma lta bu'o/ /dmigs pa med pas de bzhin du 'gro ba gnas 40—816

pa thams cad kyang so sor snang ba tsam du rtogs pas/ de nas thog ma med pa'i dus kyi rnam pa ma yin pa'i rnam par rtog pa'i sa bon spangs nas rang bzhin dag pa zhes lhag par grol bar bya'o/ /oṃ swa bhā ba shurnyaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba shurnyolha①haṃ zhes lan gsum brjod par bya'o/ /de nas sngon du gsungs pa'i sa bon rdzogs pa las zla ba'i steng du oṃ yig de thams cad yongs su gyur pa las dpal ldan mgon po rnam par snang mdzad pad+ma'i snying po dang seng ge'i gdan gyi steng na rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa gser gyi mdog lta bu byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs pa ral pa'i cod pan can zhi zhing rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa bsam par bya'o/ /de nas rang gi snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yi ge nyi shu rtsa lnga mchog gi snying po dang po'i gnyis pa ladang yang dag par ldan pa zla ba phyed pa dang ①thig les brgyan pa bsgom par bya'o/ /de las skyes pa'i mya ngan med pa'i shing / de'i steng du zla ba la gnas pa'i saṃ bu yig bsams nas/ de thams cad yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid 'od zer can kyi skur bsgom par bya'o/ /bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das ma 'od zer can zhes pa ⑤sku mdog shin tu ser ba 'dzam bu nā da'i 'od lta bu bu'abar ba mchod rten kyi nang na gnas pa/ na bza' dmar po mnabs pa/ phu dung ⑦dmar po'i stod g.yogs can/ phreng ba sna tshogs pa dang rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/rna rgyan ⑧gyi tshogs dang / rked pa la dril bu g.yer ka'i ⑨dra ba dang / rkang gdub dang ldan pa/ phyag brgyad pa/ zhal gsum pa spyan gsum pa 'bar zhing 'od zer gyi phreng ba 'phro ba/ ban+d+ra ⑩dza ba'i me tog dang mtshungs pa/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan pa/ mya ngan med pa'i phreng bas ⑩brgyan pa/40—817

phyag g.yon pa rnams kyis zhags pa dang / skud pa dang / mya ngan med pa'i shing dang / gzhu bsnams pa/ g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje rgyas pa dang /khab dang / lcags kyu dang / mda' bsnams pa/ zhal dang po zhi zhing 'dzum pa'i zhal shin tu ser ba gser gyi mdog lta bu/ spyan rgyas pa sin+d+ra ①ras brgyan pa/ sgeg pa'i nyams kyis 'gying ba'o①/ /zhal g.yon pa ni phag zhal khro ba dang bcas shing mi sdug pa gcigs shing 'jigs pa in+d+ra nī la'i 'od lta bu nyi ma bcu gnyis kyi 'od dang mtshungs pa/ shin tu khro gnyer gcigs shing ljags 'dril ba 'jigs shing ①'jigs par byed pa/ zhal gnyis rjopa shin du dmar ba mdzes shing 'od zer 'bar ba/ mya ngan med pa'i shing gi 'og na gnas pa/ me tog gi phreng ba gcal du bkram pa de'i spyi bor rnam par snang mdzad kyis mgon du gyur pa sngon ⑤du gsungs pa'i sku mdog dang phyag rgya dang ldan pa/ 'og tu phag bdun gyi shing rta'i steng du g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/lang tsho gzhon nur gnas pa shing rta 'dren pa'i phag gi 'og tu yo las byung ba'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor la haṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las sgra gcan pyalag pa dag gis zla ba dang ⑦nyi ma dag 'dzin pa/ nyin mo snang bar byed cing mtshan mo zla ba dang mtshungs pa lha mo bzhis yongs su bskor bar bsam par bya'o/ /de la shar du oṃ mā rī tho baṭ+wā li ba dā li bā ra li bā rā hā ⑧mu khi sirnyi mā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥswā hā zhes so / /de ltar lha mo sku mdog dmar mo phag zhal gcig pa/ phyag bzhi pa phu dung ⑫ dmar po'i stod g.yogs can/ phyag g.yon pa zhags pa dang / mya ngan med pa'i shing bsnams pa/ g.yas pa rdo rje'i lcags kyu dang / khab bsnams pa—/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /rtog pa las gsungs pa'i cho gas 40—818

mngon par 'dod pa'i dngos grub 'gugs par byed par ①bsam par bya'o/ /oṃ mā rī stso bat+tha li ba dā li ba rā li bā rā hā mu khi sarba duṣ+ṭa pra duṭ+wā rgo mu khaṃ ④brnya brnya hūṃ swā hā/ lha mo ba dā ①li sngon du gsungs pa'i gos dang / rgyan dang sku mdog lta bu phyag g.yon pa zhags pa dang / rdo rje bsnams pa/ g.yas na yal ga dang khab bsnams pas gdug dupa can rnams kyi kha mig 'tshem par byed pa lho ru bsam par bya'o/ /oṃ mā rī byi baṣ+ṭha li ba dā li ba rā li bā rā hā mu khi sarba duṣ+ṭa rjorgo s+t+waṃ bha ya baṃ swā hā/ zhes pas lha mo ba rā buli de bzhin du gos dang rgyan dang kha dog la⑦/ 'on kyang phyag g.yas na rdo rje dang khab bsnams pa/g.yon na zhags pa dang / mya ngan med pa'i shing bsnams pa/ gdug pa can rnams rengs par byed pa nub tu dgod par bya'o/ /oṃ mā rī byi bat+tha ④li ba dā li ba rā li bā rā hā ⑨mu khi sarba satā ⑩na me ba sha ma nā spyoya hoḥswā hā⑫/ zhes pa'i sngags kyis lha mo phag zhal ma sku mdog dmar mo de bzhin du gos dang rgyan dang / yang phyag g.yas na rdo rje dang / mda' bsnams pa/ g.yon na mya ngan med pa'i shing dang gzhu bsnams pa sems can thams cad rjes su chags par byed pa can byang phyogs su blta bar bya'o/ /de nas lcags kyu la sogs pa'i phyag rgya rnams dang / de'i sngags kyis kyang dgug pa la sogs pa bya'o/ /ye shes sems dpa' dgug pa dang / rab tu gzhug pa dang / bcing ba dang / dbang du bya bas bsgrub par bya'o/ /mdzub mo lcags kyu bcings la/mthe'u ⑫chung lcags kyu chen po ste⑫/ tshigs mang po'i rtse mo dag lcags sgog ⑩ rgyab tu btsir ba la sogs pas/ oṃ badz+ra saṃ ku sha dzaḥzhes pa 'dis ye shes sems dpa' ⑩mdun du gdan drangs nas mchod pa la sogs pa dbul bar bya'o//40—819

'od zer can gyi phyag rgyas de nas oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūṃ 'dis gzhug par bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra zwa ṭa baṃ 'dis bcing bar bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra ā be sha hoḥ'adis mnyes par bya'o—/ /de nas dam tshig gi lha rnams kyis lhan cig tu gnyis su med par bya'o//de la 'di'i phyag rgya ni/ lag pa gnyis po mnyam byas nas/ /thal mo'i rnam par bsres bya ste①/ /mtheb chen dang ni ming med kyi/ /rtse mo gnyis po bye ba yis—/ /gung mo'i sor mo yang dag 'khyud/ /'khyil pa'i rnam par bcings pa dag /skyil krung steng du nyer bzhag nas/ /lte ba'i phyogs su dgod par bya/ /rab mchog phyag rgya 'di yis ni/ /las rnams kun la legs par sbyor/ /de nas dbang bskur ba blang bar bya ste/ phyag rgya chen po ni mtheb chen sems dpa'i skyil krung bkug nas mdzub mo'i rtse mo bzung ste/ 'di'i gung mo oṃ yig lhag ma rdo rje thal mo sbyar ba spyi bor bkod nas oṃ bhuḥkhaṃ mo zhes pa dbang bskur ba'i sngags kyis rnam par snang mdzad gser gyi mdog lta bu byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas bzhugs pa/ spyi bor oṃ bsams nas bsgoms pas ngal na sngags bzlas par bya'o/ /rang gi snying gar zla ba la gnas pa'i sngags 'bar zhing 'bar ba dang ldan pa'o/ /oṃ mā rī byi māṃ rnguswā hā/ zhes bltas la bzlas pa bya'o/ /ji ltar nus pa'i bsgom pa sngon du 'gro bas lha mo thams cad yang dag par rgyal bar blta zhing sngags bzlas par bya'o/ /phyi nas chad lhag bskang ba'i cho ga yi ge brgya pas kha ④bskang bar bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/badz+ra satwa twe dhino pa tiṣ+ṭha/ dṛ ḍho me bha ba/ su toṣ+yo me bha ba/ su poṣ+yo me bha ba/a nu rak+to me bha ba/ sarba sirnyi ⑤me pra yats+tsha sarba karma su tsa me tsit+t+waṃ rjogre yaḥku ru hūṃ/ha ha ha ha hoḥ⑦bha ga bān sarba ta thā ga ta ④badz+ra mā me muñtsa badz+rī ⑨bha ba ma hā sa ma 40—820

ya satwa yasaḥ'adis dus thams cad du gshegs su gsol zhing dge ba yongs su bsngo zhing mngon par 'dod pa'i dngos grub zhus ②te rang gi phyag rgya spyi bor bgrol nas oṃ mā rī rtsu muḥzhes so/ /rang gi lhag pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor gyis zas dang khrus dang / nyal ba la sogs pa thams cad du rab tu brtag par bya'o/ /de'i phyir rim pa 'dis lus ngag yid gsum bsrung bar byas nas ci bder gnas par bya'o/ /'phags ma'i sgrub thabs byas pa yis/ /dge ba nyer ①bsags gang de yis/ /ye shes dri med 'od zer can/ /skye bos go 'phang thob par shog /oṃ kha kha khā nyi khā nyi kṛṇ+ḍi kṛṇ+ḍa tu sarba khyu ta butī ba li ma ma shārnyi rjoku ru ban+tu swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags kyis gtor ma 'bul dulo/ /rtog pa las gsungs pa'i 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta slob dpon snying po'i ④zhabs kyis mdzad pa'o// //bsdur mchan/815 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ rjo〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thadus/ ldu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mi'i/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7/816 ⑨〈〈pe 〉mirba bisna/ 〈'ar 〉mirba birtswa/ ⑤〈〈snar 〉thatshal/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉tits+tsha/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgro/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tits+tsha/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thazung / zu〈〈pe 〉〉〈'ar 〉〉sgrub/ ldu 〈〈snar 〉〉bskyod/ ⑨〈'ar 〉7/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉7lha/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7spyon lam sngon du 'gro bas bdag med pa/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7kyang //17 ①〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉7lha/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7pa/ ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7dang / ④ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈sar 〉rna/⑤〈〈pe〉〉〈snar 〉7pa/ rjo〈〈snar 〉༄ra/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉thung / blu〈〈snar 〉thargyan/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga'i/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉than sgro/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉snga'ar 〉7dbu/40—821

818 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉7)na sgro/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉brjid pa'o/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉dze'adir 〉mi ljags 'dril ba 'jigs shing / rjo〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉stanayas/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pangon/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉can/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉bodang / ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉ba ra ha/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉lo'adir 〉〉thung /819 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pas/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ba ra ha mu ṣi sarba dus pra duṣ+ṭa ṭ+wāṃ mu kha/ ③〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉smon/④〈〈snar 〉sngagadugs/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉ring li ba ra ha mu 9wa sarba duṣ+ṭa/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉gla ra/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dang / ⑧〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉ba tā/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba ra ha/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stagatā/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉na/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉 ཿ/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pathe/ ⑫〈〈pe〉dze〈snar 〉mi ste/ ⑫〈〈snar 〉〉sgrogs / tu9〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/82༷ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanas te/ ②〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉mi/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉mi kha/ du〈〈snar 〉〉te/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉nyagi:/ du〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉stsatai/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉waḥ/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉sko'adir 〉〉nā/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thadzi/821 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snam/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ces/ ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉sngagang / rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ca ti/du〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉smugarnye/ rjo〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉dbul/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉po/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2156)40wa 822

༄ga /'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ mā rī byi sā dha rna/ bod skad du/ 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs/ 'phags ma 'od zer can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang po nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dang po'i bcu gsum pa'i sa bon zla phyed dang thig les nye bar brgyan pa de las skyes pa'i 'od zer can sku mdog dmar mo ⑤zhal drug pa dang po dmar po/ gnyis pa nag po/ gsum pa ljang gu bzhi pa ser po/ lnga pa dkar po drug pa ni steng gi phag zhal te nag po'o/ /mya ngan med pa'i shing dang mchod rten gyis brgyan pa/ lto 'phyang ba thod pa'i phreng bas mdzes shing dbu skra bsdes pa sgrul gyis rnam par brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ bgegs 'joms par mdzad pa/ kha dog sna tshogs pa'i phag gi shing rta la bzhugs pa/ phyag g.yas na ral gri dang / rdo rje dang /gtun shing dang / mda' dang / rdo rje rtse gcig pa dang / dgra sta bsnams 40—823

paske/ g.yon pa sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang / thod pa dang /mya ngan med pa'i yal ga dang / tshangs pa'i mgo bo dang / gzhu dang / rtse gsum bsnams pa ste/ 'di phyag bcu gnyis pa/ spyan gsum pa/ kha dog dmar zhing zlum pa/ zhal gatshigs pa'o/ /shing rta'i dbus su phyag gnyis pa sdigs mdzub dang yal ga bsnams pa/ mdun du gnyis pa bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das ma 'od zer can ①kyi phyag rgya bcing bar bya'o//rdo rje ②thal mo sbyar nas ting nge 'dzin gyis gung mo brkyang nas mnyam du myu gur byas te/ mtheb chen skyil krung bcings nas mdzub mo'i rtse mo rnam par gzung bar bya'o/ /oṃ mā rī tho māṃ ①hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //

bsdur mchan/823 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉po'adir 〉〉nga'od can/824 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wacan/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉rje'i/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stakhri/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2157)40wa 825

༄ga /dpal 'od zer can po tsu pa'i sgrub thabs/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī mā rī byi pi tsu pā sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/dpal 'od zer can pi tsu pa'i snesgrub thabs/ 'phags ma 'od zer can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang gi rtog ngan cha yis bskyed/ /bar du gcod pa kun zhi dang / /kun mkhyen shes rab thob bya'i phyir/ /'od zer can nyid bsgom par bya / /phyogs kun dus gsum nang bzhugs pa'i/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang bla ma'i mdun/ /bdag nyid lta ①las yang dag mchod/ /cho ga bzhin du bshags la sogs/ / dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /rjosdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /⑤sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung / /bdag med pa yi rjongo bo ni/ /stong nyid mtshan med rgyu dang bral/ /de phyir smon pa med pa dang / /'gro rnams rang nyid rnam thar spyogasum/ /sku gdung mchod rten chos dbyings gnas/ /snying ga sangs 40byed826

rgyas lam nas ni/ /mkha' khyab sangs rgyas tshogs 'phro bas/ /gru bzhi la sogs yang dag ldan/ /phyi dang nang du zur bzhi la/ /rtse gsum gyis mtshan zla ba'i dkyil—/ /gdug pa'i sems can mthil du mnan/ /ri yi rgyal po rab tu gnas—/ /de la saṃ yig bsgom par bya/ /mya ngan med ①shing las byung ba'i/ /sgeg cing dpa' ⑤dang bden pa'i char/ / 'dzam bu nā ④da'i 'od dang mtshungs//g.yas zhal in+d+ra nī la'i mdog /mi sdug 'jigs shing drag po ste/ /cig shos zhal ni zla 'od 'phro/ /snying rje dulas byung zhi ba ste/ /zhal gsum rnam par thar pa gsum/ /chos dang longs spyod sprul par gsungs/ /yi ge ser po gos bzang dang / /'od zer gyis ni zhal gnas ma/ /kha mig khab kyis 'tshem byed cing / /kha dang mig dag 'ching bar byed/ /snying mgrin lcags kyu zhags pa dang / /mda' dang gzhu yis 'bigs ⑤par byed/ /rdo rjes gdug pa'i rjosnying 'bugs shing / /mya ngan med pas 'brab par byed/ /rnam thar brgyad brgyad rnams kyis ni/ /gdug pa 'joms par rab tu bsgom/ /zhabs ni brkyang bskum dag gis ni/ /dbang phyug dang ni go rī ④dag /thabs dang shes rab zhabs kyis mnan/ /'od zer can bsgom brtul zhugs can/ /phyogs kun dang ni dus gsum dang rjo/ /bdag nyid spro bsdu byas nas ni/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥbarjod nas ni/ /de la sangs rgyas kun gzhug bya/ /sangs rgyas sku bskyed rim pa yis/ /bdud rtsi'i bum pa rnams bzung nas/ /rin chen dbu rgyan ⑨cod pan can/ /rtag tu dbang bskur blta bar bya/ /phyag na mchod pa kun thogs nas/ /me tog la sogs rdo rje mas/ /mchod cing bstod pa byas nas ni/ /shin tu bza' dang chang sogs kyis/ /lus ngag yid ni rengs byed 40—827

paske/ /pi dhitsu'i sngags ni bzlas par bya/ /sarba duṣ+ṭa pra duṣ+ṭa rna②/ /rang ming bzhi pa'i mtha' can gyis/ /thun mtshams bzhi'am thun mtshams gsum/ /snga bar brgya dang rtsa brgyad bzlas/ /rig pa chen mo bsgom pa yis①/ /don chen la ni stong phrag gcig /bzlas nas mchod cing bstod par bya/ /dge ba'i don du zhu bar bya/ /bdag nyid gnas nas rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /gang la'ang chags pa spang bar bya/ /gshegs gsol dang ni lha gnas la/ /spyir ni yi ge gsum dran bya/ /rab gnas dus su ④rgyud la ni/ /lus ngag yid ni bsgrub par bya/ /thun mtshams bar yang chod ⑤pa sogs/ /sngon du 'gro bas bzlas par bya/ /dang po rjocho gas slar yang ni/ /snga bar lha mo gru ⑦yis bskul//rig pa 'di dang de bzhin bdag /bsgom zhing yang dag bzlas par bya/ /rgyud kyi man ngag nyid las ni/ /sngags pas mngon 'dod rtag tu bsgrub/ / pi tsu ⑧cung zad yang dag bris/ /bsod nams yang dag nyer bsags pa/ /de yis 'jig rten thams cad ni/ /'jam pa'i rgyal po nyid du shog /dpal 'od zer can pi tsu pa'i ⑨sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //40—828

bsdur mchan/826 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod// ②〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉pa'i ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mus/ rjo〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉wadakon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉〉dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bzung / bden med gnyis pa'i/ ⑦〈〈snar 〉〉par/827 ①〈〈snar 〉〉khyipa/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stanapal/ ①〈〈snar 〉mdzasgru na/ rjo〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stapo/ ⑤〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉torabugs/ du〈〈snar 〉stanadung ba'i/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ri/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉du/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brgyan/828 ①〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉nyaspru/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉dus pra duṣ+ṭa ṭ+wāṃ/ 〈〈snar 〉〉duṣ+ṭa pra dus na/ ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stan/ rjo〈〈pe〉〉su/ 〈〈snar 〉〉su la/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pachod/ du〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉por/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉ku/⑧〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉nyaspru gi ⑨〈〈snar 〉〉pa'i/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2158)40wa 829

༄ga /'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs/①༄tha/ /rgya gar skad du/ mā rī stso sā dha dz+wa/ bod skad du/ 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs/ 'phags ma 'od zer can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdug pa thams cad 'dul mdzad pa'i/ /lha mo 'od zer can btud nas/ /las rnams thams cad sgrub pa yi/ /de yi sgrub thabs bshad par bya/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs nas/ /snying ga'i zla ba oṃ yig brgyan/ /'bar zhing dmar ba'i sa bon las/ /sna tshogs 'od zer yang dag 'khrigs/ /des bskyed rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / /bla ma byang chub sems chen rnams/ /phyag 'tshal mngon par bsngags nas mchod/ /zhal zas la sogs dbul bar bya//badz+ra puṣ+pe/ badz+ra dhū pe/ badz+ra dī pe/ badz+ra gadhe/ badz+ra ne+e — bye ⑤hūṃ/zhes pa'i sngags kyis thams cad du'o/ /de nas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /byang chub sems kyang bskyed par bgyi/ /smon lam sngon 40—830

du 'go ba yis/ /chos kun bdag med bsgom par bya/ /'dis oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā ba a kolha①haṃ/ de nas brtan g.yo'i ②dngos po kun/ /sa bon rang bzhin nyid bsams nas/ /de'i ①rjes su oṃ swa bhā ba shurnyaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba shusgolhaduhaṃ/ de'i sa bon las skyes pa'i 'khor lo/ de'i lte ba la nyi ma'i dkyil ⑤'khor ro/ /de'i steng du drug pa'i lnga pa'i sa bon la saṃ ⑦yig dang zla ba phyed pa dang thig les brgyan pa'o/ /de thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa las 'od zer can gyi skur bdag nyid bsam par bya'o/ /gos dang sku mdog dmar mo yon tan nyis 'gyur gyi phyag rol zhing stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs ⑦can/ral pa gyen du badze+es pa/ cod pan dmar po zhal gsum pa/ zhal gnyis ni phag zhal lo/ /dang po'i zhal ni zhi zhing cung zad 'dzum pa'i zhal sgeg cing 'gying ⑧ba'i nyams dang bcas pa'o/ /thams cad la ⑨spyan gsum pa'o/ /g.yon pa ni phag zhal dmar po ste/ rdo rje tho ba bsnams pa lus med kyis phyag mdzad pa'o/ /g.yas pa na phag zhal dmar skya'o/ /rdo rje'i zhags pa bsnams pa'i dbang pos phyag mdzad pa/ mchod rten kyi nang na khro bo nag po g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa'o/ /'og tu khyab 'jug dang dbang phyug dang tshangs pa la sogs pas phyag mdzad pa/ nor lha ⑩dang 'jig rten skyong ba thams cad 'jigs pas 'dud pa dang / rje btsun ma la ⑩phyag 'tshal zhing bka' sgrub ⑫ par mdzad pas gnas pa'o/ /de nas rna bar bkang ba'i gzhu dang / mya ngan med pa'i yal ga dang mdas bsgrub bya'i snying gar 'bugs par bsam par bya'o/ /phu dung ⑫dmar po'i stod g.yogs can/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa bsam par bya'o/ /mya ngan med pa'i dbu rgyan bcings pa'o⑫/ /phyag g.yon na mya 40—831

——ngan med pa'i me tog bsnams pa/ snying gar sdigs mdzub kyis gnas pa'i rdo rje zhags pa dang / thod pa chen po dang / skud pa dang / mgo bo dang /bum pa bzang po rnams phyag na bsnams pa'o/ /g.yas pa rnams kyis skud pa dang / lcags kyu dang / rnyiṇ+ḍi pā ①la dang / ral gri 'phyar ba dang ①/rdo rje'i dbyug pa dang / rdo rje bsnams pa'o/ /dpal ldan rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po rdo rje'i ④skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ byang chub mchog gi ④phyag rgya can ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs pa ral pa'i cod pan can zhi ba ye shes kyi spyan zim bur mdzad pa spyi bor rnam par bsams nas las thams cad brtsam par bya'o/ /man ngag ji lta ba bzhin du ye shes sems dpa' dgug pa dang / rab tu gzhug pa dang / bcing ba dang / dbang du bya bas ⑤bsgrub par bya'o/ /dbang bskur ba dang / go cha dang / cod pan bcing rjob dang / mchod pa dang / bstod pa yang byas nas phyi nas bzlas pa brtsam par bya'o/ /ji ltar nyi ma 'bar zhing rab tu gsal ba ni ⑦mi g.yo ba dang ldan pa'i me dang ldan pa'o/ /de bzhin du chos 'bar ba'i sku la rtse gcig pa'i sems kyis bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas phyag rgya bcing bar bya ste/ mtheb chen sems dpa'i skyil krung bcings nas mdzub mo'i rtse mo bkug ④ste bzung la⑨/ mnyam du gung mo yan lag mchog la ⑩lhag ma rdo rje'i thal mo sbyar ba snying ga dang mdzod spu dang mgrin pa dang spyi bo rnams su bzhag nas 'dis/ oṃ mā rī byi hūṃ sarba duṣ+ṭṛ ⑪mdzā ya hūṃ phaṭa/ brgyad pa'i gsum pa dang bzhi pa dag gi ⑫gsum pa las bdun pa'i bzhi pas gang ba dang po'i gnyis pas brgyan ⑫pa/ bzhi pa la'ang dang po'i gnyis pas brgyan pa'o/ /dkar po dbang po'i zhal gyis 40—832

dgongs ①mo'i thun nas gung thun bar du zhes pa'i sngags rab tu gsal bar bya ste/oṃ mā rī byi de ba dat+ta ④su shāk+ṣiṃ ku ru swā hā/ dang po'i bcu gsum pa'i sa bon zla phyed thig les brgyan pa sngon du 'gro bas gung thun bar du ser po lus ngan po'i zhal gyis rgyas pa'i sngags bzlas par bya ste/ oṃ mā rī byi de ba dat+ta gya puṣ+ṭi ku ru oṃ/ brgyad pa'i bzhi pa dang po'i bcu gsum pa bcu drug pa dang yang dag par ldan pas nam phyed la chu bdag gi zhal dmar pos ming med kyis dbang du bya ba'i las kyi ④rab tu dbye ba'o/ /oṃ mā rī byi de ba dat+ta su ba sha ma na ④ya hoḥrngu drug pa'i gnyis pa dang bzhi pa'i dang por rjophyed nag po'i ⑦gshin rje'i zhal gyis nyi ma'i gung la mngon spyod 'di'i sngags sdigs mdzub kyis rab tu bskul lo/ /oṃ mā rī byi de ba dat+t+waṃ mā ra ④ya hūṃ phaṭa/ gsum pa'i gsum pa'i sa bon las bcu drug pa yang dag par ldan pas thams cad 'gugs pa'i mchog go⑨/ /oṃ mā rī stso a myu ka su sirnyi mā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ'od zer can gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur nas bla ma la gus shing bden pa'i ngag gis 'grub ste/ de'i lha rnams kyi ⑩bzlas pas the tshom med par rig go/ /sngags bye ba bzlas par 'gyur ro//ras bris kyi mdun du legs par bzlas pa dang ldan pas las thams cad 'grub cing yid la gang 'dod pa 'byung ngo / /'od zer can 'byung rgyud las ni/ /mchog gi sgrub thabs bris pa yis/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di yis ni/ /sems can bde gshegs 'gyur bar shog /'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //40—833

bsdur ma na/83 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉༅ bya/831 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wa3/ ②〈〈snar 〉〉tha'i/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉de/ rjo〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉wa3/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mi dkyil/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉tog ⑦〈〈snar 〉〉thams/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bgying / ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉wal/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉walha/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wal/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bsgrub/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉thung / ④〈'dir 〉〉sgar bya'o/832 ①〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉pa/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉3ra ba dang / 〈〈snar 〉〉phyar ba dngas/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉rje/ rjo〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉gis / ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉43sa pas/ du〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉ཿnga / ⑦〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉wani/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉mo bkug 〈〈snar 〉〉mo dgug ⑨〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wamachog la/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉dusan/⑫〈〈snar 〉stanas/ ⑫〈〈snar 〉〉rtan/833 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉gyi rgongs/ ②〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉stanata/ ③〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉stakyis/ rjo〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉to'i ma/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉waḥ/ rji⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stapo/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉pa ra/ 〈〈snar 〉〉pa na/ ⑨〈〈snar 〉〉gego/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉kyis/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2159)40wa 834

༄ga /'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs mdor bsdus pa/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ saṃ k+ṣ-ip+ta mā rī byu sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs mdor bsdus pa/ 'phags ma 'od zer can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang gi snying gar zla ba la saṃ yig bsams nas/ de'i 'od zer rnams kyis bskyed pa'i bla ma dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams mdun du bltas nas phyag 'tshal ba dang mngon par mchod nas sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa bya'o/ /de nas chos thams cad kyi bdag nyid kyang sgyu ma'i dpe la sogs pas so sor snang ba tsam sa bon las bsams nas rang bzhin rnam par dag pa brjod par bya ste/ de nas stong pa nyid kyis ④lhag par grol ba la sogs pa brjod par ①bya'o/ /de nas de'i sa bon yongs su gyur pa las mya ngan med pa'i shing / de'i steng du zla ba la gnas pa'i rma yig /de thams cad yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid 'od zer can gyi skur blta'o/ /de yang sku 40—835

mdog ser mo zhal gsum pa/ so sor spyan gsum pa/ phyag brgyad pa/ na bza' dmar po mnabs pa/ phu dung stidamar po'i stod g.yogs can/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan cing 'od 'phro ba'i phreng ba 'khrigs pa ban+tu dzi ba ka'i me tog lta bu dang ldan pa'i ②phyag g.yon pa rnams kyis sdigs mdzub kyi ④zhags pa dang / gzhu dang / mya ngan med pa'i yal ga dang / skud pa bsnams pa/ g.yas na rdo rje dang / mda' dang /lcags kyu dang / khab bsnams pa/ mchod rten gyi nang na gnas shing phag bdun gyi shing rta la zhabs g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ lang tsho gzhon nus gnas shing spyan rgyas pa/ de'i rtsa ba'i zhal zhi zhing sgeg pa/ g.yon na rjophag zhal nag po khro ba dang bcas pa khro gnyer gtsigs shing 'jigs par byed pa ljags bskyod pa'o/ /zhal g.yas pa dmar zhing zlum pa pad+ma rā ga dang mtshungs pa gtsang khang nang na bzhengs shing mya ngan med pa'i shing gi me tog gcal du bkram pa/ 'og tu rlung gi dkyil 'khor la haṃ yig ④las byung ba'i sgra gcan zla ba dang nyi ma 'dzin pa lha mo bzhis yongs su bskor ba'i bcom ldan 'das ma bsam par bya'o/ /de la shar du lha mo bat+ta rjoli sku mdog dmar mo phyag bzhi pa phyag g.yon pa dag gis zhags pa dang mya ngan med pa'i shing bsnams pa/g.yas pa dag gis rdo rje dang ⑦lcags kyu dang / khab bsnams pa'o/ /lho ru lha mo ba dā ⑧li sku mdog ser mo phyag bzhi pa g.yon pa dag gis zhags pa dang rdo rje g.yas pa dag na mya ngan med pa'i shing dang / khab bsnams pa'o/ /nub tu lha mo ba ⑨rā li de'i gzugs 'chang ba phyag g.yon pa dag gis zhags pa dang /mya ngan med pa'i shing / g.yas pa dag gis rdo rje dang / khab bsnams pa'o/ /40—836

byang du lha mo bā rā hā ①mu khi sku mdog dmar mo phyag bzhi pa phyag g.yon pa dag gis mya ngan med pa'i shing dang gzhu/ g.yas pa dag gis mda' dang rdo rje bsnams pa bsam par bya'o/ /yang na thams cad dkar mo rin po che'i cod pan can/ phag zhal gcig pa spyan gsum pa/ rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan pa phu dung ②dmar po'i stod g.yogs can bsam par bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje lcags kyu ma la sogs pa rnams kyi phyag rgya dang sngags kyis ye shes sems dpa' dgug pa la sogs pa bya'o/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥzhes pa 'dis ye shes sems dpa' dgug pa dang gzhug pa dang bcing ba dang dbang du bya bas mnyes par bya'o/ /de nas 'od zer can gyi phyag rgyas gnyis su med par bya zhing bsgom pa sngon du 'gro bas bzlas par bya'o/ /oṃ mā rī stso swā hā/ dge ba thams cad yongs su bsngo ④nas gshegs su gsol lorjo/ /oṃ mā rī stso muḥzhes pas gshegs su gsol zhes so/ /'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs mdor bsdus pa rdzogs so// //40—837

bsdur mchan/835 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉4)/ ni〈〈pe 〉〉〈'ar 〉bopa brjod par/836 ①〈〈pe 〉stapo mnabs pa/ phu thung / 〈'dir 〉〉pa mnabs pas phu thung / ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa/ ③〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉4)sa/ rjo〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉wan/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wayig rjo〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bod tā/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉bodang / ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉gle dā/ 〈〈snar 〉〉bā rā/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉gla/837 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ba rā ha/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉thung / ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bsngos/ du〈〈pe 〉྾po ra 〉〉 lo/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (216༷)40wa 838

༄ga /'phags ma 'od zer can gyi gzungs gdon pa'i man ngag①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya mā rī stso dhā ra ṇi ②pa tho pa de shaḥ/bod skad du/ 'phags ma 'od zer can kyi gzungs gdon pa'i man ngag /bcom ldan 'das 'phags ma 'od zer can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /blo ldan sems dpa'i skyil krung ste/ /dmigs pa brtse ba chen po yis/ /snga thun snying gar zla ba la/ /oṃ yig dkar po bsgom par bya/ /rnam snang gsungs pa'i bdag nyid can—/ /kun nas dkar zhing de 'od kyis/ /ra ba zlum zhing mchod rten brgyan—/ /steng du 'od zer 'bar ba ste/ /bsrung ba'i don du mdun rgyab dang / /g.yas g.yon 'og dang steng rnams su/ /rim pas ma sogs g.yog la sogs—/ /zhang po la sogs bu la sogs/ /bris sku dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang / /po ti la sogs las byung ba/ /de nas zla ba me ④yig ser/ /mya ngan med pa'i yal gas rjobyung / /'phags ma 'od zer can bsam bya/ /khro zhing 40—839

khab dang skud pa bsnams/ /gang zhig lte ba nas langs te/ /sna bug g.yas pa de mdun du/ /gzhan nas skud pas kha mig btsems/ /gdug ①can ra ba'i phyi rol bya/ /lan cig ma yin byas nas ni/ /byang chub mchog gi ①gzungs bklag go/ /de nas oṃ dang mā rī byi swā hā/ /sngags ni ji bzhin stobs kyis bzlas/ /de nas sngags rig ①g.yon pa yi/ /sna bug nas ni de'i snying gar/ /gzhug cing mya ngan med shing girjo/ /'od zer kyis bskyed phag ser gyis/ /phyi ru gdug can yang dag 'joms/ /sna yis bumatshams ni 'ching bar byed/ /gser gyi mdog can phag la bzhugs/ /gtso mo gser gyi mdog dang ldan/ /mi 'jigs rab sbyin 'od zer can/ /gos dkar can la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /'phags ma 'od zer can gyi gzungs bklag pa'i man ngag rdzogs so// //40byed840

bsdur mchan/839 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉dha ri rī/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gli/ du〈〈snar 〉stan las/840 ①〈〈snar 〉stagadugs/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stonas/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉rigs/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stagos/⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stan/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2161)40wa 841

༄ga /ri khrod lo ma can gyi sgrub thabs/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ par+ṇa sha ①ba ri sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/ri khrod lo ma can gyi sgrub thabs/ 'phags ma ri khrod lo ma can la phyag 'tshal lo//sngon ma bzhin du thams cad bsgrubs nas rang gi snying gar pad+ma dkar po dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la paṃ yig ser po las skyes pa'i rdo rje'o/ /de'i lte ba la paṃ yig go/ /de thams cad yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das ma ①sku mdog ser mo zhal gsum pa/ spyan gsum pa/ phyag drug pa/ dang po'i zhal ser po—/ g.yas dkar po/ g.yon dmar po 'gying zhing bzhad ④pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ lo ma dang rma bya'i mdongs kyi sham thabs can/ lang tsho gzhon zhing rgyas pa/ phyag g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje dang / dgra sta dang / mda' rnams bsnams pa/ phyag g.yon pa rnams kyis sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang / yal ga dang bcas pa'i rma bya'i mdongs dang /40—842

gzhu rnams bsnams pa/ me tog bcings pa'i ral pa'i cod pan la gnas pa'i mi bskyod pa 'chang ba/ nyi ma'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor can/ 'og tu bgegs rnams mnan pa'i pad+ma dkar po dang zla ba'i gdan la g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa—/ thugs kar g.yon pa'i sdigs mdzub kyis 'og gi bgegs kyi tshogs skrag par mdzad pa'o①/ /g.yas rdo rje'i khu tshur gyis mtshon cha 'phyar ba'i tshul/de bzhin du phyag bzhi'i g.yon pa dag gis sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang / lo ma dang bcas pa'i rma bya'i ②mdongs bsnams pa/ phyag g.yas pa dag gis rdo rje dang / dgra sta bsnams pa/ shin tu 'jigs pa ster bar ④bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas sngags bzlas par bya ste/ oṃ pi shā tsi par+ṇa sha ba ri sarba ma rī dupra sha ma ṇi swā hā/ de nas ji lta ba bzhin du gshegs nas ci bder gnas par bya'o/ /ri khrod ⑤lo ma can gyi sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //40—843

bsdur mchan/842 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉sa / /ri khrod lo ma can gyi sgrub thabs gnyis dang sher phyin dkar mo'i sgrub thabs skor 'phags ma ri khrod lo ma can gyi gzungs rnams bzhugs/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉1/ ③〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wam/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉gzhad/843 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sga/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉warma bya'i/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉ba/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉7)/du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 ma/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2162)40wa 844

༄ga /ri khrod lo ma can gyi sgrub thabs/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ par+ṇa sha ba ri sā dha rna/ bod skad du/ ri khrod lo ma can gyi sgrub thabs/ 'phags ma ri khrod ma ④lo ma can la phyag 'tshal lo—/ /sngon du gsungs pa'i cho gas stong pa nyid bsgoms pa'i rjes la sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba la gnas pa'i ④paṃ yig ljang gu las skyes pa'i ri khrod ma lo ma can sku mdog ljang gu zhal gsum pa/ spyan gsum pa/ phyag drug pa/ nag po dang / dkar po dag g.yas dang g.yon kyi zhal lo/ /phyag g.yas pa gsum na rdo rje dang / dgra sta dang / mda' bsnams pa/ phyag g.yon pa gsum na gzhu bkang ba dang / yal ga dang / sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa bsnams pa/ zhal khro ba dang bcas shing bzhad pa/ lang tsho gzhon pa/phreng ba bcings shing stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can cung zad lto ba two 'phyang ba/skra steng du badze+es pa/ 'og tu ma lus pa'i nad dang / bdud zhabs kyis 40byed845

mnan pa/ don yod grub pas dbu brgyan pa'i bdag nyid du skad cig gis bskyed nas sngags bzlas par bya'o/ /oṃ pi shā tsi par+ṇa sha ba ri sarba mā ri pra sha ma ṇi hūṃ phaṭa/ ri khrod lo ma can gyi sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/845 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉lo'adir 〉bom/ ②〈〈snar 〉〉/pa'i/ 0〈〈pe〉〉〈snar 〉bob/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2162)40wa 846

bsdur mchan/847 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉ཿ dha ra tī/③〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wam/ ④〈〈pe〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa/ bume〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ta/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sprosamyakle bu / 〈〈snar 〉〉bamyakle bud+ma/ ⑧〈〈co 〉〉waḥ/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ko/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pra stu/⑪〈〈snar 〉stan ni/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉lha mi spyo na ma ṣā mi ba/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ti/ ④〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉sha stsapa rā shu dha ra/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉cisto bha ma/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉waḥ/ ⑩〈〈pe〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa/ ⑫〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ci'i rgya ta mi/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉zo'i/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉banā/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉〉jo bo/ 〈〈snar 〉〉dha bo / du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉ri ཿ/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉kya/848 ①〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pan+ta pa de rma/ ③〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉ri tra/ ④〈〈pe 〉stanan+da/ 〈〈snar 〉stanaṇ+ḍa/du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉shas+t+ra/ du〈〈pe 〉〉ta/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉dhu/ 〈〈snar 〉〉bhu/ ni〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stan:/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉gta/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skoskut+ta/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉ta/ 〈〈snar 〉〉te/ tunye〈〈pe 〉〉gle/ 〈〈snar 〉nyaspru/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bad+dha/ ⑫tunye⑩⑩〈〈pe〉dze〈snar 〉〉spru/ ⑫〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉gaskra/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉〉par+pā bya dha/ 〈〈snar 〉〉sar+pā bya dhā/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gisbyi/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ri tsaṇ+ḍa/ tshu〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa bā ra ṇi ma/ ⑫④〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sha ⑤〈〈pe〉྾〈snar 〉〉 ma/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2164)40wa 849

༄ga /dpal ldan nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs/①༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī ma na ma ②hā kā la sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/dpal ldan nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs/ dpal ldan ①mgon po chen po rjol phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin du sngon du gsungs pa'i rim pas mestong pa nyid bsgoms pa'i rjes la sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la hūṃ yig nag po/ de yongs su gyur pa las dpal ldan rje btsun nag po chen po phyag gnyis pa/ zhal gcig pa/sku mdog nag po/ spyan gsum pa 'bar ba chen po/ phyag g.yas pa dang g.yon pa dag gis gri gug dang thod pa bsnams pa/ mgo bo'i phreng ba'i do shal gyis sku brgyan pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du bsdes pa/ mche ba gcigs pas 'jigs par byed pa/ sku thams cad la sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ sku rjothung ba/zhal nas khrag 'dzag pa'i bdag nyid du skad cig gis bskyed nas sngags bzlas par bya'o/ /de la sngags ni 'di'o/ /oṃ ma hā kā la hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ dug dang 40byed850

khrag dang / sgog pa dang / yungs kar rnams kyis nag po chen po'i spos phul nas sran ma sha dang 'dzam ①bu ti ka dang chang dang me tog dang byug pa lnga'i lcags kyu'i bdud rtsis nag po chen po ②mchod pa bya ste/ gtor ma'i sngags 'dis so/ /oṃ ma hā kā lā ya shā sa no snepa kā ri r+ṇa e ṣā pa— ma ka lo a buyi i rda rat+na tra yā pa kā ri ṇi ya di pra ti ā+oṃ sma ra si ta dā i rda duṣ+ṭa kha kha khā hi khā hi ma ra ma rjor kṛṇ+ḍi kṛṇ+ḍa brnya brnya/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ dī na me ke na mā ra ya buhūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa tsha ba gsum gyis bsgrub ⑦bya'i gzugs byas te lus la tsher mas dgang zhing dug dang ske tshe rnams kyis cho ga bzhin du byugs nas me la bsro bar bya'o/ /gang gi ming dang bcas pa de/ /de bzhin skad cig mthong bar 'gyur—/ /slob dpon zhe sdang rtag khro gang / /gang zhig dkon mchog gsum po dang / /dpag med sems can rnams 'tshe rnams/ /nag po chen pos za bar byed/ /de yi lus la sha gcod cing / /de bzhin khrag ni 'thung bar byed//spyi bor thig le byas nas gus pa rgya chen po byas nas ⑧bzlas par bya'o/ /dpal ldan nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //40—851

bsdur mchan/85༷ ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉༄ga /dpal ldan nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// ②〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉wan ma/ ①〈〈snar 〉mi ldan/ du〈〈pe 〉stanag po chen po/ 〈〈snar 〉stanag po/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉the/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉〉bong /951 ①〈〈pe 〉〉dzam/ 〈〈snar 〉〉dzi/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉po'i/ 〈〈snar 〉〉tha'i/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉〉/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉wayi/du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉sta'i ra mā/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa ra yā/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉nya'i sgrub/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉te/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2165)40wa 852

༄ga /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ shuklu ①pradzñā pā ra ①mi tā sā dha māṃ/ bod skad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs/ 'phags ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma ④la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig bsgoms 5pa tsam kyis ni/ /shes rab pha rol phyin 'byung zhing / /kun gyi byang chub rnam 'dzin pa—/ /de nas yang dag bshad par bya/ /zhal gcig phyag ni gnyis pa ⑥ste/ /sku mdog dkar mo yid 'ong ma/ /dbu skra phyed phyed 'khyil pa can/ /chu skyes dkar la yang dag gnas/ /phyag g.yas na ni pad+ma dang / /g.yon na shes rab pha rol phyin/ /mdog dkar rnam par bsgom par bya/ /rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i/ /rgyan rnams thams cad yongs su rdzogs/ /lte ba'i dkyil 'khor la bsgom bya/ /oṃ yig ye shes las byung ba/ /mchog tu dga' bar byed pa mo/ /dam tshig sems dpa' rdzogs byas la/ /ye shes sems 40—853

dpa' bsgom par bya/ /rnal 'byor zla drug goms pa yis/ /shes rab pha rol phyin mar 'gyur/ /mtshan mo bdun gyi ①rnal 'byor gyis/ /bstan bcos kun la 'jigs pa med/ /bzlas pa 'bum du sbyor ba yis/ /nyin re nyin re tshigs bcad brgya/ /'bad pa med par rab tu rtsom/ /gzhung yang brgya ni 'dzin par byed/ /'di rnams sngags kyi tshig tu 'gyur/ /oṃ pi tsu pi tsu pradzñā wasnyo ④ni dz+wa la dz+wa la me dha wasnya gni dhi ri dhi ri bu dhi wasnya rjoni swā hā/ bya rog gi sgra mi grag par sngags 'dis lan bdun rang ⑤sgyur la mngon par bsngags nas ji srid zla ba drug gi bar du 'thungs na ④shes rab chen por 'gyur ro/ /oṃ pre swā hā—/ sngags 'dis kyang ngo / /'di la mi bskyod pa'i rgyas gdab po zhes so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma ⑦dkar mo'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //40—854

bsdur mchan/853 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉shukla/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ni/ ④〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉7/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉skabasgom/ 0〈〈pe 〉po〈snar 〉stab/854 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stabadun gyis/ ②②du〈〈pe 〉snga'adir 〉〉brtse/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉stabangar/ rjo〈〈snar 〉〉nas/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉the/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2166)40wa 855

༄ga /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma sku mdog ser mo'i sgrub thabs/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ smi ta bar+ṇa pradzñā pā ra mi tā sā ②dha dz+wa/ bod skad du—/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma sku mdog ser mo'i sgrub thabs/ 'phags ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngon du gsungs pa'i cho gas a yig las skyes pa'i zla ba la dhīḥyig ser po las skyes snepa'i sna tshogs pad+ma la haṃ yig ser po la a yig la sogs pa'i dbyangs bcu drug gis yongs su bskor zhing gnas pa'i phyi rol du ④ka yig la sogs pa'i yi ge sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis yongs su bskor ba bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas sgeg mo dang / phreng ba ma dang / gar ma dang / glu ma dang / me tog ma dang / bdug spos ma dang / mar me ma dang / dri ma zhes pa'i rnal 'byor ma brgyad do/ /de thams cad yongs su gyur pa las ye shes kyi rjozla ba shar ba 'od rab tu gsal ba'o/ /de'i steng du pad+ma—/ de'i steng du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i pusterjo/ de'i steng du zla 40—856

ba'i ①dkyil 'khor gnyis pa la de'i steng du puste ④gnyis pa'o/ /de thams cad yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma ①de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i dbu rgyan can/chos 'chad pa'i phyag rgya dang ldan pa/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba la bzhugs pa na bza' dang rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ g.yas g.yon gyi logs dag na byedal la gnas pa'i shes rab kyi rjopha rol tu ⑤phyin pa'i puste rjobasnams pa'o/ /sngags ni/ oṃ byedadhīḥhūṃ swā hā/ dpral bar oṃ ⑦yig ser po/ mgrin par byedaḥyig dkar po/ snying gar dhīḥyig ser po/ lte bar hūṃ yig nag po zhes bzlas pa'i dus su yi ge bzhi po rnams kyi ⑨rjes su bsam par bya'o zhes so//shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma sku mdog ser mo'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //40—857

bsdur mchan/856 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉gan /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i sgrub thabs bskor bzhugs so// ②〈〈snar 〉〉ba/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉skyed/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tu/ ⑤〈〈snar 〉ste)sa/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stapo ti/857 ①〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉ri steng du/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉staṅge ti/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉sga/ rjo〈〈pe〉dze'adir 〉〉wakyi/⑤〈〈pe〉〉〈snar 〉〉watu/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉po ti/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉snoni/ 〈〈snar 〉〉ni/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉mos/⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyis/bsdur 'azas re'u migargyud/ (2167)40wa 858

༄ga /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma d+ku mdog ser mo'i sgrub thabs mdor bsngus pa/①༄ / /rgya gar skad du/ spru ta bar+ṇa saṃ k+ṣip+ta pradzñā pā ra mi tā sā dha rgo/bod skad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma sku mdog ser mo'i sgrub thabs mdor bsdus pa/ bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngon du gsungs pa'i cho gas stong pa nyid bsgoms pa'i rjes la pad+ma dmar po dang zla ba la gnas pa'i dhīḥser po yongs su gyur pa las shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma sku mdog ser mo mi bskyod pa bzhugs pa'i ral pa'i ②cod pan can—/ chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad nasasde/ g.yon gelogs su puste ⑤dang bcas pa'i ut+pa la sngon po bsnams pa/ na bza' dkar po'i stod g.yogs can/mdzes shing gos dang rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /zhes de bzhin du bsams nas/ oṃ be+eḥshu ta smṛ rjoti bi dzā ⑦ya swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags bzlas par bya'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma ④sku mdog ser mo'i sgrub thabs 40—859

mdor bsdus pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/859 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉lo'adir 〉to/ralapa'i/⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ me〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉 phyogs/ rjo〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉po ti/ rjo〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉ti gli⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉mdza/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉pa/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2168)40wa 860

༄ga /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ shuklu ①pradzñā pā ra mi tā sā dha rna/ bod skad du—/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu ①phyin ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs/ 'phags ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngon du gsungs pa'i cho gas rang gi snying gar chu skyes dkar po dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la pri ④yig dkar po rnam par bkod la de bzhin du sngon ma bzhin du rjothams cad bya'o/ /pre yig dang pad+ma yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das ma sku mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa lung dang rtogs pa'i gzugs can ma/ rin po che'i cod pan bsnams pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i punyis ⑥mtshan pa'i chu skyes gnyis g.yon dang g.yas kyi logs dag gi nang du langs pa bsnams pa'i phyag dag gis chos 'chad pa'i phyag rgya mdzad pa/ pad+ma dkar po dang zla ba la rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ lang tsho gzhon zhing dar la bab pa/ na bza' 40—861

dang rgyan ①rnam pa sna tshogs pas brgyan pa/ so sor snang ba tsam rab tu 'phro ba'i sna tshogs pa'i 'od zer kyi tshogs kyis nam mkha' gang ba/ mar me'i phreng ba lta bu thogs pa med pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu med pa spro zhing bsdu ba'i sbyor bas thams cad rang bzhin gcig tu lhag par mos pas ji srid shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma mngon ②du ma gyur pa de srid du bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas gang gi tshe dgod par ①gyur na pad+ma dkar po sna'i rtse mor tsa na ka'i tshad tsam kun nas bris pa bzhin du rnam par bsgoms la/ de la bzhugs pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma shin tu phra bar gsungs pa'i gzungs la rtse gcig pa'i yid kyis yang dang yang du mngon du bya zhing bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas bskyed pa'i rim pa'i phyogs kyi sngags ni oṃ pre swā hā/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i phyogs la ni//sngags med don dam rim pa'o/ /shes rab pha rol phyin ma yi/ /man ngag thob pa'i rnal 'byor parjo/ /dge 'dun byin ⑤kyi bu yis ni/ /rigs kyi ming gis kyang 'bad nas/ /sems can kun kyi don phyir du/ /sgrub thabs gsal po 'di bris so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma rjodakar mo'i sgrub thabs slob dpon dge 'dun byin gyi bus mdzad pa rdzogs so// //40—862

bsdur mchan/861 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉stan ta/ 〈〈snar 〉stag ta/③〈〈snar 〉mi tu/ 0〈〈pe 〉lo'adir 〉〉gi/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉po'ar 〉bobazhin du/ 0〈〈pe mi'isnar 〉༅ tis/862 ①〈'dir 〉〉brgyan/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉snordzon/ ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉(da pa/ du〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉4sa/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skasmin/ rjo〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2169)40wa 863

༄ga /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ shuklu ④pradzñā pā ra mi tā sā dha rgo④/ bod skad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs/ 'phags ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shes rab pha rol phyin ma yi/ /lha mo sgrol ma'i ④gzi brjid can/ /zla ba gang zhig shar ba yisadu/ /rgol ba'i zhal ⑥pad gnyid log go/ /brtse ba dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas stan bde ba la 'dug nas rang gi snying gar paṃ yig dkar po yongs su gyur pa las ⑦pad+ma/de la yang saṃ las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ⑧de la oṃ dkar po'o/ /de las byung ba'i 'od zer gyis nam mkha' la bla ma dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams bltas nas/sa bon de las gyur pa'i mchod pa'i nyer spyod rnams kyis ⑨mchod pas mchod nas/de bzhin du phyag 'tshal ba dang / gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang / sdog pa 40—864

bshags pa dang mi byed pa'i sdom pa dang / bsod nams la rjes su yi rang ba dang / bdag nyid ①dbul ba dang / bsod nams yongs su bsngo ba dang /byang chub tu sems bskyed ②pa dang / rgyal ba'i lam la brten ④pa dang /gzhan la bde ba phun sum tshogs par 'dod pa'i byams pa dang / gzhan sdug bsngal dang bral bar 'dod pa'i snying rje'i bdag nyid dang / sems can rnams la dga' ba'i rnam pa sbyin par 'dod pa dang / bshes dang bran mo dang dgra rnams la mthun pa dang / khro ba burnam par spang zhing ⑤mtshungs par dubyed pa ni btang snyoms zhes pa rnams bsam par bya'o/ /de nas stong pa nyid kyi byang chub kyi sngags/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa yi ko3⑦haṃ zhes so/ /de nas pad+ma de khrul zla ba rnam par bsgoms la/ de'i dbus su sa bon las bcom ldan 'das ma shel dag pa las byas pa lta bu zhal gcig pa/ dbu skra nag po phyed phyed du 'khyil pa'i zhags pa can/ phyag gnyis pa/ skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/mchu dang phyag dang zhabs kyi mthil dmar ba rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/na bza' dkar po bsnams ⑨pa/ phyag g.yas na sdong bu dang bcas pa'i chu skyes bsnams pa/ phyag gzhan na thugs kar puste ⑫bsnams pa'i bdag nyid shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i ngo bor bskyed nas/ lte ba'i dkyil 'khor du de bzhin du gzhan yang bcom ldan 'das ma rgyan thams cad bsnams par bsgom ⑪par bya'o/ /'di'i thugs kar yang pad+ma dang zla ba'i sa bon la/ de las 'phros pa'i 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pas ma 'ongs pa na grub pa'i bcom ldan 'das ma dzaḥ/ zhes pa'i sngags kyis gdan drangs nas/ yang dag par mchod cing hūṃ zhes pas rab tu bcug nas baṃ zhes pas bcings te hoḥzhes pas 40—865

mnyes par bya'o/ /de'i rjes la sa bon las 'phro zhing byung ba'i 'od zer gyis dpag tu med pa'i 'jig rten kyi khams na gnas pa'i sems can rnams kyi don mdzad pa mtha' yas pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sprul pa'i sku slar yang de las sdud pa bsgom par bya'o/ /spro zhing bsdu bas ngal na ①bcom ldan 'das ma'i nga rgyal gyis gnas par bya'o/ /de bzhin du gung thun dang thun phyi ma'ang spro zhing rnam par bsgoms te/ bsdus nas de'i nga rgyal gyis gnas par bya'o zhes so/ /yang snga dro'i thun la muḥyig gis gshegs nas de bzhin ②bsgom par bya'o—/ /de la 'dir bzlas pa'i cho ga ni snying ga'i sa bon gyi yi ge nang dang phyi ru lha mo'i zhal gyi sgo nas thon nas lte ba'i dkyil 'khor du de la de bzhin du rab tu zhugs te sngags kyi yi ge rnams shel gyi phreng ba'i rnam pa dkar po spro zhing nye bar bsdus nas lha rnams kyi nga rgyal gyis bzlas par bya'o/ /de la bzlas pa'i sngags 'di'o/ /oṃ pi tsu pi tsu pradzñā brnyo ni dz+wa la dz+wa la me dha brnyo ni dhi ri dhi ri bu dhi bar+bha ni swā hā/ de bzhin du bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor pas dus mi ring bar bstan bcos thams cad la mkhas par 'gyur ro zhes pa ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa'i rim pa'o/ /shes rab pha rol phyin gyur pa'i/ /sgrub thabs gang byas bsod nams des/ /shes rab pha rol phyin gyur par/ /'gro ba 'di rnams 'gyur bar shog /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs sdogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta dpal ldan pad+ma 'phel gyi zhabs kyis mdzad pa'o// //40—866

bsdur mchan/864 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉sko'adir 〉〉zhu kra/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gli/ ④〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bsgom pa'i/ ⑤〈〈pe〉྾〈snar 〉stab/ ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉sngarag ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〉la/ 〈〈snar〉〉 las/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/865 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉〉la/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉skyed/ ③〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉thasten/ ④〈〈snar 〉〉bo/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈'dir 〉〉sungs shing / rjo〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉〉'du byed pa des sems can tsam mtshungs par/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉—2/ ⑧〈〈pe〉྾〈snar 〉〉wade/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉panabs/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉po ti/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsgoms/866 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wangal na/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉〉du/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2170)40wa 867

༄ga /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma gser mdog can gyi sgrub thabs/①༄tsho/ /rgya gar skad du/ ka na ka war+ṇa ①pradzñā pā ra mi tā sā dha rna/bod skad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma gser mdog can gyi sgrub thabs/'phags ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang gi snying gar e yig las byung ba'i zla ba'i ⑤dkyil 'khor la dhīḥyig rnam par bkod pa las 'od dpag tu med pa/ de las byung ba'i 'od zer gyis bla ma dang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams bskul zhing gdan drangs nas mdun du stan sna tshogs pa la bzhugs par bltas nas/ yid kyis phyag dang / mchod pa dang ④/ sdig pa bshags pa dang / bsod nams la rjes su yi rang ba dang /gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang / byang chub tu sems bskyed ⑤pa dang / bsod nams rjoyongs su bsngo ba dang / bzod par gsol ba rnams byas te/ de nas byams pa dang / snying rje dang / dga' ba dang / btang snyoms rnams 40byed868

bsgoms te/ de nas oṃ shu n+ya tā ①dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa ā kolhahaṃ ④zhes brjod nas stong pa nyid bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas de bzhin du skad cig gis ①zla ba la gnas pa'i dhīḥyig bltas la/ de yongs su gyur pa las shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma ral pa'i cod pan can/ zhal gcig pa cho phyag bzhi pame/ phyag gnyis chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ rin po che sna tshogs pas brgyan pa/gser mdog 'bar ba/ phyag g.yon pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa'i ut+pa la sngon po bsnams ⑥pa/ na bza' sna tshogs pa'i stod g.yogs can—/ phyag g.yas pa ⑦mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa/ pad+ma dmar po dang zla ba la rdo rje skyil ④krung gis bzhugs pa'i bcom ldan 'das ma rnam par bsgoms te/de nas brtan pa'i nga rgyal bya'o/ /gang bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i nga rgyal dang bcas pa'i nga rgyal can gang yin pa de bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'o/ /de nas sngags dgod ⑨par bya ste/ mgrin par oṃ dhīḥlce la oṃ ghiḥ⑩rna ba dag la dziḥde nas rang gi snying gar āḥyig dmar po las byung ba'i pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa ze'u ⑪'bru ge sar dang bcas pa bsams la yi ge rnams dgod par bya'o/ /yid kyis pad+ma'i 'dab ma dang ze'u ⑫'bru ser po rnams la shar gyi 'dab ma la na mo/ me'i 'dab ma la bha ga wa ⑫tre+e/lho'i 'dab ma la pradzñā pa ra mi tā ④yi/ bden bral du a mi ta gu ṇa ye / chu bdag gi 'dab ma la bha ga wa ti bats+tsha lā ye⑩/ rlung gi 'dab ma la sarba ta thā ga tā dzñā na pa ri pu rā ye⑫/ lus ngan gyi 'dab ma la swa twa bats+tsha ⑫lā ye/ dbang ldan gyi 'dab ma la tar+ya thā oṃ dhīḥkaṇi ⑩kā yi/ shar du shu/ me ru ti/ lho ru smṛ/bden bral du te/ chu bdag tu'i⑫/ rlung du dzā/ lus ngan du ye/ dbang ldan du 40—869

swā hā/ de bzhin du sngags kyi yi ge rnams bkod nas bzlas so/ /yi ge 'di rnams de bzhin du bsam ①par bya'o/ /thun mtshams gsum du stong phrag brgyad ji srid zla ba drug gi bar ram yang na los de thos pa 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /gser mdog can gyi shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/868 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉snga'adir 〉thaṇ+ḍi/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉bozlaba'i/ ①〈〈snar 〉bodang / ⑤〈〈snar 〉〉skyed/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈'ar 〉〉jil/869 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ta/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ba añtsako ha/ ni〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉〉bsams nas/ du⑤〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ rjo〈〈snar 〉〉snams/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉nen/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉kyil mo/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉wadagod/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉waḥ/ ⑪⑫〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉ze/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉ba/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ta/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉thi/ tso〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉startot+ta bar tsha la yi/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉ri tā yi/tso〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bta tsha/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ka ṇi/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉tu bi/87༷ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsams/bsdur 'bras re'u migabyud/ (2171)40—870

༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ pradzñā pā ra mi tā sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i sgrub thabs/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yid 'ong gnas ni 'ga' zhig tu/ /bde ba'i stan la 'dug byas nas/ /rnal 'byor byams dang snying rjer ④ldan/ /sngags ni lan gsum brjod par bya/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā ba ā kolhahaṃkhru/ zhes pas brtan dang g.yo ba'i dngos/ /bdag gi lus kyang thams cad du/ /sems kyis ④stong nyid bsgom par bya/ /rmi lam rmi lam mtshungs pa ru/ /paṃ yig rnam pa las skyes pa'i/ /pad+ma zla ba'i gdan gnas pa'i/ /dhīḥyig ser po dgod bya ste/ /de yis ⑤bdag nyid bcom ldan ma/ /phyag gnyis shes rab pha rol phyin—/ /sna tshogs gos 'chang sna tshogs rgyanabu/ /chos 'chad phyag rgya yang dag ldan—/ /sgeg pa gcig pu'i nyams ldan zhing / /rdo rje skyil krung yang dag 40—871

gnasaske/ /puste ①dang bcas chu skyes ni/ /g.yon gyi logs su bsnams pa'o/ /spyi bo mgrin pa snying gnas su/ /zla ba la gnas de nyid gsum/ /oṃ lhahūṃ/āsayig hūṃ yig dag gi dbus/ /zla ba ④dhīḥyig ser po yis/ /'od zer rnam par bsgoms nas ni/ /de nas sku mdog ser mo bsgom/ /kun rdzob kyi ni rnal 'byor pas/ /shes rab shes rab bsgom par bya/ /don dam pa ni rtogs ༷pa'i sku/ /shes rab bdag nyid chen por gsungs/ /gang gis byang chub nges thob pa'i/ /rim pa sbyor bas rgyal bar 'gyur/ /ston ka'i zla ba lta bu yi/ /dkar ba'i sems ni rnam par bsgom/ /sna tshogs g.yo dang mi g.yo ba/ /phyi nas nam mkha'i dpe dang 'dra/ /rnam rtog ma lus stong pa ste/ /rang byung stong pa gzugs kyang med/ /gzugs sgra dri dang ro dang ni/ /reg bya la sogs gzung dang 'dzin⑤/ /rtog pas yongs su ma gos pa/ /bsam mi khyab pa'i rkyen las byung / /yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub gnas/ /kun mkhyen sems kyi go 'phang ngo / /de la bzlas pa'i sngags ni 'di'o/ /oṃ prazlo ma hā prazlo dhishu ti smṛ ti bi dzā ye dhīḥswā hā/ shes rab pha rol phyin bsgom pa'i/ /bdag byas bsod nams gang thob pa/ /de yis 'jig rten ma lus kun/ /shes rab pha rol phyin yum shog /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i ⑦sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //40—872

zhe spretu phyan ma' sgrub thabs/①༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ ka na ka war+ṇa ④pradzñā pā ④ra mi tā sā dha rgo/bod skad du/ gser mdog can gyi shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i rjosgrub thabs—/ 'phags ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang por re zhig sgrub pa pos stan bde ba la 'dug nas/ rang gi snying gar dbyangs yig dang po yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dbus su be+eḥyig ser po bsgoms te/de las byung ba'i me tog la sogs pa rnams kyis bsgom rjopar bya ba dang ldan pa'i bcom ldan 'das ma rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi chas gdan drangs nas rang gi mdun du bzhugs te/ yang dag par mchod nas de'i mdun du sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa bya'o/ /de'i rjes la tshad med pa'i gnas bzhi bsgoms ④pa sngon du 'gro bas skad cig gis stong pa nyid bsgom par bya ste/ sngags 'di'o/ /oṃ swa bhā wa ④shudhaḥsarba dharmāḥ⑧swa bhā ba shurnyolha⑨haṃ zhes so/ /phyi nas nam mkha'i 40—874

phyogs su dbyangs yig dang po yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la dhīḥyig ser po la/ a yig la sogs pa'i dbyangs bcu drug gis yongs su bskor ba'oske/ /de nas ka la sogs pa gsal byed sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi phreng bas yongs su bskor ba'o/ /dhīḥyig yongs su gyur pa las shes rab kyi ①pha rol tu 1phyin pa'i po tis nye bar mtshan pa bsgom par bya'o/ /thams cad yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma sku mdog ser mo sna tshogs pad+ma la rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa zhal gcig pa/ phyag gnyis chos 'chad pa'i phyag rgya mdzad pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ rin po che'i cod pan can—/ g.yon logs su pad+ma'i dbus su shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i puste bsnams pa ①bsgom par bya'o/ /dpral bar oṃ yig ser po/ mgrin par s+dzadakar po snying gar dhīḥyig ser po/ lte bar hūṃ yig nag po'i sngags bzlas par bya'o—/ /oṃ t+padhīḥhūṃ swā hā/ gser mdog can gyi shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //40—875

bsdur ma na/874 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stabaṇi/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉4/ du〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉pa'i/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bsgoms/ rjo〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bsgom/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha/ ni〈〈pe 〉skosnar 〉boḥ/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉po'adir 〉〉walha/875 ①〈〈snar 〉nya)sa/ ②〈〈snar 〉〉watu/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉po ti bsnams par/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2173)40wa 876

— pa' sgrub thabs/①༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ pradzñā pā ⑤ra mi tā sā dha rna/ bod skad du/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgrub thabs/ bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma lal phyag 'tshal lo/ /shes rab pha rol phyin gnyis med/ /ye shes de ni de bzhin gshegs/ /bsgrub bya'i don de sbyar ba yis/ /gzhung lam dag la de yi sgra/ /byang chub sa bon bla na med/ /shes rab pha rol phyin btud nas/ /gnyis med ye shes bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /de yi sgrub thabs bri bar bya / /dang po rjore zhig sngags pas mnyam par gzhag ⑤ par gyur pas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i sgrub pa yid la byas te/ tsan+dan kyi maṇ+ḍal byas nas de'i yan lag ngo bo nyid med pa'i rang bzhin kyis de la dbus su mi bskyod pa bltas nas me tog dbul bar bya'o/ /sngags 'dis so/ /oṃ na mo asgo bh+ya ⑥hūṃ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūṃ swā hā/ de bzhin du akhyo bh+ya ⑦hūṃ zhes pa'i sa bon gyi yi ge brjod 40—877

par bya'o/ /gzhan rnams kyang ngo / /oṃ badz+ra byu pe hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra gadhe hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra dī stipe hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra ne+e bi bye hūṃ swā hā/ zhes pas thams cad dbul bar bya'o/ /de'i mdun du oṃ na mo be+e ro tsa nā ④ya oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūṃ swā hā/ zhes so/ /de bzhin du g.yas phyogs ①su oṃ na mo rat+na sam+bha bā ya t+t+waṃ/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūṃ swā hā/ de bzhin du rgyab tu/ oṃ na mo a mi tā bhā ya juḥ④oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe ⑤hūṃ swā hā/ de bzhin du g.yon du oṃ na mo a mo gha sidhi ye aḥsde oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūṃ swā hā/ 'dis de rnams mchod nas/ rnam par snang mdzad dang rin chen 'byung ldan dag gi dbus su lha mo spyan ma la mchod par bya'o//oṃ na mo lo tsa nā ye waṃ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūṃ swā hā/ de bzhin du rin chen 'byung ldan dang / 'od dpag med dag gi dbus su/ oṃ na mo mā ⑦ma kye me oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūṃ swā hā/ yang 'od dpag med dang don yod grub pa dag gi dbus su oṃ na mo ⑧pāspyo rā ye ⑫ṭ+wāṃ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūṃ swā hā/ yang don yod grub pa dang rnam par snang du mdzad dag gi dbus su oṃ na mo stu ra ⑪⑪ t+t+waṃ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūṃ swā hā/ de nas mi bskyod pa'i gnas su/ oṃ na mo pradzñā pā ⑫ra mi tā ye dhīḥ.oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūṃ swā hā/ zhes pas thams cad la me tog la sogs pa lan gsum dbul bar bya'o—/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā wa yis kolha⑫haṃ/ zhes pas lha mo ④mchod pa rnam pa sna tshogs pas mchod par bya'o zhes pa ni maṇ+ḍal gyi las so/ /da ni de nyid bsam par bya ste/ 'dir sems can rnams srid pa'i sdug bsngal gyi tshogs kyis mnar zhing yang dang yang du 'khor bar ⑫'khor te/ kye ma 'di rnams sdug bsngal lo zhes snying rje'i sems bskyed cing de nyid bsam par bya'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rnal 'byor ⑫pas bla na med pa yang dag par 40—878

rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob nas de rnams kyang bdag gis de la dgod cing ji ltar de rnams kyang slar yang sdug bsngal med cing 'khor ba las grol zhing bde bar yang bya'o zhes pa ni rton pa sems bskyed pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /de nas rang gi snying gar na bun kyi do shal can dbang phyug dgod pa lta bur dkar zhing bdud rtsi'i tshogs lta bu'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bltas la/ de la dhīḥyig gser gyi kha dog lta bu las 'od zer dpag tu med pa brgya stong gi sgon mas stong gsum gyi 'jig rten gyi khams na sangs rgyas dpag tu med pa ①bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong dpag tu med pa 'phros pa bltas nas/ 'dir de bzhin du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma dang / spyan ma la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyang dpag tu med pa'i me tog dang / spos dang / mar me dang / dri dang / zhal zas dang / 'khor lo rin po rngudang / glang po rin po che dang / rta rin po che dang / bud med rin po che dang / skyes bu rin po che la sogs pa rnams kyis kyang ste⑪/ 'di rnams kyis snyisangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad dang / lha mo rnams dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyang nam mkha' la yid las skyes pa'i me tog la sogs pa rnams kyis mchod par bya'o/ /bdag nyid dbul ba dang / gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang / sdog pa bshags pa dang / bsod nams la rjes su yi rang ba rnams bya'o/ /de nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang / spyan ma la sogs pa rnams kyang nam mkha' la spro zhing bsdu ba thun mtshams med par bya'o/ /de bzhin du bsgom pa ni 'jug pa'i sems bskyed pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /de nas oṃ swa bhā wa shurnya sru dharmāgrwa bhā wa shustolhahaṃ⑤/ zhes pa'i tshigs su bcad pa bklag 40—879

par bya'o/ /de la bdag nyid gcig pu bzhin du blta zhing bar snang la 'phro bzhin pa'i bdud rtsi'i tshogs pa bzhin du dri ma med cing zla ba yongs su gang ba lta bu cha shas kyi tshogs pa thams cad yongs su gang ba 'bar zhing 'bar ba bltas nas de nas oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na dhibadz+ra swa bhā wa a kopho②haṃ/ zhes brjod par bya'o—/ /bdag nyid bltas nas gzugs med cing 'du shes kyi rang bzhin med pa ste/ 'on kyang 'od zer gyi tshogs pa lta bu 'ba' zhig 'phro ba zhes de bzhin du bsams nas yang a yig yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la de nas dhīḥyig de dang 'dra ba ①bsams nas/ de yongs su gyur pa las sna tshogs pad+ma⑦/de'i dbus su ha ⑤yig bltas la a yig la sogs pa dbyangs yig bcu drug gis bskor ba la de bzhin du ka yig la sogs pa'i yi ge sum cu rtsa gnyis ha yig la sogs pa thams cad kyang dkar po'o/ /de bzhin du de'i 'dab ma la sgeg mo dang / phreng ba ma dang / glu ma dang / gar ma dang / me tog ma dang /bdug spos ma dang / mar me ma dang / dri chab rjom ste rnal 'byor ma brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba'o/ /de thams cad kyang yongs su gyur pa las ye shes kyi zla ba bskyed de/ de las skyes pa'i pad+ma la/ de'i steng du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i puste'o⑦/ /slar yang de'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ de'i steng du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i puste ⑧gnyis pa'o/ /be+er yang de thams cad yongs su gyur pa las sna tshogs pad+ma la bzhugs pa chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya can gser gyi mdog lta bu yan lag thams cad la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis ⑨rgyan du mdzad pa/ yang g.yon dang g.yas na at+pa la dang bcas pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i puste gnyis pa ⑩bsnams pa/ de bzhin 40—880

gshegs pa lnga'i dbu rgyan can/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i sras kyis yongs su bskor ba/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las ①nye bar 'khrungs pa ste/ de lta bu'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma ②bsgom par bya'o/ /gang gi tshe bsam gtan mi nus na de'i tshe sngags bzlas par bya'o/ /oṃ 66④dhīḥhūṃ swā hā/zhes so/ /bzlas pa'i dus su yang dpral bar oṃ yig ser por ④blta bar bya'o//de bzhin du mgrin par wabyuyig dkar po'o/ /yang thugs kar dhīḥyig ser po'o//yang lte bar hūṃ yig sngon rjopo'o/ /zhes so/ /shes rab pha rol phyin ma ⑥yi/ /lha mo 'di bzhin sgom byed pa/ /blo ldan gang zhig kun mkhyen gyi/ /go 'phang thob ⑦'gyur the tshom med/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i sgrub thabs slob dpon 'phags pa thogs med kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// ⑤//bsdur mchan/877 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7/ 1〈'ar 〉〉pa/ pya〈〈pe 〉༅ra/ 〈'ar 〉༅ra/ du〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thazhag ⑥⑦〈〈pe〉sko〈snar 〉7ya/878 sti〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉rnyi/ ②〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉ra/ ①〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉7logs/ ④〈〈pe〉sko'ar 〉riḥ/rjo〈〈pe 〉sngasar 〉7ye/ rjo〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉dz+radhi ye/ rma.ā hūṃ/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7/ ④〈〈pe 〉skosnar 〉7ཿ / ⑨〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉'a/ ⑩〈'ar 〉7snang / ⑪〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉rdza rā/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉zoḥpra1 pa/⑫〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉7lha/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉rdza'i/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈'ar 〉7'khor bar/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉 brnyes/879 ①〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉mis/ sde〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉snga〈co 〉7che/ ①〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉7ste/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉〉kyi/ du〈〈pe 〉tha shurtseḥsarba dharmā ga bhā ba shud sto ha/ 〈'ar 〉tha shusasarba dharmā ga bhā ba shurngo haṃ/88༷ ①〈'ar 〉pho/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7lha/ ①〈〈pe〉sko'ar 〉thar/ ④〈〈pe〉sko〈snar 〉7dang / ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉40byed881

sngag /'phags ma rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs/thu༄spro/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya badz+ra swa ④ra swa tī 1sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/ 'phags ma rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs/ 'phags ma rdo rje dbyangs can ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas gsungs gsal rjosbyin yon tan rang bzhin rdo rje dbyangs can mar ⑤btud nas/ /rang la phan pa yang dag sgrub mdzad mdzes pa'i nyams ldan rtsod pas thub par dka' mdzad ma/ /de yi sgrub thabs 'di pyani kun nas yang dag mi bzad mi shes mun pa 'joms mdzad pa/ /blo ngan rnams kyis ⑦rtogs phyir sems can phan phyir legs par gsungs pa'i cho gas bshad par bya/ /dang por snga bar kha la sogs pa dag pa'i rang bzhin snying rje dang ldan bzod ldan pas/ /sngags pas gtsang ba'i stan la byams pa'i dga' bas myos shing gang zhig dga' ba dang ldan pas/ /gnas kyang yid du 'ong zhing dbe+en par yang ni rang gi snying gar chu skyes blta zu40byed883

bar bya/ /de las sprul pa las byung ri bong 'dzin pa yang dag bsgom par bya'o ①de la yang / /do④ཿyig 'od zer rnams kyis phyogs dang bar rnams kyang ni 1'di yis yongs su gang bar gyur/ /de nas sangs rgyas tshogs rnams mdun du bltas nas 'dir ni mchod pa la sogs bsgom par bya/ /me tog la sogs de nas phyag 'tshal slar yang 'dir ni sdig pa rab tu bshags par bya/ /de bzhin bsod nams rjes su yi rang sngags rig pa yis gsum la skyabs su yang dag 'gro//zhes pa la sogs smon lam legs btab de yis bdag nyid kyang ni dmigs pa rab tu bya/ /gcig dang du ma dang bral rang bzhin yongs su brjod pa dri med yang dag shes rtogs pa/ /de nas sna tshogs rnam rtog dra ba ma lus thams cad stong pa nyid du bsgom par bya'orjo/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā ⑤na badz+ra swa bhā wa rjoyi kolhakluhaṃ—/ stong pa nyid las byung ba chu skyes dang ni zla ba la gnas doḥskeyig dmar po ste—/ /slar yang sna tshogs 'od zer tshogs rnams shin tu mdzes par gyur pa'i pad+ma 'dab brgyad pa/ /de la dmar zhing 'od zer chen po dang ldan bcom ldan 'das ma mdzes pa'i rgyan kyis brgyan/ /g.yon brkyang ba yi zhabs kyis yang dag gnas shing zhal gsum phyag drug gis ni rab brgyan pa/ /g.yas pa'i zhal ni sngo zhing phyag na pad+ma ral gri gri gug ⑨rab tu bsnams pa ste/ /g.yon zhal dkar zhing phyag na lhung bzed dang bcas rin chen bzang dang 'khor lo de bzhin no/ /snying gar pad+ma la gnas zla ba'i dbus su gnas pa'i der yang doḥyig 'od gsal bas/ /sna tshogs mi shes mun pa 'joms pa'i 'od zer gyis ni 'gro ba ma lus 'gengs mdzad pa/ /yang dag bsdus la rang gi snying gar zla ba la gnas sa bon bltas la slar yang spyo/ /de nyid yang dang yang du rtag tu 40—884

snyom ① las med par nyi ma so sor bsam par bya/ /bsam gtan ngal na sa bon mnyam skyes bsdus la sngags 'di yis ni bzlas pa rab tu bya/ /do shal g.yo zhing nyin byed rim pas 'byung ba'i yid bzhin du ni sngags kyis bzlas par bya'o⑤//oṃ pi tsu pi tsu pradzñā wadzha ⑧ni/ dz+wa la dz+wa ④la/ me dha war+bha buni/ rnyi ri dhi ri budhi wasnya duni swā hā/ thun mtshams thams cad du ni lha mo'i sku la yid ni rtag tu rab tu dga' ba yis/ /yang dag gsungs pa'i cho gas sems can rnams kyi don gyur ④sngags 'di yongs su bzlas par bya/ /bsod nams kyang ni yongs su bsngo bya dgos pa byed na bsam gtan rtse gcig gnas par spyod/ /ji srid 'bum phrag yongs su ma rdzogs pa'am rdzogs nas kyang ni las kyi rim bzhin bya/ /rnam pa thams cad du ni mi mthun phyogs su nye bar yang yang de nyid bsam gtan byed—/ /dkar po'i tshes gcig nas ni shin tu dge ba'i yid kyis ji srid zla ba gnas kyi bar/ /de srid legs sbyar de bzhin nub re bzhin du ji srid zla ba gang ba bzhin du bya/ /de nyid kyi ni mtshan mo thub par dka' ba'i snyan ngag mkhan gyi dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /gang zhig dpal ⑧ldan gshin rje gshed kyi rgyud la ⑨gnas shing dpal ldan nag po'i gzi brjid kyis/ /dpal ldan rdo rje dbyangs can bcom ldan 'das ma de yi yang dag sgrub pa'i thabs gyur pa/ /sems can rnams la phan pa'i don du bdag gis brtsams pa'i bsod nams yang dag thob gyur pa/ /de yis 'gro rnams nag po lta bur thub par dka' ba'i snyan ngag mkhan du grub ⑩par shog /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor dpal 'dzin kyis/ /dpal ldan rdo rje dbyangs can gyi/ /'joms byed mthar ni byed pa yi/ /sgrub pa'i thabs ni legs byas so/ /'phags ma rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs 40byed885

slob dpon dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/882 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉gag /'phags ma rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉snga/ ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉masto/ rjo〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gsung la/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa/ rjo〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉toradir/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾po ra 〉7)/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lta/884 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉skrun/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉rna ho/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉wani/ 0〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉rgya/ ⑤〈〈snar 〉〉’/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉wahwa/ ni〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉mi ཿ/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉skabug885 ①〈〈snar 〉snostoms/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gra/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉balha/ ④〈〈pe 〉྾po ra 〉mdza la dza ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasnya/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉burnyi bsgo/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉sko'adir 〉7)sa don 'gyur/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉dang /⑨〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉wal/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉toragrub/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2175)40wa 886

༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā swa ra swa tī sā ④dha dz+wa/ bod skad du/dbyangs can ma chen mo'i sgrub thabs/ 'phags ma dbyangs can ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngon du gsungs pa'i cho gas 'dir stong pa nyid ji srid mngon du byas shing gnas nas chu skyes dkar po khru bdun gyi tshad tsam/ de'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i dbus su trīḥyig dkar po/ de las chu skyes dkar po la rang gi sa bon gyi snying po can bsgom par bya'o/ /de las yang bcom ldan 'das ma dbyangs can ma chen mo rjes su bsam par bya'o/ /ston ka'i zla ba'i 'od kyi rnam pa can/ chu skyes dkar po la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs pa/phyag g.yas pa mchog sbyin pa/ g.yon pa sdong bu dang bcas pa'i chu skyes dkar po bsnams pa/ zhal 'dzum zhing shin tu brtse ba'i bdag nyid can/tsan+dan dkar po dang me tog gi na bza' mnabs pa/ mu tig gi do shal gyis 40—887

thugs ka nye bar mdzes pa rin po che sna tshogs kyi rgyan dang ldan pa lo bcu gnyis kyi rnam pa can/ nu ma 'bur zhing nang rgyas pa/ rked pa byin gyis phra ba/nang nas 'od zer kyi tshogs 'phro bas 'jig rten gsum po snang bar mdzad pa'o/ /de nas de'i mdun du bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab ma'o/ /g.yas su blo can ma'o—/ /rgyab tu blo gros ma'o/ /g.yon du dran pa ma'o/ /'di rnams rang gi gtso mo dang sku mdog la sogs pa mtshungs shing / zhal mngon par phyogs pas bzhugs par bsam par bya'o/ /de nas rang gi lte ba'i phyogs su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ①la oṃ yig dkar po bsgoms nas de las byung ba'i ngag gi rang bzhin ma lus pa'i phreng ba ④bar ma chad pa rab tu 'bab bzhin pa bsams nas sngags kun nas bzlas par bya'o/ /de la sngags ni 'di'o/ /oṃ byāḥm hā mā yi ge ma hā swa ra swa bye na maḥde bzhin du gso sbyong blangs nas mi smra bar gnas nas rgyun du lha'i nga rgyal dang bcas pas sngags bzlas shing las gzhan mi byed pas zla ba gcig gis dbyangs can ma'i ngag thob par 'gyur ro/ /zla ba gsum gyis tshangs par spyod pa nyams pas ④kyang 'grub po/ /zla ba drug gis dbyangs can ma dang mtshungs par 'gyur ro zhes so/ /de nas sman brjod par bya ste/ ra'i 'o ma dang / a ru ra dang / tsha ba gsum dang / ma nu pa tra ⑦dang / shu dag dang / se ⑤'bru dang / rgyam tsha rnams mar la lan bdun mngon par bsngags nas 'thungs na/ dbyangs can ma'i dngos grub tu 'gyur ro/ /yon tan bzhi 'gyur ra du'o ma⑦/ /mar bcug nas ni btso bar bya/ /blo ldan mi ⑧ni dal 'jam gyis/ /sman ni tshos pa tsam gyis so/ /zla ba gcig tsam rab sbyor bas/ /bla med dag ni thob par 'gyur/ /zla ba drug tu las 40—888

༄ga /rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra swa ra swa s+t+ri 1sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs/ 'phags ma dbyangs can ma la phyag 'tshal lo—/ /sngon du gsungs pa'i cho gas snying gar chu skyes dmar po ①zla ba la doḥyig dmar po'i sa bon yongs su gyur pa las chu skyes dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa la rang gi sa bon kyi snying po can/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje dbyangs can ma zhal gsum pa④/ phyag drug pa/ sku mdog dmar mo spyan gsum ma/ sngon po dang dkar po ⑤ni g.yas dang g.yon gyi zhal lo/ /pad+ma dang / ral gri dang / gri gug rnams phyag g.yas pa rnams ⑦na bsnams pa—/ thod pa dang / rin po che dang / 'khor lo rnams phyag g.yon pa rnams na bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i gzhon nu ma'i lang tsho dang ldan pa/ rgyan sna tshogs pa 'chang ba/ thugs kar gnas pa'i sa bon gyi 40—890

mtshan mas gzhan gyi don mdzad par spro ba'i bdag nyid bsgoms nas/ skyes pi tsu pi tsu pradzñā bsnya ni/ dz+wa la dz+wa ①la me dha bsnya ni/ dhi ri dhi ri bu dhi ②bsnya ni swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags bzlas par bya'o/ /rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs cardogs so// //bsdur mchan/89 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉dzesnar 〉lte/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〉dang / ④〈〈pe 〉snga'adir 〉〉wapa/ 0〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉glo/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈'dzir 〉bornams/891 ①〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉mdza la dza/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉burtse/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2177)40wa 891

༄ga /rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra swa ra swa tī ②sā dha rna/ bod skad du/rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje dbyangs can ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal stug ston ka'i bdud rtsi'i 'od/ /ku mu da bzhin ①bla med gang / /'gro ba'i mi shes mun zhi mdzad/ /rgyal gyur rdo rje dbyangs can ma/ /de yi man ngag nyer bsdus nas/ /de yi sgrub thabs brjod par bya/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi rdo rje gur/ /kun nas bstan rjopa brjod par bya/ /gtsang zhing yid 'ong gnas su ni/ /bde ba'i stan la 'dug nas ni/ /dad cing las gzhan med pa yis/ /rjes 'jug thun mtshams gsum du bsgom/ /brtse ⑤ba'i mthu yis rdzogs byang chub/ /smon lam yongs su 'dren pa yis/ /rmi lam sgyu ma'i dpe bzhin du/ /khams gsum ma lus brtag par bya/ /nyi rjozla sa bon 'od zer gyis—/ /de bzhin gshegs rnams gdan drangs nas/ /kun la phan 'dod 40—892
