༄ga /rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan gyi sgrub thabs/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ dh+wa dzā gra ke ②yu rā sā dha rna/ bod skad du—/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan gyi sgrub thabs/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan sku mdog nag mo/zhal gsum pa/ phyag bzhi pa/ dmar po dang ljang gu ni g.yas dang g.yon gyi zhal lo/ /phyag g.yas pa gnyis na ral gri dang / zhags pa'o①/ /rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang / 'khor lo dag phyag g.yon pa dag na bsnams pa'o—/ /dbu skra kham pa gyen du badze+es pa/ thod pa skam po lngas dbu brgyan pa—/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhal mche ba gcigs rjoshing lto 'phyang ba/ nyi ma'i gdan la zhabs g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ 'od zer dang ldan pa'o/ /gos ser po'i sha 'gag can/ sa bon ni hūṃ yig go/ /mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa can no/ /rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan gyi sgrub 40byed1036

thabs rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/1༷36 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉snga'adir 〉sto// ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈'dir 〉〉pa bsnams pa/ rjo〈〈snar 〉〉gcigabasdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2216)40wa 1037

༄ga /gzhan gyis mi thub ma'i sgrub thabs/①༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ a pa ②rā dzi tā sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/gzhan gyis mi thub ma'i ④sgrub thabs/ 'phags ma gzhan gyis mi thub ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhan gyis mi thub ma sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig pa rjophyag gnyis pa/ rin po che sna tshogs pa'i rgyan gyis nye bar mdzes pa/ tshogs bdag yang dag par gnon pa/ phyag g.yas pa thal lcag brdeg ༷pa'i tshul du byas pa/ phyag g.yon pa zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub thugs kar gnas pa/ zhal mche ba gcigs shing shin tu 'jigs par byed pa ma lus pa'i bdud 'joms pa/ tshangs pa la sogs pa'i gdug pa can gyi drag po'i lha rnams kyis bskor zhing gdugs bgreng ba'o zhes so/ /gzhan gyis mi thub ma'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //40—1038

bsdur mchan/1༷38 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉snyi/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7'i/ rjo〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stab/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉skardogabasdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2217)40wa 1039

༄ga /rdo rje gasnya rī'i sgrub thabs/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra garnya rī ⑤sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/ rdo rje garnya rī'i ①sgrub thabs/ 'phags ma rdo rje gān+t+ra rī rjol phyag 'tshal lo rdo rje gan+ta rī rjonag mo zhal drug pa/ phyag bcu gnyis pa/ dbu skra kham pa gyen du badze+es shing zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'o/ /zhal mche ba gcigs pa/ zhal so so la spyan gsum gsum pa/ phyag g.yas pa drug na go rims bzhin du rdo rje dang /skyodril bu dang / ral gri dang / tri shu ⑦la dang / mda' dang 'khor lo rnams bsnams pa/ phyag g.yon pa drug na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang / lcags kyu dang / gzhu dang / dgra sta dang / zhags pa dang / snying gar sdigs mdzub 'phyar ba'o//zhal dang po ni nag po'o/ /zhal gzhan rnams ni ④kha dog lnga ste/ dkar po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / ljang gu dang / sngon po'o/ /sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o/ / bzla ba'i ⑨sngags ni/ oṃ 40byed1040

lha/ ༷/ lha/ swā hā/ zhes so/ /rdo rje gad+dha rī'i ①sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //ba ra mchan/1༷4 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉gag /rdo rje gā na dha ri'i sgrub thabs gnyis bzhugs so// ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ri/ ⑧du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉shān dha rī/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈'dir 〉〉yin dha ri/ 0〈〈pe 〉lo'ar 〉〉jirdo rje/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉〉zhu/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉sko'adir 〉lhu ni/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈'ar 〉thazlas pa'i/1 41 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉klan dha ri'i/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2218)40wa 1041

༄ga /rdo rje garnya rī'i sgrub thabs/①༄spro/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra garnya rī ④sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/ rdo rje garnya rī'i ④sgrub thabs/ rdo rje garnya rī ④la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje gārnya rī penag mo zhal drug pa/ phyag bcu gnyis pa/ dbu skra kham pa gyen du badze+es shing zhabs g.yon brkyang ba/ zhal mche ba gcigs pa/ zhal so so la spyan gsum gsum pa/ g.yas kyi phyag drug rnams su go rims bzhin du rdo rje dang / rdo rje dril bu dang / ral gri dang / rtse gsum dang/ mda' dang / 'khor lo rnams so/ /g.yon gyi phyag drug rnams su kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang / lcags kyu dang gzhu dang / dgra sta dang / zhags pa dang / snying gar shrīgs mdzub 'phyar ba'o—/ /zhal dang po ni nag po'o/ /zhal gzhan lnga ni kha dog lnga ste/ dkar po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / ljang gu dang / sngon po'o/ /sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o/ /'di la yang gzungs 'di'o//40byed1042

na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na maḥtsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta ①ye/ na mo bha ga wa ti ma hā badz+ra garnya rī ④a de ka sha ta sā ha sra pra dz+wa li ta dīste dz+wa li ta dīste ①dzā yi u gra dz+rī ma bha yān kā ma yo gī nī ma bhi rjoṣa ma bha gi nī yi dwa ⑤da sha byu dza ma bi tīr+ṇa ke shī ye a ne+e ka rū pa bi bi dha be+e sha dha ra bhā yi e bye hi bha ga wa tī rjom hā badz+ra garnya rī ⑦tra ya ṭ+wāṃ rat+na ⑧māṃ sa bye na ā kasgye a kasgru ⑨ba la de wā di rka ye tsā bye sa ma ye na tiṣ+ṭha na ti tā nā brta yi sgyu ⑫mi/ shī rgyu kṛṇ+ḍa kṛṇ+ḍa ⑩oṃ a li a li hu lu hu lu mu lu myu lu tsu lu tsu lu dha ma dha ma ⑫ram̐ ga ram̐ ga ram̐ gā pa ya ram̐ gā pa ya pū ra ya pū ra ya/ ā bi ⑫sha ā bi sha bha ④ga ba tī spyom hā badz+ra garnya rī sirnya tsaṇ+ḍa ⑩badz+ra pā ṇi rā dzñā pa ya ⑩ti tweḥha ha hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ 'di'i las rab tu brkyang pa ni cho ga 'di las so/ /rdo rje garnya rī'i ⑫sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //40—1043

ras /bsrung ba lnga'i cho ga①༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ pañtsa rak+ṣa bi dhiḥ⑪/ bod skad du/bsrung ba lnga'i cho ga① /'phags ma so so ④'brang ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang por re zhig sngags pas zhal bsang ba la sogs pa byas nas yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su stan bde ba la nye bar 'dug ste/ oṃ āḥrak+ṣaḥkhya rak+ṣa hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/zhes pas rnal 'byor pa'i gnas dang bdag nyid bsrung zhing lhag par gnas par bya'o—/ /de nas rang gi thugs kar a yig las skyes pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la—/ de'i steng du paṃ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams snang bar mdzad nas mdun du bltas te so so ⑪'brang ma chen mo la sogs pa'i 'khor dang bcas pa mchod par bya'o/ /me tog dang / bdug spos dang / mar me dang / dri bzangs dang / gtor ma dang / zhal zas la sogs pa rnams phul nas sdig pa so sor bshags pa dang /40byed1045

dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang / byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su bsngo ba dang / bzod pa ①gsol ba rnams bya'o / /de nas tshad med pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom par bya ste/ de la sdug bsngal ba rnams 'don par 'dod pa'i snying rje dang / bde ba la rab tu dgod pa'i byams pa dang / bde ba la gnas pa nyid kyis dga' ba dang / de bzhin nyid kyi ngo bo nyid kyis gtang ①snyoms su bya'o/ /de nas chos thams cad la yid kyis dmigs nas rnam par mi rtog pa rnam par bsgoms te/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā ④wa a kolhabuhaṃ zhes so/ /de nas hūṃ yig gis sa gzhi sna tshogs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du byin kyis brlab par bya'o/ /de nas de bzhin du rdo rje'i gur dang / rdo rje'i ra ba dang / rdo rje'i bla bye yang rjornam par bsam par bya'o/ /de'i dbus su sum̐ yig yongs su gyur pa las ri bo mchog rab thar pa chen po'i grong khyer du gyur pa me tog sna tshogs mngon par bkram pas so/ /de'i steng du hūṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las/ sna tshogs rdo rje la paṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las/ sna tshogs pad+ma ge sar dang bcas pa'i ze'u rjo'abru la/ de'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su pre yig las 'od zer yang dag par 'phro ba—/ des ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid spyan drangs nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang lhan cig tu byas nas sa bon yongs su gyur pa las 'chad par 'gyur ba'i sku mdog gi rnam pa can dang ro gcig tu gyur nas so so 'brang ba ⑦chen mo sku mdog dkar mo lo brgyad gnyis lon pa'i rnam pa can spyi bor zla ba'i gdan la mchod rten gyis brgyan pa/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la zhabs g.yas brkyang skyikha krung phyed pas bzhugs pa/ zhal bzhi pa/ spyan gsum pa/ phyag brgyad pa/40—1046

rna rgyan ①g.yo bas mdzes shing do shal dang rkang gdub kyis brgyan pa/ phyag gdub dang / dpung rgyan dang / ska rags kyis mdzes shing rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ bcom ldan 'das ma de'i zhal dang po ni sku mdog ltar dkar po—/ g.yas nag po/ rgyab ser po/ g.yon dmar po'o/ /g.yas kyi phyag dang po na 'khor lo/ gnyis pa na rdo rje/ gsum pa na mda' dang ①/ bzhi pa na ral gri/ g.yon kyi phyag dang po na rdo rje'i zhags pa/ gnyis pa na rtse gsum—/ gsum pa na gzhu/ bzhi pa na dgra sta'o/ /byang chub kyi shing gis nye bar mdzes pa/ sna tshogs pa'i rin po che'i me tog dang 'bras bu la sogs pas brgyan pa/ tshangs pa dang / khyab 'jug dang / dbang phyug ④chen po dang / dga' byed dbang phyug la sogs pa rnams kyis yang dag par bstod pa dang lha dang klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za rnams kyis g.yas phyogs nas yang dag par bsnyen bkur bar rjobyed pa/ dbang po dang / gshin rje dang / chu bdag dang / rnam thos sras dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po la sogs pa rnams dang /lha rnams kyis bstod pa⑤/ 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang gti mug gi bag chags las skyes pa'i rjornam par smin pa rnams gcod par mdzad pa/ gsang sngags mchog gi phyag rgyas dug dang byad stems ⑦rnams 'joms shing phye mar mdzad pa/ zhe sdang rab tu sbyor ba'i mngon spyod kyis kyang gdug pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams rnam par 'joms par mdzad pa/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams yang dag pa'i mchod pa rnams kyis mngon par dga' ba rnams yongs su skyong bar mdzad pa/ theg pa 40—1047

chen po len pa dang / yi ge 'dri ba dang / klog pa dang / 'chang ba dang /kha ton byed pa dang / nyan pa dang / 'dzin pa dang mngon par ldan pa rnams la yongs su skyong bar mdzad pa de lta bur gyur pa'i bcom ldan 'das ma spro ba dang bsdu ba'i sbyor bas dus rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par goms shing blta bar bya'o—/ /de'i bzlas pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ ma ṇi dha ri badz+re ①ṇi ma hā pra ti sā ⑤re hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ so so ①'thang ma chen mo de'i shar phyogs su ji lta rjob de bzhin du sngon ma'i sbyor bas lhag par byas te/ sna tshogs pad+ma'i dbus su hūṃ yig gi sa bon dang mtshan ma yongs su gyur pa las stong chen mo rab tu 'joms ma ⑤sku mdog nag mo dbu skra kham pa gyen du badze+es pa mi'i thod pas brgyan pa smin mtshams su khro gnyer bsdus shing zhal mche ba gcigs pa/ 'od zer 'phro ba nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan la rol pa'i stabs kyis 'byung po chen po dang /gnod sbyin chen po kun nas gnon pa/ phyag gdub dang / dpung rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ do shal dang / zhabs gdub kyis mjes pa/ de'i phyag g.yas kyi dang po na mchog sbyin dang rdo rje/ gnyis pa na lcags kyu/ gsum pa na mda'—/ bzhi pa na ral gri/ phyag g.yon gyi dang po na sdogs mdzub dang zhags pa⑥/ gnyis pa na dgra sta/ gsum pa na gzhu/ bzhi pa na pad+ma'i steng du rin po che cha drug pa'o/ /de'i rtsa ba'i zhal nag po/ g.yas dkar po/rgyab ser po/ g.yon ljang gu/ thams cad spyan gsum gsum pa④/ sku la rin po che la sogs pa sna tshogs pas brgyan pa/ pha rol gyi stobs chen po gnon pa—/ drag skemo'i cha lugs can/ n+ya gro dha'i shing ljon pas ⑨nye bar mdzes pa ma mo bdun la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams ⑩skrag par mdzad pa/ nam gru la sogs 40—1048

pa'i mi ①rnams 'joms par mdzad pa/ nor rgyas la sogs pa'i klu rnams ④yang dag par skrag par mdzad pa/ rlung dang mkhris ①pa dang bad kan la sogs pa rnams sbyong bar mdzad pa/ drag po'i mun pa stug po'i sprin rnams sel bar mdzad pa/ 'chi bdag thams cad zad par byed pa'o/ /de'i bzlas pa'i sngags ni oṃ a mṛ ta ba ri ba ra ba ra pra ba ra bi shurte hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/de nas so so rjo'abrang ma chen mo'i lho phyogs su sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su me yig gi sa bon yongs su gyur pa las skad cig gis rma bya chen mo sku mdog ser mo nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la zhabs g.yas brkyang ba'i sems dpa'i byas krung gis bzhugs pa/ zhal gsum pa spyan gsum pa/ phyag brgyad pa/ rin po che'i cod pan can rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ de'i g.yas kyi phyag dang po na mchog sbyin/ gnyis pa na rin po che'i bum pa bsnams pa—/ gsum pa na 'khor lo/ bzhi pa na ral gri'o/ /g.yon gyi phyag dang po na lhung bzed kyi steng na dge slong / gnyis pa na rma bya'i mdongs/ gsum pa na bum pa'i steng na sna tshogs rdo rje/ bzhi pa na rin po che'i rgyal mtshan no/ /de nas rtsa ba'i zhal ni ser po/ g.yas nag po/ g.yon dmar po'o/ /mya ngan med pa'i shing ljon pas nye bar mdzes pa'o/ /de'i logs na gnas pa'i ⑤bi sheḥbadun gyis g.yogs pa/ drag po dang bcas pa'i ser skya la sogs pa'i srin po rnams 'joms par mdzad pa klu la sogs pa thams cad skrag par mdzad pa—/ lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za rnams kyis phyag bya ba'i 'os su gyur pa/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa bdun dang bcas pa'i gza' dgu dhil sogs pa rnams kyis bsnyen bkur bya ba'i 'os su gyur pa/ brtan pa dang g.yo 40byed104 9

ba'i dug thams cad ①rnam par grol ba/ lha dang bcas pa'i lha ma yin rnams yang dag par rmongs par mdzad pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das ma de'i bzlas pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ a mṛ ta bi lo ki ni gasgo saṃ rak+ṣa ā kar+ṣa ni ④hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā zhes so/ /so so ④'brang ma de'i nub phyogs su sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su oṃ yig gi sa bon yongs su gyur pa las skyes pa'i gsang sngags rjes su 'dzin ma bsgom par bya ste/ sku mdog dkar mo zhal gsum pa/spyan gsum pa/ phyag bcu gnyis pa nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od 'phro ba la g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ rin po che'i cod pan can/ rgyan thams cad kyis mdzes shing lang tsho gzhon nu dang ldan pa/ do shal dang / rkang gdub dang / rna rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ shi ri rjoshā'i shing ljon pas nye bar mdzes pa/de'i phyag dang po chos kyi 'khor lo'i phyag rgya/ gnyis pa ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya—/ gsum pa mchog sbyin/ bzhi pa mi 'jigs pa/ lnga pa ⑤rdo rje/drug pa na mda'o/ /g.yon kyi gsum pa sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/bzhi pa na gzhu bu/ lnga pa na rin po che'i dog pa/ drug pa na pad+mas mtshan pa'i chu skyes so/ /rtsa ba'i zhal dkar po/ g.yas nag po/ g.yon dmar po'o/ /me tog sna tshogs pa mngon par bkram pa/ 'jig rten skyong ba brgyad la sogs pa dang bcas pa'i lha rnams kyis yang dag par mchod pa'i 'os su gyur pa/ rgyal po chen po bzhi dang bcas pa'i lha'i tshogs rnams kyis yang dag par bstod pa/me tog mo ⑦dang bcas pa'i rig 'dzin ma rnams kyis mchod pa'o/ /de'i bzlas pa'i sngags ni oṃ bi ma le bi pu le dza ya ba re a mṛ te bi ra dze hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā zhes so/ /de nas so so ⑧'brang ma de'i byang phyogs su sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng du 40—1050

zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su tram̐ yig gi sa bon yongs su gyur pa las skyes pa'i bsil ba'i tshal chen mo sku mdog ljang gu nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ zhal gsum ma/ spyan gsum ma/ phyag drug pa/de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbu rgyan can/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing lha'i na bzas nye bar spras pa'o/ /de'i phyag dang po mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya/ gnyis pa na rdo rje/ gsum pa na mda'o/ /g.yon kyi dang po zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub/ gnyis pa na gzhu/ gsum pa na rin po che'i rgyal mtshan no—/ /rtsa ba'i zhal ljang gu/ g.yas pa dkar po/ g.yon pa dmar po'o/ /tsam pa ka'i shing ljon pas nye bar mdzes pa/ 'dod lha dang bcas pa'i lha rnams kyis mchod cing bstod pa/ 'phrog ma dang bcas pa'i gnod sbyin dang gnod sbyin mo rnams rnam par 'joms par mdzad pa/ bya rog dang / 'ug pa dang / bya rgod dang / khra dang / ka po ra la sogs pa rnams 'joms shing 'ded par mdzad pa/ 'byung po dang / yi dwags dang / sha za dang / ro langs dang / srin po la sogs pa dang bcas pa rnams yang dag par rmongs par mdzad pa'o/ /de'i bzlas pa'i sngags ni oṃ bha ra bha ra/ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra/ im+bi ya ba la bi sho dha ni hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa①/ de bzhin du ji ltar gsungs pa'i maṇ+ḍal rnam par bsgoms nas/ de'i 'od zer gyi tshogs kyis khyab pa las rang rang gi sa bon las byung ba'i 'od zer gyis khams gsum ma lus pa mngon par khyab nas de la de bzhin du yi ge la rab tu gzhug par bya'o/ /slar yang nam mkha'i mthongs su spros nas ye shes kyi 'khor lo spyan drangs nas yang dag par bstod cing gdan drangs pa rang gi dam tshig gi 'khor lo la ②rab 40—1051

tu gzhug par bya'o/ /de nas gnyis su med cing ro gcig tu gyur par rnam par bsgoms la/ de'i 'od zer rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gdan drangs te yang dag par mchod nas dbang bskur ①bar gsol ba btab nas bdag nyid la dbang bskur bar blta bar bya'o/ /mchod pa dang / bstod pa dang / bdud rtsi myang ba sngon du 'gro bas mkhas pas bsgom par bya'o/ /mig la gti mug rdo rje so so ②'brang ma chen mo'o/ /rna ba la zhe sdang rdo rje stong chen mo rab tu 'joms pa chen mo'o/ /sna la ser sna rdo rje rma bya chen mo'o/ /zhal la 'dod chags rdo rje gsang sngags rjes su 'dzin ma ①chen mo'o/ /reg bya la phrag dog rdo rje bsil ba'i tshal chen mo'o/ /de bzhin du gzugs dang / tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa rnams te/phung po dang / khams dang / skye mched kyi rang bzhin rnams la de bzhin du lha rnams kyi rnam par dag pa'i khyad par shes par bya'o/ /de la de lta bu'i dam tshig tu gyur pas cho ga 'dis sngags bzlas par bya'o/ /gong gi sngags kyi yi ge brjod par bya ba de'i lha'i sbyor bas bsgrub bya'i ming spel nas zhi ba'i sems kyis rgyun mi 'chad par bzlas par bya'o/ /rims dang / dug dang / de bzhin du nad dang / g.yul la yang de bzhin du bya'o/ /mkha' 'gro ma dang /'byung po dang / rmugs byed dang / gtsang po dang / dgras rab tu 'tshe ba dang / thog dang / skar mda' lhung ba'i 'jigs pa rnams la ri dang /nags dang / lam dag tu de'i sngags dran pas rtag tu bag tsha ba thams cad sel bar byed do/ /de la rim ④pa 'di bzhin du/ /sems can kun la phan don phyir/ /sems can kun la phan 'byung ba/ /gang dang gang gis gsol 40—1052

'debs pa/ /de yi tshe ni 'phel ba'i rgyu/ /bsrung ba lnga yi cho ga 'dis/ /bde legs 'byung ba bdag gis bri/ /sems can kun la phan don phyir/ /dge ba'i maṇ+ḍal zlum po bri/ /sa phyogs gtsang zhing nyams dga' bar/ /ba yi lci ①bas nye bar byugs/ /bla re yis ni stod g.yogs shing / /rnam pa sna tshogs gos rnams bcad/ /tsan+dan khyad par can dag dang / /dri bzangs dag gis kun nas byugs/ /sor mo nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi/ /maṇ+ḍal zlum por bri bar bya/ /de nas rdul tshon dkar po yis/ /zhi ba'i las la rab tu bsngags/ /ze'u ④'bru ge sar dang bcas pa'i/ /pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad par bya/ /bum pa lnga ni yang dag dgod/ /me tog phreng ba gos kyis mdzes/ /lo ma dag gis kha brgyan cing / /gdugs dang ba dan yang dag ldan/ /puste ④dang ni chos dbyings dang / /bris sku mdun du yang dag bkram⑦/ /me tog spos dang dri dang ni/ /gtor ma zhal zas dbul bar bya/ /drur ⑤ba kun dang yang dag sbyor—/ /me tog dkar po khyad 'phags rnams/ /phyogs dang phyogs mtshalas lha rnams kyi/ /cho ga ji bzhin mchod par bya/ /zan dang bu ram me tog dkar/ /'o ma yi ni bye brag rnams/ /shar phyogs gnas su dgod byas nas—/ /dri za rnams la gtor ma dbul/ /til nag dang ni chang gis bkang //sha dang nya sha sgog pa rnams/ /lho phyogs su ni yang dag dgod/ /grul bum rnams la gtor ma dbul/ /'o ma zho dang 'o thug dang / /maspru rjon yi bye brag rnams—/ /nub kyi phyogs su yang dag dgod/ /gtor ma chen po klu la 'bulas/ /mon gre'u mud ga rgya sran dang / /dzasru ⑧ṭi dang bur chang rnams/ /byang gi phyogs su yang dag dgod/ /gnod sbyin rnams la gtor ma dbul/ /dbang 40—1053

ldan nas ni brtsams nas ni/ /ji srid rlung ①gi spyod yul bar/ /nag po dmar po ser po dang / /ljang gu'i me tog phreng ba dpyang ②/ /dbus su me tog phreng ba dkar/ /me tog sna tshogs khyad 'phags rnams/ /'o ma khrag gi kham ①phor rnams/ /zho zan dri rnams de bzhin du/ /de bzhin dngos po ma lus rnams/ /ji ltar rigs pas mchod yon dbul/ /'bras bu rtsa ba ji snyed dang / /la du mo da ka chang bu/ /ji skad gsungs bzhin chang bu sogs/ /ka ra 'o ma'i bye brag girjo/ /gtor ma lho yi phyogs su bzhag /mtshan ma brgyad kyis rab mdzes pa/ /de bzhin du yang / chos 'chad pa yi slob dpon dang / /las kyi rdo rje de bzhin du/ /khrus byas gtsang ma'i gos bgo zhing / /de bzhin stan yang gtsang mar 'dod/ /zhal ni shar du mngon phyogs nas/ /smra bcad nas ni rtag tu bklag /dge slong tshul khrims gtsang ma yi/ /bsod snyoms pa rnams mchog tu bsngags/ /sbyin bdag slob dpon gang zhig gis/ /yongs su dag par bklag par bya/ /lan gcig ⑤la sogs brtsams nas ni/ /nyi shu rtsa gcig la sogs bklag /cho ga chad pa la sogs pas/ /bklags pas yang dag 'grub mi 'gyur/ /blo dang brtson 'grus phun tshogs pa/ /brtse bas sems can don brtson pas/ /de yi bubade legs sgrub par ni/ /sngon gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs/ /kha zas dkar pos ston mo byas/ /sha yi bza' ba rnam par spangs⑦/ /bstan bcos kun las mthun par ni/ /kun la sha ni med byas la/ /slob dpon byang du zhal phyogs pas/ /de la las ni yang dag brtsam/ /bsgom pa sngon du gsungs pa bzhin/ /lha rnams so so la dmigs nas/ /mchod cing bstod pa dang ldan pas/ /dril bu dkrol zhing de 40—1054

bzhin la/ /mtha' yas spyod yul sangs rgyas la ni phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /bden pa gsung ①mdzad sangs rgyas la ni phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /bden pa la ni rab gnas rab tu rgyal gyur cig /'dod pa kun las grol zhing 'bras bu dang bcas shog /skyes bu dpa' bo phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /de bzhin gshegs la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /lha rnams kun la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /chos kyi dbyings la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /drur ba kun dang ④yang dag sbyar/ /bsgrub bya'i ming ni sngags kyis spel/ /lha rnams kun ni mchod bya zhing / /chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin du/ /sngags ni lan cig brjod nas ni/ /lan cig sbyor bas mchod par bya/ /khri phrag gcig gi las kyis ni/ /tshe ni kun du 'phel bar rigs④/ /gang dang gang gis gsol 'debs na/ / der ni ④maṇ+ḍal bri bar bya/ /rgyal srid yul dang de bzhin grong / /lhas dang skyed mos tshal de bzhin/ /mi ma yin pa zhugs rjogyur pa'i/ /'chi nad dang ni mu ge rnams—/ /de yi las kyis bsrung bar bya/ /shing skam rjol yang lo 'bras 'byung / /las kyi sdug bsngal bsam mi khyab/ /bya ba gang zhig bsgrub 'dod na//de nas bsrung ba'i cho ga yis/ /nges par srung khyebar byed par 'gyur/ /rlung dang mkhris pa las skyes nad⑧/ /bad kan 'dus pa las gyur pa'i/ /ma lus pa yi nad rnams kun/ /rtag tu bde legs nyid du 'gyur/ /klog dang kha ton sbyor ba yis/ /nges par bgegs rnams med par 'gyur/ /bsrung ba lnga'i cho ga rdzogs so// //40byed1055
brtsar 'azas re'u migasgro/da/ (2220)40wa 1057

༄ga /rdo rje lcags sgog gi sgrub thabs/①༄ga /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra shri kha lā ②sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/rdo rje lcags sgog gi sgrub thabs/ rdo rje lcags sgrog ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngon du gsungs pa'i cho gas/ snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la hūṃ yig ljang gu'i yi ge las skyes pa'i rdo rje lcags sgog ma zhal gsum pa phyag drug pa/ sngon po dang dkar po ni g.yas dang cig shos kyi zhal lo/ /zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum pa rdo rje dang / rdo rje lcags sgog dang mda' rnams g.yas kyi phyag gsum na'o—/ /sdigs mdzub dang / zhags pa dang / gzhu rnams ni g.yon kyi phyag gsum na'o/ /sku mdog ljang ser zhal cung zad bzhad pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ gdug pa can gyi sems can rnams 'dul ba'i bdag nyid du bsams la phyag rgya bcing bar bya'o/ /de la lag pa gnyis so sor khu tshur bcings te mtheb chung dang sdigs mdzub gnyis lcags sgrog gi rnam pa can du 40—1058

bcing bar bya ba ni rdo rje lcags sgrog gi phyag rgya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra shrī kha ①le hūṃ phaṭa swā hā zhes pa ni bzlas pa'o/ /rdo rje lcags sgrog gi sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/1༷58 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉ga / /rdo rje lcags sgrog gi sgrub thabs rims grangs bzhugs so// ②〈〈pe 〉〉zhi kha la/ 〈〈snar 〉〉glokha la/1༷59 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉gyikhā/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2221)40wa 1059

༄ga /rdo rje lcags sgog gi sgrub thabs/sti༄ga /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra shri kha khā sā dha khrurna/ bod skad du/rdo rje lcags sgog gi sgrub thabs/ rdo rje lcags sgog ma ①la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngon du gsungs pa'i cho gas stong pa nyid du bsgoms pa'i rjes la/ sna tshogs chu skyes dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūṃ yig ljang gu rjolas skyes pa'i sku mdog ljang gu zhal gsum pa phyag brgyad pa/ zhal dang po cung zad bzhad pa/ g.yas ser skya la spyan ser skya dang ldan pa/ g.yon pa dmar zhing khro gnyer can mche ba gatshigs pa—/ g.yas kyi phyag bzhi rnams su mi 'jigs pa dang / rdo rje dang / rdo rje lcags sgrog ⑤dang mda' bsnams pa/ g.yon gyi phyag bzhi rnams su khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa dang / sdigs mdzub dang / zhags pa dang / gzhu bsnams pa'o/ /rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ byi la'i pags pas stod g.yogs byas pa/ don yod grub pas dbu brgyan pa/ dbu skra ser skya gyen du 40byed1060

'khyil par bsams la/ skyes badz+ra shri ①kha le lha/ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags bzlas par bya'o/ /'di ni man ngag gi rim pa'i nang nas 'byung ba'i rdo rje lcags sgrog gi sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/1༷'i ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉7gle kha la sā dha/ 〈'dir 〉〉shrī kha la sā dhā/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉mi ma/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉snyer/ ⑤〈'dir 〉skosgogs/1061 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉spyo/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2222)40wa 1061

༄ga /rdo rje lcags sgog gi sgrub thabs kyi cho gasti༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra shri ①kha lā sā dha na u ④pa yi ka /bod skad du/ rdo rje lcags sgrog gi sgrub thabs kyi cho ga /'phags ma rdo rje lcags sgrog ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang por re zhig sngags pas stan bde ba la nye bar 'dug ste/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid do zhes de bzhin du brjod nas/gzhan gang zhig rnams kyang 'dis chos rnams stong pa nyid kyi mthar blta zhing phun sum tshogs par bskyed nas/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba la sogs pa bya'o/ /de nas ji srid sems can dang sems can gyis bsdus pa rnams yang dag par blangs nas bdag gis thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes la dgod par bya'o zhes so/ /de nas snying gar sna tshogs chu skyes/ de'i steng du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khorarjo/ de nas hūṃ yig las skyes pa'i rdo rje lcags sgrog ma'i bdag nyid 'ching ba thams cad gcod pa/ gdug pa'i sems can rnams 40—1062

'dul ba/ sku mdog ljang gu zhal gsum pa/ spyan gsum gsum pa ①g.yas pa'i zhal ser skya la spyan ser skya/ zhal g.yon pa khro gnyer can/ dmar po mche ba gatshigs pa'o/ /zhal dang po cung zad bzhad pa'o/ /phyag brgyad pa g.yas kyi ⑤dang pos mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa/ gnyis pa na rdo rje/ gsum pa na rdo rje ①lcags sgog /bzhi pa na mda'/ g.yon kyi phyag dang po na thod pa khrag gis yongs su gang ba/ gnyis pa na sdigs mdzub/ gsum pa na zhags pa/bzhi pa na gzhu'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi sprin tshogs 'phro ba shin tu rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ byi la'i pags pa'i rjostod g.yogs byas pa'i rdo rje lcags sgrog ma bsgom par bya'o/ /skad cig gis byang chub kyang thob na dngos grub gzhan smos ci dgos/ oṃ badz+ra shri ⑤kha le hūṃ phaṭa swā hā zhes so/ /rdo rje lcags sgrog gi sgrub thabs kyi cho ga rdzogs so// //40—1063

bsdur mchan/1062 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉spyo/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉do/ du〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉jil/1༷63 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈sna ra 〉〉waspyan gsum gsum pa/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉zhephyag ③〈〈pe 〉྾po ra 〉〉rje'i/ ④〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pas/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉spyo/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2223)40wa 1064

2297༄ga /rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo'i dpung rgyan 4) 21ba thabs/tsa༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ dh+wa dzā gra kai yu rā ⑤sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/rgyal mtshan gyi ①rtse mo'i dpung rgyan gye sgrub thabs/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ngan song 'jigs pa kun 'joms pa'i/ /rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan 'dud/ /de yi sgrub thabs dngos grub phyir/ /bdag gis dad pas bri bar bya/ /dang por re zhig sngags pas zhal bsang ba la sogs pa byas nas yid dang mthun rjopa'i gnas su stan bde ba la nye bar 'dug ste—/ mkhas pas byams pa la sogs pa'i yid dag pas sbyin pa'i pha rol tu ⑤phyin pa'i mchog bdud rnams 'joms shing g.yul las sgol bar byed pa bsgom par bya'o/ /oṃ tsan+d+rarka rjobi mā le swā hā zhes pa'i sngags brjod nas rang gi snying gar a yig yongs su gyur pa las zla ba dang nyi ma yang dag par sbyor ba'i steng du t+t+waṃ yig ser po'i 'od zer kyis nam mkha'i phyogs su sangs rgyas dang byang chub 40byed1065

sems dpa' rnams bltas nas/ yid kyis ①rang bzhin gyi me tog la sogs pas yang dag par mchod nas gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshigs su bcad pa brjod par bya'o/ /de'i rjes la oṃ swa bha wa shud+dhā②ཿsarba dharmā④ཿswa bhā wa shurnyophohaṃ zhes pa'i sngags brjod nas skad cig gis stong pa nyid du bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma kolha⑤haṃ zhes pas nga rgyal bskyed nas sems can rnams gdon pa'i bsam pas gzugs brnyan bzhin du zla ba dang nyi ma yang dag par sbyor ba'i steng du t+t+waṃ yig ser po'i 'od zer gyis mtha' yas pa'i sems can rnams la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i skus brgyan cing /de'i snying gar ⑥rab tu zhugs nas be+er log ste/ 'od zer kyi tshogs pas sa bon la rab tu zhugs par bsgom par bya'o/ /de thams cad yongs su gyur pa las g.yul las sgol bar byed pa'i lha mo sku mdog ser mo yid du 'ong ba zhal bzhi pa phyag bzhi pa khro zhing zhabs g.yon brkyang ba lto ba 'phyang ba/ spyan gsum parka/ dmar la zlum zhing mdzes pa/ na bza' sngon po mnabs pa/ ral gri dang / 'khor lo phyag g.yas na bsnams pa/ g.yon pa dag gis sprugs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa nag po dang / rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gtun shing dkar po bsnams pa/ sku'i phyogs g.yon du rtse gsum la 'khyud pa'o/ /zhal dang po ni ser po'o/ /g.yon pa ni dmar po'o/ /cig shos ni dkar po'o/ /steng du 'jigs shing du ba'i mdog lta bu'o/ /ral pa dmar ser gyen du badze+es shing bcings pa/ thod pa lngas brgyan ⑦pa/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dbus su bzhugs shing brtan pa bsgom par bya'o/ /de bzhin du dam tshig sems dpa' bskyed nas nyi ma la gnas pa'i snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis ye shes sems 40byed1066

dpa' gdan drangs te yang dag par mchod par bya'o/ /dzaḥ①hūṃ baṃ hoḥzhes pa 'di rnams kyi yi ges dgug pa dang / gzhug pa dang / bcing ba dang dbang du bya'o/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur ④du gsol zhes so/ /de nas mi bskyod pa la sogs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis rang gi thugs ka ①nas rnam par 'phros pa'i dhibadud rtsi lngas yongs su gang ba'i gser gyi bum pas phyag nas dbang bskur bzhin pa'i bdag nyid du bsgom par bya'o/ /de la dbang bskur ba'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di'o/ /dbang bskur ba ni rdo rje che/ /khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum kyi/ /gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta ⑤sa ma ya shri buye byed⑦hūṃ swā hā/ de nas rab tu gang zhing yongs su gyur pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par bskyed la/ sngags bzlas nas rtag tu bde ba'i tshig gis mchog ster bar 'gyur ro/ /oṃ bha ga ba tī dh+wa dzā ⑧gra kai yu re pa ra be+e n+ya bi t+t+waṃ sa na ka ri swa be+e n+ya pa ri pa la ni/ u pa kā mu khi kha kha khā hi khā nyi pa ra mai n+ya a nan+da ⑨mu khe na a nan+da ⑩bhu dze na pra ha ra pra ha ra hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ snying po'i sngags so/ /oṃ sarba gra ha nak+ṣe tra rgya mi ka ra ṇi swā hā nye ba'i snying po'o/ /phreng sngags ni gzungs las blta bar bya'o/ /langs pa'i dus su/ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /ji ltar rjes 'jug dngos grub spyod/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'dir ni byon ⑪par zhu/ /zhes pa'i sngags 'dis gshegs nas gnas par bya'o zhes so/ /rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan kyi sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //40byed1067

༄ga /'phags ma gtsug tor rjam par rgyal ma'i sgrub thabs/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya uṭī ṣa bi dza yā sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/'phags ma gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i sgrub thabs/ 'phags ma gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang por re zhig sngags pas kha bsang ba la sogs pa byas nas stan bde ba la nye bar 'dug ste/ tshad med pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom par bya'o/ /de'i rjes la rang gi snying gar a yig yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsams nas/ de'i steng du hūṃ ⑤yig dkar po bltas la de las byung ba'i 'od zer kyi tshogs kyis 'gro ba rnams gsal bar mdzad nas/mdun du sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams bsams nas mchod pa dang sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa rnams bya'o/ /de nas oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+pa ko3①haṃ zhes so/ /de nas slar yang rang gi snying gar zla ba la paṃ yig las skyes pa'i sna tshogs chu skyes bsams nas/ de'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 40byed1069

'khor gyi dbus su gnas pa'i zlo ①yig dkar po bltas la/ de yongs su gyur pa las gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma mchod rten gyi drung du ②bzhugs pa sku mdog dkar mo zhal gsum pa spyan ①gsum pa/ phyag brgyad pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ sna tshogs chu skyes dang zla ba la rdo rje skyil krung bcings nas bzhugs pa/ zhal dang po dkar po/ zhal g.yas pa ser po/ zhal g.yon pa sngon po/ mche bas ma mchu mnan pa/ g.yas kyi phyag bzhi rnams su sna tshogs rdo rje dang / chu skyes dmar po'i steng na bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba 'od dpag med pa ④dang / mda' dang mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya rnams so/ /g.yon gyi phyag bzhi rnams su gzhu dang / sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang / mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i phyag rgya dang / bum pa bzang po rnams so/ /rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan rjocing lha'i na bza'i stod g.yogs mnabs pa/ sna tshogs pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ 'od zer dkar po'i phreng ba can du blta bar bya'o—/ /de'i g.yas phyogs su 'jig rten dbang phyug sku mdog dkar po dugayon na pad+ma bsnams pa/ phyag g.yas na rnga yab bsnams pa'o/ /g.yon phyogs su phyag na rdo rje sku mdog ut+pa la sngon po'i 'dab ma lta bu phyag g.yon na ut+pal la gnas pa'i rdo rje bsnams pa/ phyag g.yas na rnga yab bsnams pa de dag bzhugs par bsam par bya'o/ /de nas shar dang / lho dang / nub dang /byang phyogs rnams su mi g.yo ba dang 'dod pa'i rgyal po dang / dbyug sngon can dang / stobs po che rnams thams cad sku mdog sngon po phyag gnyis pa/ zhal gcig pa/ spyan gsum pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i ⑦stag gi pags pa'i na bza' mnabs pa/ dbu skra gyen du badze+es pa/ klu brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ sna 40—1070

tshogs chu skyes dang nyi ma la bzhugs pa/phyag g.yon pa sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa bsnams pa/ phyag g.yas pa rnams su ral gri dang / lcags kyu dang /dbyug pa dang / rdo rje bsnams pa bsgom par bya'o/ /steng gi phyogs su gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha'i bu bdud rtsis bkang ba'i bum pa bsnams shing bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'bab bzhin pa bsam par bya'o/ /de lta bu'i bcom ldan 'das ma 'khor dang bcas pa bsam zhing dgod par bya'o/ /oṃ yig ni ①spyi bor ro/ /uyig ni mgrin pa la'o/ /hūṃ yig ni snying gar ro/ /ṭ+wāṃ yig ni ⑤dpral ba la'o—/ /spyoḥyig ni snelte ba la'o/ /saṃ āḥrkang pa dag la'o/ /de nas phyag rgya bcing bar bya'o/ /thal mo yang dag par sbyar nas mdzub mo bkug nas mtheb chen dag dang sbyar ba legs par ④sbyin par mdzad nas/ oṃ yig gsum dang bcas pa'i gzungs lan cig bzlas nas phyi nas 'dul ba'i phyag rgyas sngags bzlas par bya'o/ /oṃ rgyu rjoswā hā snying po'i sngags so④/ /oṃ a mi ta ā ⑦yurda de ṭ+wā hā/ nye ba'i snying po'i sngags so/ /oṃ a mi te a mi tod bha be a me dze+eta bi krān te a mi ⑨ta ga te a mi te gā mi ni a ⑩mi tā yurda de ga ga na krirti ka re sarba kle sha k+ṣa yo ka ri yi ⑪swā hā/ zhes pa ni phreng ba'i sngags so/ /'phags ma gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //40—1071

bsdur mchan/1༷69 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉༄ga /'phags ma gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i sgrub thabs rim pa bzhugs so/ / ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉ga / ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉go3/1༷7༷ ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉te// ②〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉stanang na/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉jigasum/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wapa/⑤〈〈snar 〉stanabus rgyan/ 0〈〈pe 〉sko'adir 〉〉wasku mdog dkar po/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉sko'adir 〉〉bas/1༷71 ①②①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wani/ rjo〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉tho/ du〈〈snar 〉〉waso/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉spru ta a/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉stan tā mṛ bha ba ya mṛ/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉tān+ta ya mṛ/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa mṛ ta ga mi n+ya/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa kā raṃ ye/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2225)40wa 1072

༄ga /gtsug tor rjam par rgyal ma'i sgrub thabs/①༄ / /rgya gar skad du/ u: ⑤ṣa bi dza yā ①sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i sgrub thabs/ 'phags ma gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsam gtan ma chags 'gro la mnyes/ /'gro mgon pad+ma la btud nas/ /rang nyid sgrub thabs dran bya'i phyir/ /rnam par rgyal ma'i sgrub thabs bshad/ /sa 'dzin la sogs yid 'ong ba'i/ /phyogs 'ga' zhig tu gnas nas ni/ /shin tu 'jam rjopa'i stan la 'dug /rnal 'byor bsam bya bsam par bya/ /sems can rnams kyi bde 'byung ba/ /de la hūṃ ⑤bcas 'od zer 'phrosarjo/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni gsal byas nas/ /dus gsum gshegs rnams mchod par bya/ /mchod cing de rnams mdun du ni/ /lus sogs las skyes sdig pa rnams/ /bgyid srul dbye bas yang dag skyes/ /man ngag rig pas thams cad bshags/ /de las byung ba rnam par sbyang / /40—1073

dge ba kun la rjes yi rang / /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs song nas/ /spros pa dang bcas rim pa bzhin/ /man ngag gis ni brtan byas nas/ /ji srid byang chub bar du bsgrub/ /brtse bas sems can rnams la dmigs/ /byang chub sems nyid bsgom par bya/ /mtshan med dmigs pa med pa yi/ /rang bzhin med pa mkha' dbyings bzhin/ /de la a yig las byung ba'i/ /chu skyes la gnas zla dkyil la/ /sa bon las byung lha mo ni/ /zhal gsum so sor spyan gsum pa/ /lang tsho gzhon zhing phun sum tshogs/ /sgeg pa la sogs nyams dang ldan/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi yon tan gang / /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /'od zer dang ldan na bza' ni/ /ston ka'i zla ba dang mtshungs pa/ /dze+e bu nā da'i gser mdog can/ /g.yas pa'i zhal ni zhi ba'o/ /dus mtha'i me 'bar sprin bzhin 'phro/ /'jigs shing mi bzad g.yon pa'i zhal//phyag g.yas nyid kyi thugs kar ni/ /sna tshogs rdo rje yang dag bsnams/ /gnyis pa chu skyes steng gnas pa'i/ /sangs rgyas dang ni gsum par mda'/ /mchog sbyin phyag rgya bzhi pa'o/ /g.yon na ①go rims ji bzhin du/ /sdogs mdzub dang bcas zhags pa dang / /gzhu dang de bzhin mi 'jigs pa/ /bum pa gang ba bsnams pa ni/ /mchod rten nang bzhugs bsgom par bya/ /snying gar sa bon dang bcas pa'i/ /pad+ma bsam bya de steng du/ /'od zer dkar po'i dra ba yis/ /bskul zhing gdan drangs nam mkha' la/ /sangs rgyas sprin tshogs chen po dang / /byang chub sems dpa' mtha' dag 'khod/ /brtse chen bdag nyid de rnams kyang khru/ /rang rgyud dus gsum 'khor bar bsamaske/ /dbang bskur rab tu sbyin par mdzad④/ /'bad pas rtag tu bsam par bya/ /40—1074

mchod rten nang bzhugs oṃ dang ṭ+wāṃ/ /s+dza①yig 'od zer ⑤rab tu 'phro/ /hūṃ byāḥsaṃ āḥzhes pa yi①/ /sa bon las skyes go rims bzhin/ /spyi bo dpral ba mgrin pa'i gnas/ /snying ga lte ba rkang pa'i gnas/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas pa'i/ /'jig rten dbang phyug rnal 'byor bsam/ /ston ka'i zla 'od dang mtshungs pa/ /'od zer dag gi phreng ba 'phro/ /chu skyes rdo rje dag las byung / /g.yas pa dag gis rnga yab bsnams/ /pad+ma rdo rje 'dzin pa dag /de yi g.yas g.yon logs su'o/ /mdun du mi g.yo ba dang ni④/ /'dod pa'i rgyal po g.yas phyogs su/ /rgyab kyi phyogs su dbyug sngon can/ /g.yon du stobs chen dgod par bya/ /ral gri lcags kyu dbyug pa dang / /rdo rje rnams ni phyag na bsnams/ /glog bcas rdo rje rtsang bzhin pa'i/ /dus mtha'i chu 'dzin dang mtshungs pa/ /spyan ni sos ka'i rjonyi 'od bzhin/ /gdug pa rnams kyi srog 'phrog byed/ /kun kyi phyag g.yon pyarnams na ni/ /sdigs mdzub dang bcas zhags pa bsnams/ /'od zer 'bar ba'i phreng bas 'khrigs—/ /sna tshogs pad+ma nyi dze+edakyil bzhugs/ /sngags pas nyin dang mtshan mo ru/ /rnal 'byor ldan pa 'di yis bsgom/ /rdo rje'i theg par rab zhugs nas/ /de yis myur du byang chub 'thob/ /ces pa ni gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //40—1075

༄ga /lha mo nor rgyun ma'i sgrub thabs/①༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ de wī sdeb su dhā rā ④sā dha rna/ bod skad du/lha mo nor rgyun ma'i sgrub thabs/ lha mo nor rgyun ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngon ma bzhin du stong pa nyid kyi mthar thug par rnam par ④bsgoms nas skad cig gis bdag nyid rdza bha la'i skur bsams nas/ rang gi snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi ⑤dbus su baṃ yig gi sa bon las byung ba'i bcom ldan 'das ma nor rgyun ma bsam par bya ste/ sku mdog gser lta bu rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa lo brgyad gnyis lon pa lta bu/ phyag g.yas pa mchog sbyin/ g.yon pa rin po che'i phreng ba dubasnams pa/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa'o/ /⑦bcom ldan 'das ma'i mdun du dpal gyi nor/ g.yas phyogs su nor ster ⑤ma/ rgyab kyi phyogs su dpal gyi nor zhal ma/ g.yon phyogs su nor gyi ⑨blo gros brten ⑩ ma'o/ /de rnams kyang dang po'i sa bon gyi ⑪yi ge las rang gi gtso ⑫mo 40byed1077

dang mtshungs pa'i skur bsam par bya'o/ /de bzhin du bsgoms nas sngags bzlas par bya'o/ /oṃ ba su jo ri tsā ①swā hā/ oṃ shrī ⑤ba su swā hā/ oṃ ba su shrī ye swā hā/① oṃ shrī bub su mu khi ⑤swā hā/ oṃ ba su shrī buye swā hā/ so so'i bdag nyid la ba'i lci ba'i maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi pa khru gnyis pa'i tshad du byas nas thun mtshams gsum du me tog dri bzang pos stong phrag bzhir ⑦mchod par bya'o/ /zla ba drug tu bzlas pas yid kyi shing rta yongs su gang bar 'gyur ro/ /ji ltar rnyed pa'i me tog gi sbyin sreg ④'bum phrag bzhi ⑨byas pas dpal chen mor 'gyur ba'o⑩—/ /nor rgyun ma'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/1༷77 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smod pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉ga / /lha mo nor rgyun ma'i sgrub thabs rim pa bzhugs so// khru〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉༅/ ①〈〈snar 〉〉 / rjo〈〈snar 〉7rnam par/e 〈snar 〉7dkyil 'khor gyi/ rjo〈〈snar 〉thar/ ⑦〈'ar 〉rgami bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa'o// ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉ster rten/ 〈〈snar 〉lten/ 1〈〈pe 〉lker bu'i/ 〈〈snar 〉rja nor bu'i/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉rten/ ⑪〈〈snar 〉〉gyis—/ ⑪〈'a ra 〉ritso/1༷78 hu〈〈pe 〉skosnar 〉thā ri ṇi/ ②〈sar 〉sngag ①〈'ar 〉7rmab su 1ye swā hā/ 0〈'ar 〉mgo ⑤〈shar〉〉khre—/ h+phu〈〈snar 〉mkhye/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉du/ 〈〈snar 〉〉tu/ ⑧〈'ar 〉stagan bsreg ⑨〈〈snar 〉sngasum/ ⑩〈〈pe〉la/〈〈snar 〉〉〈/ /zhes so/40byed1078
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2227)40wa 1079

༄ga /nor rgyun ma'i sgrub thabs/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ba su dhā rā 1sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/nor rgyun ma'i sgrub thabs/ lha mo nor rgyun ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas nor rgyun ma bsgom ①par 'dod pas de'i tshe sngon ma bzhin du thams cad byas nas/'on kyang drug pa'i sa bon la zla ba phyed pa dang thig les brgyan pa'o/ /de de bzhin du yongs su rdzogs pa las nor rgyun ma sku mdog ser mo phyag g.yon na 'bru'i snye ma dang rin po che sna tshogs pa'i char 'bab bzhin pa'i bum pa bsnams pa—/ phyag g.yas pa mchog sbyin mdzad pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/grogs mo'i 'khor kyis bskor bar bsgom par bubya'o/ /bdag nyid de bzhin du nor rgyun ma zhes so/ /lag pa gnyis khu tshur bcings nas gung mo'i tshigs gsum pa bcag ⑤pa nor rgyun ma'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nas sngags bzlas par bya'o/ /oṃ ba su ni dha dun k+ṣe tre ⑦swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i bris sku bkram ⑧nas 40—1080

mchod pa chen po ①byas te bsgoms nas nyal bar ②bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das ma'i dngos grub tu 'gyur ro/ /nor rgyun ma'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/108༷ lamatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ 7 ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉dha rā/ 〈snar 〉〉dha ra/②〈'dir 〉〉bsgoms/ du〈'dir 〉〉wabasgom par/ ⑤〈〈snar 〉stanacig 0〈'dir 〉〉sgyu/ ⑦〈〈snar 〉〉te/⑧〈〈snar 〉〉bkrams/1༷81 ①〈'dir 〉to/chen po/ ②〈'dir 〉7ra/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2228)40wa 1081

༄ga /nor rgyun ma'i sgrub thabs/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ba su dhā rā ④sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/nor rgyun ma'i sgrub thabs/ nor rgyun ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngon du gsungs pa'i cho gas 'dir baṃ yig ser po yongs su gyur pa las sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig ④phyag gnyis pa lang tsho gzhon zhing rgyan dang na bzas durnam par brgyan pa 'bras kyi snye ma dang rin po che'i char 'bab bzhin pa'i bum pa phyag g.yon na bsnams na⑤/ phyag g.yas pa mchog sbyin mdzad pa/ dpag tu med pa'i grogs mo'i 'khor gyis bskor ba/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs pa—/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan pa/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las skad cig gis bskyed nas phyag rgya bcing bar bya ste/ lag pa gnyis khu tshur byas nas/ gung mo'i tshigs gsum pa bcag pa ni nor rgyun ma'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nas oṃ ba su dhā rā rat+na ni dhā bun k+ṣe tre ⑦swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags bzlas par 40—1082

bya'oske/ /nor rgyun ma'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/1༷82 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈snar 〉〉〉 ra/ ②〈'dir 〉〉gsum/ du〈〈pe 〉snga'adir 〉〉bza'/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉sga/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉dha rā rat+na ni dha/ 〈〈snar 〉〉dha ra rad na ni dha/ ⑦〈'ar 〉〉te/bsdur 'azas re'u migargyud/ (2229)40wa 1083

༄ga /nor rgyun ma'i gzungs kyi man ngag①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ba su dhā rī ṇi ④u pa de shaḥ/ bod skad du/nor rgyun ma'i gzungs kyi man ngag /'phags ma nor rgyun ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nor rgyun ma'i bris sku'am/ sku gzugs bkram nas mdun du tsan+dan gyi maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi pa byas nas/ de nas bcom ldan 'das ma bskyed nas mchod cing lag pa tsan+dan gyis byugs te/ nor rgyun ma'i gzungs kyi po ti skud pas bcings nas me tog phreng ba dpyangs te ①mdun du chu'i snod bzhag nas nang du bcug ste/sems can thams cad la dubyams pa'i sems kyis dmigs nas⑤/ dngos grub mngon par 'dod pas snying gar bzung ste/ nor rgyun ma'i gzungs bklag par bya'o/ /klog pa yang swā hā dang ldan pas sngags rnams kyi ④swā hā zhes pa'i sgra brjod pa ④na me tog dkar po drur ⑧ba dang bcas te ka ra dang 'bras dang chu'i snod du dbul bar bya'o/ /gos dang sa ⑨phyogs gtsang mar ji srid zla ba 40byed1084

drug bklag ①cing chu'i nang du gshegs par bya'o/ /nor rgyun ma'i gzungs kyi man ngag rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/1༷84 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉r+sā rā ṇi/ 〈〈snar 〉〉dha ra ṇi/ ①〈〈pe 〉stab tog bcings te/ 〈〈snar 〉〉wame tog phreng ba dpyangs te/ rjo〈〈snar 〉〉wal ⑤〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉te/ du〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉nya)sa/ ⑦〈〈snar 〉〉sgas/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉dur/ ⑨〈〈snar 〉〉〉gtsang /1༷85 ①〈〈snar 〉〉bkugabasdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2230)40wa 1085

༄ga /rgo rje phag mo'i sgrub thabs/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra bā rā tī ②sā dha rna/ bod skad du/rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje phag mo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnal 'byor pas ④snga bar langs nas zhal bsang ba la sogs pa byas nas dam tshig gi ri lu zhal du bcug ste/ ri'i phug la sogs pa yid du 'ong ba'i gnas su sna tshogs rdo rje'i stan la 'dug nas ā li dang kā li rjodabyangs lan gsum brjod pas bdag nyid rdo rje phag mor gyur nas de'i rnam pa can du 'gro ba thams cad nges par byas te/ rang gi snying gar chu skyes dang nyi ma la baṃ yig dmar po bltas nas de las byung ba'i 'od zer dmar po bskal pa'i me lta bu'i shin tu mi bzad ⑤pa 'og min gyi gnas su song nas rdo rje phag mo 'chad par 'gyur ba'i rjosku mdog dang phyag mtshan dang ldan pa dang / bla ma dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams mdun gyi nam mkha' la spyan drangs nas bzhugs te/ snying ga nas 40byed1086

phyung ba'i 'od zer kyi mchod pa rnams kyis yang dag par mchod nas/ de'i mdun du sdig pa bshags pa dang / bsod nams la rjes su yi rang ba dang /dge ba yongs su bsngo ba dang / gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang / byang chub tu sems bskyed pa la sogs pa byas nas tshad med pa'i gnas bzhi rnam par bsgoms te/ de nas chos thams cad rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi stong pa nyid du byas nas—/ oṃ shu n+ya tā tshwa na badz+ra swa bhā wa ā kolhastihaṃ/ zhes pa'i sngags kyi ⑧don mngon du byas nas skad cig gis mi gnas pa'i skur bsam ①par bya'o/ /sngon gyi smon lam gyi dbang gis ting nge 'dzin las rnam par bzhengs nas nam mkha' la yi ro baṃ lo rjoyongs su gyur pa las gzhu'i dbyibs dang zur gsum dang zlum po dang gru bzhi rnams nag po dang dmar po dang dkar po dang ser po rnams te 'byung ba chen po bzhi'i dkyil 'khor rnams steng nas steng du blta bar bya'o/ /de'i steng du sum̐ yig las byung ba'i ri rab gru bzhi pa rin po che bzhi'i rang bzhin can spyog ⑤brgyad kyis nye bar mjes pa rnam par bsams nas/ de'i steng du oṃ rjome di nī badz+rī ⑦bha ba badz+ra brnya skehūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra pā kā rā hūṃ baṃ hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra paṃ dza ra hūṃ yo hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra bi tā na hūṃ khaṃ hūṃ/ oṃ sha ra dzā la ṭ+wāṃ shaṃ ṭ+wāṃ⑨/oṃ badz+ra dz+wa lā na lārka ⑩hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ sngags 'di rnams kyis rdo rje'i sa gzhi la sogs pa'i rim pa drug go/ /bsgrubs ⑪nas de'i nang du gru bzhi la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan pa'i gzhal yas khang rnam par bsams nas de'i dbus su paṃ yig dmar po las skyes pa'i pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'o/ /de'i ze'u ⑫'bru la ā li ⑫kā li yongs su gyur pa las zla ba dang nyi ma yang dag par sbyor ba 'od dmar po rdo rje'i nang du song ba las bam̐ yig dmar po'i rang bzhin 'od rab 40—1087

tu gsal bar blta bar bya'o/ /de thams cad yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo se 'bru'i me tog lta bu phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas pa rdo rje'i sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ g.yon na thod pa dang kha ṭī ga bsnams pa zhal gcig pa/ spyan gsum pa/ skra gol ba/ phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ phyogs kyi gos can ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba'i rang bzhin can/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan mnan pa/ mgo bo rlon pa'i phreng bas sku la brgyan pa/ khrag 'dzag bzhin pa 'thung ba bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas shar la sogs pa'i 'dab ma bzhi rnams la go rims ji lta ba bzhin du g.yon skor ①du mkha' 'gro ma dang / lā ma dang / dum skyes ma dang / gzugs can ma ②rnams nag mo dang / ljang gu dang / dmar mo ①dang / dkar mo ④rnams te de rnams zhal gcig pa/phyag bzhi pa'o/ /phyag g.yon na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang thod pa bsnams pa/ g.yas na ḍa khyem ru dang gri gug bsnams pa/ spyan gsum pa/ dbu skra grol ba/ gcer bu zhabs g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ phyag rgya lngas rnam par brgyan par ⑥bsgom par bya'o/ /mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhi rnams la byang chub kyi sems la sogs pas gang ba'i thod pa rnams bsgom par bya'o/ /de'i rjes la snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros nas bcom ldan 'das ma'i ye shes kyi 'khor lo dzaḥyig gis spyan ⑦drangs nas/ hūṃ yig gis rang dam tshig gi 'khor lo ⑧chu la chu bzhin du gzhug par bya'o/ /baṃ yig gis bcings nas hoḥyig gis mnyes par bya'o—/ /de nas oṃ kri r+ghaṃ bhuhūṃ khaṃ dbyutsā ha⑩/ zhes pa'i yi ge rnams kyis skye mched rnams sbyang bar bya'o/ /lha mo drug gi dag pa dang / /sngags kyi rkang pa 40—1088

rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das ma'i go char bya'o/ /oṃ baṃ lte ba la'o/ /haṃ ①yo thugs ka'oske/ /dz+rī snemi zhal lo/ /spyo ṭī rjodabu la'o/ /hūṃ hūṃ spyi bo la'o/ /phaṭa phaṭa sku thams cad la na bzar bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das ma'i sku gsung thugs rnams la go rims ji lta ba bzhin du oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes pa rnam par rjodagod do/ /bsgoms pas ngal na sngags bzlas par bya'o/ /de la sngags ni oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī duye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā zhes so/ /thun mtshams gsum du gtor ma sngon du 'gro bas bcom ldan 'das ma bsgom par bya'o/ /spyod lam thams cad la go rims ji lta ba bzhin du ⑦bcom ldan 'das ma'i sku gzugs kyis gnas par bya'o zhes so/ /rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta chen po a ba dhū tī ⑧pa dpal ldan gnyis med rdo rje'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa'o// //40—1089

bsdur mchan/1༷86 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉༄ga /rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// ②〈〈pe 〉〉ti/ 〈〈snar 〉〉grig ①〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ du〈〈pe 〉〉spa dang / ka li'i/〈〈snar 〉75'i/ ⑤〈'dir 〉tshod/ du〈'dir 〉munar pa'i/1༷87 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wa3/ ②〈〈snar 〉4)sa/ ①〈〈snar 〉stananas/ rjo〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉mi raṃ baṃ lo ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈'dir 〉〉cog du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉jilo/ ⑦〈〈snar 〉〉badzi/ ⑧〈〈snar 〉〉ban+da/ ⑨〈〈snar 〉〉tre/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉parka/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bsgrub/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉sko'adir 〉〉ze/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉7)1088 ①〈〈snar 〉〉bskor/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wam/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉po/ ④〈〈pe〉〉po ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈'dir 〉〉nge/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉the/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stanadan/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉 la ⑨〈〈pe〉〉〈'dir 〉sta / ⑩〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉 ཿ/1༷89 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉sgrosgok+shi/ ②〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉pa'o/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉sta1/ du〈〈pe 〉〉la'o/ /spyo spyo/〈〈snar 〉〉pa'o/ /gli trī/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉rams/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ni/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉mi go rims ji lta ba bzhin du/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ti/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2231)40wa 1090

༄ga /shes rab kyi snang ba sgrub pa'i cho ga①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ pradzñā lo ka sā dha rgo bi dhiḥ②/ bod skad du/shes rab kyi snang ba sgrub pa'i cho ga /rdo rje phag mo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /blo ngan bsreg ①mkhas smra ba ngan pa'i phyogs 'jig cing / /dug 'joms skye bo'i tshogs rnams thar la bde bar skyong / /rab zhi bde ba 'phel mdzad rdo rje phag mo la/ / shaṃ kas rjobyen ni phyag 'tshal lha mo'i tshogs pa rjobri/ /de la mtshan mo nam phyed kyi thun gyi lhag ma la cho ga bzhin du rjolangs nas dur khrod la sogs pa yid dang mthun pa'i gnas 'ga' zhig tu tsan+dan bzang po la sogs pas byugs te me tog sna tshogs pas gcal du bkram pas nye bar mdzes pa la/ mngon sum du ro'i gdan nam⑦/ yang na ji lta ba'i stan bde ba la nye bar 'dug ste/byams pa la sogs pa bsgom pa sngon du 'gro bas rang gi snying gar a yig las skyes pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la byāḥyig dkar po las skyes pa'i 'od zer gyi skedra 40byed1091

bas rab tu gsal bar mdzad nas/ rdo rje phag mo la sogs pa'i ①bla ma dang rnal 'byor ma rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang de bzhin gshegs pa rnams ji lta ba bzhin du mdun du mngon sum du yang dag par bltas nas snying ga'i sa bon las byung ba'i rab tu gtum mo dang / drag mig ma dang / 'od ldan ma dang / sna chen ma dang / dpa' bo'i blo gros ma dang / mi'u thung ma dang / laṅka'i dbang phyug ma dang / shing grib dze+em ste/ thugs kyi 'khor lo'i lha mo brgyad po rnams dang ④/ sa srung dum dang / 'jigs byed chen mo dang / rlung shugs ma dang / chang 'thung ma dang / lha mo sngo bsangs ma dang / shin tu bzang mo dang / rta rna ⑤ma dang / bya gdong ma ste gsung gi 'khor lo'i lha mo brgyad po rnams dang / 'khor lo'i shugs can ma dang / dum skyes ma dang / chang 'tshong ma dang / 'khor lo'i go cha ma dang /shin tu dpa' mo dang / stobs chen ma dang / 'khor los sgyur ma dang /brtson 'grus chen mo ste/ sku'i 'khor lo'i lha mo brgyad po rnams te/ nag po ⑥dang dmar po dang dkar po'i kha dog rnams so/ /mi bskyod pa dang / 'od dpag med dang rnam par snang mdzad rnams kyis dbu brgyan pa zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ spyan gsum pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ rdo rje dang / pad+ma dang / 'khor lo dang thod pa'i phreng ba dang / zur phud gsum gyis dbu brgyan pa/ gri gug dang thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang / lag pa'i 'dab mas mchod pa thogs pa rnams kyis mchod yon la sogs pa sngon du 'gro bas mchod nas phyag 'tshal ba dang / sdig pa bshags pa dang / phyin chad mi byed pa'i sdom pa dang / bsod nams la rjes su yi rang ba dang / gsum la skyabs su 40—1092

'gro ba dang / byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang / lam la brten ①pa dang /bdag nyid dbul ba dang / bskul ②ma 'debs pa dang / gsol ba 'debs pa rnams cho ga bzhin du bsgrubs ①nas bsod nams yongs su bsngo bar bya'o/ /stong pa nyid kyi ye shes bsgrubs la spyi bor thal mo yang dag par sbyar nas tshigs su bcad pa brjod pa sngon du 'gro bas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la bskul ④ma gdab par bya'o/ /de la tshigs su bcad pa 'di'o/ /oṃ de bzhin gshegs pa kun kyi sngags/ /sems can kun gyi dngos grub kun/ /phun sum tshogs pa kun 'byung bar/ /de bzhin gshegs rnams bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ swa bhā ⑤wa shudhaḥsarba dharmābuḥswa bhā ⑦wa shurnyopho⑧haṃ zhes so/ /de'i rjes la mchod par bya ba dang / mchod pa dang mchod par byed pa po'i chos thams cad kyang stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa'i rnam pas rmi lam gyi rkyen bzhin du bdag nyid so sor rig pas lhag par grol bar bya'o/ /snying ga'i sngags kyi 'od zer gyi dra bas rang bzhin med par bya'o/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa a kolha⑫haṃ zhes pa'i nga rgyal bya'o/ /de nas rang gi sems paṃ yig dmar po'i tshul gyis yongs su gyur pa las pad+ma dmar po'i steng du saṃ yig las skyes pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la hūṃ yig dkar po las nyi ma dang / zla ba la gnas pa'i dhīḥdakar pos byin gyis brlabs ⑩pa'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa dmar po bsgom par bya'o/ /spro ba dang bsdu ba sngon du 'go zhing de yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid rdo rje phag mo bcu drug gi rnam pa ston ka'i zla ba ⑪ltar dkar ba la spyan gsum dmar zhing zlum pa/ cung zad mche ba gcigs pa'i zhal mnga' ba/ sna tshogs pa'i me tog gis rnam par mdzes pa/ dbu skra gol ba phyed bcings pas rnam par 40byed1093

mdzes pa/ rdo rje nag po'i phreng ba gnyis kyi dbus su thod pa'i phreng ba dang zur phud gsum bcings pa/ 'khor lo dang rna rgyan dang mgul rgyan dang lag gdub dang ska rags kyis brgyan pa/ 'akying bzhin pa'i ba dan gsum 'bar ba/phyag g.yas kyi 'dab ma na gnas pa/ sngon du gsungs pa'i rdo rjes skyes bu'i mi shes pa'i 'jigs pa rnam par 'joms pa/ phyag g.yon pa na dbyug pa dkar po steng gi rtse mo na rdo rje rtse mo lnga pa/ 'og tu mi mgo skam po dang mgo bo don pa dang sna tshogs rdo rje gser gyi ①bum pa'i rtsa ba las byung ba sgra dang bcas pa'i dril bu g.yer ka phra mos brgyan pa ba dan sna tshogs pas rnam par mdzes pa'i dbyug pa dpung pa la reg pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang bdud bzhi'i khrag gis gang ba'i pad+ma'i snod bsnams pa/ khrag 'dzag bzhin pa'i mgo bo zon pa lnga bcu'i phreng ba mgul du 'phyang ba/ pad+ma dmar po'i steng du nyi ma la gnas pa'i shes pa med pa'i skyes bu zhabs g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ gcer bu rab tu gtum pa nyi ma'i 'od lta bu rab tu 'phro ba'i ba spu'i phreng ba can/ gzugs brnyan dang mtshungs pa/ sgeg pa la sogs pa'i nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ sprul pa sna tshogs pas phyogs bcur 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa/ gzhan nyi ma la gnas pa'i dz+rīḥyig gis byin gyis brlabs sdepa/ nyi ma la gnas pa'i rdo rje snying po la bdag nyid rdo rje phag mor bsgom par bya'o/ /de las snying ga'i sa bon kyi 'od kyi dra bas sems can thams cad de'i gzugs su gyur par bskyed nas bdag la rab tu zhugs te/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo'o zhes pa'i nga rgyal bskyed par bya'o/ /de'i rjes la rang gi lte bar sna tshogs pad+ma la nyi ma dkar dmar la tweḥyig dkar por bltas la/ de la sngags ni phreng ba'i rnam 40byed1094

pa dkar po 'khor lo 'khor bzhin pa bzhin du sbyor bas zhal gyi sgo nas 'thon te/sangs rgyas kyi yon tan gyi tshogs dang / nor bu dang / sngags dang / sman dang / zla ba dang / skar ma dang / ri mo dang / bstan bcos dang / sgyu rtsal la sogs pa'i mthu rnams bkug nas lte ba'i bu ga nas rab tu zhugs te/ rang dang ①gzhan gyi mi shes pa thams cad bsreg ②par bdag nyid bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis yang dag par bskul nas nam mkha' la bzhugs pa'i ye shes pa'i lha mo mdun du bltas nas④/ sngon du gsungs pa'i lha mo'i tshogs rnams kyis 0mchod yon la sogs pa sngon du 'gro bas mchod nas be+e ⑤yig gi sngags brjod pa sngon du 'gro bas 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral bar bcings te/ g.yon du 'khor bzhin pas spyan drang bar bya'o/ /de dag gcig tu gyur pas bsgom zhing sngags kyis rjong rgyal bya'o/ /de la sngags ni 'di'o—/ /oṃ yo ga ⑦shurtseḥsarba dharmā ⑧yo ga shurnyopho⑨haṃ/ de la de'i sa bon gyis yang dag par bskul nas nam mkha' la bzhugs pa'i mi bskyod pa la sogs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams gdan drangs te/ de rnams kyis bdud rtsi lngar gyur pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i bdag nyid kyi bum pa rnams dang / der sprul pa sna tshogs pa'i rol mo dang ⑩rnga dang dung dang rdza rnga dang 'khar rnga dang pi wang dang gling bu dang glu dbyangs rnams dang / lha dang lha ma yin rnams kyang ca co'i dpung gnyen rnams dang / gur gum dang ga bur dang gla rtsi ⑪dang dri bzangs me tog gi char 'bab pa dang / ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /de bzhin gshegs rnams khrus gsol ba/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag kyang khrus bya'o/ /zhes pa'i tshigs su bcad pa brjod pas bdag nyid la dbang 40—1095

bskur bar bya'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta ①sa ma ya shri ②ye hūṃ zhes pa 'dis byin gyis brlab cing sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la bzhugs pa'i mi bskyod pa dbu la bzhugs par bsam par bya'o/ /de nas de'i sprul pa rab tu gtum mo la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams kyis de la sprul pa ①rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i mchod pa rnams kyis mngon par mchod nas 'chad par 'gyur ba'i rim pas bdud rtsi myang ba la sogs pa byas nas ji srid 'dod kyi bar du bsam gtan byas nas spro ba dang bsdu ba la sogs pa rjosngon du 'gro bas myur ba la sogs pa'i nyes pa dang bral bas sngags bzlas par bya'o/ /de la sngags ni 'di'o/ /byā⑤ཿgang gi tshe ldang bar 'dod na de'i sngags kyi phreng ba lte ba la gnas pa'i tweḥyig la bsgom par bya'o/ /mchod pa la sogs pa sngon du 'gro bas smon lam btab ste yongs su bsngo ba byas nas yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod de lha mo'i nga rgyal gyis bya ba bya'o/ /chos thams cad kyang de la gnyis su med par blta 0zhing spyod lam ci bde bar bya'o/ /de la yi ge brgya pa'i sngags ni 'di lta ste/ oṃ yi / oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya/ma nu pā la ya badz+ra satwa twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha dṛ ⑦ḍho me bha wa su toṣ+yo me bha ba su poṣ+yo me bha ba a nu rasto me bha ba/ sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tsha sarba karma su tsa me tsit+t+waṃ gre yaḥku ru hūṃ ha ha ha ha hoḥ/ bha ⑧ga bān sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra mā me muñtsa badz+rī ⑨bha wa ma hā sa ma ya satwa lhahūṃ zhes so/ /thun mtshams rnams su yang skad cig gis lha mo'i rnam pa mngon du byas te mchod pa la sogs pa sngon du 'gro bas ji srid 'dod kyi bar du bsgoms te sngon bzhin du sngags bzlas nas sngon ma bzhin du thams cad bya'o—/ /mtshan phyed kyi thun mtshams su yang thams cad byas nas nyal ba'i dus su spyi bor bla ma dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams bzhugs par 40byed1096

bltas nas yang dag par mchod par bya'o/ /yan lag brgyad kyis phyag byas te nyal ba na seng ge'i nyal stabs kyis nyal bar bya'o/ /de nas snga dro'i thun la lha mos gnyid rab tu bslang nas sngon bzhin du thams cad bya'o zhes so/ /yang na gang ①zhig rim pa 'dis sa phyogs 'ga' zhig tu ro'i gdan la skyil krung gis stan bde ba la nye bar 'dug ste/ sems can thams cad la snying rjes dmigs nas⑦/ sdig pa bshags pa nas brtsams te ji srid byang chub tu sems bskyed skepa'i bar du sngon du 'gro bas uyig yongs su gyur pa las rang gi lce pad+ma'i rnam pa la byāḥyig 'bar zhing 'od gsal ba ji srid 'dod par bsgoms shing rjobartan par byas nas brgya phyed kyi phreng ba'i rdog po srad bu la brgyus nas thun rjogasum mam thun rjobazhir rnal 'byor pas bzlas par bya'o/ /gnyid log pa na sngon kyi cho ga bzhin du nyal bar bya'o/ /de bzhin du bzlas pa dang bsgom pa cho ga ④bzhin du rjes su gnang bas 'jig rten pa'i chos brgyad las nges par grol nas dad pa dang dam tshig dang sdom pa la gnas shing brtse ba dang ldan pas dge ba'i bshes ⑧gnyen la gus par byas nas/ de'i phyi nas rnal 'byor pas 'bum phrag bdun bzlas pas bstan bcos dang sgyu rtsal kyi chos ⑨thams cad la rang ⑩gis mngon par shes par 'gyur ro/ /shes rab dang ldan pa dang dpa' ba dang / 'jigs pa med pa dang / 'khor kyis zil gyis mi non par 'gyur ro—/ /rgol ba por yang 'gyur ro/ /rims dang ngan thabs dang / dug dang mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa rnams kyis bar du gcod par mi 'gyur ro/ /gang zos pa de thams cad kyang bdud rtsir 'gyur ro/ /'di'i sngags bzlas pas dngos grub tu 'gyur ro/ /'di'i sngags kyis thod le kor ⑪la mngon par 40—1097

bsngags nas gang gi lag tu byin na blun po yang snyan ngag mkhan du 'gyur ro/ /de'i dri tsam gyis kyang sbrul la sogs pa rnams nye nus pa ma yin no/ /'di rnams kyi ①bar du gcod pas bar chad byed pa rnams dang gzhan rnams kyi ②yang thams cad la phan par byed nus par 'gyur ro/ /bdag gis mang po smos pas ci zhig bya ste/ bems ①po'i blo yang bstan bcos la nyon mongs par bya mi dgos te/ mi g.yo ba'i sems kyis so/ /sngags 'di 'bum phrag gnyis bzlas na 'dis shes rab kyi snang ba dusgrub par byed do/ /'dir yang gang zhig rnams rjokyis sems brtan dupar gyur pas yon tan mtha' yas pa gsungs pa dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /de rnams kyis ⑦shin tu mchog gi dngos grub tu 'gyur ro zhes so/ /shes rab kyi snang ba sgrub pa'i cho ga rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/1༷91 ①/mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉sngag /shes rab kyi snang ba sgrub pa'i cho ga bzhugs so// ②〈〈pe 〉sngasnar 〉7ཿ/ ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉zabakhan sreg du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rga ka du〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉phro/ rjo〈〈pe〉lo'ar 〉7de/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉ras/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈'a ra 〉7)sa/1༷92 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉sgrib/ ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7dang / rjo〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7ngas/⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈'ar 〉ra/ rjo〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉la/1 93 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉mosten/ ②〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉ngo / ①〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉misgrub/ rjo〈〈pe 〉snga'ar 〉ngosal/⑤〈〈snar 〉rdza/ rjo〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉dharma/ ⑦〈〈snar 〉d+ku/ ⑧⑨〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7྅/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉skosnar 〉〉brlab / ⑪〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉7ba/1 94 ①〈'a ra 〉sko)sa/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉mirlab/40byed1098
