༄ga /rdo rje phag mo'i dbang du bya ba'i cho ga①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra bā rā t+yā ba sh+ya bi dhiḥ⑤/ bod skad du/rdo rje phag mo'i dbang du bya ba'i cho ga /ldo rje phag mo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can rnams dbang du bya ba 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi la gzhug ④nas dbang gi cho ga brjod par bya ste/ de nas sngon du gsungs pa'i rim pas bcom ldan 'das ma mchog tu dmar ba rdzogs par bskyed nas sa bon dang mtshan ma yongs su gyur pa las sku mdog dmar mo rnam par bsgoms nas yang dag par mchod pa dang bstod pa bya'o/ /mi bskyod rdo rje zhes bya ba la sogs pa rjotshigs su bcad pa rnams kyis de nyid gsum dbul bar bya'o/ /kha thur du bstan pa'i thod pa gsum gyi steng du a ⑤yig dmar po las byung ba'i pad+ma'i snod du dam tshig bcu dang dbyangs yig bcu drug la sogs pa gsal byed sum cu rtsa bzhis rjobyin gyis brlabs dze+epar bltas la/ 'og tu yo dang ro yig ⑧yongs su gyur pa las 40byed1100

rlung dang me'i dkyil 'khor dag gis 'bar ba dang bsreg pa dag byas nas nye bar yang dag par bkod pa'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis bskul nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs rnams gdan drangs nas de la nang du byas te/ dbyangs yig dang po las skyes pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor kyi steng du hūṃ yig las skyes pa zla ba la gnas pa des byin kyis brlabs ①pa'i rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa ②'phro bzhin pa'i 'od zer gyi dra bas rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid kyang ①zla ba'i rdo rje la gzhug par bya'o//nye bar smin pa dang the tshom la sogs pa'i skyon du gyur na de'i steng du oṃ yig bsams nas de'i 'od zer gyis de bzhin gshegs pa rnams bdud rtsi'i gzugs su gyur nas 'jig rten gyi khams sna tshogs pa na gnas pa'i bdud rtsi rnams kyang de la rab tu zhugs shing oṃ yig kyang zhugs rjote/ ji lta ba bzhin yongs su grub pa'i bdud rtsir bltas nas lan gsum de nyid gsum gyis brlabs rjonas cho ga bzhin du bdud rtsi myang ba la sogs pa bya'o/ /ji srid 'dod kyi bar bsgoms nas rang gi ming gi yi ge yongs su gyur pa las bsgrub bya mdun du 'khor bar bltas shing de la sngags kyi phreng ba las byung ba'i 'od zer rnams kyis de la bkug nas de la mang du bsgom par bya ste/ de'i sems kyi rnam pa yongs su gyur pa las kun nas dmar ba'i zla ba'i rjodakyil 'khor gyi rnam par bsam par bya'o/ /sngags kyi phreng ba las lha mo sku mdog dmar mo phyag g.yon pas tweḥyig gi zhags pa bsnams pa/ phyag g.yas pas ut+pa la dmar po kha ⑦bye ba rdo rje'i lcags kyu lta bu bsnams pa bsgrub bya'i mdun du 'go bar bltas te/ oṃ s+dzas+thāḥ/ a mu ⑧ka gya ⑨dziX mā kar+ṣa ya hūṃ dzaḥzhes pas de la rnal 'byor pas bka' bsgo bar bya'o//de nas lha mo de cho ga bzhin du rab tu gzhug par bya bas zhags pas yang dag 40—1101

par stibacings shing lcags kyus bskul zhing ji lta ba bzhin du ②bkug nas rang gi sems la rab tu gzhug par bya'o/ / lha mo ni sngags kyi nang du blta bar bya'o/ /②de nas de skra grol zhing rnam par myos shing 'dod pas myos par 'dod pas gcig pu rjodabang du gyur te lag pa thal mo sbyar nas sgrub pa po la gdong mngon par phyogs te mngag gzhug byed par 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so—/ / //phyogs kyi gos can skra grol ba'i rdo rje phag mo lte ba'i phyogs su gri gug dang thod pa bsnams shing gar mdzad pa bsgoms na dbang du byed par 'gyur ro zhes soske/ /rdo rje phag mo'i dbang du bya ba'i ⑤cho ga'o// //bsdur mchan/11 ༷ ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉ga /rdo rje phag mo'i dbang du bya ba'i cho ga bzhugs so// ④〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉7ཿ/ ske〈〈pe 〉snga'ar 〉mizhugs/ ④〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉7'i/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉mas du〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉rdzas/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉tharlab/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈'ar 〉7yig11༷1 ①〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉mirlab/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉7rdo rje/ ①〈〈pe 〉snga'ar 〉7/ rjo〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉〉bzhugs/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉khyan gyis brlab/ rjo〈〈pe〉snga'ar 〉rgazla ba'i/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉dze'ar 〉ra ba/⑧〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉d+ku/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7tsa/11 2 ①〈'ar 〉sngas/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉7du/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉ṅkalha mo ni sngags kyi nang du blta bar bya'o/ /rjo〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ma pachog tu/ ⑤〈rtepe 〉skoshar 〉twed pa'i/40byed1102

༄ga /dpal rdo rje phag mo'i rtog pa don thams cad sgrub pa/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī badz+ra bā rā tī kālpa ④sarba arba sā dha rna/bod skad du/ dpal ①rdo rje phag mo'i rtog pa don thams cad sgrub pa/bcom ldan 'das ma 'phags ma rdo rje phag mo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das ma gsang ba'i dbang phyug ma lha mo rnams dang bcas pa rnams kyi bdag mo chen mo cher gsang ba chen mo sgyu ma chen mo dbang phyug chen mo 'jig rten gsum po bsdu ba dang slar yang 'jig rten gsum du spro bar bya ba ni④/'di ni gsang ba pa rnams ⑤yum/ /sgyu ma chen mor rnam par grags/ /'jig rten gsum po skrag mdzad pa'i/ /rig sngags 'di thob dbang phyug che/ /gang gis burnam par shes tsam gyis/ /sgrub byed dbang phyug rig sngags kyis/ /lha yi tshogs rnams kun bcas dang / /gnod sbyin lha min mi dang ni/ /rig 'dzin sha za srin po dang / /ltos 'gro mi 'am cir ⑦bcas rnams/ /40—1104

dbang du 'gugs byed 'byung rnams ni/ /chu skyes thang las skyes rnams kyang //ngo mtshar cher byed rig sngags la/ /mig 'phrul ①ltar byed de bzhin du/ / rmongs dang rengs byed de bzhin du/ /⑤rnam par zhe sdang spod sogs dang / /dbang du ①'gugs byed rmugs pa dang / /dpag med ngo mtshar rnam pa rnams/ /rig sngags bklags pas 'grub 'gyur te/ /sgrub pa po yi ngag kyang 'grub/ /de la bzlas med brtul zhugs med/ /sgyung dhiganas cho gas bsgrub mi dgos/ /lha mos bden pa dag ⑤la gsungs/ /nyon mongs med par dngos grub 'gyur/ /khyod kyi sngags ni sgyu ma che/ /'jig rten gsum po thams cad sgrub/ /rnal 'byor chen por rjorab bshad bya/ /lha mo yi ge'i phreng ba yis/ /oṃ na mo bha ga ⑦ba ti badz+ra bā rā tī baṃ/ āt+yā ⑧pa rā dzi te/ tre+e lokya mā te ma hā bibye shwa ri/sarba khyu ta bha yā stib he ma hā badz+re/ badzā sa ne+e/ a dzi te/ a pa rā dzi te/ba sh+yi ka ri de tra bh+ra ma ṇi/ bi ṣa ṇi⑩/ sho ṣa ṇi/ ro ṣa ṇi/⑪ kro dhe ka rā ⑫ li ni/ ⑫tā sa ni/ mā ra ṇi④/ pā bhe da ni/ a pa spyor dza ye/bi dza ye/ rdza bha ni s+t+waṃ bha ni/ mo ha ni/ badz+ra bā rā tī/ ma hā yo gi rtswa ⑩kā me shwa rī ⑩kha ge/ tar+ya thā thra tai ge pro tai gespyo/ ha na ha na/ pā zlan ki ki ni/kho khi ni⑪/ byu na byu na badz+ra haste④/ sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ka pā la dhā ri ṇispyo/ma hā pi ṅga ta māṃ ⑫sā sha ni/ mā nu ṣa an+t+ra pā bri te/ sān+ni bye ⑫na ra si ④ra mā lā ⑫gre thi ta dhā ri ṇi/ sum̐ bha ni sum̐ bhe⑪/ ha na ha na/ pra 0ṇ+ḍaṃ/ sarba pā shu pa nā/ ma hā māṃ sats+tsha ⑫da ni/ kro dha rūsto/ rdaṭī ⑫ka rā li ni ma hā mu dre⑩/shrī te ru ka de ba myu ⑥gra ma nyi ṣi/ sa ⑫ha sra shi re/ sa ha sra ba ⑫ha be+e/ sha ta sa ha sra a ④na ne+e/ dz+wa li ta te dza se/ dz+wa la mu khi ⑫dzi ga la lo tsa no/40—1105

badz+ra shā ①rī re/ badz+ra ā sdes ni/ mi li te/ te te/ ha ha①/ hūṃ hūṃ/kha kha/ dhu dhu/ byu ru byu ru/ mu ru mu ru/ muñtsa muñtsa a dwo dute ma hā yo gi ni—/ pa ⑤ṣ+ṭha ta sedhe/ dz+re snye dz+re t+t+waṃbu/ gro gre/ te te/ hā hā⑦/ ṭī me/ ha sa ha ⑧sa/ bi re/ hā ⑨hā/ ho ho/ hūṃ hūṃ/ tre+e lokya bi nā sha ni/sha ta sa ha sra ko ṭi ta thā ga ta pa ri bā re hūṃ ⑩hūṃ phaṭa sau ha byu ⑪pe/ kha ⑫ga dza byu be+e ⑫gaḥ/ tre+e lokya u da re⑫/ sa mu dra me kha le/ gra sa gra sa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ bī ra a dwo spyote hūṃ hūṃ/ hāḥhāḥ⑩/ ma hā bi shu mo ha ⑩ni/ ma hā ⑫yo ge shwa ri two/ ḍā ki nī lo kā māṃ brnya ni sat+yaḥ/ pra t+ya ⑪ya kā ri ṇi hūṃ ⑥hūṃ phaṭa/ bhū ta tā sa ni/ ma hā bī re/ pa ra ma sidhe/ yo gi ⑥shwa ri phaṭa/ hūṃ ⑪hūṃ phaṭa/hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ 'di ni bcom ldan 'das ma sgyu ma chen mo ⑫bklags pas 'grub pa'i sgrub thabs so/ /zla ba gzas bzung ④ba'am/ nyi ma gzas bzung ④ ba mthong nas lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bklag par bya'o/ /de nas dngos grub tu 'gyur ro/ /ji srid bklags pa ⑪de srid du bud med stong phrag gcig gi nga rjes su 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /lhan cig brjod pas dbang du ⑫'gyur ro/ /khro ba'i sems kyis snying por byed pas sgod pa dang rnam par zhe sdang ba dang rengs par yang byed do/ /dbang du bya bar 'dod pas me tog la yongs su bzlas nas nam mkha' la 'phangs na/ tshangs pa la sogs pa mthong bar byed do/ /dur khrod kyi sol ba la lan cig bzlas nas khyim dang grong dang grong khyer du 'phangs na sreg par mthong bar byed do/ /rma bya'i sgo la lan cig bzlas nas nam mkha' la bskor na slar yang zhi bar byed do/ /ka ra la lan cig bzlas nas phyogs bzhir gtor na dpung tshogs yan lag bzhir mthong bar byed do/ /rma bya'i sgros phyir 40—1106

bzlog nas bskor na slar yang med par byed par 'gyur ro/ /da ni sgyu ma chen mo'i dur khrod brjod par bya ste/ shar phyogs kyi cha la dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub pa po rjes su ①'dzin pa zhes bya ba'i dur khrod do/ /byang du gnyis su med par byed pa'o/ /nub tu khro bo'i sdegadong ngo / /lho ru mun pa mi bzad pa'o/ /me ru 'jigs pa chen po'o/ /bden bral du rnal 'byor mang po'i 'dus pa chen po'o/ /rlung du seng ge'i sgra phaṭa chen po sgogs ①pa'o//dbang ldan du chu skyes sa bon zhes bya ba'i dur khrod rnams so/ /'di rnams su ji lta ba bzhin du sbyor bas lus dang yan lag sreg pa dang / byed sreg pa dang lus nyams pa dang / lus phyed nyams pa 'jigs pa'i rnam pa 'jigs par byed pa dang / mdung gis phug pa'i ro bcings pa dang / skya snar rjodang /shaṃ ko la li dang / a mra dang / shi ri ⑤ṣa dang / u dusmra bur dang / a shwaṭī ⑦dang / nā ga ge sar gyi shing rnams so/ /go rims bzhin du ma he dang byi la dang / dom dang stag dang / bya rgod dang phag dang / sha za'i gdong pa can rdzu 'phrul chen po'i gnod sbyin rnams so/ /kun nas dur khrod brgyad du ce spyang dang bya rgod dang 'ug pa dang bya rog dang ro langs la sogs pa zhes so lha mo sgyu ma chen mo'i dur khrod do// //rdo rje phag mo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ byāḥgha ṭa ya gha ṭa ya sarba duṭ+wāṃ ⑧hūṃ phaṭa sā hā/ gtor ma phul nas bsam gtan bya'o/ /lte ba'i dbus su re yig yongs su gyur pa las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum/ de'i dbus su pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa/ de'i steng du s+thāḥyig bskal pa'i me bzhin du rab tu 'bar bzhin pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid rdo rje phag mo sku mdog 40—1107

dmar mo'o/ /'dab ma bzhi la bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i pad+ma'i snod bsam par bya'o/ /yi dwags kyi gdan la g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis ①bzhugs pa/gcer bu skra gyen du bsdes pa thod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa/phyag bzhi pa'i g.yas na rdo rje dang lcags kyu bsnams pa/ g.yon na snekha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang thod pa dang sdogs mdzub kyi ①zhags pa bsnams pa/ zhal gcig pa spyan gsum pa/ khro gnyer bsdus shing zhal gcigs pa'o/ /rdo rje rta rna rjom dang shin tu 'jigs byed ma dang / lto chen ma dang / ljags bskyod ⑤ma rnams bsgom ⑥par bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra bā rā tī spyo.ā be+e sha ya sarba duṣ+ṭṛ zo ⑧swā hā/ nye ba'i snying po'o/ /oṃ twe hūṃ s+thā 1 ⑨snying po'o/ /'bum bzlas par bya'o/ / 'dir ting nge 'dzin du gyur pas 'grub ⑩par the tshom med do/ /oṃ a s+thāḥhūṃ haṃ haḥ⑫sngags 'dis sha chen phye mar byas nas ri mo'i mdun du spos dbul bar bya'o—/ /nyin re bzhin ji srid du ⑫lan nyi shu rtsa gcig gis 'grub ste gzhan du ma yin no/ /oṃ hūṃ hūṃ haṃ haḥhaḥhri hri ⑫phe tse phe phaṭa ka ram̐ zhes ④mtshan mo gtor ma dbul ⑫nas bdud ⑩thams cad ⑩zhi bar bya ba'i phyir mtshan mo gtor ma dang yo byad ⑩lnga sbyin par bya'o/ /gang 'ga' zhig tu ⑪smra bar yang ⑩mi bya ste—/ rdo rje rnal 'byor mas 'dir byin gyis rlob par the tshom med do/ /dpal spyordo rje phag mo 3rtog pa las gsungs pa'i ⑫don thams cad sgrub pa'i ④ thabs rdzogs so// //40—1108

༄ga /byams pa'i sgrub thabs/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ mi tre ya ②sā dha ṭ+wāṃ/ bod skad du/byams pa'i sgrub thabs/ mgon po byams pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngon du gsungs pa'i cho ga 'dis zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du mo peyig ser po yongs su gyur pa las sna tshogs chu skyes la bzhugs pa'i zhal gsum spyan gsum/ phyag bzhi pa nag po dang dkar po ni g.yas dang g.yon gyi zhal lo/ /sku mdog gser lta bu'o/ /sems dpa'i skyil krungarjogis bzhugs pa chos 'chad kyi mephyag rgya mdzad pa'o/ /gzhan g.yas pa dang / g.yon pa'i phyag dag rjogis mchog sbyin dang nā ga ge sar gyi me tog gi ⑦snye ma bsnams pa/ sna tshogs pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i byams pa'i skur bdag nyid dmigs nas phyag rgya bcing ④bar bya'o—/ /lag pa gnyis so sor khu tshur bcings nas sdigs mdzub dag mthe bo'i dbus su bzhag nas me tog gi ⑨rnam par sbyar bar bya'o/ /de nas bzlas pa bya 40—1111

ste①la/ skyes mi tre ya swā hā/ byams pa'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/1111 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉༄ / /byams pa'i sgrub thabs gnyis bzhugs so// ②〈〈pe 〉〉tre yā/ 〈〈snar 〉〉tra ye/ ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉mi/ du〈〈snar 〉〉krungs/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉ཿnga / rjo〈〈snar 〉〉wadag ⑦〈〈snar 〉〉wagi ⑧〈'dir 〉〉tseng / ⑨〈〈snar 〉stonas/1112 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉rgya'o//bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2225)40—1112

༄ga /byams pa'i sgrub thabs/①༄ga /rgya gar skad du/ mi tre ya sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/ byams pa'i sgrub thabs/ 'phags pa byams pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngon du gsungs pa'i cho gas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du mo yig ser po yongs su gyur pa las/sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng du bzhugs pa'i 'phags pa mgon po byams pa zhal gsum pa laphyag bzhi pa nag po dang dkar po ni g.yas dang g.yon gyi zhal lo/ /sku mdog gser lta bu phyag gnyis kyis chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ gnyis pa'i phyag g.yas pas mchog sbyin pa/ gnyis pa'i phyag ④g.yon pas nā ga ge sar gyi me tog gi snye ma bsnams pa'o/ /lha'i rgyan dang na bzas sku la rnam par mdzes pa'i bdag nyid mngon du bya sterjo/ phyag rgya bcing bar ⑤bya'o/ /rjolag pa gnyis po ⑦so sor ⑧bcings te sdigs mdzub dag mtheb chen kyi dbus su bzhag nas me tog gi ⑨rnam par sbyar bar bya'o/ /de nas bzlas pa bya'o/ /40—1113

skyes mi tre ya ba/ hā/ byams pa'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/1112 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉bopa/ ③〈〈pe 〉〉〈'dir 〉〉waphyag ①〈〈pe 〉snga'adir 〉snanas te/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bcings par/ du〈〈pe 〉lo'adir 〉mi de la/⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉wapo/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉ri khu tshur/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stonas/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2236)40wa 1114

༄ga /khro zhing dgyes pa jo bha la'i sgrub thabs/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ uphro ②rdza bha la sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/ khro zhing dgyes ①pa rdza bha la'i sgrub thabs/ dpal ldan rjodze+e bha la la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thub pa'i gzhon nu rjothub dbang dge ba yisarjo/ /phun tshogs mchog gis ⑦dpag med rnam par brgyan⑧/ /gang zhig ⑨zhabs la spyan gsum drag po yi/ /gtsug gi nor bu'i rgyan gyis btud gyur pa/ /bla med yon tan gnyis med pa'i/ /rin chen tshong 'dus 'dren pa ste/ /rang gi phun tshogs 'gro rnams kyi/ /rgya ⑩chen thob phyir brten par bkyi⑪/ /de la dang por re zhig ⑫bdag gis dpal rdza bha la sgrub ⑫la sa la sogs pa'i rim pa thob nas/ de'i tshe bdag gis yang 'gro ba rnams 'di dang phyi ma'i phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas la dgod par bya'o zhes pa'i bsam pa dang ldan pas snying gi ④nang du bu ga nas rjes dbyangs dang ⑫ bral ba'i a ⑩yig 'od zer dkar po 'phro zhing de las skyes pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 40—1115

'khor la de la ①hūṃ yig dbus nag po ①phyi'i khor yug cung zad ser po'i ①'od zer gyi butshogs mgo'i steng du 'phro ba'o/ /de las skyes pa'i rdo rje ⑤'og tu rtse mo bzhi pa steng du rtse rjolnga pa sbyar ba las rtse mo dgu ste/ gsung rab yan lag dgu'i rnam par dag pa'o/ /gzhan nas ⑦steng dang 'og tu ⑧rtse mo gcig tu byas nas dbus kyi rtse mo dang dgu zhes so⑨/ /hūṃ yig bzhin du kha dog dang bya ba dang tshangs pa'i ⑩nang du zla ba la gnas pa'i de dang 'dra ba'i hūṃ dang ldan pa bsgom par bya'o⑪/ /de nas hūṃ yig dang rdo rje dag las 'od zer 'phros nas—/ oṃ a ⑫zhes pa'i sngags brjod pa sngon du 'gro bas ⑫phyogs bcu'i sems can rnams kyi don mdzad pa'i dze+e bha la'i sku dpag tu med pa mar ⑫me las mar me gzhan 'byung ⑫ba bzhin du ⑩'od zer gyis ⑩mdun du bkug nas de'i sku gcig tu bsgoms te/ nyer spyod lngas mchod nas/ sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa nas/ tshad med pa'i bar bsgom steske/ de'i rjes su yang hūṃ dang rdo rje'i 'od zer rnams ⑪ma lus pa lus kyi nang du bsgoms ⑫te/ spros pa thams cad dang bral ba stong pa nyid kyi ⑥rang bzhin la/ zla ba dang rdo rje'i sa bon gyi 'od zer rnams la/ oṃ a ⑫zhes pa 'dis spros te/ bkug nas bcom ldan 'das rab tu gzhug par bya'o/ /rab tu bcug pa'i mthar skad cig gis ⑫zla ba la sogs pa rdzogs pa las bdag nyid ④bcom ldan 'das dze+e bha la gzhon nu lo lnga lon pa lta bu sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du thung zhing rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa rin po che'i cod pan can no/ /kha nas rin po che skyug bzhin pabya/nor sbyin ser po gan rkyal du nyal ba'i dpral bar zhabs g.yas pas mnan pa/rkang pa gnyis kyi steng du zhabs g.yon pas mnan cing / g.yon brkyang gi ⑩ 40—1116

zhabs su mdzad pa/ gcer bu ①rtags steng du langs pa/ lto ba 'phyang ba/thugs kar phyag g.yas pas ④thod pa khrag gis bkang ba la ①zhal mngon par gzigs pa④/ brla g.yon pa'i ⑤steng du phyag g.yon pas rin po che'i snye ma skyug bzhin pa'i na gu li kha thur du bstan pa bsnams rjopa/ mi'u thung rna ba ma phug pa—/ zhal zla ba phyed pa lta bu⑦/ mche ba gcigs pa/ spyan gnyis zlum zhing dmar ba/ dpral bar ⑧khro gnyer bsdus pa/ dbu skra kham pa gyen du badze+es pa/ sa gnon kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i thub pa mi bskyod pa sngon pos dbu brgyan pa/ dga' bo sngon po ta ma la lta bus dbu skra bcing ⑨pa/ 'jog po dmar pos snyan dkris pa/ pad+ma chen po pad+ma'i rtsa ba lta bu dkar pos do shal byas pa/ du ⑩ba'i mdog lta bu ⑪mtha' yas kyis mchod phyir thogs mdzad pa/nor rgyas dkar pos ska rags mdzad pa/ pad+ma kun da ltar shin tu mdzes pas zhabs gdub byas pa⑫/ dung skyong ser pos lag gdub mdzad pa/ rigs ldan du ba lta bu ⑫khra bos dbu rgyan byas ⑫pa/ mdog nag spyocing phyi'i khor yug cung zad ser ba 'od zer gyi ⑩tshogs 'phro ba bsams nas/ dpral ba dang zhal dang dpung pa g.yas g.yon ⑩dang snying ga dang rdo rje'i steng dang brla g.yas g.yon spyodang zhabs g.yas g.yon dag gi nang du ⑪bu gar gnas pa'i zla ba'i ⑫dkyil 'khor bcu rnams la/ oṃ dze+e bha la dza len+d+ra ye swā hā/ zhes pa'i yi ge rnams ser zhing 'od zer ser ⑪por blta bar bya'o/ /de'i dus su ⑫sna nas rlung 'byung ba'i dus su hūṃ yig la sogs pa'i 'od zer rnams kyis snying ga'i hūṃ dang rdo rje'i 'od zer rnams kyis yang phyogs rnams su ⑫'phro zhing reg ④pa tsam gyis sems can rnams bcom ldan 'das kyi skur ⑫bsams te/ yang rlung rngub pa'i 40—1117

dus su hūṃ yig gis rab tu 'jug par bsams nas sems ①brtan par bya ste ②sngags bzlas par bya'o/ /'jig rten gsum na gnas pa'i rin po che sna tshogs pa thams cad klu dang sre mo dang nor sbyin rnams kyi kha ru rab tu gzhug par bya'o/ /slar yang rlung 'byung ba na klu la sogs pas mid pa'i rin po che rnams mdun du skyug par bsam par bya'o/ /de bzhin du yang dang sneyang du spro zhing bsdu ba la sogs pa byas nas/ de'i rjes su ④ngal na/ na mo rat+na tra yā yas/ na mo ma ṇi bha drwa ya/ ma hā yak+ṣa se na pa ta ye/ oṃ rdza bha la dza len+d+ra ye swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags bzlas par bya'o/ /yang na yi ge bcu bkod pa'i sngags so/ /chu 'bul ba'i dus su lag pa g.yas pa gan rkyal du byas pa'i dbus su baṃ yig gi 'od zer gyis lag pa bum pa rjobazang po bzhin du bya'o/ /lag pa'i rtsa bar oṃ yig gi 'od zer gyis lag gdub kyi rnam pa dang ldan pa'i ⑦baṃ mo/ /dbus su dze+e ngo / /mdzub ⑧mo dang gung mo dang ming med dang mthe'u chung dang /mtheb chen gyi rtse mo rnams la/ bha la dza len+d+ra'i ⑨yi ge rnams rim pa ji lta ba bzhin no/ /oṃ dang baṃ yig ⑩ni dbus su'o/ /gang ⑪yam̐ yig gi ⑫g.yas dang g.yon du swā hā'i yi ge'o/ /'di rnams ni oṃ yig la sogs pa ⑫rang rang gi gnas la bu ga rnams su ⑫zla ba la gnas pa'i kha dog ser zhing 'od zer ser por bsams nas/ lag pa chu dang me tog dang bcas pas kha ⑫mngon par phyogs te/oṃ in+d+ra ṇi mu khaṃ blu ⑫ma ri swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags lan bdun mngon par bsngags ⑩nas/ de'i rjes su lag pa brkyang ste ⑫sbyin par bya ba'i chu rang gi zhal du zhugs shing dze+e yig gi 'od zer gyis snying ga'i gnas nas rdo rje hūṃ yig gi 'od zer gyis ⑪yang kha dog ser por byas te/ rdo rje'i sgo nas thon ⑩te lag 40—1118

mthil du'o/ /mdun du skad cig gis bsgoms nas de'i zhal ①mngon par phyogs pas ②sku gzugs kyi zhal gyi ①nang du/ oṃ zlo rjoswā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags kyis brgya rtsa brgyad do/ /⑤rat+na tra yā duzhes pa la sogs pas kyang lan bdun ④dbul bar bya'o/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ⑧zhes pa la sogs pa ⑨yang lan cig brjod nas—/ bu ram dang bsres ⑩shing 'bras kyi khur ⑪ba la sogs pas ⑫gtor ma dbul bar bya'o/ /⑫ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin du thun mabyedas gsum dang yang na thun gcig tu gnas nas bstod pa dang smon lam yang gdab par bya'o/ /de bsgoms pa'i rjes la bcom ldan 'das oṃ badz+ra muḥzhes pas gshegs par bya'o/ /'on kyang smin drug dang dbo dang sa ga dang chu stod dang / ④gzhan yang bzang zhing bzang ba'i nyi ma dge ba la/ rdo rje'i ⑫dum bu la skad cig gis/ bcom ldan 'das kyi skur bskyed nas yang dag par mchod de/ gso spyong blangs nas/bzo bo gcig gis nyi ma gcig la dpa' bo'i rim pas ⑩sku gzugs bya'o/ /byas nas kyang ⑩bdag nyid kyi rim ⑫pa ji lta ba bzhin du bcom ldan 'das kyi sku la yi ge rnams dgod pa dang ⑪bsgom pa dang chu dbul ba la sogs pas bsgrub par bya'o zhes pa ni man ngag go/ /de nas gshegs su gsol bar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi sku gzugs ni rtag tu gnas te bkur ste la sogs pa bya'o zhes so/ /paṇ+ḍi ta chen po 'jigs ⑩med 'byung gnas sbas pas mdzad pa'i gis dze+e ⑥bha la'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //40—1119

༄ga /dze+e bha la'i sgrub thabs/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ dze+e bha la sā skedha rna/ bod skad du/ dze+e bha la'i sgrub thabs/ dpal ldan dze+e bha la la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngon ma bzhin du stong pa nyid kyi mthar thug pa ①rnam par bsams nas/ sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i rjosteng du zla ba la dze+e yig las skyes pa'i bcom ldan 'das rdza bha la bsgom par bya ste⑤/ gser kyi mdog can rjolta bu thung zhing lto ba spyo'aphyang ba/rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ g.yon pa dang g.yas pa'i phyag dag gis/sre mo dang bī dza pūr ④ka bsnams pa/ rin chen 'byung ldan kyis dbu brgyan pa/ut+pa la'i ⑨phreng ba bsnams pa'o/ /shar ⑩la sogs pa'i 'dab ma rnams su ⑪nor bu bzang po dang gang ba bzang po dang / nor sbyin dang rnam thos sras rnams so/ /me la sogs pa'i 'dab ma ⑫la ki li mi li dang / tsi pi kuṇ+ḍa ⑫li dang / mu khen+d+ra dang / tsa ren+d+ra ④rnams so/ /de bzhin du ji ltar gsungs 40—1122

pa'i rim pas ①nor rgyun ma dang / chu shel ma dang / so legs ②ma dang /'phags ma dang / shin tu bzang mo dang / sbas ma dang / lha mo dang ①/dbyangs can ma zhes te/ gnod sbyin mo rjo'adi rnams bsam par bya'o/ /nor rgyun ma ni rdza bha la dang lhan cig tu'o/ /gnod sbyin mo rnams ⑤ni nor rgyun ma ji lta ba bzhin no/ /gnod sbyin rnams rdza bha la bzhin te/ de bzhin du bsams nas sngags bzlas par bya'o/ /de la gnod sbyin rnams kyi rjosngags ni/oṃ rdza bha la dza len+d+ra ⑦ye swā hā/ oṃ ma ṇi bha dra ④ye swā hā/ oṃ pur+ṇa bha dra ye swā hā—/ ⑨ oṃ dha na dā ye swā hā/ oṃ bai shra ma ṇa yi ⑩swā hā/ oṃ ki li mi li ye ⑪swā hā/oṃ tsi pi kuṇ+ḍa li yi ⑫swā hā/ oṃ mu khen+d+ra ye ⑫swā hā/ oṃ tsa ren+d+ra ye ④swā hā/ de nas gnod sbyin mo rnams kyi sngags ni/ oṃ ba su dha rā ye spyoswā hā/ oṃ tsan+d+ra kan+ta yi ⑩swā hā/ oṃ dha na dā yi ⑩swā hā/ oṃ su dan+ta yi spyoswā hā/ oṃ āt+yā ma ⑪swā hā/oṃ su bha dā yi ⑫swā hā/ oṃ gu pa ta spyom swā hā/ oṃ de bī ma swā hā/⑫ oṃ swa ra swa tī ma ⑫swā hā/ de bzhin du thun mtshams gsum du bsgoms nas/ chu khyer ba brgya rtsa brgyad rab tu phul bas/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mnga' ris ster bar 'gyur ro/ /snga bar bya rog mi grag ④pa tsam na chu'i snyenang du bzlas na nor mi nyams shing 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas gser la sogs pa'i snod du nor rgyun ma dang gnod sbyin ⑩lhan cig tu'o/ /snod gnyis par bcom ldan 'das dzam+bha la gnod sbyin rmis yongs su bskor ba ⑦bris te yang dag par sbyar nas bsgrub par bya'o/ /dngos grub chen po brgyad la sogs pa yang ster bar 'gyur ro/ /dzam+bha la'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //40—1123

1123 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈snar 〉〉tā/ ③〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sprar/ du〈〈pe 〉7d+ma'i/ ①〈'dir 〉skruna'o// ①〈'dir 〉bocan/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉bob/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉stan dza pu ra/ ⑨〈〈snar 〉〉la/ ⑩〈〈snar 〉〉shos/ ⑫〈po ra 〉〉pa/ ⑫〈〈snar 〉〉〉rnams/⑫〈〈snar 〉〉kun ra/ ⑫〈〈snar 〉〉ren/1123 ①〈'dir 〉〉〉de rnams dang / de bzhin du/ ②〈〈snar 〉stab dang / so la sogs/ ③〈〈snar 〉〉wadang /bu〈〈pe 〉stab/ 〈〈snar 〉〉ma/ ⑤〈〈snar 〉〉thams cad/ rjo〈〈snar 〉7)/ ⑦〈〈snar 〉〉spon drwa/ ⑧〈〈snar 〉〉ni bha drwa/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉wa.oṃ pur+ṇa bha dra ye swā hā/ 〈〈snar 〉〉mi pur ṇa bha tra yī gu hā/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉ba ma ṇa ye/〈〈snar 〉〉sha ba ṇa ya/ ⑫〈〈snar 〉to'i li ne/ ⑫〈〈snar 〉〉ni/ ⑫〈〈snar 〉skaban drwa ya/ ⑫〈〈snar 〉〉ren tā ya / 8〈〈snar 〉〉dri ṇi/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉tsan+t+ra garnya ye/ 〈〈snar 〉〉tsan tra kān rkye/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉dhan+ta go 〈〈snar 〉〉dan tā yi/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉darnya ye/ 〈〈snar 〉stanan tā yi/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉ma ar+ya ye/ 〈〈snar 〉〉〉na ye/ ⑥〈〈pe〉〉1 ye / 〈〈snar 〉〉tā ye/ ⑥〈〈snar 〉〉tā/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉mi de be+e ye swā hā/ 〈〈snar 〉〉was/ de bī yi gu hā/ ⑫〈〈snar 〉〉ṇi/④〈〈snar 〉〉sgogs/ tso〈〈snar 〉〉chu/ tso〈〈snar 〉〉 mo rnams/ ⑩〈〈snar 〉〉〉kun nas/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2238)40wa 1124

༄ga /dze+e bha la'i sgrub thabs/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ②dze+e bha la sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/ ④dze+e bha la'i sgrub thabs/ rjordza bha la la phyag 'tshal lo/ /stong pa nyid bsgoms ⑤pa'i rjes la/ nyi ma la dze+e yig las skyes pa'i dza bha la rjoser po zhal gsum pa phyag drug pa mi bskyod pas ⑦ral pa'i cod pan can/ phyag g.yas pa gsum na ma tu lung ga dag ⑧dang lcags kyu dang mda' bsnams pa/ g.yon gyi phyag dang pos rtsibs ⑨logs g.yon du gnas pa'i shes rab ma la 'khyud pa/ gzhan ⑩dag gis zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sre mong ⑪dang / gzhu bkang ba'i bdag nyid du bskyed nas⑫/ mdun du de'i sku bsams ⑫shing lhag par gnas nas de'i spyi bor rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po bsgoms la④/ de la rab tu bcug cing ⑫dbang bskur nas/ rdo rje'i chu khyer ba brgya rtsa brgyad blud par bya'o/ /oṃ dza bha la dza len+d+ra ⑩ye swā hā/ zhes pa ni sngags so/ /bar kyi man ngag dze+e bha 40—1125

la'i sgrub ①thabs rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/1125 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈'ar 〉ṅkagli ni0〈snar 〉〉rgodapal/ ⑤〈〈snar 〉thasgom/ 0〈'dir 〉75sa/ ⑦〈〈snar 〉7 dang / ⑧〈〈snar 〉〉wadag ⑨〈po ra 〉〉po gcig gis rtsib/ ⑩〈〈snar 〉snasag g.yon pa/ ⑪〈〈snar 〉g.yo/ ⑫〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ ⑫〈〈snar 〉〉bsam/⑫〈〈pe 〉〉bsgoms nas/ 〈〈snar 〉〉bsams nas/ ⑫〈〈snar 〉〉bzhugs shing / ⑫〈po ra 〉〉spen drwa/1126 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉sgrubs/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2239)40wa 1126

༄ga /dpal jo bha la'i sgrub thabs mdor bsdus pa/①༄ga /rgya gar skad du/ saṃ k+ṣibe+e shrī rdza bha la sā dha dz+wa/ bod skad du/dpal rdza bha la'i sgrub thabs mdor bsdus pa/ dpal ldan ①dze+e bha la la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngon du gsungs pa'i cho gas ①snying gar zla ba'i dbus su rdza yig rjoser po rjolas dpal dze+e bha la sku mdog ser po phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas na bī ④dza pū ra ka dang / g.yon na ne+e'u le ⑦rin po che'i char ⑧'bebs bzhin pa ⑨bsnams pa/ sangs rgyas lnga'i cod pan can/ zhabs gnyis kyis dung gi mgo dang pad+ma'i mgo'i gter chen po dag mnan pa/ ut+pa la sngon po'i phreng ba can ⑩rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i dzam+bha la'i skur rang nyid bsgom ⑪par bya'o/ /rang gi khyim du yang rin po che sna tshogs pa'i ()char 'bab bzhin pa ⑫rab tu 'jug pa'i bdag nyid bsam par bya'o/ /de nas spyolag pa gnyis khu tshur bcings te/ gung mo dag gi spyodabus ma'i tshigs gsum pa bkug pa ni rdza bha 40byed1127

la'i phyag rgya'o①/ /oṃ dzi bha la dza len+d+ra ye swā hā/ sngags 'dis rje btsun la chu khyor ba brgya rtsa brgyad dbul bar bya'o/ /phyi nas mchod nas ②sngags bzlas par bya'o/ /①dngos grub ni sbyin bdag chen por 'gyur ༷te the tshom med do/ /dpal rdza bha la'i sgrub thabs mdor bsdus pa rdzogs so// //⑤slob dpon chen po tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa'odu// //bsdur mchan/1127 lamatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈snar 〉boldan/ ①〈'ar 〉〉/'di/ ①〈〈snar 〉〉ba bon gsum pa'i gsum pa kha dog ⑤〈〈snar 〉〉nestong pa'i lhas mnan pa zla ba phyed pas dbu brgyan pa/ de nyid rdzogs pa'i/ 0〈〈pe 〉stanayon na ne le/ 〈'dir 〉45ga g.yon na/ ⑦〈'ar 〉ṅkarab tu/ ⑧〈〈snar 〉〉4'i ne'u le/ ⑨〈〈snar 〉〉bsnams pa/ ⑩〈'dir 〉thadag nyid bsgoms/ ⑩〈〈snar 〉75 sogs pa/ ⑩〈〈snar 〉〉sgar/ ⑩〈〈snar 〉mi phyag rgya bcings par bya ste/ ④〈〈pe 〉po〈snar 〉stagos/1128 ①〈'dir 〉mun+t+ra zhes bya'o/ ②〈〈snar 〉〉pa byas te/ ③〈'dir 〉〉skode nas/ 0〈murnor 〉mu'ur/ ⑤〈〈snar 〉〉—rdzogs so// // ni〈〈snar 〉〉pa rdzogs so/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (224༷)40wa 1128

༄ga /jo bha la'i sgrub thabs mdor brtsas pa/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ saṃ k+ṣip+ta rdza bha la sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/dze+e bha la'i sgrub thabs mdor bsdus pa/ bcom ldan 'das dze+e bha la la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngon du gsungs pa'i cho gas snying gar ①pad+ma dang / zla ba la dze+e yig las byung ba'i 'od zer gyis sangs rgyas la sogs pa yang dag par mchod nas—/ sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa bya'o/ /de nas ①stong pa nyid sngon du bya sterjo/ de la de bzhin du gnas pa'i sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba la rdza las byung ba'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis sems can gyi don rjomadzad nas/ de yongs su gyur pa las dze+e bha la gser gyi mdog lta bu sangs rgyas lnga'i cod pan can/mdzes pa'i gos dang / rgyan gyis spras pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pabu/phyag g.yas na bī dza pū ra ka dang ⑦/ g.yon na kha nas rin po che sna tshogs skyug ⑧pa'i ne+e'u le bsnams pa/ ut+pa la sngon po'i phreng ba can⑨/ logs gnyis na 40—1129

rin po che'i snye ma'i char 'be+ebs pa'i gnod sbyin gnyis gnas pa/ zhabs kyi 'og na gnas pa'i rin po che'i snye ma'i ①bum pa dpag tu med pa'i 'od zer kyi phreng ba 'khrigs pa'i bdag nyid du bsam par bya'osne/ /oṃ dze+e bha la dza len+d+ra ①ye swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags bzlas sodhi/ /lag pa gnyis khu tshur bcings te gung mo'i dbus su tshigs gsum pa bcag pa'i phyag rgyas snying ga dang / mgrin pa dang / spyi bo dang mdzod sru rnams su sbyin par bya'o/ /snga bar yang de bzhin du skad cig gis bsgoms nas/ 'dis chu snyim pa brgya rtsa brgyad dbul bar bya'o//oṃ rdza bha la dza len+d+ra ye dha na rjome de nyi da da pā ya rjoswā hā/ rdza bha la'i sgrub ⑦ thabs mdor bsdus pa rdzogs so// //bldur mchan/1129 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉7sna tshogs/ ③〈〈snar 〉7sa nas dus phyis/ ④〈〈snar 〉7ngon du byas te/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉tsho) 'od zer gyi sems can gyi don/〈〈snar 〉sko sa gang ba sa bon gyi sems can snying po can de'i 'od zer gyis sems can dpag tu med pa'i don sna tshogs pa/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉spras pas/ 〈〈snar 〉rabargyan pa/ zhal gcig pa/ phyag gnyis pa/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉(pe dza pu rā ka dang / 〈〈snar 〉〉glo dza pu ra ka bsnams pa/ phyag gi/ ④〈〈snar 〉muḥgs/ ⑨〈〈snar 〉rabasnams pa/113༷ ①〈'a ra 〉7snye ma'i / ②〈〈snar 〉〉ngab tu rnam par bsam mo/ ①〈〈pe 〉zaban+d+ra/ 〈'a ra 〉raban tā/ me〈〈snar 〉〉par bya'o/ rjo〈〈pe 〉zaban+d+ra snya dz+wa/ 〈'a ra 〉raban tra dha rna/ rjo〈〈pe 〉ra/ la/ 〈〈snar 〉snga pa/ ⑦〈'a ra 〉〉sgrubs/40byed1130
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2241)40wa 1131

༄ga /jo bha la'i sgrub thabs rgyas pa/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ bistu ②ra dze+e bha la sā dha dz+wa/ bod skad du/dze+e bha la'i sgrub thabs rgyas pa/ dpal ldan rdza bha la la phyag 'tshal lo/ /stong pa nyid bsgoms pa'i rjes su ①cung zad dmar ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnod sbyin kyi shing rta zur gsum pad+ma 'dab ma dubargyad pa'i rnam pa'o/ /de'i dbus su baṃ yig las nor rgyun ma sku mdog ser mo phyag na 'bras kyi snye ma dang mchog sbyin mdzad pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ gnod sbyin mo brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba 'di lta ste/ bzang mo dang / rab tu bzang mo dang / sbas ma dang / rab tu rjosbas ma dang / lha mo dang / dbyangs can ma dang /'phags ma dang / chu shel ma rjornams kyis yongs su bskor ba/ lha mo chen mo de'i bha ga'i dbus su dze+e yig las skyes pa'i dze+e bha la ⑦nor rgyun ma la 'khyud pa/byang chub kyi sems nges par sbyor bas rin po che phyag na yang dag par bstod pa 40—1132

gsal ①bar bsgom par bya'o/ /'bab pa'i dus su bcom ldan 'das kyi shar phyogs su nor bu bzang po sku mdog sngon po'o/ /lho phyogs su gang ba bzang po skeser po'o/ /nub phyogs su rnam thos sras dmar po'o/ /byang phyogs su gnod sbyin ①dmar po'o/ /me dang bden bral dang rlung dang / dbang ldan gyi mtshams su mu khen+d+ra sngon dupo dang ki li mi li dang / ki li mi li chen po dang /zhal gyi dbang po sku mdog dmar po dang / spyod pa'i dbang po sku mdog ⑤ljang gu ste/ gser gyi zur phud lnga pa/ phyag g.yas na bī dza pū rjor ka ⑦dang /nyegayon na rin po che 'bar ba 'bo ⑨bzhin pa'i sre mong ⑩bsnams pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga 'phro ba/ pad+ma can dang dung can gyi gter chen po'i mgo bor rin po che'i char (spre'abebs bzhin pa rang gi khang pa'i gnas kyi phyogs gcig tu bsam par bya'o/ /mgon po rdza bha la sku mdog ser po ut+pa la sngon po'i ⑩phreng ba bsnams pa⑫/ de thams cad kyang gnod sbyin mo brgyad kyi bha ga'i dbus su gnas pa/ rin po che'i char ④'be+ebs bzhin pa/ rdza bha la dang 'dra ba bsgom ⑫par bya'o/ /shar sgor nor sbyin dang nor sbyin chen po⑩/ lho sgor gnod sbyin dang gnod sbyin chen po dang ⑩/ nub sgor ki li mi ⑫li dang /ki li mi spyoli chen po'ostso/ /byang sgor gang ba dang gang ba ⑥bzang po chen po ste⑫/de thams cad kyang gcer bu 'bras bu 'phyang ba/ lto ba 'phyang zhing rin po che'i char 3'be+ebs pa'o/ /de nas spyi bor nor bu bzang po④/ mig gnyis la rnam thos sras⑫/ kha la mu khen+d+ra'o/ /nu ma'i bar du gang ba bzang po⑩ lte ba la nor sbyin⑩/ brla dag la ki li mi ⑫li dang / ki li mi li chen mo⑥/rkang pa dag la tsi pi kuṇ+ḍa li'o⑥zhes pa'i lha rnams bkod la⑪/ yi ge rnams 40—1133

dgod par bya'o/ /oṃ ni spyi bor ro/ /lcu ni dpral bar ro/ /smri ①ni rna ba dag la'o/ /mgo bo'i rgyab tu swā hā'o/ /mkhrig mgul du lha mo/ /lag pa'i dbus su hūṃ ②mo/ /sor mo thams cad la oṃ rdza bha la dza len+d+ra ye ①swā hā/ oṃ dh+ri rja swā hā zhes pa'i sngags so/ /de bzhin du mdzub mo la nor bu bzang po'o /gung mo la gang ba bzang po'o/ /ming med la nor sbyin no/ /mthe'u chung la rnam thos sras so/ / tsi pi rjokuṇ+ḍa li ni mtheb chen la'o/ /mkhrig mtshams su ki li mi li na'orjo/ /yi ge rjornams lag pa la bkod nas/ snga bar rdo rje'i chu la sogs pa'i bdud rtsi lnga ste/ de'i ngo bo ma yin pa yang rdo rje'i chu tsam yang bsres te khyod bas 'thung nas/ lag pas ⑦khyor ba brgya rtsa brgyad dbul bar bya'o—/ /thun mtshams ⑧gsum gyis yun mi ring bar 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /oṃ dh+ri rja ⑨s+t+waṃ saṃ zhes brjod nas chu khyor bas sbyin par bya'o/ /gal te de bzhin ⑩byas pas ma grub na/ dpal rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi skur bdag nyid bsgoms nas/ dze+e bha la'i sku ⑪gzugs la dug dang ske tshe dang tshwa dang myos byed kyi lo ma'i khu ba dang dur khrod kyi sol bas byugs te/ dur khrod kyi me la khros pas bdugs ⑫na/ nges par 'grub par 'gyur spyozhes so/ /dze+e bha la'i sgrub thabs rgyas pa rdzogs so// //40—1134

1132 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉tsā sta/ ni〈〈snar 〉〉la/ 0〈'ar 〉〉wam/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉losnar 〉torab tu dga' ma dang / 0〈〈snar 〉7zhes te/ 'di/ ⑦〈〈snar 〉ringani/1132 ①〈〈snar 〉stanaser/ ②〈'dir 〉〉〉sku mdog ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉nor sbyin/ 〈'dir 〉rnar sbyin sku mdog ①〈〈snar 〉〉rnams su gang ba bzang po dang / gang ba bzang po chen/ du〈〈pe 〉bosku mdog dmar po dang / spyod pa'i dbang po sku mdog rjo〈〈pe 〉༅ dza pu/ ⑦〈〈snar 〉〉〉ra/ ⑧〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〉phyag ⑨〈〈snar 〉〉che'i char 'babs/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉dze'adir 〉〉mo/ ⑫〈〈snar 〉〉ce chen po la sogs pa'i char rab tu/ ⑫〈〈snar 〉〉ud pa/ la'i/ ⑫〈〈snar 〉〉pa'o// ④〈〈snar 〉〉nerab tu/ ⑫〈〈snar 〉〉bsgoms/ tso〈〈snar 〉ringadang /⑩〈'dir 〉ya'o// ⑫〈〈snar 〉stab/ yi〈'dir 〉〉gro/ 0〈〈snar 〉nyapo dang / 0〈〈snar 〉〉wadang gang ba/du〈'ar 〉〉dang / gang ba bzang po chen po dang / 0〈〈snar 〉ṅkarab tu/ ④〈snar 〉smra'o// ④〈〈snar 〉〉sras so// ⑩〈'dir 〉〉po'o// sh+yi〈〈snar 〉〉〉no// phyi〈〈snar 〉tsho'i/ ⑥〈〈snar 〉〉gli li dag go/ /ci pi kun shesali/ ⑥〈〈snar 〉〉pa'o/ ⑥〈〈snar 〉stanas/1134 ①〈〈snar 〉〉spyom/ ②〈〈snar 〉〉sru/ ②〈〈snar 〉〉spon tra ya/ du〈〈snar 〉stab gi dhi〈〈snar 〉to'i li'o/ du〈〈snar 〉〉/'di/ ⑦〈'dir 〉〉〉chu/ ⑧〈〈snar 〉〉cesu/ ⑨〈〈snar 〉〉sgom snom/ ⑩〈'dir 〉〉nedu/ ⑪〈〈snar 〉〉—sku/ ⑫〈〈snar 〉〉pa bsros/ ⑫〈〈snar 〉〉〉ro/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2242)40wa 1135

༄ga /dpal dze+e bha la'i sgrub thabs/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī dze+e bha la sā dha rna/④ bod skad du/dpal dze+e bha la'i sgrub thabs①/ j-i bha la la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang po re zhig gyeganas kyi don thams cad dang rang gi lus kyang stong par bsgom pa'o⑤/ /de'i rjes la cung zad dmar ba'i zla ba'i rjodakyil 'khor la thabs dang shes rab kyi rang bzhin ④nyid gnod sbyin gyi shing rta gru gsum pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i rnam pa'o/ /de'i dbus su baṃ yig las nor rgyun ma sku mdog ser mo phyag na 'bras kyi snye ma dang mchog sbyin mdzad pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/gnod sbyin mo brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba 'di lta ste/ bzang mo dang /rab tu bzang mo dang / sbas ma dang / rab tu sbas ma dang / lha mo dang /dbyangs can ma dang / 'phags ma dang / chu shel ma ⑧rnams kyis yongs su bskor ba'o⑨/ /lha mo chen mo de'i bha ga'i dbus su/ dza yig ⑩gi bdag nyid 40—1136

sangs rgyas lnga'i cod pan can/ phyag g.yas na bī dza pū ra ka① /g.yon na rte'u le bsnams pa'o①/ /de bzhin gshegs pa lngas rin po che sna tshogs pa'i char 'be+ebs bzhin pa dung can gyi mgo dang / pad+ma can kyi mgo'i gter chen po la zhabs gnyis bzhugs pa ①rang gi khang pa'i phyogs gcig tu bsam par bya'o//sku mdog ser po ut+pa la sngon po'i phreng ba bsnams pa'i rjodapal ldan mgon po dze+e bha la nor rgyun ma la yang dag par ⑤'khyud pa/ byang chub sems kyi thig le las skyes pa'i rin po che'i tshogs kyis nam mkha' ma lus par khyab rjopar bsgom par bya ste⑦/ 'bab pa'i dus su shar phyogs su gang ba bzang po sngon po④/lho phyogs su rnam thos sras ser po⑫/ nub phyogs su nor sbyin ⑩dmar po'o/ /byang phyogs su nor bu bzang po ⑪ser po'o/ /me'i mtshams ⑫su tsi pi kuṇ+ḍa li dmar po⑫/ bden bral du ki li mi ⑩li sngon po⑫/ rlung du spyod pa'i dbang po ser po⑩/ dbang ldan du kha'i dbang po ser po'o⑩/ /de thams cad kyang nor ⑫sbyin mo'i bha ga'i dbus na gnas pa'i ⑪rin po che'i char 'be+ebs bzhin pa'i dze+e bha la ⑫bzhin du bsgom par bya'o/ /shar sgor gnod ⑥sbyin chen po ⑫gcer bu 'bras bu 'chang ⑫ba rin po che'i char 'bebs pa'o/ /lho sgor pad+ma dang pad+ma chen po dag go/ /nub sgor ki li dang ma hā ki li dag go/ /byang sgor gang ba ⑫dang gang ba bzang po spyodag go/ /de dag ⑪rnams kyang gcer bu 'bras bu 'chang ⑥ba'o/ /mgon po dze+e bha la la stego rims bzhin du sngags kyi yi ge rnams dgod par bya'o/ /oṃ ni spyi bor ro⑫/ /dze+e ni zhal la'o/ /bha la ni ⑫phyag gnyis la'o/ /dza thugs kar ⑪ro/ /len lte ba la'o/ / dā ya ni ⑫brla gnyis la'o/ /swā hā ni ⑫pus mo gnyis la'o/ /spyi bor nor bu bzang po'o /40—1137

spyan gnyis la rnam thos sras so/ /①kha la mu khen+d+ra'o②/ /nu ma'i bar du gang ba ①bzang po'o/ /lte bar rjonor sbyin no/ /brla gnyis la ki li mi li'o/ /rkang pa dag la tsi pi kuṇ+ḍa li'o/ /yan lag thams cad la tsa ren+d+ra'o/ /⑤da ni yi ge dgod par bya'orjo/ /oṃ spyi bor ro⑦/ /lja dpral bar ro/ /rja rna ba dag la'o/ /saṃ mgo bo'i rgyab tu ⑧dgod par bya'o/ /da ni lag pa la dgod she par bya ba ⑩ste / lha rnams kyi yi ge oṃ mkhrig ⑩mgul du/ lja lag pa'i dbus su/ rja sor mo thams cad kyi rtse mo la saṃ sor ⑫mo thams cad kyi rtsa — ba la'o/ /oṃ dze+e bha la dza len+d+ra ④ye swā hā/ zhes pas rab tu gnas par bya'o/ /mdzub mo la ⑫nor bu bzang po/ gung mo la gang ba bzang po⑫/ ming med la sanor sbyin/ mthe'u chung la rnam ⑫sras/ de bzhin du kha'i dbang po lag pa'i mthil du/ mkhrig ⑪mgul du ki li mi ⑫li/ mtheb chen la tsi pi ⑪kuṇ+ḍa lirka/ mdzub mo dang bcas pa'i ⑫mtheb chen gyi bar du tsa ren+d+ra'o⑫/ /lag pa'i dbus su dze+e bha la dza len+d+ra'o④/ /rdo rje'i chu la sogs pa'i ④bdud rtsi lnga de'i ngo bo ma yin kyang / rdo rje ⑫chu dang chu bsres nas khyod bas btung ste⑩/ khyor ba brgya rtsa brgyad thun mtshams gsum du dbul bar bya'o/ /ring por khyemi thogs par dze+e bha la dang 'dra bar 'gyur ro/ /nor dang gser 'phel zhing sa gzhi rdzas kyis yongs su gang bar 'gyur ro⑥/ /oṃ lja rja saṃ ⑩zhes bajod cing chu khyor bas dbul bar bya'o/ /grub par ma gyur na dpal rdo rje hūṃ mdzad du bdag nyid bsgoms la dze+e bha la'i sku gzugs la dug dang ske ⑪tshe dang nim pa'i lo ma dang / dha du ⑫ra dang / dur khrod kyi sol bas ⑫byugs la bsro zhing skam ④par bya'o/ /phyi nas dur khrod kyi me la khros pas bdugs na nges par 'grub par 'gyur ro⑪/ /40—1138

dpal ldan ①rdza bha la'i sgrub thabs ④rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/1136 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈snar 〉7be+estar/ ④〈'ar 〉7rgyas pa/ dpal/ rjo〈〈snar 〉yar re shig ⑤〈〈snar 〉misgoms te/ rjo〈〈snar 〉7zla ba'i/ ⑦〈'ar 〉7de/⑧〈'ar 〉7ma/ ⑨〈'ar 〉mi/ ⑩〈'ar 〉7yig1137 ①〈〈snar 〉7bsnams pa/ ②〈〈snar 〉7/ ④〈〈pe 〉7dung can gyi mgo dang / pad+ma can gyi mgo'i gter chen po la zhabs gnyis bzhugs pa/ 〈〈snar 〉〉dung can gyi mgo dang / pad+ma chen pos mgo'i gter chen po la zhabs gnyis bzhugs pa/ rin po che la sogs pa'i char 'bab bzhin pa/ rjo〈snar 〉7/ ⑤〈〈snar 〉7yang dag par/ rjo〈〈snar 〉mi rnam/ ④〈'a ra 〉ra 'o// ⑧〈'a ra 〉skab dog sngon po'o// ⑨〈〈snar 〉skab dog ser po'o// ⑩⑩〈'a ra 〉7kha dog ⑫〈〈snar 〉stabags/ ⑫〈〈snar 〉skab dog dmar po'o// ⑫〈'a ra 〉〉mā/ ⑫⑩〈'a ra 〉shesa'o ⑩〈〈pe 〉shes/ ske〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉sngaganod/ ⑪〈'a ra 〉7/ ⑦〈〈snar 〉〉—bzhin pa'i bha la/ ⑥〈shar 〉ror/ ⑪〈'ar 〉7dang / 3〈'ar 〉thaphyang / ④〈'ar 〉〉 bzangapo/ bla〈'ar 〉7chen po/ ⑫〈〈snar 〉ṅkadag ⑦〈〈snar 〉thaphyang / 3〈'ar 〉7la/ ⑥〈〈snar 〉d+ku'o/⑫〈'ar 〉rag ⑥〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉rakar/ ⑫〈〈snar 〉〉tra ye/ ⑫〈shar 〉7ni/1138 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈'ar 〉7de bzhin du/ khru〈'ar 〉shen dra yang dag par gnas so/ ④〈'ar 〉7gang ba/du〈〈snar 〉7gnod sbyin/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉7de bzhin du mgon po dzam bha la'i bdag nyid bsgoms la/bu〈〈snar 〉7 ste/ ⑦〈'ar 〉jo ru'o/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ṅkarnam par/ ⑨〈〈snar 〉ragod pa brjod/⑩〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉〉gib/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉〉gos chamakhrigs/ 〈po ra 〉snga sa cha'akhrigs/ ⑫〈'a ra 〉ra mor/⑫〈〈snar 〉tsha/ ④〈〈snar 〉ṭhan 7/ ⑫〈'ar 〉ṅkal/ ⑩〈'ar 〉༅'o// ⑩〈'ar 〉7la/⑩〈〈snar 〉stabazeb chen rnam thos/ spyo〈po ra 〉〉logs su 'khrigs/ ⑥〈〈snar 〉snga li mā/ spyo〈po ra 〉〉 /⑫〈〈snar 〉7bcas pa'i/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉than tra ka'o/ 〈'ar 〉than tra'o/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉'an tra'o/⑫〈'ar 〉7/ ⑪〈shar 〉tsā'i/ ⑦〈'ar 〉d+kuthungs te chu/ 3〈snar 〉ya/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉sngasnar 〉twed do/⑫〈〈snar 〉7ཿ/ ⑪〈'ar 〉〉skye ⑫〈'ar 〉ra tu/ ⑫〈〈snar 〉ṅkarab tu/ ④〈'ar 〉miskam/ ⑫〈'ar 〉jo/1139 sti〈zhar 〉7ldan/ ④〈〈snar 〉7rgyas pa/40—1139

༄ga /jo bha la la chu dbul ba'i man ngag①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ dhā ra dā na ④j-i bha lo pa de sha /bod skad du—/ rdza bha la la chu ①dbul ba'i man ngag /dpal ldan rdza bha la la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ming med kyi rtse mo la rdza rjoyig ser po bsams la/ phyag rgya la sogs pas snod la rdza bha la bsgoms nas/ ming med kyi rtsa ba la chu rgyun lag pa'i bar du lhung bas⑤/ de'i dbu la de bzhin du 'bab cing dze+e yig brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas la rjobasgom par bya'o/ /dze+e bha la la chu ⑦dbul ba'i man ngag go/ /lag pa g.yas pa la bye dang po'i lnga pa'i sa bon yongs su gyur pa las de bzhin gshegs pa lnga bsams nas/ de la yang zla ba dang lhan cig khu bar ④byas te/mdun du rdza las byung ba'i rdza bha la ⑨rab tu grags pa bskyed nas/ sngon du gsungs pa'i khu bas de'i spyi bor chu dang lhan cig ⑩brgya rtsa brgyad mdzub mo brkyang ba'i bar du'o/ /khu tshur phyed bcings pa'i ⑫lag pas chu khyod ba nas 40byed1141

thong ①bas ma lus pa'i phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ro/ /rdza bha la'i man ngag go//rgyal ba rnam par snang mdzad zhes grags rin chen 'byung ldan dang / /de bzhin 'od dpag med dang don yod grub pa mi bskyod grags/ /'di rnams sku mdog dkar ser dmar dang ljang gu sngon po rnams/ /byang chub mchog dang mchog sbyin bsam gtan mi 'jigs ④sa gnon phyag /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi 1sa bon ni/ / hūṃ dze+e d+dhi khaṃ rjohūṃ zhes so/ /zla ba lag pa g.yas gnas pa'irjo/ /yi ge lnga las byung ba yibu/ /de bzhin gshegs pa lnga bsams ⑦nas/ /khu ba'i gzugs su rnam par bsgom/ /rdza las byung ba'i dze+e bha la/ /bsams nas chu khror gus pas dbul/ /de yi sngags ni bzlas pa yi⑧/ /brgya rtsa brgyad ni dbul bar bya/ /rdza bha la la chu ⑨dbul ba'i man ngag rdzogs so// //⑩40—1142

bsdur mchan/1141 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉lo〈snar 〉〉dha ra/ ①〈〈snar 〉〉/rgyun/ 0〈〈snar 〉ringam/ ⑤〈〈snar 〉rdzang ba'i/ 0〈'ar 〉〉〉rnam par/ ⑦〈'ar 〉〉〉rgyun du/⑧〈'dir 〉〉tu khu ba/ ⑨〈〈snar 〉〉wabyung ba'i dze bha la/ ⑩〈'dir 〉〉skotu/ ⑫〈'dir 〉〉bcing ba'i/1142 ①〈〈pe 〉ro:nga / 〈〈snar 〉〉 ngas/ ②〈〈snar 〉mi bsam gtan/ ①〈〈snar 〉nya)sa/ du〈〈pe 〉〉byi 4/ rnyed badzi 15 〈〈snar 〉glesa.am dzim kham/ ⑤〈〈snar 〉〉pa yis/ rjo〈〈snar 〉stabs/ ⑦〈〈snar 〉〉bsam ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈'dir 〉stabs/ ⑨〈po ra 〉〉nergyun/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉 shubha mastu sarba dza ga te// //dge'o// //bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2244)40wa 1143

༄ga /rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs/①༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ ha ya 1 ②ba sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/ ①rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs/ dpal rta mgrin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngon du gsungs pa'i cho gas sna tshogs chu skyes dang nyi ma la haṃ yig dmar po'i ye shes rdzogs pa las rta mgrin sku mdog dmar po zhal gsum pa phyag brgyad pa/ zhal so so ba ④la spyan gsum pa sngon po dang dkar po ni g.yas dang g.yon gyi zhal lo/ /sbrul gyis brgyan pa zhabs rol pa'i ⑤stabs kyis bzhugs shing / khro bo'i lta stangs kyis gzigs pa/ zhal dang po bzhad pa zhal g.yas pas ljags bsgril ba/ zhal g.yon pa'i mche ba dag gis ma mchu bsdams pa'o/ /stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can no/ /rdo rje dang dbyug pa dang mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang / mda' 'phyar ba ni g.yas kyi phyag bzhi na'o/ /sdigs mdzub dang rang gi nu ma bzung ba dang / pad+ma dang / gzhu 'phyar ba ni g.yon gyi phyag bzhi na'o/ /mi bskyod 40—1144

pas dbu brgyan par ①bsam par bya'o zhes pa ni rta mchog gi ye shes rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin no/ /bzlas pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ haṃ ha ya shrī ②ba swā hā/rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs/ slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/1144 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉༄ga /lha so so'i sgrub thabs rims grangs las rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs rim pa bzhugs so// 〈〈snar 〉〉༄na /lha so so'i sgrub thabs rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ②〈〈pe 〉ri'adir 〉stayi/ ①〈〈pe 〉lo'adir 〉〉jidapal/ 0〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉gsum po/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉po〈snar 〉bopa'i/1145 ①〈〈snar 〉〉spyan pa/ ②〈〈snar 〉sto1/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2245)40wa 1145

༄ga /rtog pa bdun brgya pa las gsungs pa'i rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ sap+ta sha sketi ka kaspok+ta ①ha ya shrī dhib sā dha rgo/bod skad du/ rtog pa bdun brgya pa las gsungs pa'i rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs/dpal rta mgrin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos po thams cad rang bzhin gyis mi gnas pa zhes pa ni bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi dgongs par rig par byas nas—/ de nas ri rab yan lag brgyad pa rin po che sna bdun gyi rang bzhin la de'i dbus su dpag tshad stong gi tshad kyi gdan la nye bar 'dug ste/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba la sogs pa sngon du 'gro bas lus dang ngag dang yid byin gyis brlabs la/ de yis de bzhin du nam mkha' khyab pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la mngon par khyab par sprul nas/ de la de bzhin du hūṃ yig 'bar ba las 'od zer gyi rnam par bsam zhing / de nas lus ngag yid thams cad rdo rje rnams kyis phyag 'tshal bas oṃ ābyuhūṃ zhes pa 'dis phyogs bcu'i mthar 40—1146

thug pa'i sde'ajig rten gyi khams na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams gdan drangs nas ye shes kyi rnam pas rab tu zhugs te/ slar yang hūṃ yig gnyis pas rta mgrin yang dag par bskul zhing gdan drangs nas rab tu zhugs te hūṃ yig gsum pas bdag nyid de bzhin du rta mgrin bzhin du rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi bdag nyid can sku mdog ④dmar po 'jigs su rung ba spyan gsum pa/ drag po sma ra dmar ser can/ gsus pa che ba/ zhal mche ba gcigs pa/ thod pa'i phreng ba can/ ral pa'i cod pan can/ 'od dpag tu med pas dbu brgyan pa/ zhal gnyis pa sngo zhing 'jigs su rung ba'i ①tī tī'i sgra sgrogs shing tshangs pa'i sgo nga'i rtse mo nas rnam par gnon pa/ gnyis pas srid pa la sogs pa'i mthar thug pa la'o/ /klu brgyad kyis brgyan pa/mi'u thung gi rnam pa can/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ sbrul gyi burgyan gyis brgyan pa/ lha dang lha ma yin mtha' dag la baspyigs ⑤par mdzad pa/rdo rje dang dbyug pa bsnams pa/ rta mgrin dulas kha dog sna tshogs pa'i 'od zer spro ba dang bsdu ba bsam par bya'o/ /sngags ni oṃ ha ya shrī ⑦ba byāḥhūṃ phaṭa swā hā zhes te/ bcom ldan 'das 'di'i mthus yid bzhin kyi nor bu dang /bum pa bzang po dang / dpag bsam gyi shing dang / bcud dang / bcud kyis ⑧len la sogs pa'i dngos grub rnams bsgrubs pas mngon du 'gyur ro zhes rtog pa bdun brgya ⑨pa las gsungs so/ /cis kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi ⑩ bzlas pa 'bum phrag gsum byas pas 'khor los sgyur ba dang rgyal srid gnyis mngon du 'gyur ro/ /lha'i bu mo dpag tu med pa'i 'khor gyis bskor zhing rig 'dzin ma ⑪mdun du byas te/ de la bde ba'i 'bras bu nyams su myong zhing 40—1147

gnas so/ /lha'i dbang pos gdugs 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /tshangs pa'i sngags pa dang / thag bzangs ris kyi dmag dpon dang / 'phrog ①byed dang /so sor 'phrog ④byed dang / lha rnams mtha' dag stobs med par 'gyur ro/ /gcer bu pa'i slob dpon bde byed dang mtha' dag gi yon tan rnams nye bar ston par byed do/ /ji srid bcom ldan 'das kyis ①byams pa mngon par ma rtogs pa de srid du gnas so/ /mngon par rtogs nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu rjolung ston par 'gyur ro/ /rtog pa bdun brgya ⑤pa las gsungs pa'i rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //baspur mchan/1146 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈po ra 〉〉kawa ka kalnga/ rjo〈〈pe 〉snga / 〈po ra 〉sta1/1147 ①〈〈snar 〉7mthar thug pa'i/ ④〈〈pe 〉skosnar 〉7sku mdog ④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉tha/ rjo〈'a ra 〉7)sa/⑤〈〈pe 〉thasdig 〈〈snar 〉stagags/ rjo〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉〉gimagrin/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉mgri/ ⑧〈'a ra 〉7)/⑨〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7brgya/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉snga' ra 〉7)sa/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉snga' ra 〉〉du mas/1148 ①④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉'ag ①〈〈snar 〉7kyis/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7tu/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ṅkabargya/40—1148
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2246)40wa 1149

2na2༷༄ga /rgyud thams cad kyi snying po phyi ma'i rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs/①༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ sarba tan+t+ra z-i da ya ut+ta ②ra ha ya shrī 1ba sā dha rgo—/ bod skad du/ rgyud thams cad kyi snying po phyi ma'i rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs—/ dpal rta mgrin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs yang dag par rab tu bshad par bya'o/ /dang por re zhig sngags pas yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su bdud rtsi lngas byugs te/ ji ltar rnyed pa'i stan la nye bar 'dug nas rang gi snying ga nas hūṃ yig gi 'od zer gyis yang dag par bskul nas bla ma dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams nye bar spyad pa thams cad kyis yang dag par mchod cing phyag 'tshal ba dang / sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa rjobyas nas/ yang dag par brjod par bya ste/ oṃ su bhā ba shudhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ⑤ba shustsolhaduhaṃ/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā ba ā kophospyohaṃ—/ sngags 'dis rang bzhin stong par bsgom par bya'o/ /phyi nas 40—1150

nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i ze'u ①'bru'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan la bdud rtsi dang bcas pa'i thod pa bsam par bya'o—/ /de la hūṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las sangs rgyas kyi thugs drag po rnam par bsam par bya ste/ zhal bzhi pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ g.yas bskum pa ④dag dang / g.yon brkyang ba dag go/ /phyag brgyad pa/ dpa' bo chen po lha mo bzhis yongs su bskor ba'o/ /bdag nyid gang zhig grub 'dod pas/ /khyab bdag chen po rta mgrin ni/ /sku mdog dmar po mche ba rno/ /spyan ni gsum pa dmar po dang / /nag po dkar po rtsa ba dang / /g.yas dang g.yon pa'i zhal nyid do/ /steng zhal rta yi rnam pa la/ /pā la sha yi kha dog bzhin/ /thod pa khrag gis gang ba dang / /sha chen chang nyid dag kyang ngo / /rta yi zhal sogs dbu la ni/ /dbang bskur rab tu sbyin par bya/ /rgyan rnams thams cad yongs rdzogs shing / /thod pa'i phreng bas rnam par brgyan/ /be+egs kyu mda' dang thod pa dang / /rdo rje rnams ni phyag g.yas na/ /zhags pa gzhu dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /dril bu rnams ni phyag g.yon na/ /bha ga'i dbus su sgrub pa pos—/ /'di lta bu nyid 'dir bsgom bya/ /bdud rtsi lnga yis yang dag mchod//mchod pa'i bdag nyid bsgom par bya/ /shar du lha mo bri bar bya/ /rta yi rdo rje 'jigs chen mo/ /byāḥyig las ni yang dag byung / /zhal gcig pa la phyag ni bzhi—/ /g.yon na gzhu dang thod pa la/ /bdud rtsi dang bcas g.yas pa ni/ /mda' nyid dang ni keng ①rus te/ /sna tshogs gzugs can 'bar ba ste/ /lho ru phyag rgya bri bya ba/ /zhal gcig phyag ni bzhi pa ste/ /haṃ yig las ni yang dag bskyed④/ /phyag g.yon kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang ni/ /khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa 40—1151

bsnams—/ /g.yas na zhags pa chen po dang / /keng rus brtul zhugs bsnams pa'o/ /thod pa'i gdan gyi dbus gnas pa'i/ /sku mdog nag mo 'bar ba che/ /phag mo zhes pa bri bar bya/ /nub tu ce ①spyang rdo rje ma/ /thod pa'i gdan la yang dag bzhugs/ /trīḥyig las byung lha mo ni/ /sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig ma/ /phyag bzhi g.yon gyi thod pa na/ /dri chen gyis gang rgyal mtshan zhags/ /g.yas kyis ④ḍa ma ru dang ni/ /keng rus brtul zhugs bsnams pa'o/ /byang du phyag rgya bri bar bya/ /sku mdog dkar mo rdo rje'i lag /'dab ma bzhi la bri bar bya/ /cha bsags rta mgrin mchod par bya/ /dri chen dri chu dang bcas pas/ /lha mo thams cad g.yas brkyang gi/ /zhabs gnas 'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrigs/ /thod pa'i phreng bas rnam par brgyan/ /spyan gsum mche ba rno zhing 'jigs/ /bdag nyid dngos grub 'dod gang gis/ /sngags kyi rgyal po dran par bya/ /de la sngags ni 'di'o/ /oṃ ha ya shrī ba d+dhāḥ.a haṃ a haṃ/ s+t+waṃ slo/ hūṃ hūṃ swā hā/ sngags 'di bsam gtan byas nas ni/ /rtag tu bzlas shing dran par bya/ /'bum phrag gnyis dang bye ba dang / /stong phrag gcig gis nad med 'gyur/ /sngon du nges par bsags pa yi/ /sdig pa'ang cung zad med par 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug dus kun du/ /srung bar byed cing bgegs med 'gyur/ /de yi sems kyis rta yi zhal/ /lha mo sa khams brtan par bsgom/ /byams pa 'phrog pa'i ①sems kyis ni/ /me long lta bu'i ye shes sbyor/ /lha mo ce spyang gdong de yis/ /chu yi khams kyi ④dbang bskur nas/ /snying rjer gyur pa'i sems kyis ni/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes gzugs/ /phag mo zhal gyi spyor ba yis/ /me yis mi shes bsregs ⑤gyur 40—1152

nas—/ /dga' bas rnam par dgyes pa yis/ /so sor rtog pa'i ye shes so/ /lha mo glang po gdong de yis/ /rlung zhes mngon par brjod par bya/ /btang snyoms dran pa'i sems kyis ni/ /bya ba grub ①pa'i sbyor ba las/ /sems ni dkar po'i gzugs kyis ni/ /sna tshogs gzugs su mngon par brjod/ /snying rjes brlan pa'i chos rnams ni/ /nag po'i sgra yi ④sgra nyid la/ /dkar po sdog pa 'joms pa ste/ /ser po dri ma med pa'i cha/ /dmar po byed pa'i chos rnams kyi/ /chags pa'i sems kyis de bzhin gshegs/ /zhabs bzhi rnam par dag pa ni/ /de yi rdzu 'phrul rkang pa bzhi/ /rnam pa bzhi po 'di yis ni①//zhal nyid kyang ni 'dir gsungs so/ /sems kyi rang bzhin nam mkha' mtshungs/ /chos dbyings rnam par dag pa las/ /lam ni rnam par dag pa yis/ /gsang ba thob par mngon par brjod/ /gang tshe rgyu yi de nyid mthong / /'bras de nyid kyis rjorgyas btab bo/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi/ /thar pa spyan gyis gzigs pa nyid/ /shes rab med cing sems med pa'i/ /dud 'gro'i gdong can rnams kyis mthong / /bla ma dam pa'i gsung las ni/ /lha yi rnal 'byor gyis sbyangs parjo/ /rgyud thams cad kyi snying po phyi ma'i rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta pra bhā rjoka ras mdzad pa'o// //40—1153

bsdur mchan/115 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉snga'adir 〉〉thi da yot+ta/③〈〈pe 〉sko'adir 〉sto1/ ④〈'dir 〉〉wapa/ ⑤〈〈snar 〉garto/ du⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wa3/1151 ①〈〈pe 〉lo〈snar 〉〉ze/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉brkyang ba/ ③〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉〉rteng / 0〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉mu)sa/1152 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〉/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉kyi/ ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉'phro ba'i/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉4)sa/⑤〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉srig1153 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉skabasgrub/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stabs/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉pa gzhi/ 〈〈snar 〉〉par bzhi/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉4)/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pas/ du〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉garto/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2247)40wa 1154

rī'i ①nu ma zung ②mnan pa/ sangs rgyas me tog phreng ba la sogs pa sna tshogs pa'i rgyan dang / na bza' bsnams par bdag nyid bsgoms nas/ phyag rgya bcing bar bya ste/ de la khu tshur gnyis rgyab sbyar nas mthe'u chung lcags sgrog gi rnam par sbyar bar ①bya'o/ /sngags ni/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha /du/ ④groṇ+ḍa groṇ+ḍi /dul/ gros ⑦pa ya gros ⑧pa ya hūṃ/ ā na ya ho/ bha ga bān bit+yā rā dza hūṃ phaṭa / 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/1155 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉sa / /'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// ②〈〈pe 〉lo〈snar 〉skoyokyā/ ②〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉〉bskyed/1156 ①〈〈pe 〉'a'i/ 〈'ar 〉〉sdo'i/ ②〈'ar 〉thazung / ②〈〈pe 〉po'ar 〉ṅkasbyar bar/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉ṅkachasu ni su rgyu/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〉oṃ/ 〈〈snar 〉〉〉sko 0〈〈pe〉〉〈snar 〉borgyu/ ⑦⑧〈〈pe 〉snga'adir 〉stanaṇ+ḍi/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2248)40wa 1156

༄ga /rdo rje me dang nyi ma 'bar ba'i sgrub thabs/①༄ga /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra dz+wa la a na lha ①sā dha rgo/ bod skad du—/ rdo rje me dang nyi ma 'bar ba'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje me dang nyi ma 'bar ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nyid bzhin du stong pa nyid kyi rjes la nyi ma la hūṃ yig mthing ga yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje me dang nyi ma 'bar ba sku mdog mthing ga 'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrigs pa'i 'od can/ zhal bzhi pa/ phyag brgyad pa/sgeg pa dang / dpa' ba dang / 'jigs pa dang / snying rje'i nyams dang ldan pa'i zhabs bzhi pa/ g.yas kyi phyag bzhis rdo rje dang / ral gri dang /'khor lo dang / mda' bsnams pa/ g.yon gyi phyag bzhis dril bu dang /gzhu dang / zhags pa dang / kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ba dan sna tshogs pa ①dang bcas pa bsnams pa/ dbu skra skya bo'i tshogs me 'bar ba can/ shin tu 'jigs pa sbrul chen po 'khyil bas lag gdub dang / rked rgyan dang / rkang gdub dang /40byed1157

mgul rgyan dang / rna rgyan ①dang / cod pan du brgyan pa/ sgyu ma chen po'i rdzu'akhor lor byas pa bzhi la chung ma dang bcas pa'i khyab 'jug g.yas brkyang ba'i zhabs kyis mnan pa dbang du byed pa ②bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas phyag rgya bcing bar bya ste/ lag mthil rdo rje bcings pa'i sor mo 'bar ba'i snying po'i dbus su mthe bong gnyis blang bar bya'o/ /de nas sngags bzlas par bya ste/oṃ badz+ra dz+wa lā na lārka durgyu zhes so/ /rdo rje me dang nyi ma 'bar ba'i sgrub thabs cardogs so// //bsdur mchan/1157 lamatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉sa / /rdo rje me dang nyi ma 'bar ba'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// ②〈〈pe 〉lo〈snar 〉tsho'i na larka/ ③〈〈snar 〉〉wapa/1158 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thargyan/ ②〈〈pe 〉lo'adir 〉jo'i/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉bobyed pa/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉parka/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2249)40wa 1158

༄ga /rta mchog gi sgrub thabs/①༄ / /rgya gar skad du/ pa ra ma a ②shwa sā dha rna/ bod skad du/rta mchog gi sgrub thabs/ rta mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin du nyi ma la hūṃ yig mthing ga las skyes pa'i rta mchog dmar po zhal bzhi pa/ phyag brgyad pa/zhabs bzhi pa/ zhal dang po khro zhing sgeg pa/ spyan gsum pa/ g.yas zhal drag po/ g.yon zhal 'jigs su rung ba/ steng zhal mchu rol zhing rta'i zhal ljang gu/ phyag g.yas kyi gcig gis sna tshogs rdo rje dang bcas shing bzhengs pa'i tshul du byas pa/ phyag g.yon gyi gcig gis ral gri dang bcas pa'i sna tshogs pad+ma bsnams pa'o/ /slar yang ④g.yas kyi ba dan gsum phyag gis blang ba'i rjotshul mdzad pa/ slar yang phyag g.yon gyis mdung bsnams pa/ slar yang g.yas kyi phyag gis ral gri dang / mda' bsnams pa/ g.yon gyi phyag lhag mas dbyug pa dang / gzhu bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang dang /40—1159

g.yas kyi gcig gis dbang mo dang / dpal mo mnan pa/ g.yas kyi zhabs gnyis pas 'dod lha dang / 'dod lha'i chung ma mnan pa/ g.yon pa'i zhabs gcig gis dbang mo ①dang / sbrang rtsir byed pa mnan pa/ g.yon gyi zhabs gnyis pas rgyal bar byed pa dang / dpyid kyi lha mnan pa/ bdag nyid de lta bur bsgom par bya'o/ /sna tshogs rdo rje dang ba dan gsum pa bsgreng ba ni/ rta mchog gi phyag rgya'o/ /sngags ni/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūṃ zhes so/ /rta mchog gi sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/1159 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉sngag /rta mchog gi sgrub thabs bzhugs so// ②〈〈pe 〉po〈snar 〉gaspru/ ②〈〈pe 〉lopo ra 〉〉wayang / 0〈〈pe 〉po'adir 〉〉blangs pa'i/116 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉po/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2250)40wa 1160

po'i sgrub thabs/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya rak+ta ②ya mā ri sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/'phags pa gshin rje gshed dmar po'i sgrub thabs/ bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang por re zhig sgrub pa pos stan bde ba la nye bar 'dug nas/ āḥyig dmar po yongs su gyur ④pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rang gi snying gar bsgoms te/ de'i steng du hūṃ yig dmar po rnam par bkod nas/ mdun du gshin rje gshed dmar po dang / bla ma dang /sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams dmigs te/ me tog la sogs pa rnams kyis yang dag par mchod cing phyag 'tshal nas gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba la sogs pa byas te/ stong pa nyid bsgom par bya'o/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā ba ā kolharjohaṃ/ zhes so/ /de'i rjes la āḥ⑤yig dmar po las skyes pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ yig de yongs su gyur pa las mgo bo 40byed1161

rlon pas mtshan pa'i dbyug pa dkar po hūṃ yig gis byin gyis brlabs pa bsgom par bya'o/ /de thams cad yongs su gyur pa las gshin rje mthar byed bsam par bya ste/ bdag nyid sku mdog dmar po zhabs g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/zhal gcig pa/ phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yon na khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa bsnams pa/ phyag g.yas na mgo bos mtshan pa'i dbyug pa dkar po bsnams pa/sbrul gyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ 'jigs su rung ba/ dbu skra ser po gyen du badze+es pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs bsnams pa/ rang 'od kyi shes rab ma rgyan ⑫sna tshogs pa can/ zhabs g.yas brkyang gis ④bzhugs pa la 'khyud pa'i bdag nyid bsgom par bya'o/ /phyi nas bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la hūṃ yig gis byin rmis brlabs pa de yongs su gyur pa las—/ mgo bo rlon pas mtshan ma'i ①dbyug pa dkar po mi g.yo ba bsgom par bya'o—/ /de'i dbus su nyi ma dmar po la gnas pa'i hūṃ yig rjokha dog dmar po bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas gsang ba'i rdo rjer hūṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las/bcom ldan 'das ma'i gsang bar chu skyes 'dab ma brgyad pa la ṣāyig dmar po/de'i rjes su sngags brjod par bya'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā nu rā ga ṇa ⑤badz+ra swa bhā ba da kolharjohaṃ/ de'i rjes la lte ba'i 'og tu chu skyes 'dab ma brgyad dang bcas pa/ dmar po'i steng du tweḥdamar po 'bar bzhin pa de la bsam par bya'o—/ /shes rab ma dga' bas myos pa gos phud pa/ phyag gnyis pa/zhal gabe+eg ma'i bcom ldan 'das ma dang lhan cig yang dag par sbyor bas bzhugs pa/ de lta bur gyur pa'i gshin rje gshed dmar po ma te'i steng du sna tshogs chu skyes la bzhugs pa bsgom par bya'o zhes so/ /dam tshig la sogs pa'i 40—1162

cho ga ①sngon du 'gro bas de nas gnyis gsum bzhi'i thun mtshams su bsgom par bya'oske/ /skyes a ②dzi 9/ lha/ sa ma ya zhes pa ni dam tshig byin gyis brlab pa'i sngags so/ /skyes trīḥ:ཿnibi kṛ tā na na ༷/ lha/ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā rtsa ba'i sngags so/du /:/ ya mān+ta ka lha/ snying po'i sngags so/ /'phags pa gshin rje gshed dmar po'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/1161 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉༄ga /'phags pa gshin rje gshed dmar po'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// ②〈〈pe 〉ri'ik+ta/ 〈〈snar 〉ri'iṣ+ṭha/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉yerdzogs/ 0〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉bo3/ ⑤〈〈pe〉〉〈snar 〉boḥ/1162 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉brgyan/ ②〈〈pe 〉dze'adir 〉ston/ ①〈〈pe 〉'i〈snar 〉zo'i/ du〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉〉nedamar po/ ⑤〈〈pe〉྾〈snar 〉〉ta/ dhi〈〈pe〉〉〈snar 〉〉wa3/1163 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stanas/ ②〈〈pe 〉mokhri 〈〈snar 〉〉mi/ ②〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉ji/ du〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉wartsa ba'i sngags so/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2251)40wa 1163

2 25༄ga /gshin rje gshed nag po'i sgrub thabs/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ kṛṇ+ḍa ya mā ⑧ri sā dha dz+wa/ bod skad du/gshin rje gshed nag po'i sgrub thabs/ bcom ldan 'das gshin rje'i dgra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang por re zhig sgrub pa pas④stan bde ba la nye bar 'dug ste/saṃ yig dmar po las skyes pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rang gi snying gar bsgom par bya'o / /de'i steng du hūṃ yig mthing nag bkod la hūṃ yig mthing nag gi 'od zer gyis gshin rje mthar byed la sogs pa'i bla ma dang / sangs rgyas dang /byang chub sems dpa' rnams dmigs la me tog la sogs pa rnams kyis yang dag par mchod cing phyag 'tshal nas gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba la sogs pa byas te—/ stong pa nyid du bsgom par bya'o/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+pa kopho④haṃ—/ de'i rjes la i yig dmar po las skyes pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la hūṃ yig de yongs su gyur pa las rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa nag po hūṃ yig 40—1164

gis byen gyis brlabs pa bsgom par bya'o/ /hūṃ yig gi 'od zer gyis bskul nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rab tu gzhug pa sngon du 'gro bas so/ /de thams cad yongs su gyur pa las gshin rje mthar byed bsam par bya'o/ /zhabs g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ zhal gcig pa/ phyag gnyis pa/sku mdog mthing nag /phyag g.yas kyis ①rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa mthing nag bsnams pa/ phyag g.yon pa sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ de lta bur gyur pa'i gshin rje gshed spro ba dang bsdu ba'i tshul gyis sna tshogs chu skyes kyi steng du nyi ma la bzhugs pa ma he'i steng du bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la hūṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las/ hūṃ yig gis byen gyis brlabs pa'i dbyug pa mthing nag ④las hūṃ yig gi 'od zer kyis 'gro ba rnams snang bar byas te/ slar yang de la de bzhin du rab tu gzhug par bya'o/ /rim pa 'di nyid ji srid 'dod kyi bar du spro ba dang bsdu bar bya'o//dam tshig la sogs pa'i cho ga sngon du 'gro bas so/ /de bzhin du gnyis gsum bzhi'i thun mtshalas su bsgom par bya'o/ /oṃ tweḥ1ཿ①bi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags bzlas par bya'o/ /gshin rje gshed nag po'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //40byed1165

bsdur mchan/1164 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉gag /gshin rje gshed nag po'i sgrub thabs rim grangs bzhugs so// ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉zo'i ma/ ③〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pos/du〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉walha/1165 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stekyi/ ②〈〈snar 〉sngag ③〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉rtsi/bsdur 'azas re'u migargyud/ (2252)40wa 1166

༄ga /gshin rje gshed nag po'i sgrub thabs/①༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ kṛṇ+ḍa ya mā ri ⑤sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/gshin rje gshed nag po'i sgrub thabs/ bcom ldan 'das gshin rje'i dgra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gis ①brtse ba'i dbang gis dman dang mchog rnams kyang //stobs kyis gdul bya'i skye rnams drag por rjoston mdzad cing / /phan pa sna tshogs sgrub mdzad sgyu ma'i gar kyi skur/ /gshin rje mthar byed de la bdag ni phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang por bsgrub rjobacas mchog tu bde ster stan la 'dug /bsam gtan khang pa dri bzangs kyis byugs yid mngon dga'/ /bsam gtan ting 'dzin yid kyis snying gar e rjoyig las/ /dmar po'i rnam par rab byung gtum po smig rgyu'i gzugs/ /de yi steng gnas 'od zer dang bcas kha dog mthing / /hūṃ yig 'od zer brgya 'gyed gshin rje gshed la sogs/ /yang dag mchod bya yid kyis rnam 'phrul ⑦me tog spos/ /mar me la sogs rnam mang gis 40—1167

mchod gus phyag 'tshal/ /sngon du byas pa'i sdig ①rnams bshags pa la sogs bya//'gro rnams ma lus stong nyid mngon bya de nas kyang / /oṃ shu n+ya tā la ④sogs sngags mchog tshig ①tu bya/ /bdag nyid rang gi ngo bo gus pas yongs bsgoms ④ /pa / /e yig dmar po las byung nyi ma la gnas mthing / /hūṃ yig gzugs la rdo rjes mtshan pa'i ⑤dbyug pa mthing / /dbyug pa la gnas hūṃ yig rab 'phro dra ba rjocan/ /rgyal ba ma lus bskul zhing gdan drangs rab tu gzhug /de nyid blta zhing ma lus yongs bsngo phyi nas ni/ /bdag nyid myur du gshin rje mthar byed rnam bsgom bya/ /sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis khro bcas pa/ /phyag g.yas na ni rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug mthing bsnams/ /phyag g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub zhags pa dang bcas pa/ /zhal gyi pad+ma smin ma sma ra dmar ser 'bar/ /stag gi pags pa'i na bza' gsang phyogs yang dag ldan⑦/ /zhal nas ljags ni ltos 'gro bzhin du rnam par bskyod/ /sna tshogs chu skyes 'dab bcas steng du nyi ma la/ /yang dag bzhugs shing drag po ma te la zhon sgrogs/ /zhal ni mche gatshigs mi'u ④thung lto ba rab tu 'phyang / /spyan ni gnyis pa nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang mtshungs pa/ /klu brgyad khros pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing thod pa yi/ /phreng ba dkar po mnyam gshibs bcings shing zhal 'phro ba/ /mi mgo rlon pa'i do shal mgul du rab bcings shing / / aṣ+ṭa ha yi ⑨gad rgyangs bdud kyi dpung las rgyal/ /phyi nas bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kar nyi ma la/ /rab zhugs hūṃ yig dang ldan dbyug pa sngon po bsam/ /der gnas hūṃ yig 'od kyis khams gsum snang byas shing / /der zhugs yun mi ring bar slar yang nang du bya/ /rim pa 'dis ni spro bsdu ji ltar 'dod par bya//40—1168

slar yang dam tshig sngon ma bzhin du kun byas te/ /thun mtshams bzhi ru 'di ni ma lus bsgom bya zhing / /ngal bar gyur na ji bzhin bsgrubs la sngags bzlas bya//bcom ldan gshin rje mthar byed sgrub thabs bsdus byas pa'i①/ /byams pa dpal bdag dpag med bsod nams gang 'di yis/ /'gro ba ma lus bcom ldan gshin rje mthar byed gyur/ /bdag kyang myur du 'dir ⑤ni gshin rje mthar byed shog /de la sngags kyi rgyal po 'di'o/ /oṃ s+thāḥ 1ཿbe+e kṛ ①tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ gshin rje gshed nag po'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/1167 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉zo rī/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈'a ra 〉lke/ rjo〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉stab/ sde〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉sgrub/ rjo〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉mas/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈'ar 〉thāl/1168 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7pa/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7la/ ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7tshig pya〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉bsgom/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉7/ dhi〈〈pe 〉snga'ar 〉mthod dra/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉skosnar 〉7snams/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈'ar 〉dz+ra/ sti〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thaṇ+ḍa ḍa'/1169 ①〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉thas/ ②〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉skoradi/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉ji be+e kṛ/ 〈〈snar 〉〉ji bi kri/40byed1169
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2253)40wa 1170

༄ga /gshin rje dgra nag po'i sgrub thabs/①༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ kṛṇ+ḍa ④ya mā ri sā ④dha —/ bod skad du/gshin rje dgra nag po'i sgrub thabs/ bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpa' bo thod pa'i phreng ba can/ /sbrul sogs rgyan gyis rngam byas pa'iske/ /gshin rje gshed mgon phyag 'tshal nas/ /de yi sgrub thabs bri bar bya—/ /bde ba'i stan la yang dag 'dug /snying gar nyi ma hūṃ yig dgod/ /der skyes mchod pa'i khyad par gyis/ /gus pas khyab bdag yang dag mchod/ /de yi mdun du phyogs byas te/ /sdig pa bshags pa la sogs bya/ /'gro kun rang bzhin med par ni/ /skad cig gis bltas bude nyid las/ /snying ga'i sa bon rtags las byung / /zhabs kyi chu skyes g.yon brkyang ba/ /khro gnyer bsdus shing zhal 'jigs la/ /sma ra smin ma dbu skra ser/ /zhal gsum ljags ni bskyod pa yis/ /'jigs byed mche ba gcigs pa can/ /spyan ni dmar zhing 40—1171

gsus chen ①la/ /sprin nag gsar pa'i 'od zer can/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas shing / /ma he yi ni mtshan ④la bzhugs/ /stag gi sham thabs mi'u thung / /nga rgyal thams cad 'joms mdzad pa/ /nyi ma'i 'od zer gzi mdangs che/ /sa steng ④ma lus kun du mchod/ /'bar zhing 'bar ba'i phreng ba rno/ /dus mtha' yi ④ni me dang mtshungs/ /rdo rje ral gri gtun shing drag /ro langs sta re zhags pa bsnams/ /phyag g.yas dang ni g.yon pa yi/ /drug po rnams su mdzes par bsnams/ /khro bcas 'jigs byed shin tu drag /gshin rje mthar byed bdud 'joms pa/ /hūṃ yig gis gang mgrin bsams nas//'dir ni de yi nga rgyal bya/ /snying gar nyi rdor snying 'od kyis/ /gshin rje sdang ba bza' bar bya/ /mdun phyogs de nas mchod nas ni/ /rang dang rnam pa gcig byas te/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs bon bzhis/ /yang dag dgug dang gzhug pa dang / /bcing dang mnyes pas bdag mchod cing / /bsam gtan kyis ni mchod byas nas/ /yang dag bstod nas sngags bzlas bya/ /dge ba yongs su bsngo bya zhing / /langs nas lha yi rnal 'byor gyis/ /brtse ba gcig pu'i yid kyis spyad/ /de bzhin nyi ma so sor bya/ /dngos grub thob pa'i mtshan ma 'byung / /'dod pa'i dngos grub bsgrub rjobya ba/ /las mchog rab tu brkyang na yang / /las kyi rjes su 'brangs pa'i tshul/ /mangs pas kho bos ma bshad do—/ /bla ma'i man ngag de yang ni/ /rgyud las mngon 'dod bsgrub par bya/ /mkhas pas 'khor lo gzhan rnams kyang / /kun nas 'bad pas shes par bya/ /gtor ma nyer spyod rnal 'byor gyis/ /thun mtshalas bzhi ru cho ga bya/ /bzlas pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ byāḥ1ཿrjobi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ bdag gi ⑦bla 40—1172

ma'i man ngag las rtogs nas/ /sgrub ①thabs cho ga byas pa'i bsod nams kyis//'jig rten pa rnams thams cad gyur pa 'dis/ /mngon par 'dod pa'i 'bras bu myur thob shog /gshin rje'i ②dgra nag po'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/1171 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉〉kyeḍi/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉staḥ su/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉blta/1172 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ca/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stanas ni mtshon/ ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉stengs/ du〈〈pe〉〉〈'dir 〉stanas/ du〈〈snar 〉〉sgrub/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉triḥnyi/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sko〈co 〉stanas/1173 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈co 〉〉bsgrub/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉garje/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2254)40wa 1173

༄ga /gshin rje mthar byed kyi sgrub thabs/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ya mārnya ka sā dha rna/ bod skad du/gshin rje mthar byed kyi sgrub thabs/ gshin rje mthar byed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpa' bo thod pa'i phreng ba can/ /klu sogs rgyan gyis gsal mdzad pa/ /gshin rje gshed mgon phyag 'tshal nas/ /de yi sgrub thabs bri bar bya/ /bde ba'i stan la yang dag 'dug /snying gar hūṃ yig mthing nag dgod/ /de skyes mchod pa'i khyad par gyis/ /khyab bdag mchog tu rab mchod bya/ /de yi mdun du phyogs byas te/ /sdig pa bshags pa la sogs bya/ /'gro kun rang bzhin med par ni/ /skad cig gis ni thams cad blta/ /snying ga'i sa bon rtags las byung / /zhabs kyi chu skyes g.yon brkyang ba/ /khro gnyer bsdus shing zhal 'jigs la/ /sma ra dmar ser sngon ma bzhin/ /zhal gsum ljags ni bskyod pa yi②/ /'jigs byed mche ba gatshigs pa can/ /sbyan ni dmar zhing 40—1174

gsus chen la/ /sprin nag sar ①pa'i 'od zer can/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas shing / /ma he yi ni mtshan ④la bzhugs/ /mi'u ①thung stag gi sham thabs can/ /khengs pa thams cad 'joms mdzad pa/ /nyi ma'i 'od zer gzi mdangs can/ /ma lus phyogs rnams 'gengs byed pa/ /'bar zhing 'bar ba'i phreng ba can/ /bskal pa tha ma'i me dang mtshungs/ /'khor lo ral gri gtun shing 'bar/ /ro langs dgra sta zhags pa bsnams/ /phyag drug rnams na memadzes pa ste/ /g.yas dang g.yon pa'i phyag rnams su/ /khro bcas 'jigs byed shin tu drag /gshin rje mthar byed bdud 'dul ba/ /hūṃ yig gis gang mgrin par bsgom/ /skrag pa rnams ni rnam par spang / /nyi shu phyed kyi stong phrag gis/ /sngags rnams sngags ni rtag tu rig /sems ni gzengs ⑤bstod bzlas par bya/ /'dis ni 'dod pa'i dngos grub bo/ /sngon du bsnyen pa'i cho ga yis/ /'di yis sngags pa'i sngags rnams 'grub/ /las kyi rjes 'brang rjokha dog rnams/ /mangs pas bdag gis ma bshad do/ /bla ma'i man ngag bsams nas ni/ /de las 'dod pa'i dngos grub bo/ /'bad pa yis ni shes byas la/ /dpa' bo rnams kyi ⑦bsnyen pa'ang bya/ /gtor ma nyer spyod rnal 'byor gyis/ /thun mtshams bzhi ru bsgrub par bya/ /bzlas pa'i sngags ni—/ oṃ tweḥ1ཿ⑧bi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ gshin rje mthar byed kyi sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //40—1175

bsdur ma na/1174 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉༄ga /gshin rje mthar byed kyi sgrub thabs rim grangs bzhugs so// ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stanas/1175 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉stanasar/②〈〈pe 〉snga'adir 〉stabatshon/①〈〈pe 〉sko'adir 〉stab/rjo〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉la/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gzeng / du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉torabrangs/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉4)sa/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉ji/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2255)40wa 1176

༄ga /gshin rje mthar byed kyi sgrub thabs/①༄ ༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ ya mān+ta ka sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/gshin rje mthar byed kyi sgrub thabs/ dpal gshin rje mthar byed la phyag 'tshal lo—/ /sgom pa pos dang por zhal bsang ba la sogs pa bya ste/ rang gi snying gar a yig las skyes pa'i zla ba la yi yig nag po bsgom par bya'o/ /de'i 'od zer gyis bla ma dang / sangs rgyas rnams gdan drangs nas yang dag par mchod cing sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa bya'o/ /de nas yi yig tsam ⑤las rnal 'byor pas bdag nyid stong pa nyid mngon du bya zhing byen gyis brlab par yang bya ste/ smon lam rjes su dran par bya'o/ /de'i rjes su ram̐ yig ①las byung ba'i nyi ma la hūṃ yig las byung ba'i rdo rje tho ba/ rang gi sa bon gyis mtshan pa rnam par bsgom par bya'o/ /de las skyes pa'i rdo rje'i rjos gzhi dang / rdo rje'i ra ba dang / rdo rje'i gur bsgom par bya'o/ /de'i dbus su zla ba'i 40—1177

dkyil 'khor la dbyangs yig nyis ①'gyur gyi rang bzhin skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis mtshan pa/ shes rab kyi rang bzhin yang dag par blta'o//de'i steng du dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i rnam par ④dag pa de la/ ḍa bhā ④ya ra la wa bzhi nyis 'gyur dang bcas pa dang / ka la sogs pa'i gsal byed nyis (she'agyur yongs su rdzogs pa las/ gzhan yang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la thabs kyi ngo bo mtha' yas pa 'bar ba 'phro zhing bsam par bya'o/ /de nas de gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la hūṃ mthing ga dang / yam̐ las yang dag par byung ba'i char sprin nag po gsar pa'i kha dog can gsus pa che ba—/ smin ma dang sma ra dmar ser gyen du badze+es pa/ mche ba gatshigs pa/thung zhing rgyas la ma te la bzhugs pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs bsnams pa—/ ri dwags bdag po'i pags pas stod g.yogs byas pa/ shin tu 'jigs par byed pa/ rang gi sku'i 'od zer gyis khro bo lnga 'phro bzhin pa sprul nasaske/ gdengs ka'i rgyal pos brgyan pa/ khrag 'dzag pa'i mgo bo brgya'i phyed kyi kyephreng ba bsnams pa/ phyag drug pa g.yas kyi phyag rnams kyis ⑦tho ba dang / ral gri dang / rdo rje bsnams pa/ g.yon gye phyag gsum gyis sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa bsnams pa'o/ /zhal drug pa dang po khro zhal dang / mthing ga dang / dkar po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / nag po rnams gzhan rnams su zhal gyi rim pas so/ /zhal thams cad ni zlum zhing dmar ba'i spyan gsum pa'o/ /zhabs drug pa/ zhabs gnyis g.yon brkyang mdzad cing yang ④zhabs gnyis gar stabs mdzad pa/ zhabs gzhan gnyis sems dpa'i skyil krung mdzad pa/ nyi ma 'bar ba'i dbus su 40—1178

bzhugs shing bgegs rnams 'joms par mdzad pa/ thod pa brgyad kyis legs par brgyan cing shin tu 'jigs pa'i mgo bo'i phreng ba can no/ /de'i rjes la spyo dze+e khaṃ①/ lo s+t+waṃ saṃ gi ④sa bon rnams las byung ba'i sa'i snying po dang /phyag na rdo rje dang / nam mkha'i snying po dang / 'jig rten dbang phyug dang /sgrib pa rnam par sel ba dang / kun du bzang po zhes pa rnams mig dang /rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang / nu ma dag dang / lte ba zhes pa rnams kyi 'khor lo dang / rdo rje dang / rin po che dang / chu skyes dang / mda' dang / rdo rje rnams phyag g.yas pa rnams kyis bsnams pa/ phyag g.yon pa rnams kyis sdigs mdzub kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ dkar po dang / nag po dang /ser po dang / dmar po dang / ljang gu dang / dkar po rnams su bzhugs pa—/ de'i rjes su mgo bo dang / mgrin pa dang / snying ga ste/ sku dang gsung dang / thugs rnams su gnas pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs pa/oṃ 66hūṃ zhes pa las byung ba kha dog dkar po dang / dmar po dang / nag po dang / rdo rje dang / chu skyes dang / rdo rje rnams phyag g.yas pa rnams kyis sdigs mdzub kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa'o/ /de nas snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer rnams kyis ye shes sems dpa' gdan drangs nas ro gcig tu bsgoms te/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan ④pa'i bdag nyid yun rjoring du bsgom par bya'o/ /de la sngags ni 'di'o/ /oṃ tweḥ 1ཿbi kṛ ④tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ de nas gshegs su gsol nas ldang bar bya'o zhes pa ni gshin rje mthar byed kyi sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //40—1179

bsdur mchan/1177 7mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉sta / ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈'ar 〉boyig 0〈〈pe 〉posnar 〉bordo rje'i/1178 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉gnyis/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉pa/ ②〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉 da dha/ rjo⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉gnyis/me〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉waphyed kyi/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉pa/1179 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉ska 9wa gi/ ②〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉4)/ ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉 bsnams pa/ phyag g.yon pa rnams kyis/ me〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉spyan/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wayun/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉mji wi kri/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2256)40wa 1180

༄ga /bgegs mthar byed kyi sgrub thabs/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ bispyon+ta ④ka sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/bgegs mthar byed kyi sgrub thabs/ bcom ldan 'das bgegs mthar byed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang por re zhig sgrub pa pos stan bde ba la nye bar 'dug ste/saṃ yig dmar po las skyes pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rang gi snying gar bsgom par bya'o—/ /de'i steng du hūṃ yig nag po bkod nas/ hūṃ yig las skyes pa'i 'od zer kyis bgegs mthar byed dang / bla ma dang / sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams dmigs nas me tog la sogs pa rnams kyis yang dag par mchod nas phyag 'tshal te/ gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba la sogs pa byas nas—/ stong pa nyid du bsgom par bya ste/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā ba ā kolha④haṃ—/ zhes pas so/ /de'i rjes la e buyig dmar po las skyes pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ yig /de yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje hūṃ yig 40—1181
