gis tsa)byin gyis brlab par bsgom par bya'o/ /hūṃ yig gi 'od zer gyis bskul nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rab tu gzhug pa sngon du 'gro bas/ de thams cad yongs su gyur pa las/ bgegs mthar byed bsgom par bya'o/ /zhabs g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa'i bdag nyid zhal gcig pa/ phyag gnyis pa / sku mdog mthing ga /phyag g.yon pas sdigs mdzub dang / zhags pa/phyag g.yas pa rdo rje 'phyar ba/ 'jigs par byed pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du badze+es pa'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi ②thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la hūṃ yig gis byin gyis brlabs pa'i rdo rje'o/ /de las byung ba'i bgegs mthar byed spro ba dang bsdu ba'i tshul gyis chu skyes 'dab ma sna tshogs kyi steng du nyi ma la gnas pa bsgom par bya'o/ /dam tshig la sogs pa'i cho ga sngon du 'gro bas so/ /'di gnyis dang gsum dang bzhi'i thun mtshams su bsgom par bya'o/ /oṃ ābyubispyon+ta ①kṛ ta hūṃrjo/ bgegs mthar byed kyi sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //oṃ in+d+ra ya byāḥya mā ya 1ཿ⑤wa ru zla ya bi/ ku be+e rā ya kṛ/ yī shwa rā ya ta / asna ye ā/ nai rje byuta ye na/ wā ya we na/⑦ tsan+d+ra ya hūṃ/ al+lī ya hūṃ/ prah+ma shā ya tsaphaṭa/ ba su dhā rā ya ④phaṭa/ be+e ma tsi tra ye swā⑩/ sarba bhū skyete bh+yo hā/ tī tī/ hūṃ hūṃ dze dze swā hā/ zhes pa ni gtor ma'i sngags so/ /gang zhig bza' ba thams cad kyi dang po gshin rje gshed la dbul lo// //40—1182

bsdur mchan/1181 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉stabasnan/①〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉〉wa3/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stakhri1182 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wagis/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉7)sa/ ①〈〈pe 〉dze'adir 〉stabasnan+ta/ du〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉〉ཿ/ rjo〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa yartsi/ rjo〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stab shā nā ya tā/ lha'i ya a/ ya mā ya na/ rna ri/⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wawā ya we na/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ride/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉1/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉nehā/⑩〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉gas/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2257)40wa 1183

༄ga /rdo rje bye mdzad kyi sgrub thabs/①༄yo/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra hūṃ kā ra sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi sgrub thabs/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje hūṃ mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngon du gsungs pa'i cho gas nam mkha'i khams su re yig las skyes pa'i nyi ma la hūṃ yig 'bar zhing 'bar ba ②la bskal pa tha ma'i me lta bu shu shin tu 'bar ba'i byamachog tu kha dog gnag pa 'od zer chen po'o/ /de las skyes pa'i drag po chen po khams gsum za bar mdzad pa/ phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu rab tu sbyor ba'i phyag rgya bcing bar bya'o/ /g.yon brkyang gi rjozhabs kyis de bzhin du 'jigs byed mnan cing 'jigs par byed pa/ snying ga dang /mgrin pa dang / mgo bo rnams su oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes pa'i yi ge gsum dbang bskur ba'i cho gas thugs rdo rje'i phyag rgya bcing bar bya'o/ /sngags ni oṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā—/ rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //40—1184

bsdur mchan/1184 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈snar 〉〉wab/ ①〈〈snar 〉〉bur/ rjo〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉to/'bar ba'i/ du〈〈snar 〉stanas/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2258)40wa 1185

༄ga /stobs po che'i grub thabs/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā ba la sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/stobs po che'i sgrub thabs/ khro bo'i rgyal po stobs po che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngon du gsungs pa'i cho gas stong pa nyid kyi mthar pad+ma dkar po dang nyi ma la hūṃ yig las byung ba'i stobs po che zhal gcig pa phyag bzhi pa sku mdog thams cad dmar po/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du 'khyil pa/ sbrul gyis bcings pa/phyag g.yas pa gnyis kyis dbyug pa dkar po dang / rnga yab bsnams pa/phyag g.yon pa gnyis kyis phyag 'tshal ba'i tshul dang / zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba/ zhal mche ba gcigs pa/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'od kyi phreng ba can/ 'od dpag tu med pas dbu brgyan ②pa bsgom par bya'o/ /sngags bzlas par bya ste/ oṃ ma hā ba la gā hā/④ zhes pa'o/ /rjostobs 40—1186

po che'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/1186 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉khog /stobs po che'i sgrub thabs gnyis bzhugs so// ②〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉spron/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wacham hā ba la swā hā/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉7 ni/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2259)40wa 1187

༄ga /'phags pa khro bo stobs po che'i sgrub thabs/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya ④kro dha ma hā ba la sā dha rgo/ bod skad du / 'phags pa khro bo stobs po che'i sgrub thabs/ bcom ldan 'das khro bo stobs po che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /stong pa bdag med pa las paṃ las pad+ma/ me las nyi ma a las zla ba'i steng du hūṃ sgrug nag ④las rdo rje rtse lnga pa yongs su gyur pa las khro bo stobs po che zhal gsum sgrug nag gi sku mdog can/ rdo rje dang zhags pa dang tho ba g.yas na bsnams pa/ dung dmar dang gshol mda' dang gtun shing g.yon na bsnams pa/ thugs ka nas 'od zer gyis rjoye shes pa dgug gzhug byas nas yang 'od zer gyis ⑤ji ltar 'dod pa nye bar bsgrub po/ /oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la ha na da ha pa tsa bi ṅgād+ma buya/ dzā ṭi ⑦lam̐ bo dha ra u ṣ+ṭha kro dha hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ phyogs ngan pa bsrungs ⑧na sarba dur di ka ⑨rak+ṣa rak+ṣaḥ⑩swā hā/mi gtsang ba sel na sarba a sna ta kro shusnye shudha ⑪swā hā/ 'chi ba bzlog ⑫na sarba 40—1188

a kā ①la mṛ kyu brta ya brta ②ya swā hā/ 'phags pa khro bo stobs po che'i sgrub thabs / dge slong shākya bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //ā tsar+ya nan+das phyirang 'gyur du mdzad pa'o/ /sgra bag tsam bcos so// //bsdur mchan/1188 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉lo'ar 〉ṅkabadz+ra/②〈〈snar 〉〉nepa/ me〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉nya)/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉to/gyis/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉dha na sa/⑦〈〈pe 〉sko'adir 〉〉〉la/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉〉bsrung / ⑨〈〈pe 〉sko'adir 〉〉kar/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉lo〈snar 〉〉waḥ/⑪〈〈pe 〉྾kurnor 〉〉kyidhe shudhe/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉zlog1189 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ka ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ba brta yarta/ ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉nan+tas/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2260)40wa 1189

༄ga /he ru ka'i sgrub thabs/①༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ he ru ka sā dha dz+wa/ bod skad du/ te ru ka'i sgrub thabs/ he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dur khrod brgyad kyi dbus gnas nas/ /zla med yid kyi 1dga' ba yis/ /thabs dang shes rab rnam pa yis—/ /zla ba nyi ma rab sbyor bas/ /ā li kā li mnyam sbyor ba/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la bsgom bya/ /de la hūṃ yig las byung ba'i/ /rdo rje rtse gcig dang ldan pa/ /mi yi pags pa ro yi bugadan/ /ro langs skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs—/ /thal ba'i rdul gyis lus la byugs/ /rdo rje 'phro ba phyag g.yas na//ba dan g.yo bcas kha ṭ+wāṃ g.yon/ /thod pa dmar po dang bcas pa brgya phyed mgo bo'i phreng ba yi⑤/ /do shal yis buni 'phrog par byed/ /cung zad mche ba gcigs pa'i zhal/ /sbyan gsum pa ni sgeg bcas shing / /dbu skra dmar ser gyen du badze+es/ /mi bskyod dbu rgyan ⑦rna rgyan dang / /rus pa'i 40byed1190

rgyan gyis mdzes byas shing / /thod pa lnga yis dbu la brgyan/ /sangs rgyas nyid der bsgom par bya/ /'gro ba'i bdud rnams 'joms byed pa/ /oṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā zhes pa 'di mdor bsdus pa'i phyag gnyis pa'i ①te ru ka'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/119 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉gan /he ru ku'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// ②〈〈pe 〉dze'adir 〉〉ni/ ①〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉staspris/ 0〈〈pe 〉sko0snar 〉〉rdo rje'i/⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉stabs/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉stasprid/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉brgyan/1191 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2261)40wa 1191

༄ga /dgyes pa'i rdo rje phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs/khye༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ dī bhu dza he badz+ra sā dha dz+wa/ bod skad du/dgyes pa'i rdo rje phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs/ bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten gsum bdag he ru ka /dpal mgon bla ma la phyag 'tshal/ /de yi sgrub thabs cho ga ni/ /shādhi pas gsungs rnam gsal las—/ /dpa' bo zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /bdag med ma yis mgul nas 'khyud/ /'khor lo la sogs rgyan dang ldan/ / spyan gsum ②zhabs ni gnyis pas pemadzes/ /'dir rgyud las bsgom pa khong du chud par bya ste/rnal 'byor pa snga bar mal nas langs te rang gi snying gar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūṃ yig bltas la/ de'i 'od zer gyis he ru ka gsal zhing gdan drangs nas me tog la sogs pa nye bar spyod pa durnam pa lngas yang dag par mchod nas mdun du sdig pa bshags pa dang / bsod nams la rjes su yi rang ba dang / gsum 40—1192

la skyabs su 'gro ba dang / byang chub chen por sems bskyed pa dang / sems can rnams lha'i bde ba la nye bar longs spyod pa la rnam par bsdu ba'i byams pa dang / thams cad sdug bsngal gyis 'joms pa'i rnam pa'i snying rje dang / de 'a bde ba rgyun mi 'chad par nges pa'i rnam pa'i dga' ba dang / nyon mongs pa dang nye ba'i nyon mongs pa gzung ①ba dang 'dzin pa la sogs pa'i yid med par byed pa'i mtshan nyid btang snyoms rnams kyang bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas chos kyi bdag la sogs pa'i rnam par rtog pa'i dri ma spangs te/ gzugs ni ston ka'i dri ma med pa'i nyi ma gung gi nam mkha' lta bu gnyis su med pa'i ye shes dang ro gcig pa'i sku stong pa nyid bsgom par bya'o/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa a kolha⑤haṃ/ zhes pas byin kyis brlab par bya'o/ /de nas rnam par sad nas nam mkha'i phyogs su nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūṃ yig bltas la de yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje'i lte ba la gnas pa'i hūṃ yig blta bar bya'o/ /de las byung ba'i 'od zer rnams kyis dpal he ru ka'i skus 'gro ba thams cad kyi don mdzad cing /de la de bzhin du rab tu zhugs te/ de yongs su gyur pa las dpal te ru ka sna tshogs pad+ma dang ro'i steng na nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs pa/ phyag gnyis pa/sbyan gsum pa/ phyag g.yas kyis rdo rje/ g.yon pas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i thod pa bsnams pa/ gar gyi nyams dang bcas pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ /dbu la mi bskyod ④bdag nyid ni/ /mi mgo las byas 'khor lo bsnams—/ /'od dpag med pa'i bdag nyid snyan/ /mi yi rus pa'i rna rgyan no—/ /rin chen 'byung ldan bdag nyid mgul/ /mgul rgyan dang ni yang dag ldan/ /lag gdub rnam par snang mdzad dag /don yod grub pa'i 40—1193

bdag nyid kyis/ /rked pa la ni rgyan du mdzad/ /skra yi ①mchod phyir thogs dang ni/ /rkang gdub kyis kyang yang dag brgyan/ /dbu skra dmar ser gyen du badze+es pa/ zhal gcig pa/ phyag gnyis pa/ gri gug dang / thod pa bsnams pa'i bdag med mas yang dag par 'khyud pa de lta bur gyur pa'i bdag nyid bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas 'di'i rna ba la bdag med ma/ mig la gti mug rdo rje can/ /sna la sbas pa'i go rī/ /lce la chu yi rnal 'byor ma/ /lus kyi dbang po la rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ yid la bdag med ma rnams lhag par mos par bya'o/ /de la mgo bor chu skyes 'dab ma sum cu so ②gnyis kyi steng du haṃ yig mgo thur du bstan pa'i rnam pa/ mgrin par chu skyes 'dab ma bcu drug pa'i steng du oṃ yig mgo steng du bstan pa/ snying gar chu skyes 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du hūṃ yig mgo thur du bstan pa/ lte bar chu byes 'dab ma drug cu rtsa bzhi'i steng du a yig mgo steng du bstan pa bsam par bya'o/ /de nas dam tshig sems dpa' dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' gdan drang bar ①bya ste/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥzhes pa'i sngags 'dis dgug pa dang / gzhug pa dang bcing ba dang /dbang du byas te chu dang 'o ma bzhin du ro gcig par bya'o/ /de'i rjes la rang gi snying gar nyi ma dang rdo rje'i lte ba la gnas pa'i hūṃ yig las 'od zer byung ste—/ 'od des de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ngo bo te ru ka gdan drangs te mchod nas/ a rnyi ṣiñtsa tu rmā ⑦sarba ta thā ga ta zhes pas dbang zhu bar bya'o/ /de rnams kyis rjobadud rtsi lngas gang ba'i rin po che'i bum pa rnams kyis bdag nyid dbang bskur te mgon po mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan rjopa bsam par bya'o/ /rnal 'byor pa'i tshogs de thams cad rang rang gi byang chub kyi sems la sogs 40byed1194

pa'i khu bas mchod par bya'o/ /zhal ni mche ①gcigs 'jigs chen po/ /sngags kyi me tog phreng bas brgyan/ /sha chen rnams ni rol mdzad pa'i/ /he ru ka dpal bdag phyag 'tshal/ /zhes pa 'dis bstod par bya'o/ /de nas nam mkha'i ④hūṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje de'i 'og tu snyayig yongs su gyur pa las pad+ma'i snod/ de'i dbus su oṃ yig gis mtshan pa'i go ku ①da ha na dang / ma rjomu shu bi ra la sogs pa'i dam tshig gi rdzas rnams ni rdo rje dang pad+ma yang dag par sbyor bas bsregs shing 'bar bas de'i rjokhu bar byas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi tshul ji lta ba'i ye shes nyi ma'i 'od dang ye shes kyi sa bon gyi 'od zer rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug nas dngos po de rnams kyis lhan cig byas te/ oṃ uhūṃ zhes pa'i yi ge gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs rjol hūṃ yig dkar po las skyes pa'i rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi ljags su byas te bdag nyid des tshim par bya'o/ /de nas snying gar nyi ma dang rdo rje'i lte ba la gnas pa'i hūṃ yig gis yang dag par bskor bar bzhugs pa'o/ /oṃ tre+e ⑦lokyā k+ṣe pa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa ④swā hā zhes pa'i yi ge bcu gnyis kyi sngags kyi phreng ba rab tu gsal zhing 'bar bzhin pa yid kyis mngon par bris te/ go rims bzhin du brjod par gyur pas dben par bzlas par bya'o—/ /nyi ma'i gung thun la skad cig gis dpal he ru ka'i skur bdag nyid bsams te/ de nas mig la sogs pa'i rnam par dag pas 'khor lo bzhi bsgoms nas mchod pa dang bstod pa dang bdud rtsi myang ba dang / bzlas pa la sogs pa bya'o/ /'jig rten gsum bskyod dpa' bo yi/ /sgrub ⑨thabs mchog ni byas pa yis⑩/ /bsod nams gang bsags de yis ni/ /'gro kun rdo rje 40—1195

'dzin par shog /dgyes pa'i rdo rje phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //tā ra shrīs mdzad zer// //bsdur mchan/1192 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉༄ga /dgyes pa'i rdo rje phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉phyag dang / ②〈〈pe 〉〉pa/ 〈〈snar 〉〉pa/④〈〈pe 〉sngasnar 〉to)ra spyod/1193 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bzung / ②〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉wahwa/ ②〈'dir 〉sku da/1194 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉stanas/ ②〈〈snar 〉〉rtsa/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉྾〈co 〉〉drangs par/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉me/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉po'adir 〉〉〈co 〉nya)/ 0〈〈pe 〉po'adir 〉〉skyun/1195 ①〈〈snar 〉〉neb/ ②〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉pakhar/ ①〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉ga/ hri〈〈pe〉sko〈snar 〉ga'i/ ⑤〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉nekhu bas tsha zhing smin pas/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brlab/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉tre/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉waphaṭa/ ⑨〈〈snar 〉〉bsgrub/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stab/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2262)40wa 1196

༄ga /bdag med ma rkyang pa'i sgrub thabs/①༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ kai ②ba la ne+e rātū sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/bdag med ma rkyang pa'i sgrub thabs/ bdag med ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngon du gsungs pa'i cho gas stong pa nyid du bsgoms pa'i rjes la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la i yig sngon po'i sa bon dang gri gug spro ba la sogs pa sngon du 'gro zhing yongs su gyur pa las ro'i steng du rang gi snying gar zla ba la gnas pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i bdag med ma sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig ma/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du badze+es pa/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa—/ zhal mche ba gcigs shing ljags bskyod pa phyag g.yas na gri gug① /g.yon na thod pa bsnams pa/ spyan gsum dmar zhing zlum pa/ phyag rgya lngas rnam par brgyan pa/ de'i mgo 0dang mgrin pa dang snying ga rnams su oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes pa'i yi ge rnams so/ /snying gar zla ba la gri gug gi yu bar rjozla ba 40—1197

la e yig bltas te sngags 'di bzlas par bya'o/ /skyes a ā i zhi u lca ṛ rī lo 'o/ e i o skyor+shayaṃ swā hā/ zhes so/ /bdag med ma rkyang pa'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/1197 7mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉༄ga /bdag med ma rkyang pa'i sgrub thabs gnyis bzhugs so// ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ke/ ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉mi bsnamasapa/④〈〈pe〉〉〈snar 〉ṅkabo/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉tha la/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2263)40wa 1198

༄ga /bdag med ma'i sgrub thabs/①༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ be+e rāt+tha sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/bdag med ma'i sgrub thabs/ bcom ldan 'das ma bdag med ma ②la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang por sems can thams cad gdon par 'dod pa'i tshul kyis ⑦snying rje bsgoms nas phyi dang nang du bcas pa stong pa nyid du dmigs te/bar snang la busaṃ yig las gri gug de'i yu bar ⑤zla ba la ⑥saṃ yig rnam par bsams te/ de nas rnal 'byor pas 'khor lo spro ba dang bsdu ba bsgoms nas de thams cad yongs su gyur pa las ro'i snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la bcom ldan 'das bdag med ma sku mdog nag mo gri gug dang thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ phyag gnyis pa zhal gcig pa bsam par bya'o/ /dmar zhing zlum pa'i spyan gsum pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du badze+es pa/ mgo bo dang mgrin pa dang snying ga rnams su oṃ ābyuhūṃ gi yi ge rnams so/ /snying gar zla ba la 40—1199

༄ga /dpal 'byung po 'dul byed kyi sgrub thabs mdor bsdus pa/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī byu ta ḍā ④ma ra saṃ k+ṣip+ta sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/ dpal 'byung po 'dul byed kyi sgrub thabs mdor bsdus pa/ dpal 'byung po 'dul byed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshangs pa brgya byin lus ngan sogs/ /myos rnams 'doms par mkhas pa yi/ /dpal ldan 'byung 'dul phyag 'tshal nas—/ /de yi sgrub thabs bri bar bya/ /mdor bsdus man ngag rnam dag pas//mdor bsdus 'dod phyir sbyar bar bya/ /gnod sbyin gnod sbyin mo sogs 'grub//bdag snying ya mtshan skyes nas bris/ /dang por re zhig sngags pas thugs kar zla ba la khams gsum rnam par gsal ba'i 'od zer yang dag par 'khrigs pa/lus la re yig dmar po'i sa bon rnam par bsam par bya'o/ /de nas dag pa'i lcags kyu'i rnam pas mdun du 'byung po 'dul byed gdan drangs nas bla na med pa'i mchod ①pa rnam pa bdun gyis mngon par mchod nas stong pa nyid bsgom par 40—1201

bya'o—/ /de nas kun+da dang mtshungs dri med rnam rgyas mtshan mor byed pa yi/ /steng du dung 'dra hūṃ yig bkod pa'i gnas dbus zla ba'i dkyil/ /shin tu 'bar byed ma lus yongs gyur yang dag las/ /sna tshogs pa yi ①chu skyes 'dab ma 'jam po blta bar bya/ /de nas de yi dbus su e yig yongs gyur sman gyi dbang po ste/ /hūṃ yig snying po hūṃ yig yongs gyur las/ /mthing nag 'bar ba'i rdo rje rnam par bsgom/ /de dag yongs gyur skad cig gis blta zhing / /mche ⑤gtsigs sku mdog mthing nag 'byung po rnams/ /skrag mdzad rang bzhin 'gro la nyer phan mdzad/ /khyab bya gcig chags rgyu yis ①'phrog byed dang / /dbang phyug gzhon sogs bdud drag las gcig pa/ /zhal ni cung zad mche gtsigs shing / /khro bo 'bar zhing ④rnam par 'phro/ /dbu skra dmar ser gyen badze+es mthing / /na bza' sngon pos sku la brgyan/ /phyag g.yas na rdo rje bsnams pa/ g.yon na zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/thod pa lnga'i dbu rgyan rjocan/ phyag g.yon na thod pa dang rjortse gsum ⑦bsnams pa—/ g.yas na ḍa ⑧ma ru bsnams pa/ ral pa dmar ser gyis dbu brgyan pa/spyan gsum pa/ stag gi pags pa'i na bza' bsnams pa/ 'byung po'i dbang po gzhan las rgyal ba/ zhabs g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ phyag gnyis dpal 'byung po 'dul byed kyi phyag rgya bcings pa bsgom par bya'o/ /de la phyag rgya 'di'o/ /ming med gnyis po bcing ⑨bya ste/ /mdzub mo gnyis po bskum par bya/ /mthe'u chung gung mo de bzhin du/ /mtheb chen gyis ni mnon par bya//klu brgyad kyis nye bar mdzes pa ste/ de la stobs kyi rgyu sngon pos dbu skra bcings pa—/ 'jog po dmar pos mgul rgyan ⑩byas pa/ dga' bo dang nye dga' 40—1202

bos rna rgyan byas pa/ 'di dag ni ser por gcig pa'o/ /mtha' yas dkar pos tshangs skud byas pa/ nor rgyas dkar pos rked rgyan byas pa/ phyag rgya'i phyag dag la rigs ldan dngul chu'i kha dog lta bu'o/ /phyag gzhan dag la de bzhin du dung skyong dkar po'o/ /zhabs gdub la pad+ma dang pad+ma chen po dag go//'di dag ni dmar por gcig pa'o/ /de bzhin du spyan gnyis dmar por gyur pa'i dpal 'byung po 'dul byed bsgom par bya'o zhes so/ /khro ba dang bcas shing gcig tu 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa/ snying ga dang / mgrin pa dang /mdzod spu dang / mgo rnams su bsrung ba'i don du phyag rgyas reg par bya'o/ /bsam gtan gyis ngal na sngags bzlas par bya'o/ /rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang /khro bo'i bzlas pas so/ /sngags ni/ hūṃ badz+ra phaṭa ces so/ /skyes bu dam pa nges par yon tan don gnyer rnams kyi phyir/ /gang zhig gis kyang de bris cis kyang bdag gis gsal byas pa/ /dge ba gang des rnam par snang mdzad thob gyur nas/ /'jig rten gsum po'i sdig pa mtha' dag 'joms par shog /dpal 'byung po 'dul byed kyi sgrub thabs mdor bsdus pa rdzogs so// //40—1203

bsdur mchan/1201 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉sa / /dpal 'byung po 'dul byed kyis sgrub thabs gnyis bzhugs so// ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉rgya ta sheg ②〈〈snar 〉〉chod/12 2 ①〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉to/payi ②〈〈pe 〉〉 ba/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾po ra 〉〉rung yid/ ④〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉bzhin/⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉brgyan/ 0〈〈pe 〉〉〈'dir 〉〉wathod pa dang / ⑦〈〈pe 〉dze'adir 〉〉〉dang thod pa/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉nge/ ⑨〈〈snar 〉〉bcings/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉brgyan/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2265)40wa 1204

sngag /'byung po 'dul byed kyi sgrub thabs kyi cho gasde༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ bhū ②ta ḍā ma ra ①sā dha no pa yi ka /bod skad du/ 'byung po 'dul byed kyi sgrub thabs kyi cho ga /dpal 'byung po 'dul byed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'byung po'i snyems pa rnam thu'ajoms pa'i/ /khro bo 'dul byed phyag 'tshal nas/ /ji ltar rnyed pa'i man ngag gis/ /de yi sgrub thabs bshad par bya/ /dang por re zhig rngulag pa gnyis la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rnam par bsgoms te/ de'i dbus su hūṃ yig 'bar bar 'ubasams nas/sngags 'di bzlas par bya'o/ /oṃ sidhi badz+ra hūṃ/ de nas phyag rgya bcing bar bya'o—/ /sor mo rnams phan tshun du 'khyud nas sdigs mdzub gnyis po rtse mo bzhin du rab tu spyobarkyang bar bya'o/ /snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rnam par bsam par bya'o/ /de la ra yig dmar po thig le dang bcas pa 'bar zhing 'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrigs ⑧pa bsam par bya'o/ /'dir sdig pa thams cad 40byed1205

zhi ba brjod par bya ste/ oṃ ha na bi t+t+waṃ sa ①ya tsā sha ya pā paṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ de'i rjes la stong pa nyid du bsgom par bya'o/ /mdun du kun+da dang / shel bzhin du blta bar bya'o/ /de'i dbus su hūṃ yig dang juḥyig yongs su gyur pa las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa rnam par bsam par bya'o/ /de'i steng du saṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /de la de bzhin du hūṃ yig 'bar zhing 'khrigs pa rnam par bsgoms nas/ khro bo 'be+ebs pa'i phyag rgya dang sngags kyis gdab par bya'o/ /phan tshun du khu tshur bcings te/ sdigs mdzub gnyis 'khyud par bya'o/ /oṃ snyagro dha be sha hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ aḥ/ de'i 'od kyis yang dag par bskul zhing gzhug par bya'o/ /de la de bzhin du dpag tu ④med pa'i khro bo'i sku rab tu bzhugs ①par bsam par bya'o/ /de la bsod nams dang ye shes las mngon par grub pa'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'bar bzhin pa'i rdo rje nag po las 'od zer 'phro zhing 'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrigs pa bsgom par bya'odu/ /rdo rje de las dpag tu med pa'i khro bo la sogs pa phyogs bcur 'phros te/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzu 'phrul la sogs pa mdzad par blta bar bya'o/ /de la phyag rgya de bzhin du/ /mngon du phyogs pas dgug par bya/ /sngags ni brjod pas de nyid la/ /rdo rje dang ni zhags pa bsam/ /oṃ badz+ra be sha pa ta ye hūṃ/de nas khro bo chen po'i skur bdag nyid bsgom par bya ste/ drag po 'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrigs rjopa'i 'od can/ phyag bzhi pa/ khro bo chen po mig sman phyis pa'i 'od lta bu/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rje gsor ba/ g.yon pas sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ zhal mche ba gcigs pa/ klu brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ mtha' yas kyis tshangs skud byas pa/ nor rgyas kyis ska rags byas pa/ dung skyong gis 40—1206

lag gdub byas pa/ gzhan yang 'di rnams dkar po'o①/ /phyag g.yon pa la rigs ldan gyis skelag gdub byas pa ste/ dngul chu'i kha dog lta bu'o/ /dga' bo dang nye dga' bos rna rgyan byas pa/ 'jog pos mgul rgyan byas pa/dpung rgyan ni gzhan te 'di rnams ni ser po'o/ /pad+ma dang pad+ma chen po dmar pos rkang gdub byas pa/ stobs kyi rgyu nag pos dbu skra bcings pa'o thod pa'i phreng bas dbu brgyan ④cing / /'jig rten gsum yang 'joms byed pa'i/ / aṣ+ṭa ha dhiyi gad chen sgrogs/ /khyab bdag 'jig rten gsum na gnas/ /g.yon brkyang zhabs kyis legs bzhugs pa'i⑤/ /nyi ma bye ba'i 'od dang mtshungasarka/ /gzhan gyis mi thub zhabs kyis gnon/ /phyag rgya sngags kyis rab tu gnas/ /ming med gnyis po 'khyud bya zhing / /mdzub mo gnyis po bskum par bya/ /mthe'u chung gung mo'ang de bzhin du/ /mtheb chen gyis ni mnan par bya/ /mchog gi phyag rgya 'di yis ni/ /dpal ldan 'jig rten gsum rgyal bsgrubarjo—/ /de nas khro bo'i bdag po khro bo ⑦phyag rgya dang / sngags kyis ⑧yan lag drug la dgod par bya'o/ /phan tshun du khu tshur bcings nas gung mo dag rab tu brkyang bar bya'o/ /spyi bor phyag rgya'i sngags ni/ oṃ ha na badz+ra hūṃ/phyag rgya 'dis de bzhin du gung mo dag nang du bcug ste/ mdzub mo dag rtse mor byas pa ni thor tshugs kyi phyag rgya'o/ /sngags ni/ oṃ da ha ⑨badz+ra hūṃ/ de bzhin du phyag rgya 'dis mtheb chen dag logs su byas te/ mtheb chen g.yas pa ni mig g.yas pa ⑩la mtheb chen/ g.yon pa ni mig g.yon pa la/ oṃ dīp+ta badz+ra hūṃ/ phan tshun khu tshur bcings nas mthe'u chung gnyis 'khyud par bya'o/ /mdzub mo dag rab tu brkyang bar bya'o/ /snying ga'i phyag rgya'o/ /sngags ni/40—1207

oṃ badz+ra ro ṣa hūṃ/ de bzhin du phyag rgya 'dis mdzub mo dag rna rgyan du bya'o/ /go cha'i phyag rgya'i sngags ni/ oṃ ḍi bye badz+ra hūṃ/ mdzub mo gnyis rab tu brkyang ba ni mtshon cha'i phyag rgya'o/ /sngags ni/ oṃ ha na da ha pa tsa kro dha badz+ra sarba duṭ+wān mā ①ra ya hūṃ/ de nas rdo rje khro bo dbab par bya'o/ /phan tshun 1du byas nas mdzub mo gnyis bskum par bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra kro dha sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya shī rgyu a gats+tsha twe④ཿdzaḥhūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ de nas mchod yon thal mo gan rkyal du byas nas mtheb chen gnyis logs su sbyar bar bya'o/ /oṃ sarba de ba dīp+ta dhisī da bha ga bān ma hā kro dha ar+ghaṃ ⑤pra tīts+tsha hūṃ aḥde nas gdan dbul bar bya'o/ /lag pa g.yon pa gan rkyal du byas nas mtheb chen bsgreng stebu/ lag pa g.yas pa'i khu tshur kyis g.yon pa'i mtheb chen gzung dze+ebar bya'o/ /g.yas pa'i mtheb chen bsgreng bar bya'o/ /oṃ dza ya dza ya ma hā kro ⑧ti kro dha rā dza i rda byu ⑨ta se rgo dar shā ya rak+ṣa rak+ṣa pra ti griṇ+ḍa swā hā/ thal mo sbyar bar byas nas sor mo thams cad ma 'byar bar byas pa ni pad+ma'i phyag rgya zhes brjod par bya'o/ /gdan gyi phyag rgya'i sngags ni/ oṃ pad+mod bha ba ni ṣa na ṇa ya sarba de bat+ta swā hā/ de nas 'phang bar bya ste/ phan tshun du khu tshur bcings nas mtheb chen rab tu brkyang ste⑫—/ khu tshur g.yon pa snying gar bzhag ste/ khu tshur g.yas pa mtshon cha 'phen pa'i tshul du bya'o/ /oṃ nā sha ya sarba duṭ+wān ⑪da ha pa tsa duṣ+ṭhan bhasmri ⑫ku ru hūṃ phaṭa/ de nas sngags 'dis phyogs bcing bar bya ste/ phan tshun du ⑫khu tshur so sor bcings te/ lag pa g.yon pa'i sdigs mdzub rab tu brkyang ste g.yas pa'i dpung pa'i rtsa bar gzhag ④par bya'o/ /g.yas pa'i mtheb chen gyis mthe'u chung gi sen mo mnan te sor mo lhag ma rnams rab tu brkyang nas phyogs 40—1208

bcur bskor bar bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa/ brnya brnya①/ sha di ⑤shaṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ de nas 'di brjod nas rdo rje gsor bar bya ste/ khro bo'i dngos grub dngos grub che/ /dngos grub rgya chen dam tshig bstan/ /lha rnams kun gyi dngos grub dang / /bla med dngos grub bdag myur mdzod/ /khro bo'i rgyal po ①rtsa ba'i phyag rgya bcings nas hūṃ badz+ra phaṭa/ blta zhing dam tshig sbyin par bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la mchod par byas nas khro bo dbab pa'i phyag rgya bcings nas rdo rje khro bo rang gi lus la rab tu gzhug par bya'o/ /oṃ pra bi rjosha kro dha hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ stos dz+wa lā mā ⑤lā ku la bhi sha rjoṇa badz+ra stosarang gi lus kyi nang du bsgoms te go cha la sogs pa byas nas thams cad 'dir rdzogs par bya ba'i don du snyim pas thal mo sbyar nas rdzogs par bya ba'i sngags brjod par bya'o/ /oṃ sidha badz+ra a dze+epū ra ya a khrupū ra ya ⑨hūṃ phaṭa/ 'dis lhag chad thams cad yongs su kha skong ⑩bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas khro bo'i nga rgyal bskyed pas dngos grub thams cad 'gugs par byed do/ /sngags 'dis phan tshun du khu tshur bcings te mthe'u chung gnyis po 'khyud par bya'o/ /mdzub mo rab tu brkyang ste bkug nas cung zad bskyod par bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra ro ṣa ma hā kro dha sidh+yā ⑪ka ra ⑫ hūṃ dzaḥde nas rang gi snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la yi ge rnams bung ba nag po'i phreng ba me 'bar ba bzhin du bsam par bya'o/ /hūṃ badz+ra phaṭa/ rang gi ba spu'i bu ga nas khro bo'i sku spro ba dang bsdu bar ⑫byed par bsam par bya'o/ /de'i yi ④ge dang sems rtse gcig tu gyur pas so/ /bzlas pas ngal na khro bo'i sku rang gi snying ga'i nang du bsgoms te/ thal mo sbyar nas dngos grub thams cad zhu bar bya'o/ /sirnyi badz+ra a pū ra ya sarba satā māṃ/ ā paṃ sarba sernyim+me ⑩pra 40—1209

yats+tsha hūṃ dzaḥ/ de nas pad+ma'i phyag rgyas mtheb chen gnyis po bskyod par bya zhing /lha thams cad gshegs su gsol ba'i phyag rgya dang / sngags ni oṃ sā ra sā ra①/bi sa ra bi sa ra/ gats+tsha gats+tsha/ sarba de ba tā na shrī badz+ra dha ra sa mā dzñā pa ya ti swā hā/ de nas rang gi lus la go cha ④byas te/ khro bo'i nga rgyal gyi yid kyis spyod lam ci bde bar bya'o/ /rim pa 'dis sngags 'bum phrag gcig bzlas pas myur du 'grub po/ /de nas sngags pas dbang bskur ba rjes su gnang ba a+yobyas te/ sngon du bsnyen pas rdo rje 'dzin pa bsgrub par 'dod pas zla ba gcig tu thun mtshams gsum du stong phrag re bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas bco lnga la ji ltar 'byor pa'i mchod pa byas nas/ ting nge 'dzin la legs par gnas te/ khro bo'i phyag rgya bcings nas mtshan mo ril po bzlas pa bya'o/ /de nas nang par snga bar sa g.yo ba'i phyag rgya 'bar te/ 'bar ba tsam gyis rdo rje 'dzin pa dang mtshungs par 'gyur te/ rgas pa dang / 'chi ba med par lha'i lus su 'gyur bar bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pas gsungs so/ /mdor bsdus pa yongs su rdzogs shing rgyas pa'i rim par gyur pa 'byung po 'dul byed kyi sgrub thabs kyi cho ga dam pa thams cad 'dren pa'i 'jig rten gsum gyi rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so// //40—1210
bsdur 'azas re'u migargyud/ (2266)40wa 1212

༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī mad+ma hā kā ②la sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/dpal ldan nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs/ dpal ldan mgon po nag po la ⑦phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin du sngon du gsungs pa'i rim pas stong pa nyid bsgoms pa'i rjes la sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la hūṃ yig nag po de yongs su gyur pa las dpal ldan rje btsun nag po chen po rjozhal gcig phyag gnyis rjopa/ sku mdog nag po/ spyan gsum pa 'bar ba chen po/ phyag g.yas pa dang g.yon pa dag gis gri gug dang thod pa bsnams pa/ mgo bo'i phreng ba'i do shal gyis sku la brgyan pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du badze+es pa/ mche ba gcigs pa/'jigs par byed pame/ sku thams cad la sbrul ⑦gyis brgyan pa/ sku bong thung ba—/ zhal nas khrag 'dzag pa'i bdag nyid du skad cig gis bskyed nas sngags bzlas par bya'o/ /de la sngags ni 'di'o/ /oṃ ma hā kā la hūṃ hūṃ ⑧phaṭa phaṭa swā 40—1213

hā—/ dug dang / khrag dang sgog pa dang / yungs kar rnams kyis nag po chen po la ①spos phul nas sran ma ma sha dang / dzamyu ti ga dang / chang dang /me tog dang / byug pa lnga'i lcags kyu'i bdud rtsis nag po chen po mchod par bya ste / gtor ma'i sngags 'dis so/ /oṃ ma hā kā lā ya/ shā sa no pa hā ④ri ṇi—/ e ①ṣa pa— ma kā rjolo/ a rjoyo i rda rat+na tra ya/ a dupa kā ri ṇ+ḍaṃ—/ ya di pra tīdzñā ⑦sma ra si ta ⑧dā/ i rda duṣ+ṭa ⑨kha kha/ khā nyi khā nyi ma ra ma ra kṛṇ+ḍa kṛṇ+ḍi/ ban+ta brnya/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa di na me ke na/ mā ra ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ tsha ba gsum gyis ⑩bsgrub bya'i gzugs byas te lus la tsher mas dgang zhing dug dang ske tshe rnams kyis cho ga bzhin du byugs ⑪nas me la bsro bar bya'o/ /gang gi ⑫ming dang bcas pa de/ /de bzhin skad cig mthong mi 'gyur/ /slob dpon zhe sdang rtag khro gang / /gang zhig dkon mchog gsum po dang / /dpag med sems can rnams 'tshe rnams/ /nag po chen pos za bar byed/ /de yi lus kyi sha gcod cing / /de bzhin khrag ni 'thung bar byed/ /spyi bor thig le byas nas gus pa ⑫chen po byas te bzlas pa'o—/ /dpal ldan nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //40—1214

bsdur mchan/1212 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉༄ga /dpal ldan nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs gnyis bzhugs so// ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rim ha ka ①〈〈pe 〉〉can po/ 〈〈snar 〉〉cen po la/ me〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉khyiphyag gnyis pa/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉waphyag gnyis/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉 dang / ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉〉gyi rgyan/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉ste:/ 〈〈snar 〉〉ni/1214 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉po'i/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉sna nā pa kā/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉wage du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉hā/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wa.a/ du〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉sta'i/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ti dzñā/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉nyanat+ta/⑨〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉duṭaṃ/ tī〈〈snar 〉〉)/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉byug ⑫〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stanas/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉ṅkargya/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2267)40wa 1215

༄ga /nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs/①༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā kā la sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/ nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs/ dpal ldan nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang por re zhig sngags pas rang gi yi dam gyi lha'i rnal 'byor gyi ④bdag nyid bskyed nas yi ges byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /de la rim pa 'dis so/ /nam mkha'i phyogs su paṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las pad+ma de'i steng du āsaḥyig yongs su gyur pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de'i dbus su hūṃ yig gi sa bon yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ de'i lte ba la ④nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūṃ yig bltas nas de'i 'od zer gyis sngon ma bzhin du bsgrub cing sku mdog la sogs pa 'chad par 'gyur ba'i nag po chen po gdan drangs nas/ hūṃ yig las byung ba'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis yang dag par mchod nas/ oṃ ābyuhūṃ muḥzhes pas gshegs su gsol lo/ /de nas thams cad stong pa nyid du bsgom pa'i sngags 40—1216

brjod par bya'o/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa ā kopho①haṃ/ phyi nas pad+ma la a yig yongs su gyur pa las zla ba/ de la zla ba la hūṃ yig dkar po bltas nas de yongs su gyur pa las ral gri/ de'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la hūṃ yig gi sa bon gyis byin gyis brlabs la ④de thams cad yongs su gyur pa las/nag po chen po sku mdog nag po dbu skra dmar ser gyen du badze+es pa/ klu brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ phyag bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas na ral gri dang / mchog sbyin mdzad pa/ phyag g.yon na kyertse gsum dang thod pa bsnams pa/ sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ drag po'i 'od zer can/ ljags bskyod pa/ zhal mche ba gcigs pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'i dbu rgyan can/ nyi ma la bzhugs pa/ de lta bu'i nag po chen por bskyed nas/ snying gar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūṃ yig bugi 'od zer gyis sngon bzhin du nag po chen po rab tu gzhug par bya'o/ /slar yang de bzhin gshegs pa rnams gdan drangs te/ de rnams dang mā ma kri la sogs pa rnams kyi skus ①dbang bskur bar bsam par bya'o/ /de'i rjes su ye shes sems dpa'i sa bon gyi 'od zer las byung ba'i spyan ma la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod cing bstod par yang bya'o/ /bdud rtsi lnga las grub pa'i rim pa'i nyer spyod kyis de la gtor ma dbul bar bya'o/ /de la dbul ba'i sngags ni/ na maḥs madha kā ya bā—t+ta badzā ṭ+wāṃrjo/ na mo badz+ra gro dha ya ma hā rda tsāṅka ska ṭa dzhai ⑦ra bā ya/ a se myu sa skel pa ra shu ⑨pā sha ha sgyu ⑩ya/ oṃ a mṛ ⑪ta kuṇ+ḍa li kha kha khā hi khā nyi/ brnya brnya⑫/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ galja gadz+dza/ bi sbo ṭa ya bi sgo ṭa ya/ma hā ga ṇa pa ti dzī bi tārnya ka rā ya hūṃ/ na maḥs marnya kā ya wāka cit+ta badzā hūṃ⑫/40—1217

oṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ oṃ rma/ haṃ haṃ/ kai ka/ ram̐ re/ ma hā kā ya dzi gosnya ke sha bar+ha dhe①/ i mo bi lo/ kṛṇ+ḍa kṛṇ+ḍi/ kṛza ④pa ya kṛsnra dze+epa ya/ i rda karma ku ru ku ru/ oṃ stosahūṃ hūṃ/ sarba biṭ+wāṃ dubi tsā ya kān/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ zhes pa la sogs pa ni gtor ma'i sngags so/ /oṃ yasarma haṃ ram̐ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/zhes pa ni bzlas pa'i sngags so/ /dpal ldan nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //lha so so'i sgrub pa'i thabs rgya mtsho zhes bya ba 'di rnams ni dpal ldan sa skya'i gtsug lag khang chen por paṇ+ḍi ta chen po go tam shrī las brgyud cing / paṇ+ḍi ta chen po krirti tsan+d+ra'i buzhal snga nas zhus nas/ slob dpon chen po dharma pa 0la rak+ṣi ta'i sku skyabs dang / dpon chen po kun dga' gzhon nu dang / ma gcig pas sbyin bdag mdzad pa la brten nas/ de shān+ta ri yo gi grags pa rgyal mtshan kyis/ bya lo zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i dkar po'i ⑦tshes gsum la dben gnas dam pa chu mig rdzing ⑧khar yongs su rdzogs par bsgyur ro/ / grub pa'i bla ma mkhyen dang brtse ba'i mnga' bdag rnams dang ni/ /blo gros rtsal 'byang mkhas mchog kun kyis 'bad pas rab bsgrubs pa'i/ /rin chen kun gyi 'byung gnas sgrub thabs rgya mtsho chen po 'dis/ /'gro ba kun gyi dgos 'dod re ba yid bzhin legs par 'grub par shog/⑨ //40—1218

༄ga /klu'i dbang phyug rgyal po'i sgrub thabs/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ nā ④ge shwa rā ④rā dza sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/klu'i dbang phyug rgyal po'i sgrub thabs/ rje btsun sgol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thog mar gnas khang nyams dga' bar kha gdong dag par byas nas stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ 'byung po thams cad tshim par byed pa'i sngags/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇ+ḍaṃ ār+ya nut+pan+da tāta rjo.oṃ uhūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes brjod la oṃ u bispyon+ta krita ④hūṃ phaṭa ces brjod pas buphyogs bcu'i bgegs thams cad bsal bar bya'o/ / de nas ⑦byams pa dang / snying rje dang / dga' ba dang / btang snyoms sngon du song bas nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa'i blos rang gi snying gar hūṃ bai ḍūr+ya'i mdog lta bu las 'phros pa'i 'od kyis lus khyab nas rang nyid de bzhin gshegs pa klu dbang rgyal por gyur par bsams/ de nas snying ga'i hūṃ las 40byed1220

'od 'phros pas mdun gyi nam mkha' la bla ma dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa klu dbang rgyal po gtso 'khor lnga pa mdun gyi nam mkha' la spyan drangs la/ phyag 'tshal ba sngon du song bas dngos su bshams pa'i mchod pa rnams kyis mchod la/ yid las byung ba'am—/ mchod pa'i rim pa ni 'di yin te/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe t+pahūṃ zhes brjod pas me tog thogs pa'i lha mo sngon mos nam mkha' khengs pa dang / oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūṃ zhes brjod pas bdug spos thogs pa'i lha mo ser mo dpag tu med pa dang / oṃ badz+ra dī pe 26①hūṃ zhes brjod pas mar me thogs pa'i lha mo dmar mos nam mkha' khengs pa dang / oṃ badz+ra gadhe ā skehūṃ zhes brjod pas dri mchog thogs pa'i lha mo ser mo ①dpag tu med pa dang / oṃ badz+ra ne+e bi bye yasarjohūṃ zhes brjod pas zhal zas thogs pa'i lha mo ser skya ma dpag tu med pas mchod la/oṃ sarba bi sho ⑤dha byu dza me gha rjospa ra ṇa ⑦sa mu dre stos⑧hūṃ zhes pa'i sngags brjod la/de nyid la rin po che sna tshogs dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang /dril bu dang / ba dan dang / bla re la sogs pa dang / 'khor los sgyur ⑨ba'i rin po che sna bdun gyis mchod par bya'o/ /de nas sdog pa bshags pa dang /rjes su yi rang ba dang / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba dang / mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba gdab pa dang / dge ba rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ba dang / byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa dang / lam bstan ⑩pa rnams bya'o/ /de nas ye shes kyi tshogs bskyed par bya ba'i phyir sngags 'di brjod par bya'o/ /oṃ swa bhā wa shurnyaḥsarba dharmāḥ⑪swa bhā wa shurnyolha⑫haṃ zhes brjod pas—/ chos thams cad spros pa ⑫dang bral bar bsamasabya/ de nas stong pa 40—1221

nyid la gnas pas sems can kyi don mi 'grub pas snying rje chen po'i rang bzhin gyi ①paṃ las pad+ma 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa yangs shing rgya che bar bsam/ de'i steng du chos thams cad mtha' dang dbus med par ston par byed pa'i yi ge a dkar po 'od du zhu ba las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yangs shing rgya che bar bsam②/de'i steng du yi ge hūṃ mi dpogs rin po che'i mdog lta bu las 'od zer 'phros pas klu rnams dang sems can gyi las dang nyon mongs pa'i sdig pa dang ④sgrib pa thams cad dag nas hūṃ skad cig ma gcig la klu'i dbang phyug rgyal po'i skur gyur par bsam/ de yang sku mdog mi dpog rjorin po che'i mdog lta bu sgrul mgo bdun gdengs pa'i rgyab yol can/ chos gos ngur sprig rjogasol ba dbu gtsug tor dang ldan pa/ klu thams cad klu'i skye gnas las thar bar byed pa dang /sems can thams cad ngan 'gro'i skye gnas las thar bar byed pa'i phyag rgya dang ldan pa/ bzhin 'dzum pa dang ldan par bsam/ de'i mdun du byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba sku mdog dkar po/ rin po che'i myu gu phyag g.yas na bsnams pa/ g.yon na bum pa bsnams pa/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ bcom ldan 'das la blta ba'o/ /g.yas su byang chub sems dpa' byams pa sku mdog dmar po klu shing gi go spyog rjome tog dang bcas pa dang ril ba spyi blugs bsnams pa'o/ /rgyab tu byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa sku mdog gser btso ma'i kha dog ⑦lta bu at+pa la bsnams pa'o/ /⑤g.yon du ⑨spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug sku mdog dkar po pad+ma bsnams pa/ bcom ldan 'das la blta ⑩ba'o/ /g.yas phyogs su byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa dang / g.yon phyogs su dgra bcom 40—1222

pa dpag tu med pa bsam mo/ /'og gi phyogs su klu'i tshogs dpag tu med pa rin po che thogs pa thal mo sbyar ba gyen du lta ba bsam mo/ /de nas ye shes sems dpa' mdun kyi nam mkhar spyan drangs la mchod pa dang / gsol ba legs par btab la/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥzhes pa'i yi ge bzhis spyan drangs la/dgug pa dang / gzhug pa dang bcing ba dang / dgyes par byas la snying po 'di brjod par bya'o/ /tar+ya thā/ oṃ ta thā ga to bha ga bān nā ga rā dze shwa ra a byejo ①na a dhiṣ+ṭṛ te swā hā/ 'bum phrag bcu gcig bzlas pas mdze nad thams cad dang / myong bar nges pa'i las thams cad zad par 'gyur ro/ /bum pa gnyis las gcig tu bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pa'i sku gzugs dang /rin po che dang / 'bru sna tshogs kyis dgang bar bya'o/ /gcig tu klu nor rgyas kyi bu la klu chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i gzugs bcug la rin po che sna tshogs dang / klu sman sna tshogs dang / 'bru sna tshogs kyis legs par bkang la—/ pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dkyil 'khor gnyis kyi khar bum pa gnyis po bzhag la ba dmar mo gnyis kyi 'o mas dgang ba ④dang / gdugs brgya rtsa brgyad dang / tshon sna lnga pa'i ba dan brgya rtsa brgyad dang / a ka ru nag po'i bdug spos dang / spos dkar po dang / bdug pa sna tshogs dang / me tog dang / mar me dang / lha bshos dang / rol mo sna tshogs pas mchod par bya'o—/ /thun mong gi nor rdzas ①la longs spyod par 'gyur ro/ /zhag bdun du snying po rgyun ma chad par bzlas na dbul ba thams cad dang bral bar 'gyur ro//sad dang / ser ba dang / lce 'bab pa'i 'jigs pa 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro//bum pa gnyis po yang 'og tu klu'i bum pa bzhag /steng du bcom ldan 'das kyi 40—1223

bum pa bzhag nas gnas khang gi shar phyogs su gter du sbas na phongs pa'i sdug bsngal dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /klu'i gnod pa thams cad dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /rnam de'i skyes pa dang / bud med thams cad dar bar 'gyur ro//char dbab pa ni bla gab med pa'i sa phyogs su bya'o/ /char bcad pa ni bcom ldan 'das la phul ba'i me tog la sbyin sreg bya'o/ /sa'i gter 'byin par 'dod na bcom ldan 'das kyi sku gzugs kyi spyan sngar rmi lam zhu bar bya'o/ /gtor ma gsum byas la gcig ni bcom ldan 'das la dbul bar bya'o①/ /gnyis pa ni 'jig rten skyong ba rnams la'o/ /gsum pa ni klu rnams la sbyin par bya'o—/ /de nas rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni bla ma'i zhal las shes par bya'o/ /de nas gshegs su gsol la/ thun mtshalas su de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas klu'i dbang phyug rgyal po'i mtshan nyi shu rtsa re re brjod par bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa klu'i dbang phyug rgyal po'i sgrub thabs/slob dpon bdag nyid chen po klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ kā ②ra shrī dzñā na dang / bod kyi lo tsā ①ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o ④ //40byed1224

bsdur mchan/122 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉ga / /klu dbang rgyal po'i /kha thabs rdo rje sems dpa'i cho ga byams pa'i sgrub thabs rnams bzhugs so// ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈'dir 〉ra/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉nga/ 0〈〈pe 〉lo〈snar 〉〉twad/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉༅snan ta krod/ 〈〈snar 〉stabaman ta krid/ rjo〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉wapas/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉des na/1221 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉gli hā/ ②〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉waḥ/ ①〈〈pe〉྾〈snar 〉〉po/ du〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉kya lga ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉1/ rjo〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉starto ba/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈'dir 〉stan/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉tre/ 〈〈snar 〉〉te/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈'dir 〉thasgyur/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉thartan/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉zig bha ba shu sarba dharma/ 〈〈snar 〉〉〉 snya ba shu sarba dharma/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉wa3/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉ri med pa/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsam/1222 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉4)sa/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉yir par bsams/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉wadang / ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dpogs/ me〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉〉can/ me〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉smogs/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉padog ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈'dir 〉〉wabasnams pa'o// ⑨〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stan/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉lta/1223 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉giṣ+ṭha/ ②〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉pa mgod pa/ ③〈〈snar 〉〉brdzas/1224 ①〈〈snar 〉〉rgya/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ka ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉thats+tsha/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈'dir 〉〉 dge legs 'phel /tsher cig / bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2269)40wa 1225

༄7/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya badz+ra satwa twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/dṛ phyo me bha ④ba/ su toṣ+yo me bha ba/ a nu rasto me bha ba/ su poṣ+yo me bha ba/sarba sirnyidz+re ①pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+t+waṃ she yaḥku ru hūṃ/ ha ha ha ha hoḥbha ga bān sarba ta thā ga ta/ badz+ra mā me muñtsa/ badz+rī dhibha ba/ ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥduswā hā/ oṃ ha phaṭa/ stong dang lha bskyed spyan drang dang / /gdan bzhir byin brlabs ④dbang bskur ba'o/ /zhes gzhan nas bshad do/ /gsang sngags dang rig sngags thams cad kyi bdag po phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo—/ /rig sngags brgya pa'i cho ga mdor bsdus pa bshad par bya'o/ /gang zhig sems can don mdzad dang / /sangs rgyas sras rnams thob bya'i phyir/ /byang chub tu ni sems bskyed nas/ /bdag gis rig sngags bsgrub par bya'o⑦/ /sdom pa gsum la gnas pa dang / /shes bzhin dran par ldan pa dang / /40—1226

'phags pa'i nor bdun ldan pa dang / /sngags kyi rgyud sde bzhi shes pas/ /phyag rgya bzhi ldan snying rje can/ /thabs shes yo byad tshogs pas ①bsgrub/ /shes rab che ba/ stong pa nyid kyi don shes pa/ gcam ②phyar can ma yin pa/rig sngags bzlas pa'i tshe smra ba ma yin pa/ me'i las la mkhas pa/ de lta bus bsgrub par bya'o/ /de lta bu la sbyin par bya'o/ /gzhan la ni ma yin no/ /de la cho ga 'di'i thabs ni/ de la bum pa shin tu dkar ba/ gtsang ba/cho ga thams cad tshogs pa ba'i rnam lnga'i dkyil 'khor shin tu gtsang ba dri'i thig le nyer gcig /ga pur kyis byug skepa byas la/ rig sngags 'di brgya rtsa brgyad yid la ma yengs par brjod nas khrus byas sam brjod na tshe zad pa dang tshe nyams pa dang / phun sum tshogs pa thams cad nyams pa dang / bdag la mi dang mi ma yin pa thams cad bsam pa zhig par 'gyur ro/ /sngon gyi las kyi sgrib pa yang ma lus par zad par 'gyur ro/ /bum pa'i thabs so/ /zhi ba la ni mngar gsum dang 'o ma'o/ /rgyas pa la ni zas mchog gi gong bu dang yungs kar ro/ /dbang la ni yungs mar dang 'bras rnam pa sna tshogs dang nim pa'i lo ma'o—/ /drag po la ni sha dang khrag dang dug dang / ske tshe dang til mar ram tshil gzhag go/ /rig sngags brgya rtsa brgyad pa gsum mam/ bdun pa gsum brjod par bya'o/ /rig sngags re re zhing rdzas re re dbul bar bya'o/ /zhi ba la ni mthar swā hā brjod par bya'o/ /rgyas pa la oṃ/ dbang la hoḥ④/ drag po la phaṭa/ rig sngags 'di yis swā hā la sogs pa rjomi brjod pa ni phrin rjolas rnam bzhi'i spyi ⑦las pa'o/ /til gyi sbyin sreg byas pas mtshalas med pa lnga nas nyes pa phra mo yan chad 'byang ⑧bar 'gyur ro/ /de la rig sngags lan re zhing 40—1227

rdzas lan re dbul bar bya'o/ /de la grangs ni brgya rtsa brgyad pa gsum dbul bar bya'o/ /tha na rig sngags gcig tsam til gcig tsam thab tu dor na yang sdig pa 'byang ①bar 'gyur na mang ba rnams lta ci smos/ sdig pa 'byang ba'i dbang du byas pa'o/ /de la ro bsreg pa ni dong gi nang du chos kyi 'khor lo bri bar bya'o/ /chos kyi yi ge rnams kyang bri bar ⑤bya'o/ /shing brtsigs pa thogs kyegasum dang ldan par byas la/ steng khang la skar khung byasarjo/ ro kha nub phyogs su bstan la bzhag go/ /ro'i snying gar 'khor lo rtsibs bcu drug pa/ras sam gro ga'am shing shun la bris te/ dgab par bya'o/ /'khor lo la chos kyi yi ge dgod pa ni chos kyi 'khor lo'o/ /de'i dbus kyi lte ba nas gzungs thag bsgril ba drangs la bsngo phyeb mkhan gyis gzung rjoste/ chos kyi phyag rgya rig sngags 'di brjod par bya'o/ /'di'i bsam pa ni rig sngags 'di brjod pas chos kyi yi ge rnams gsal bar 'gyur ro/ /chos kyi yi ge gsal bas dbus kyi yi ge oṃ gsal bar 'gyur ro/ /oṃ ye shes kyi me byung bas phung po tshig pas ye shes lnga'i 'od zer 'phros pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la mchod pa ni/rgyud las ji skad gsungs pa bzhin mchod par bya'o/ /sems can rnams la bsngo ba ni/ dbang po lnga'i longs spyod du 'dod pa lnga'i longs spyod char bzhin 'bab par dmigs te/ de nas sngags mkhan gyis ⑦rdzas re re la rig sngags lan re re brjod pas brgya rtsa brgyad pa gsum dbul bar bya'o/ /sreg ④rdzas ni yam shing 'o ma can dang / mar dang til la sogs pa dbul bar bya'o/ /mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa'i bstod pa bya'o/ /bkra shis par bya ba'i phyir gong du bstan pa'i phrin ⑨las rnam pa bzhi char bya'o/ /de nas bsngo ⑩ba mkhan gyis tshe 40—1228

thal ba dang / sems can gyi las gsum pa bla na med pa'i byang chub tu bsngo bar bya'o/ /de la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba ni/ bsngo ba mkhan gyis bskor ba dang / sngags mkhan gyis ro'i dbus su bskor ba phrin ①las rnam bzhi'i don du bskor ba ni/ chos kyi 'khor lo rnam pa gsum du bskor ba'o/ /lan bcu gnyis su bskor ba ni/ rdo rje sems dpa' nas rdo rje khu tshur du bskor ba ni zhi ba'o/ /rdo rje rin chen nas rdo rje legs par bskor ba ni rgyas pa'o/ /rdo rje chos nas rdo rje bzhad pa la bskor ba ni dbang ngo / /rdo rje las nas rdo rje smra ba la thug pa ni drag pa'o/ /de rnam pa bcu gnyis su bskor ba'o/ /gong du bskor ba thams cad de ltar bskor bar bya'o/ /yi ge brgya pa'i cho ga slob dpon pad+mas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //40—1229

bsdur mchan/1226 ①mtshan byang 'di 〈〈sde 〉dze〈co 〉〉ltar bkod/ ②〈〈snar 〉ga1/ ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉nyasirnyi me/ dhi〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉badzi/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉waḥ/ du〈〈snar 〉〉brlab/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ba/1227 ①〈〈pe 〉྾po ra 〉〉par/ ②〈〈snar 〉〉gce/ ①〈〈snar 〉〉grags/ ④〈〈pe〉྾〈snar 〉〉waḥ/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉—pa/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉skoraphrin/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉stagan/ ni〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉toraphyang /1228 ①〈〈snar 〉〉sbyang / ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉dgod par/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉brtsig pa thogs/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〉la/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉mardzo/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bzung / ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉gyi/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsreg ⑨〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉skoraphrin/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉sdo/1229 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉toraphrin/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2270)40wa 1230

༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya mi tri ya sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/'phags pa byams pa'i sgrub thabs/ rje btsun byams pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngon du gsungs pa'i cho gas stong pa nyid bsgoms pa'i rjes la/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la sems dpa'i skyil krung ④du bzhugs pa/ zhal gsum pa/ spyan gsum gsum pa/ phyag bzhi pa/ nag po dang / dkar po'i zhal ni g.yas dang g.yon no/ /dbus kyi zhal gser kyi mdog can rab tu ser ba/ phyag dang po gnyis chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya 'dzin pa/ g.yas dang g.yon gyi phyag gnyis kyis mchog sbyin dang / klu shing gi sneme tog rgyas pa'i snye ma bsnams pa/ rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan dupa'i gzugs can kyi byams pa mgon por bdag nyid bsgom par bya'o/ /khu tshur so sor bcings la/ mdzub mo mthe bong gi dbus su bzhag pa me tog gi rnam par byas la de nas sngags bzlas 40—1231

par bya ste/ skyes mi mi tri mi tri ye swā hā/ 'phags pa byams pa'i sgrub thabs cardob/ba/ rbedu// //kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po shākya shrī bzang pos mdzad pa'o/ / lo tsā ①ba byams pa dpal gyis bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/1231 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉lo'ar 〉bokrung /④〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉bogi/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉phon/1232 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉yots+tsha/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2271)40—1232

༄ga /'phags pa byams pa'i sgrub thabs/①༄ga /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya mi tri ④ya sā dha rna/ bod skad du/'phags pa byams pa'i sgrub thabs/ rgyal ba byams pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thog mar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yi ge mo gser gyi mdog can las 'od zer 'phros pas/ bla ma dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang / rgyal ba byams pa nyid gtso byas pa yang dag par bkug ste/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ①kā ya bāka tsit+ta pra na me na badz+ra brnya ④na ka ro mi zhes bya bas phyag 'tshal ba sngon du song bas/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe ⑤āḥhūṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra dhū paṃ ⑥āḥhūṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra ⑦dī paṃ āsahūṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra gar+ghaṃ āḥhūṃ swā hā④/ oṃ badz+ra nai bi bye ⑨ā hūṃ swā hā/ zhes pas byen gyis brlabs pas mchod pa'i tshogs phul la/ de dag gi spyan sngar sdig pa bshags pa dang / rjes su yi rang ba dang /⑩ bskul ba dang / gsol ba gdab pa dang / bsngo ba dang /40—1233

sems bskyed pa byas nas/ byams pa dang / snying rje dang dga' ba dang /btang snyoms las tshangs pa'i gnas pa la sogs ①par yid la bya'o/ /de nas oṃ shu n+ya ②tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+pa kopho①haṃ/ zhes bya ba'i sngags lan gsum gyi bar du brjod de/ brdzun pa'i rnam par rtog pa goms par byas pa'i bag chags kyi dbang du gyur pa/ rang gi sems dang rjomig 'phrul mkhan gyis ⑤nye bar sprul pa'i sems can dang / snod kyi 'jig rten gyi rjornam par 'khrul pa'i dri ma sbyang bar bya ④ba'i phyir/ rdul dang / khug rna ⑧dang du ba dang / kha ba dang sprin dang / sprin gyi grib ma dang bral ba/ ston ka'i nyi ma phyed kyi nam mkha' lta bur chos kyi dbyings mtha' dang dbus med pa'i rang bzhin du phyi nang dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gsum po ma lus pa rnam par blta bar bya'o/ /de ltar yud tsam zhig rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin rab tu rtog pa ⑨nam mkha' rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin te/ de la gnas pa paṃ las pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ yi ge mi ⑩zhes bya ba'i 'od kyis phyi nang dang snod bcud mtha' dag sbyangs te/ thub pa skyes mchog byams pa ni/ /zhal gsum spyan gsum gyis rnam brgyan/ /de yi gdan ni pad+ma ste/ /sems dpa'i byas krung gis bzhugs pa/ /phyag bzhi yis ni rnam par mdzes/ /bla med chos ston phyag rgya yis/ /phyag gnyis dang po rnam par brgyan/ /phyag g.yas gnyis pa nyer bskyod pas/ /mchog tu sems can skyong ba po/ /g.yon phyag lha rdzas yal ga 'dud/ /klu shing me tog bcas pa'o/ /sangs rgyas sprin ni rab 'phros shing ⑪//byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin 'bar/ /dngos grub chen po mchog bsgom bya/ /de nas snga ma bzhin du mchod de/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥzhes pa'i yi ge bzhis drangs nas/40—1234

dam tshig sems dpa' rang nyid la dgug pa dang / gzhug pa dang / bcing ba dang / dges par byas la/ dbang bskur bar gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /de'i rjes la sku gsung thugs kyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba nyid kyis rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom par bya'o/ /de 'og phyag rgya bcings ①byas la/ /mnyam par gzhag par gsang sngags bzlas/ /lag gnyis so sor dag tu bya/ /khu tshur bcings te sdigs mdzub gnyis/ /mthe bo'i dbus su gzhug bya ste/ /me tog rnam pa'i mchod pas so/ /oṃ mo mi ①tri mi tri ye sneswā hā/ 'phags pa byams pa'i sgrub thabs slob dpon thogs med kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //jo bo chen po dang / dge bshes dhiston pas bsgyur ba las dus phyis paṇ+ḍi ta chen po budha shrī dang / gnubs lo tsā ⑤bas dag par bcos so/ /oṃ mu ni mu ni sma ra rjoswā hā//⑦ //40—1235

bsdur mchan/1233 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉tre/ ③〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉neya/ du〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉ban ta/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉gaṣ+pe/ rjo〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉pe/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mi chabadz+ra/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉lo'adir 〉〉star+ghaṃ/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉spya/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉warjes su yi rang ba dang /1234 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉spegs/ ②〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉bye/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wa3/ nga 〈〈pe〉྾〈snar 〉〉wadang /⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉nya)/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉gyis/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wabar bya/ —nye〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉sna/⑨〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉 med pa/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stab/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉toraphro zhing /1235 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bcing / ②〈〈pe 〉〉mi me/ 〈〈snar 〉〉mi mi/ ③〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ rjo〈〈snar 〉stagashes/⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉thats+tsha/ du〈〈snar 〉〉 ya/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉 nye snying ngo //bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2272)40wa 1236

༄ga /dpal mi pham mgon po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/① ༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī a dzi tā nā tha sā dha dz+wa/ bod skad du/dpal mi pham mgon po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ 'phags pa byams pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug 'jig rten mgon/ /byams chen mi pham mgon po la/ /phyag 'tshal nas ni rang dran phyir/ /de yi sgrub thabs mdor bsdus bya/ /dang por re zhig sngags pas yid dang rjes su mthun pa'i gnas su 'dug ste/ tshangs par spyod pa dang / tshangs pa'i gnas pas legs par gnas par byas la/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid du bsgom mo/ /de'i ngang la pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du bdag nyid yi ge mo ④gser kyi mdog can bltas la/'od zer spro ba dang bsdu ba sngon du song bas byang chub kyi klu shing gi bum pas mtshan par bsam mo/ /de yang snga ma ltar sbyar te sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su sbyangs pas ①'phags pa byams pa'i skur nye bar blta'o/ /de la 'phags pa 40—1237

byams pa gser btso ma'i mdog can/ khru brgyad cu'i ①tshad mnga' ba mtshan bzang po ④yongs su dag pas brgyan pa/ brtson pa'i cha byad 'gying bag phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas chos 'chad dang / g.yon klu shing rgyas pa'i sdong bu ril bas mtshan pa 'dzin pa/ sku blta bas chog mi shes shing rang bzhin gyi 'od kyi dkyil 'khor rnam par 'phro ba ral pa'i cod pan can mdzes pa la/ mchod rten gyis ①ni gtsug tor spras/ /tshangs skud dang ni phreng bas brgyan/ /snying gar bupags pa bsnams pa'o/ /de rjes mgon po nyid bskul ba/ /dga' ldan nas ni ye shes dgug /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ'i ⑤rig pa yis / /dam tshig la ni bstem par bya/ /de nas mchod sogs cho ga bzhin/ /byams la ⑥snying rje chen po can/ /grub pa'i gsang sngags bzlas par bya/ /'bum phrag bcus ni bsnyen pa 'grub/ /dngos dang rmi lam dag mthong la/ /dga' ldan gzhal med bgrod pa dang / /de yi ⑦phyag mtshan gnyis mthong ngam/ /mi pham rgyal tshab mthong gyur pa/ /de tshe de yi dri ma dag /chu bos bros ⑧nas zos pa yi/ /ljon shing bzhin du 'bad med par/ /tshe 'di nyid la zad par byed / /oṃ mo ⑨mo tri mi tri yi ⑩swā hā/ /sgrub po gang zhig 'phags pa la/ /dad pa mang ⑪dang 'gro la ⑫brtse/ /rtag tu don lam yang ston pa/ /de dag rje btsun mdun du skye/ /dpal mi pham mgon po'i sgrub thabs/ slob dpon ni ri ti pas mdzad pa/ gnubs lo tsā ⑫ba byams pa'i dpal gyis bsgyur ba'o// //40—1238

1237 lamatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉༅/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉gsung bas/1238 ①〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉thacu'i/ ②〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉nedang dpe byad bzang po/ ③〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉sko)/ 0〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stana'i/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉toḥ/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stabs ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pyos/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉rnam/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉sgo/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa/ ⑫〈〈snar 〉stab/⑫〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉yots+tsha/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2273)40wa 1239

༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ sau ha nā da sā dha rgo②/ bod skad du/seng ge'i sgra'i sgrub thabs/ 'jig rten mgon po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig sngags shes pa'i sngags pa des/ brdzun rnam pa thams cad du ①spang bar bya'o—/ /dang por dus bzhi ④kha dag par bkrus te/ shin tu gnas dbe+en par bris sku la sogs pa'i thad du dkyil 'khor byas te/ mchod pa mang po phul la stan rjobade ba la rjo'adug ste/ tshad med pa bzhi bsgom mo/ /de nas bdag gi snying gar rtsa las zla bar gyur pa'i tweḥ⑦dkar po bsams pa'i 'od kyis nam mkhar ⑧bla ma dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' gsal bar snang bar byas la/ yang de'i 'od 'phros pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyis mchod la phyag byas te/ sdig pa bshags shing rjes su yi rang nas/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su gsol te/ rgyal ba'i lam la gnas pas byang chub tu sems 40—1240

bskyed de/ 'od slar 'dus pas ①thams cad stong pa nyid du bsgoms te/ oṃ swa bhā wa shudhāḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ②wa shustopho④haṃ/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā 0wa byed kolha⑤haṃ/ zhes brjod do/ /de nas myur du paṃ las pad+ma dmar por a las gyur pa'i seng ge'i gdan gyi steng du rtsa las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du spyoḥrjolas seng ge'i sgra zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dkar po dbu skra'i cod pan can dang ⑦/ snang ba mtha' yas kyi ⑧dbu rgyan can/ spyan gsum pa/phyed dngo du rgyal po stichen po'i bzhugs thabs ⑩su bzhugs pa/ phyag g.yon gyi phyag mthil sa la sbyar ba'i mtheb mdzub kyis ral gris mtshan pa'i pad+ma bzang po'i yu ba 'dzin pa/ de'i ngos su gzhan yang bharnya dkar po dri zhim pa'i me tog sna tshogs kyis bkang ba'i pad+ma'i yu ba can yod pa dang / phyag g.yas pa pus mo la brten te brkyang ba la brten ⑪par tri shu ⑫la sbrul dkar pos dkris pa yod cing / bsam gtan mdzad pa'i tshul can dbu'i thad ka nas rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas 'phro ba bsgoms la/ snying ga'i zla bar tweḥ⑫bsams pa dzaḥ⑫hūṃ gis ye shes sems dpa' bkug ste/ baṃ gyis ⑫dbang du byas nas hoḥs dgyes pa bskyed par bsam mo/ /de nas 'dzab ni oṃ āXs+thā⑩ཿsau ha nā ⑩da hūṃ phaṭa/ seng ge sgra'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //40—1241

bsdur mchan/1240 lamatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉༄ga /seng ge'i sgra'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stabarnya nā dā sna da na/ ③〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wadu/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bzhin/ du〈'dir 〉stabastan/ du〈〈snar 〉〉khyil/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉gyi yig ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pakha' la/1241 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉pa/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉starto ba shu sarba dharma swa bha/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wa3/ du〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉rdza/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉po'adir 〉bo3/ 0〈〈pe 〉po'ar 〉༅/ ⑦〈〈pe〉lo〈snar 〉〉wadang / ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉nyakyis/ ⑨〈〈snar 〉ri chen po/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉stabs/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉rton/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉thu/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉bar hri/ 〈〈snar 〉〉ba'i hri/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉kho'od spro la/ 〈〈snar 〉mi 'od spros la/⑫〈〈pe 〉stanas/ 〈〈snar 〉stan/ ⑩〈〈snar 〉〉hrig ⑩〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉ton/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2274)40wa 1242

mgon po'i sgrub thabs/①༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya kharba pā ②ṇi lo ka nā tha sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa kharma pā ④ṇi 'jig rten mgon po'i sgrub thabs/ 'jig rten mgon po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnas dbe+en par bde ba'i stan la sngags pa 'dug ste/ dang por tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom mo/ /de nas snying gar a las ④zla bar byāḥdakar po bsams pa'i 'od 'phros pas/ mdun gyi nam mkha' la bla ma dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' gsal bar dmigs par bya'o/ /yang de'i 'od las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin kyis mchod pa la sogs pa snga ma bzhin du bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu oṃ swa bhā wa shudhaḥ⑤ sarba dharmā ཿswa bhā wa shurnyolhahaṃ pyazhes brjod pas bdag nyid stong par bsgom mo/ /de nas sna tshogs pad+ma ⑦zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du tweḥgasal ba'i 'od 'phros pas/ 'gro ba rigs lnga'i sdug bsngal thams cad sbyangs nas/ slar de nyid du 'dus pa las 40—1243

bdag nyid 'jig rten dbang phyug tu gyur par bsam mo/ /de yang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa sku mdog dkar po skyed ①skyil gyis bzhugs pa/ dbu skra'i cod pan can dang / snang ba mtha' yas kyi dbu rgyan can/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mdzes pa'i na bza' gsol ba/ phyag g.yas pus mo la brten te brkyang ba/ g.yon pa pad+ma bsnams par bsgoms la dpral bar zla ba/ mgrin par oṃ/ snying gar byedahūṃ rnams gsal bar bya'o/ /de'i g.yas ngos su lha mo sgrol ma gzhon nu'i tshul can dang / g.yon na ②khro gnyer can dang khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa ④bsam mo/ /de ltar bsam gtan byas pa'i 'og tu bzlas pa ni oṃ s+thāḥrjoswā hā/ 'phags pa khaso pā ⑤ṇi 'jig rten mgon po'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //40—1244

bsdur mchan/1242 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉gag /'phags pa khar sa pa ṇi 'jig rten mgon po'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉skab sapo/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉sko'adir 〉〉pa/du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉skala'i/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉staṇ+ḍi ba shu / du〈〈pe 〉dze'adir 〉sngag bha ba shu haṃ/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉7d+mar/1244 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stand/ ②〈〈pe 〉sngapornor 〉〉wan/ ②〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉〉sgar/ du〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉gri/⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉skab sapo/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2275)40wa 1245

༄ga /lha mo sgol ma'i sgrub thabs/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ tā rā de bī skesā dha rgo/ bod skad du/lha mo sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ lha mo sgol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngar bshad pa'i cho gas bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor de'i dbus su yi ge'i sde tshan lnga'i ④dang po'i sa bon la/ dang po'i gnyis pas sdogs par byas pa la zla ba phyed pa dang /thig les brgyan pa/ de nyid las byung ba'i lha mo sgrol ma bsgom par bya'o/ /sku mdog ljang gu phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas kyis mchog sbyin pa/ g.yon na ut+pa la bsnams pa/ pad+ma dang zla ba la bzhugs pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan par bsam par bya'o/ /de nas phyag rgya bcing bar bya ste/ lag pa gnyis thal mo sbyar la/ mdzub mo gnyis gung mo bcings la bcar ba ni lha mo sgol ma'i ④ut+pa la kha bye ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /de'i 'og tu sngags bzlas par bya ste/oṃ tā re tut+tha ⑤re tu re swā hā/ lha mo sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //40—1246

bsdur mchan/1246 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉sa / /lha mo sgrol ma dang bcom ldan 'das yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// ②〈〈pe 〉〉nga da bye/〈'ar 〉tshoṭa de bye/ ③〈'ar 〉zotshan lnga pa'i/ ①〈〈snar 〉ṅkasgrub thabs/ ⑤〈〈snar 〉〉tud tā/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2276)40wa 1247

༄ga /bcom ldan 'das yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i sgrub thabs/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ bha ga ba tī ②pradzñā pa rā ①mi tā sā dha dz+wa/bod skad du/ bcom ldan 'das yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i rjosgrub thabs—/ bcom ldan 'das yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma ⑤la phyag 'tshal lo—/ /sngar bshad pa ltar gdong pa rjobakru ba la sogs pa byas nas/ de'i rjes la bdag nyid kyi ⑦snying gar pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus su a ⑧las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su ⑨yi ge dhīḥ⑩/ de las byung ba'i pad+ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i glegs bam gyis mtshan pa/ 'di dag yongs su gyur pa las/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma pad+ma ⑪dang / zla ba'i gdan la rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ sku mdog dkar ba g.yas kyis ⑫mchog sbyin pa/ g.yon pa na pad+ma bsnams pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis ⑫brgyan pa/bsam gtan la gcig tu gzhol ba/ me tog dri zhim pos brgyan pa'i ral pa 40—1248

dang cod pan te①/ re zhig de lta bur bsams la/ mchod pa'i dus kyi tshe dkyil 'khor gyi gnas su lha brgyad po bdag nyid dang 'dra ba dang lhan cig tu sngags 'dis mchod par bya'o/ /skyes prasna ma hā pra lha hūṃ/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i ②sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/1248 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉skosnar 〉〉ti/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tor/ 0〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉7'i/ ①〈〈pe 〉snga'adir 〉7/ ①〈〈snar 〉〉wapa/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉lo'adir 〉4)sa/ni〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉tog ⑨〈〈pe 〉7)sa/ 〈〈snar 〉sko) steng du/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉〉/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉sga pad+ma/〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ ⑫⑫〈〈snar 〉sno)/1249 ①〈〈snar 〉〉ste/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa'i/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2277)40wa 1249

༄ga /rgyal po chen po rol pa'i 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sgrub thabs/①༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ mañdzu gho ṣa ②ma hā rā dza byā dze+el sā dha rgo/bod skad du/ rgyal po chen po rol pa'i ④'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi dhisgrub thabs/bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sgrub thabs brjod par bya sterjo/ sa bon drug pa'i lnga pa la dbyangs kyi yi ge lnga pas brgyan pa/ stong pa'i lhas mnan pa/sa bon de nyid las byung ba'i mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs gzhon nu'i cha lugs can—/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ zur phud lnga pa/ phyag g.yon na ut+pa la sngon po bsnams pa/ phyag g.yas pa rol ⑦pas seng ge'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan par bdag nyid bsams du la—/ lag pa gnyis thal mo khong stong du byas la⑨/ mdzub mo gnyis kyis pya srin lag gnyis kyi ⑪sen mo mnan te bzhag pa ni ut+pa la kha bye ba'i phyag rgya ste/40—1250

'dis snying ga dang / dpral ba dang / lkog ma dang spyi bor gtugs ①par bya'ol/ /oṃ wā gī shwa ri sum̐/ mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi ②rgyal po chen po sgeg pa'i sgrub ②thabs rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/125 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉༄ / /rgyal po chen po 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang 'phags pa gshin rje gshed kyi sgrub thabs bzhugs so// ②〈〈snar 〉skab/②〈〈pe 〉〉〉 dza li/ 〈〈snar 〉〉nga dza dza lī/ 0〈〈pe 〉phol po chen po/ 〈〈snar 〉rirgyal po chen po rol pa'i/rjo〈〈snar 〉〉〉rgyal po chen po sgeg pa'i/ me〈〈snar 〉〉byas te/ ⑦〈〈snar 〉〉wapa rol/ ⑧〈'dir 〉〉bsam/ ⑨〈0snar 〉〉wal/ ⑩〈〈snar 〉mi kyis/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stekyis/1251 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stanatug ②〈〈snar 〉nya)sa/ ②〈〈snar 〉ri pa'i/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2278)40wa 1251

༄ga /'phags pa gshin rje gshed kyi sgrub pa'i thabs/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya ya mān+ta ka sā dha rna/ bod skad du/'phags pa gshin rje gshed kyi sgrub pa'i thabs/ 'phags pa khro bo gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin du oṃ hūṃ zhes bya ba'i sa bon las bskyed la/khro bo'i skyil krung gis nyi ma la gnas pa'i yi ge hūṃ las byung ba'i gshin rje gshed rab tu khros pa/ zhal drug pa phyag drug pa⑤/ dbu skra gyen du badze+es pa/ ma he la chibs ①pa g.yon brkyang bas bzhugs pa/ mi'i thod pa dang rgyu mas brgyan pa/ shin tu ⑦'jigs pa'i cha lugs can/ stag gi pags ⑤pa'i smad g.yogs can/ phyag g.yas na ral gri dang rdo rje bsnams pa/ g.yon na dril bu dang / rdo rje gtun shing bsnams pa/ cod pan mi bskyod pas mtshan pa bsgom pyapar bya'o/ /de nas dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcing bar ⑦bya ste/ thal mo khong stong du sbyar la mthe bong ⑧gnyis dang mdzub mo gnyis so sor phye la gung mo gnyis 40—1252

kyi tshigs gsum pa bcag ①par bya'o/ /skyes hrīḥ:ཿbi kṛ latā na na lha/ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa ②swā hā/ 'phags pa gshin rje gshed kyi sgrub ④thabs rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/1252 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈snar 〉tshonabs drug ①〈〈snar 〉〉byibs/ du〈〈snar 〉〉du/ ⑤〈〈snar 〉〉spags/ du〈'dir 〉〉bsgoms/ ⑦〈〈snar 〉྾〈co 〉〉bcings par/⑧〈'dir 〉staṅge/1253 ①〈'dir 〉〉5ga ②〈〈pe 〉starnye sne bi kri/ 〈〈snar 〉〉griḥsaḥbi kri/ ③〈〈pe 〉to/phaṭa/ rjo〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉7)sa sgrub pa'i/bsdur 'bras re'u mig da/ (2279)40wa 1253

༄ga /lha mo nor gyi rgyun gyi sgrub pa'i thabs/①༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ ba su dhā ⑤ra sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/lha mo nor gyi rgyun gyi ①sgrub pa'i thabs/ lha mo nor gyi rgyun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas lha mo nor gyi ④rgyun bsgom ⑤par 'dod na thams cad snga ma bzhin du ⑥byas la/ gzhan du na sa bon drug pa'i gsum pa la zla ba ⑦phyed pa dang / thig les brgyan pa de nyid las byung ba'i ④lha mo nor gyi ⑨rgyun sku mdog ser po/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin pa/ g.yon 'bras sā ⑩lu'i snye ma dang / rin po che sna tshogs pa'i ⑪char 'be+ebs pa'i bum pa bsnams pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa ste/grogs kyi lha mos shānyebaskor ba'i lha mo nor gyi ⑫rgyun ni bdag nyid yin no zhes bsgom par bya'o/ /lag pa gnyis kyi khu tshur bcings la gung mo'i tshigs gsum pa bcag pa 'di ni lha mo nor gyi rgyun gyi phyag rgya'o/ /de nas bzlas brjod byas te—/ oṃ shrī ④ba su ni dha nak+ṣe tre swā hā/ ras bris la sogs par bcom ldan 40—1254

'das lha mo nor gyi rgyun spyan drangs la mchod pa yang bya ste/ bsgom par bya'o/ /des ni 'grub par 'gyur bar the tshom med do/ /lha mo nor gyi rgyun sgrub pa'i ①thabs rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/1254 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉sa / /lha mo nor gyi rgyun dang ku ru kul+le'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉dha/ ③〈〈snar 〉nya)sa rgyun gyis/ ①〈〈snar 〉〉gyis/ ⑤〈〈snar 〉〉bsgoms/ du〈'dir 〉〉wadu/ ⑦〈〈snar 〉〉wab/ ⑤〈〈snar 〉〉waba'i ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉nya)sa/ ⑩〈〈snar 〉〉ma/ ⑩〈〈snar 〉stakyi/ ⑫〈〈snar 〉staba'i/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉〉rgyun gyi/⑫〈'dir〉〉gi1255 ①〈〈pe〉〉pa'i sgrub/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyad/ (2280)40wa 1255

༄ga /ku ru kugle'i sgrub thabs/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ku ru kul+le sā dha rna/ bod skad du/ ku ru kupre'i sgrub thabs/ lha mo ku ru kul+le la phyag 'tshal lo/ /cho ga sngar bshad pa dang mthun pa las gzhan du na sa bon haṃ dmar po las byung ba②/ sku mdog dmar po①/ pad+ma dmar po dang / zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis rjobargyan pa/ phyag bzhi pa g.yas mi 'jigs pa/ g.yon ut+pa la dmar po bsnams pa/ yang phyag gnyis kyis ut+pa la dmar po kha bye ba lta bu'i mda' dang / gzhu rna ba'i mthar thug par bkang ste/ bsgrub ⑤par bya ba mdun du bsams la snying gar bsnun te/ sngar bshad pa'i ut+pa la'i phyag rgyas snying ga dang / dpral ba dang / sgog ma dang / spyi bor gtugs rjopar bya'o//de nas bzlas brjod bya ste/ oṃ ku ru kukhre che ge mo ⑦ba sha mā sken ya swā hā/dbang du bya ba'i cho ga rdzogs so// //40—1256

bzlas pa'i dus su khyad par du 'od zer gyis sdig sgrib sbyangs shing gzhan dbang du byas par yang ①mos pas so/ /don yod grub pas rgyas gdab bo// //bsdur mchan/1256 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉skozhar 〉bob/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈'ar 〉ṅkadang / 0〈'ar 〉8/ ⑤〈'ar 〉skakha/ 0〈〈pe〉ltatug ⑦〈'ar 〉bomo/ ⑧〈snar 〉zo/1257 ①〈〈snar 〉〉kyang /brtsar 'bras re'u mig da/ (2281)40wa 1257

༄ga /gnod gnas kyi sgrub pa'i thabs ①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ dze+e bha la sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/ gnod gnas kyi ①sgrub pa'i thabs/ bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' gnod gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nor 'dod pa dag gis bsgom par 'dod na/ cho ga sngar bshad pa bzhin du byas la/ gzhan du na sa bon gsum pa'i gsum pa mdog ser po/thig les mnan pa zla ba phyed pas brgyan pa/ de nyid las byung ba'i mgon po gnod gnas zhal gcig pa phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas na bī dza pū ①ri bsnams pa/g.yon na ne+e'u le'i rkyal pa rin po che'i char 'be+ebs pa bsnams pa/ sangs rgyas lnga'i cod pan can/ zhabs gnyis kyis dung gi mgo can dang pad+ma'i mgo can kyi gter chen po mnan pa/ rin po che la sogs pa'i char 'be+ebs pa rang gi khyim gyi phyogs gcig tu bsam par bya'o/ /ut+pa la sngon po'i phreng ba kha thur du 40—1258

bltas pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i gnod gnas su bdag nyid bsgom par bya'o / /de nas phyag rgya ①ni lag pa thal mo khong stong ②du byas la/ gung mo gnyis kyi ③tshigs gsum pa bcag pa'i phyag rgyas snying ga dudang / dpral ba dang /lkog ma dang / spyi bor gtugs te bzlas brjod bya'o/ /oṃ dzi bha la dza len+d+ra ya ⑤su hā / 'di nyid kyi chu sbyin blugs brgya rtsa brgyad dbul lo/ /mchod pa yang byas la bzlas pa brtsam dupar bya'o/ /de nas nor gyi bdag po chen por 'gyur bar ⑦tho tshom med do/ /mgon po gnod gnas kyi sgrub nithabs rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/1258 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉༄ / /gnod gnas dang khro gnyer can gyi sgrub pa'i thabs bzhugs so// ②〈〈snar 〉〉spyos/ ②〈〈pe 〉༅ dza pu/ 〈〈snar 〉༅ dza spu/1259 ①〈'dir 〉〉wargya/ ②〈〈snar 〉mi stong / ⑧〈〈snar 〉4)sa/ 0〈〈snar 〉skaba'i/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉spon+d+ra ya/〈'dir 〉〉spen tra ye/ 0〈〈snar 〉thartsams/ ⑦〈〈snar 〉po1ra par/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉〉pa'i/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2282)40wa 1259

༄ ga /rgya gar skad du/ ṣ+ṭṛ ②ku ṭi ③sā dha rna/ bod skad du/ khro gnyer can gyi sgrub pa'i ④thabs/ bcom ldan 'das yum khro gnyer can ma ⑤la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngar bshad pa'i cho ga las sa bon lnga pa'i gsum pa larjo/dang po'i brgyad pas rdzogs par byas pa stong pas mnan par bsams la de nyid las byung ba'i lha mo khro gnyer can ⑦ma/ ral pa dang thor tshugs 'chang ba/zhi ba/ phyag bzhi pa phyag g.yas na mchog sbyin dang bgrang phreng / g.yon na dbyig pa dang spyi blugs bsnams pa/ pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs par bsgom par bya'o / /de nas lag pa gnyis kyi thal mo brkyang ba sbyar la/ mthe bos mthe'u ⑧chung gi sen mo mnan te/ so sor bye la lhag ma rnams rdo rjer bya ba 'di ni lha mo khro gnyer can ⑨ma'i phyag rgya'o/ /sngags la oṃ 1 ⑩swā hā/ khro gnyer can gyi sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //40—1260

༄ga /lha mo 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs/①༄yi/ /rgya gar skad du/ mā rī byi de wī ④sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/lha mo 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs/ lha mo 'od zer can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de la dang por re zhig ①nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bsams la/ de'i steng du sa bon lnga pa'i lnga pa la/ dang po'i rjoganyis pa rdzogs par byas la/ zla ba phyed pa dang thig les brgyan pa bsams la/ de las byung ba'i lha mo 'od zer can sku mdog dmar ba/ zhal drug pa zhal dang po dmar po⑤/ gnyis pa nag po/ gsum pa ljang gu/ bzhi pa ser po/ lnga pa dkar po/ steng gi dbu phag gdong nag po—/ a shwa buka dang mchod rten gyis brgyan pa/ gsus khyim che ba thod pa'i phreng ba can dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brjes pa/ sbrul gyi zhags pa stag lngags kyi sham thabs bsnams pa/ bgegs rnams 1nga bar mdzad pa/ kha dog sna tshogs pa'i phag gi shing rta la g.yon brkyang bas ⑦bzhugs pa/ phyag g.yas na 40—1262

ral gri dang / rdo rje dang gtun shing dang mda' dang rdo rje rtse gcig pa dang dgra sta bsnams pa/ g.yon na sdigs mdzub zhags pa dang bcas pa dang /thod pa dang a shwa ①ka'i zhags pa dang / tshangs pa'i mgo bo dang / gzhu dang tri shu ④la bsnams pa/ spyan gsum par bsam mo/ /mdun du shing zlum po'i dbus su ④lag pa gnyis pa sdigs mdzub bsgreng bar bsams ④la/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das yum 'od zer can yin no zhes nga rgyal bskyed par bya'o/ /de nas phyag rgya bcing bar bya'o/ /rdo rje thal mo kha ⑤sbyar la gung mo gnyis gshibs rjol myu gur bya ste mthe bo gnyis skyil krung du bsnol la/ mdzub mo gnyis rtse mo dgug par bya'o/ / de nas bzlas pa'i spyosngags ni oṃ mā rī stso rmā ⑦hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ lha mo 'od zer can gyi sgrub pa'i thabs rdzogs so// //slob dpon chen po phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub brnyes pa dri ma med pa'i lhas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs bcu gcig rdzogs so// //40—1263

bsdur mchan/1262 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉gag /lha mo 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs rim grangs bzhugs so// ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stab/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉ware zhigame〈〈snar 〉stapo/ ⑤〈〈snar 〉〉ba/ rjo〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ske/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾po ra 〉stanas/1263 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉sko/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉thu/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉wasu/ ④〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ba bsam/⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wakha/ me〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bshibs/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉wade nas bzlas pa'i/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉mā re ca me/ 〈〈snar 〉mo/re rtsu me/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2284)40wa 1264

༄ga /lha mo 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ mā rī byi de bī ②sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/lha mo 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs/ lha mo 'od zer can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de la dang por nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bsams la/ de'i steng du sa bon lnga pa'i lnga pa la/ dang po'i gnyis pa rdzogs par byas la/ zla ba phyed pa dang thig les brgyan par bsam/ de las byung ba'i lha mo 'od zer can sku mdog dmar ba/zhal drug pa/ zhal dang po dmar ba/ gnyis pa nag pa/ gsum pa ljang gu/bzhi pa ser ba/ lnga pa dkar ba/ steng gi dbu phag gdong nag po/ a shwa ①ka dang / mchod rten gyis brgyan pa/ gsus khyim che ba/ thod pa'i phreng ba can—/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du badze+es pa/ sbrul kyi zhags pa dang stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ bgegs rnams thong bar mdzad pa/ kha dog sna tshogs pa'i shing rta la g.yon brkyang bas bzhugs pa/ phyag g.yas pa na ral gri 40—1265

dang / rdo rje dang / gtun shing dang / mda' dang rdo rje rtse gcig pa dang /dgra sta bsnams pa/ g.yon pa sdigs mdzub zhags pa dang bcas pa dang /thod pa dang a shwa ⑫ka'i yal ga dang / tshangs pa'i mgo bo dang / gzhu dang /tri shu ṭul bsnams pa'o/ /spyan gsum par bsam zhing / mdun du shing zlum po'i dbus su lag pa gnyis sdigs mdzub bgreng bar bsams la/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das ma yum 'od zer can yin no zhes pa'i nga rgyal bskyed par bya'o//de nas phyag rgya bcing bar bya ste/ rdo rje thal mo kha sbyar la/ gung mo gnyis gshibs la myu gur byas te/ mthe bong gnyis skyil mo krung du bsnol mdzub mo gnyis rtse mor dgug par bya'o/ /de nas bzlas pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ mā rī rtsu māṃ (snyehūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ lha mo 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //40—1266

bsdur mchan/1265 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉ṭha/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgo/1266 ①〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉sgo/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉zhu/ ③〈po ra 〉〉mi/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2285)40wa 1267

༄ga /lha mo 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs/①༄7/ /yang na sgrub thabs ras ris kyi cho ga las bsgom par 'dod na/sngar bshad pa'i cho ga dang / de bzhin du rang gi snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/de'i steng du yi ge saṃ zhes bya ba/ yi ge a dang thig le dang ldan pa'i snying po'i mchog bsams la/ de nas 'od zer sna tshogs pa spros pa las byung ba des/bla ma dang yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpar ②bsams la/ mchod pa lnga la sogs pa byas nas/ chos bdag med par khrubasgom par bya ste/ oṃ swa bha wa shudhaḥsarba dhamasaḥswa bhā rjowa shusgophorjohaṃ/ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis de ltar ⑦lhag par mos par byas pas/ khams gsum pa 'di dag mig yor tsam du shes par byas la/ de'i sa bon las byung ba'i a shwa khruka'i yal ga /de'i steng du yi ge me de thams cad yongs su gyur pa las rje btsun lha mo de'i skur bdag nyid bsam pa ni/ yum lha mo 'od zer can sku 40—1268

mdog 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser ltar shin tu ser ba/ sku'i 'od zer nyi ma ltar 'bar ba/ spyi bor mchod rten gyis brgyan pa/ na bza' dmar po dang /sku stod tshi gu can gyi zhing chung du bsnams pa/ gdu ①bu sna tshogs dang /rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ sor gdub dang / rna rgyan dang / 'og pag dang / g.yer kha ④dang / zhabs gdub kyi sgra 'khrol ba/ zhal gsum pa—/ spyan gsum pa/ phyag brgyad pa/ 'od zer gyi phreng ba 'bar ba me tog brtse ka ④dang / rgya skyegs kyi mdog rjo'adra ba 'phro ba/ spyi bor rnam par snang mdzad kyis mnan pa/ a shwa ⑤ka'i phreng bas dbu la brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas na rdo rje 'od 'phro ba dang / khab dang / lcags kyu dang / mda' gsor ba la dgyes pa/ phyag g.yon zhags pa dang / gzhu dang a shwa rjoka'i yal ga dang / skud pa bsnams pa/ zhal dang po zhi ba/ zhal ras rgyas pa/gser sbyangs pa ltar shin tu ser ba/ spyan shin tu rgyas pa/ zhal gyi sgros li khri'i rdul gyis btsos pa 'dra ba/ sgeg pa'i nyams kyis gnas par gyur pa/zhal g.yas pa pad+ma rā ga ltar shin tu dmar ba/ 'od zer bzang po 'bar ba 'phro ba/ zhal g.yon pa phag gi gdong 'phro ba dang bcas shing mi sdug pa/mche ba rnam par gamigs shing 'jigs su rung ba/ in+d+ra nī la'i mdog 'dra ba/nyi ma bcu gnyis dang 'od mnyam pa/ smin ma bsdus shing khro gnyer dang ldan pa/mche ba gatshigs pa 'jigs pa rnams kyang 'jigs par mdzad pa'o/ /dbu la bcom ldan 'das ⑦rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog gser sbyangs pa ltar shin tu dag pa/ byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can/ ral pa dang thor tshugs mnga' bar ⑧bzhugs pa/ gzhal yas khang mchod rten gyi dbyibs la shing a shwa ⑨ka'i 40—1269
