me tog gis khyab pa'i nang na/ phag ①gi steng na g.yon brkyang ba'i gnas pas bzhugs pa/ gzhon nu ma dar la bab ②pa'i khyed can/ shing rta'i 'og na ha las byung ba'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi steng na/ gza' chen po skesgra gcan 'dzin nyin mo nyi ma 'dzin pa mtshan mo zla ba 'dzin gnas pa/ lha mo bzhis yongs su bskor bar bdag nyid bsgom par bya'o/ /de'i mdun du/ oṃ mā rī stso bat+tha li/ ba rjodā li/ ba rā li/ bā rā hā ⑤mu khi/ ā rjokar+ṣa ya dzaḥ⑦swā hā—/ zhes bya bas lha mo sku mdog dmar ba zhal gcig pa/ phag gi gdong pa can spyan gsum pa/ phyag bzhi pa g.yas na khab dang rdo rje bsnams pa/g.yon na gzhu dang a shwa ⑧ka'i yal ga bsnams pa/ zhing chung du stod g.yogs dmar po bsnams pa/ rtog pa las gsungs pa'i cho ga yid la gang zhig sgrub par 'dod pa'i bud med 'gugs par mdzad pa'o/ /de bzhin du g.yas su/oṃ khyamā rī byi bat+ta li/ ba ⑫dā li/ ba ⑪rā li/ bā rā hā ⑩mu khi/ sarba duṣ+ṭa ⑫rna/ pra duṣ+ṭa ④rgo/ mu khaṃ ⑫ban+ta brnya hūṃ swā hā⑫/ lha mo sngar bshad pa'i na bza' dang rgyan dang gzugs dang ldan mod kyi/ 'on kyang 'di ni sku mdog ser ba/ g.yas na a shwa ⑩ka'i yal ga dang khab bsnams pa/ g.yon na zhags pa dang rdo rje bsnams pa/ gdug pa ⑫rnams kyi kha dang mig 'tshes par mdzad pa'o/ /de bzhin du rgyab tu/ oṃ mā rī byi brtswa li/ ba ⑪dā li/ ba rā li/ bā rā hā ⑫mu khi/ sarba duṣ+ṭa ⑥rgo/ s+t+waṃ bha ya baṃ swā hā/ zhes bya bas lha mo 'di yang na bza' dang rgyan la sogs pa sngar dang 'dra mod kyi/ 'on kyang phyag g.yas na rdo rje dang khab g.yon na gzhu dang a shwa ⑫ka'i yal ga bsnams pa—/ sku mdog in+d+ra nī la lta bu gdug pa can thams cad rengs par mdzad pa 40—1270

bsgom par bya'o/ /g.yon du/ oṃ mā rī byi/ bat+ta li/ ba dā li/ ba rā li/ bā rā hā ①mu khi/ sarba satwa na me pa sha ma nā ④ya hoḥ①swā hā/ zhes bya bas lha mo 'di yang na bza' dang rgyan la sogs pa snga ma dang mthun mod bukyi 'on kyang sku mdog nyi ma 'char ka 'dra ba/ phyag g.yas na mda' dang rdo rje bsnams pa/g.yon na ⑤gzhu dang a shwa rjoka'i yal ga bsnams pa/ sems can thams cad la rjes su chags par mdzad pa bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje lcags kyu ma la sogs pa'i sngags dang phyag rgyas dgug pa la sogs pa byas la/ ye shes sems dpa' dang dam tshig gi lha gcig tu bya'o/ /de nas bzlas brjod bya ba'i sngags ni 'di'o/ /oṃ mā rī byi oṃ māṃ ⑦hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes ci nus bzlas la sngar bshad pa'i cho gas gnas par bya'o/ /'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs byas pa las—/ /bdag gis dge ba'i rtsa ba gang bsags des/ /sems can thams cad 'od zer can gyi ni/ /ye shes dri med gnas thob shog /lha mo 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs slob dpon kun dga' snying pos mdzad pa rdzogs so/ / lo tsā ④ba rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //40—1271

bsdur mchan/1268 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i rdzogs byang las blangs te bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stanapa' la sogs pa/③〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa/ bu〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉dharma/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉starto/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉walha/ ⑦〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉waltar/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉zho/1269 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stanadub/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stan ③〈〈snar 〉〉ban sgro kai/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉skab dog⑤dhi〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉sho/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wa'adas/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉sko'adir 〉〉ba/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sho/127༷ ①〈〈snar 〉skaraphag ②〈〈snar 〉〉babs/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stab/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉gla/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stab rā ha/ du〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉tog ⑦〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉waḥ/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉sgo/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉wasko ⑩〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉gla/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉ba/ 〈〈snar 〉〉gla/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ba ra ha/⑫④〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉duṣ+ṭa/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉skab/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wagu hā/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉sho/⑫〈〈pe 〉sko'adir 〉〉〉can/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ba tā li/ bā/ du〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉gle ra li/ ba ra ha/⑥〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉duṣ+ṭa/ ⑫〈〈pe〉྾〈snar 〉〉sho/1271 ①〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉ba ra ha/ ②〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉stan/ ③〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉waḥ/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉thun mongs/〈'dir 〉〉thun mod/ 0〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉〉wan/ 0〈〈pe 〉snga'adir 〉〉sgo/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉m+wa/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skoyots+tsha/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2286)40wa 1272

༄ga /'phags ma 'od zer can gyi sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/⑫ ༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya mā rī byi sā dha rgo nā ma/ bod skad du/'phags ma 'od zer can gyi sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/ 'phags ma 'od zer can nyid la phyag 'tshal lo/ /blo ldan sems dpa'i skyil krung gis/ /snying rje chen po rab dmigs la/ /snga bar snying gar zla ba la/ /oṃ yig dkar po bsgom par bya/ /rnam snang zhes pa'i bdag nyid can/ /ti yi 'od zer kun du dkar/ /ra ba zlum po mchod rten te/ /'bar ba'i 'od kyis kun du brgyan//bsrung ba'i don du mdun dang rgyab/ /g.yas dang g.yon dang gzhan yang steng ②//rim bzhin ma sogs ④bran la sogs/ /bu mo la sogs bum sogs dhidang / /lugs ma thang sku bshes gnyen dang / /po ti la sogs ji snyed pa'o/ /ti nas snying ga'i zla bar me/ /mya ngan med kyi yal gar skyes/ /'phags ma 'od zer can ma bsam/ /skud pa khab rnams bsnams ⑤pa mo/ /ldang ba'i tshul gyis 40byed1273

g.yas pa yi/ /sna bug nas byung bdun nyer gnas/ /gdug can kha dang mig drubs ①nas/ /ra ba'i phyi rol dag tu byas/ /gzhan yang rig sngags bzlas pa bya/ /sna bug g.yon 'ongs snying ga ru/ /bzhugs nas mya ngan med par 'gyurate/ /mtshams bcing ba ni rab tu bya/ /'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs slob dpon mya ngan med pa'i dpal gyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/1272 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈snar 〉losnro/ zhu0〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanags/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉bsgom/ 〈〈snar 〉sgrosgom/1274 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉ngokub/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2287)40wa 1274

༄ga /rdo rje lu gu rgyud kyi sgrub thabs/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra shrī ②khaṃ le sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/rdo rje lu gu rgyud kyi sgrub thabs/ bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje lu gu rgyud la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngar bstan pa'i cho gas snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la hūṃ gi yi ge ljang gu las grub pa'i rdo rje lu gu rgyud zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ zhal g.yas pa dang cig shos sngo ba dang dkar ba/ zhal so so la spyan gsum gsum ①mnga' ba—/ phyag g.yas gsum na rdo rje dang lcags sgog dang mda'/ phyag g.yon gsum na sdigs mdzub dang zhags pa dang / gzhu'o/ /sku mdog sngo bsangs su ljang ba/ zhal rjocung zad bzhad pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa sems can sdang ba rnams 'joms par byed par bdag nyid bsgoms rjol phyag rgya bcing bar bya'o/ /de la lag pa gnyis khu tshur so sor bcings la mthe'u chung dang mdzub mo lcags sgog gi rnam par bcing bar bya'o/ /de nas bzlas pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra 40—1275

shrī khaṃ le hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa'o/ /'di ni rdo rje lu gu rgyud kyi sgrub thabs/ slob dpon chen po dzi ta ri dgra las rnam par rgyal bas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇ+ḍi ta su ma ti krirti ①dang / bod kyi lo tsā ②ba mkhas pa mar pa chos kyi dbang phyug gis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //bsdur mchan/1275 lamatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉༄ga /rdo rje lu gu rgyud dang seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉glo ③〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉wagasum / 0〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉wazhal/ 0〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉〈co 〉〉bsgom/1276 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉stenarti/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉yots+tsha/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2288)40—1276

༄ga /seng ljeng nags kyi sgol ma'i sgrub thabs/sti༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ kha di ②ra ba na tā rā ④sā dha rgo/ bod skad du—/ seng ldeng nags kyi sgol ma'i sgrub thabs/ seng sdeng nags kyi sgol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang por re zhig sngags pas dus gzhi legs shing mnyam la gtsang zhing yid dga' ba'i me tog sna tshogs pas brgyan ⑤pa/ dbe+en pa'i sa phyogs su stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ rang gi snying gar zla ba la t+t+waṃ yig drur skyoba'i mdog lta bur 'od zer rnam pa lnga 'phro bar bsam mo/ /de las 'od zer rnam pa lnga 'phros pas 'gro ba thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs te slar de nyid la bsdu'o—/ /de nas yang rang gi snying ga'i t+t+waṃ ⑦las 'od spros pas/ 'og min gyi gnas nas jo mo sgrol ma mdun gyi nam mkha' la spyan drangs la gsal bar bltas te/ bla na med pa'i mchod pa ⑧bya'o/ /de nas sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa dang / bsod nams la rjes su yi rang ba dang / bsod nams 40—1277

yongs su bsngo ①ba dang / gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang / byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang / lam bsten ②pa dang / bdag nyid kyi lus dbul ba la sogs pa byas la/ byams pa dang / snying rje dang / dga' ba dang /btang snyoms rim pa bzhin du bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas rang bzhin gyis dag pa'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di lan gsum brjod par bya ste/ oṃ swa bhā ④wa shudhaḥsarba dharmā④ཿswa bhā ⑤wa shurnyolharjohaṃ/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā ⑦wa byed kopho⑧haṃ/zhes brjod pas bdag dang gzhan gyi dngos po thams cad stong pa nyid du bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas sngon kyi smon lam rjes su dran pas nam mkha'i khams su paṃ ⑨yongs su gyur pa la ⑩sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar oṃ las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du drur (nyaba'i mdog lta bu'i t+t+waṃ tugeyig 'od zer sna tshogs pa can bsgoms la/de la 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams bkug nas de nyid la zhugs par bsgom ste/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las ⑫lha mo sgrol mar bsgom par bya ste/ sku mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ yid dga' ba'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yon pas ut+pa la bsnams pa/ g.yas pas bdud rtsi 'dzag pa'i mchog sbyin pa/ sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng gi zla ba la zhabs g.yas brkyang ba'i gis krung phyed pas bzhugs pa'o/ /de'i g.yas phyogs su mya ngan med pa'i 'od zer can ④sku mdog ser mo rin po che sna tshogs pa'i dbu rgyan can/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje bsnams pa/g.yon pas mya ngan med pa'i shing gi yal ga bsnams pa nye bar bzhugs pa'o/ /g.yon phyogs su ral gcig ma mi'u thung gi gzugs can sku mdog nag mo/stag gi pags pa'i na bza' bsnams pa/ spyan gsum pa mche ba gtsigs pa'i 40—1278

zhal skra ser po 'bar zhing gyen du badze+es pa/ phyag gnyis kyis ①rdo rje dang ②gri gug ①bsnams pa nye bar bzhugs pa'o/ /yang g.yas phyogs su rma bya chen mo/sku mdog ser mo rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas pas burnga yab bsnams pa/ g.yon pas rma bya'i mdongs bsnams pa/ nye bar bzhugs pa'o//yang g.yon phyogs su dug sel ma sku mdog ljang gu/ phyag g.yas pas mchog sbyin mdzad pa/ g.yon pas sgrul bsnams pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa nye bar bzhugs pa'o/ /gzhan yang lha dang lha ma yin kyis bskor bar bsgom par bya'o/ /don yod grub pas dbu la rgyas rjogadab bo/ /de nas rang gi snying ga las sangs rgyas kyi tshogs kyi sprin spro bar bsam mo/ /de ltar bsgoms bupas rnal 'byor pa skyo na/ rang gi snying gar ut+pa la'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la sngags mu tig gi phreng ba ltar dkar ba bltas la/ oṃ tā re tuṣ+ṭha re tu re swā hā/zhes so/ /de nas ldang bar 'dod na sngon bzhin du mchod pa dang bstod pa byas te / dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngos dze+el/ oṃ a mi tā ⑧bha zhes brjod pas sems can thams cad kyi don dang dngos grub thob par ⑨bsams la/ muḥzhes brjod pas sangs rgyas kyi zhing du gshegs par bsam zhing slar yang sems can gyi don du byon par gsol ba btab la de nas jo mo sgol ma'i gzugs kyis ci bde bar spyod lam bya'o/ /mchod pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ byedahūṃ t+t+waṃ tā ⑩re ye/ oṃ a ཿbadz+ra puṣ+pe hūṃ swā hā/ de bzhin du bdug spos dang / mar me dang / dri dang /byug pa dang / zhal zas dbul bar bya'o/ /seng ldeng nags kyi sgol ma'i sgrub thabs—/ slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar kyi mkhan po dpal rnam par snang mdzad rdo rjes bsgyur cing zhus te 40—1279

gtan la phab pa'o// //bsdur mchan/1277 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉staṇ+ḍi/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉nga/ rjo〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉4sa/ rjo〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉te yig dur/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rta/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉〉bdun gyis mchod par/1278 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉pa rjes su sngo/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉brten/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉starto/ ④〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉dharma/⑤〈〈pe 〉lo'adir 〉〉bha/ du〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉wa3/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉garto/ ni〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉wa3/ ⑨〈'dir 〉༅/⑩〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉sko〈co 〉〉pas/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉dur/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉rta/ ⑫〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈'ar 〉bocan/1279 ①〈〈snar 〉〉wakyis/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wadang / ③〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉 dang thod pa/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉zo/bu〈〈snar 〉〉brgyas/ du〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉bsgom/ ⑦〈〈snar 〉〉bsngo bar/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉stan ta/ ⑨〈〈snar 〉〉dang / ⑩〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉rta ta/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stagabasdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2289)40wa 1280

༄ga /sgrub thabs brgya dang brgyad pa/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ sha tai aṣ+ṭa sā dha rna/ bod skad du/ sgrub thabs brgya dang brgyad pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag tu med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma'i drin thob brtul zhugs ldan/ /bla med ye shes sgrub pa pos//ri bo dbe+en zhing yid 'ong bar/ /rin chen sna tshogs kyis mdzes shing / /ljon shing mang pos rab tu gang / /skad snyan bya rnams sgra 'byin cing / /chu gtsang yan lag brgyad ldan 'bab/ /ri dwags 'tshe ba med pa'i gnas/ /dri zhim me tog gis bkram pa'i/ /shing tog ⑤la sogs 'bras bu mang / /lha klu la sogs gru len cing / /grub 'dzin kun gyis gnas bcas pa/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas der ni/ /sngags pas kun la phan brtson pas/ /bde ba'i stan la bsdad nas ni/ /rang snying sa bon 'od zer gyis/ /'phags ma sgol sogs spyan drangs te/ /mchod pa kun gyis rab mchod nas/ /bdun po 40byed1281

rnam par dag par ①bya/ /de nas tshad med bzhi bsgoms ②pas/ /byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /'gyur med phyin ci ma log ①pas/ /de dag 'phags pa'i spyod yul ni/ /stong pa nyid du rnam par bsgom/ /oṃ swa bhā duwa bi shudheḥsarba dharmārjoḥswa bhā rjowa bi shurnyolha⑦haṃ/ pad+ma zla bar yi ge t+t+waṃ⑧/ /de la 'jig rten gsum g.yo ba'i/ /sgrol ma zhal bzhi phyag brgyad pa/ /dmar ser bzang po'i zhabs kyis bzhugs/ /ser dang ljang gu dmar dang dkar/ /rtsa zhal g.yas g.yon rgyab rim bzhin/ /mchog sbyin nyi ma gdugs dang dung / /g.yas pa'i phyag na rim bzhin bsnams/ /ut+pal zhags pa phreng ba dang / /go khrab rnams ni g.yon na bsnams/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis yang dag rdzogs/ /ye shes drangs te gzhug par bya/ /oṃ t+pahūṃ/ zhes pas sku gsung thugs byen brlab/ /dbang bskur rim gyis dbu brgyan ⑨bya/ /ye shes zla ba'i ting 'dzin sems/ /skyo bar gyur na bzlas pa bya/ /gshegs dang bsdu ba la sogs bya/ /'jig rten gsum po ⑩g.yo bar byed pa'i sgrol ma'i ⑪sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma zla ba'i gdan la ni oṃ las byung ba'i sgol ma nyi ma'i mdog can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas skyabs sbyin pa/ g.yon ut+pa la nyi mas mtshan pa rol pa'i stabs ⑫kyis bzhugs pa/ rgyan thams cad dang yang dag par ldan pa'o—/ /dge ba can zhes bya ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la hūṃ las byung ba'i sgol ma/ pad+ma dang kun da ltar dkar ba/ zla ba'i 'od mnga' ba/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ zla ba 40—1282

dang sna tshogs rdo rje g.yas gnyis na 'dzin pa/ ut+pa la dang me'i 'khor lo g.yon na bsnams pa/ rgyan thams cad dang ldan pa/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi dhidabu rgyan dang ldan pa/ skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ sku thams cad las bdud rtsi 'dzag pa'o/ /'jig rten thams cad g.yo bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i sgol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la byāḥlas byung ba'i sgol ma ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas g.yon gnyis kyis phreng ba dang / ut+pa la'i steng na po ti 'dzin pa'o/ /rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa rol pas bzhugs pa'o/ /snyan pa mo zhes bya ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs so/ //pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du a las byung ba'i sgol ma dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas na pad+ma dmar po/ g.yon na ut+pa la sngon pos brgyan pa/spyan gsum pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /dbyangs can ma zhes bya ba'i ①sgol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du ma las byung ba'i lha mo sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma rdo rje dang ut+pa la bsnams pa/ rdo rje khrus mo ④krung gis bzhugs pa/ snang ba mtha' yas kyi dbu rgyan dang ldan par bsam mo/ /shes rab ma zhes bya ba'i busgrol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //40—1283

pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la spyo ①las byung ba'i lha mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma④—/ g.yas na rin po che dang me tog /g.yon na ④mchog sbyin pa/ zhabs rol pas bzhugs pa'o/ /dpal mo zhes bya ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la t+t+waṃ rjolas byung ba'i lha mo sngon mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ dang po gnyis na mda' gzhurjo/ 'og ma gnyis na ut+pa la dang ral gri bsnams pa/ rol pa'i zhabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /blo 'phel ma zhes bya ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang zla ba dang nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ las byung ba'i sgol ma zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma⑥/ nag mo khros ma spyan gsum ma/ zhal gdangs pa khro gnyer bsnyer ba ljags 'dril ba/ stag gi pags pa'i gos 'chang ba/ gri gug dang thod khrag bsnams pa/ mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal 'chang ba'o/ /gsod par byed pa'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang ⑦zla ba dang nyi ma'i gdan stengs su rdzu ⑧las yang dag par byung ba'i lha mo sku mdog ser mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis shing thog dang mya ngan med pa'i shing lo bzung ba'o/ /rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /rgyas par byed pa'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la oṃ las byung ba'i lha mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/40—1284

mdog ljang ser du ba ltar 'dug pa/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ rgyan thams cad dang ldan pa/ mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa'o/ /'dod gzugs can kyi sgrol ma zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la hūṃ las byung ba'i lha mo/ dkar dmar mdog can zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma ①g.yas kyi dang po na skyabs sbyin pa/ g.yon mchog sbyin pa tha ma gnyis kyis ut+pa la dang phreng ba 'dzin pa/ zhabs rol pas bzhugs pa'o/ /phan par brtson pa'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang ②nyi ma'i steng du i las byung ba'i lha mo mdog mthing sngon/zhal gsum phyag drug ma g.yas dmar ba g.yon sngo ba/ phyag dang po gnyis ①mda' gzhu 'gengs pa/ bar ma na glang po che dang / rgyal mtshanarjo/ tha ma na ral gri dang zhags pa bsnams shing rol pas shing rta'i steng na bzhugs pa'o/ /g.yul las sgrol bar byed pa'i sgol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //rjopad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du oṃ las lha mo dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ g.yas na 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa/ g.yon na ba dan lce brgyad pa bsnams shing / 'gying ba'i tshul kyis bzhugs pa'orjo/ /rgyal ba mo zhes bya ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la a las byung ba'i lha mo gser kyi mdog can zhal 40—1285

gcig phyag bzhi ma g.yas dang pos skyabs sbyin pa 'og mas rdo rje/ g.yon dang pos mchog sbyin pa 'og mas ut+pa la dang po ti'o/ /zhabs rol pas bzhugs pa'o—/ /rgyan thams cad dang yang dag par ldan pa'o/ /shes rab ①pha rol zhuphyin ma zhes bya ba'i sgol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la tai las byung ba'i lha mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/g.yas mchog sbyin pa g.yon ut+pa la dang bcas pa'i skyabs sbyin pa/ mdog ljang gu'o—/ /'phags ma sgol ma'i zhes bya ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan steng na tram̐ las byung ba'i lha mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ mdog dkar mo g.yas klu shing gi me tog bsnams pa/ g.yon ba dan rin po ches mtshan pa 'bar ba/ na bza' dang rgyan sna tshogs mnga' ba/rgyal po'i rol pas bzhugs pa'o/ /yid 'ong ma zhes bya ba'i sgol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la a las byung ba'i lha mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/mdog ser mo/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rin po che dang ral gri /'og ma gnyis na rdza rnga brdung ba la brtson pa'o/ /zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /rdza rnga can gyi sgol ma'i sgrub thabs so—/ / //40—1286

pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la baṃ las byung ba'i lha mo mdog sngo ljang zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma①/ dang po gnyis na dung dang rgyal mtshan/ tha ma gnyis na ral gri dang ut+pa la sngon po bsnams pa'o/ /zhabs rol pas bzhugs pa'o/ /dung can ④ma zhes bya ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la twesneḥlas byung ba'i lha mo mdog ser mo zhal bzhi pa g.yas sngo 0ba rgyab dkar ba g.yon dmar ba/ phyag g.yas dang po na bum pa/gnyis pa na bgrang phreng / gsum pa na gdugs/ bzhi pa na gaṇ+ḍirjo/ g.yon dang po na a mra'i 'bras bu/ gnyis pa na ut+pa la/ gsum pa na lhung bzed/bzhi pa na sdigs mdzub/ rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis ༷bzhugs pa/ rgyas par byed pa'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs so/ //pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du hūṃ las byung ba'i lha mo ⑦zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ral gri dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa⑧/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ phyag rgya chen po rab tu 'grub par ⑨byed pa'i bdag nyid can zhal nas mi 'jigs pa sbyin par mdzad pa'o/ /tshig snyan ma zhes bya ba'i ⑩sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la oṃ las byung ba'i lha mo zhal lnga ma/ sku zla ba ltar dkar ba/ zhal lnga ku mu da dkar po ltar 'bar ba/ phyag bcu dang ldan pa—/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis me long dang dung 'dzin pa/ g.yas gnyis pa na rdo rje dang / gsum pa na byed la dkar po/ bzhi pa na mchog sbyin pa⑪/40—1287

lnga pa na mda'o/ /g.yon gyi gnyis pa na ①mdung thung dang / gsum pa na 'khor lo/ bzhi pa na dril bu/ lnga pa na gzhu'o/ /rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs gnyis rol pas bzhugs pa'o/ /zla ba'i mdog can zhes bya ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la a las byung ba'i lha mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/sku mdog dkar mo phyag gnyis kyis bum pa dang / mchog stsol ba'o/ /rgyan dang na bza' sna tshogs pa bsnams pa/ zhabs gnyis skyil krung du bzhugs pa'o//dkar mo chen mo zhes bya ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan kyi ②steng na so las byung ba'i lha mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma ser mo glang po che dang seng ge'i steng du ④rol pas bzhugs pa'o/ /phyag gnyis na rdo rjes mtshan pa'i ut+pa la ser po bsnams nas skyabs sbyin dang /mchog sbyin stsol bar mdzad pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /mi pham ma zhes bya ba'i rjosgrol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la gi las byung ba'i lha mo mdog dmar zhing 'od 'phro ba/ zhal bzhi phyag brgyad ma/ g.yas dkar ba g.yon ser ba rgyab zhal nag pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas dang po na seng ge gnyis pa na rnga zlum gsum pa na dbyu gu/ bzhi pa na lcags kyu/ g.yon dang po na ⑤ut+pa la/ gnyis pa na rtse gsum/ gsum pa na rgyal mtshan/ bzhi pa 40—1288

na ce spyang bsnams pa/ ①zhabs rol pas bzhugs pa'o/ /sgyu ma chen mo zhes bya ba'i ④sgol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la aḥlas byung ba'i lha mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/mdog sngon mo spyan gsum pa/ cung zad khros pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas pa na pi wang bsgreng ba/ g.yon du ut+pa la sngon po'i nang du khang pa brtsegs dze+epa 'dzin pa/ zhabs rol pas bzhugs pa'o/ /stobs chen ma duzhes bya ba'i sgol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ las byung ba'i lha mo mdog sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ rgyan thams cad kyis yang dag par brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas ral gri g.yon ⑤sdigs mdzub bsnams pa/ zhabs phyed krung dang ༷bcas pa'o/ /gtum mo chen mo zhes bya ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du yo las byung ba'i lha mo mdog dud kha zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma rgyan rnams kyis brgyan pa/ g.yas na tri shu ⑦la dang / g.yon na spu gri bsnams pa/ zhabs skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /sdang ba thams cad rlag ⑧par byed pa zhes bya ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang zla ba'i ⑨steng du oṃ las byung ba'i lha mo sku mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ zhabs rol pas bzhugs pa/ rgyan kun dang ldan zhing 40—1289

mdzes pa/ phyag g.yas dang po skyabs sbyin/ g.yon dang po me dpung 'dzin pa/'og ma gnyis kyis dbyug pa dang lcags kyu bsnams pa ①zhabs skyil krung du bzhugs pa/ rma bya'i khri la mdzes pas rol par ④mdzad pa'o/ /rab tu zhi ba zhes bya ba'i sgol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du/ hūṃ ③las byung ba'i lha mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ mdog ser mo rgyan thams cad kyis yang dag par brgyan ma/phyag g.yas na nyi ma dang dbang po/ g.yon na zla ba dang thag rjobazangs ris bsnams pa'o/ /zhabs rol pas bzhugs pa'o/ /rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i sgol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ las byung ba'i lha mo zhal gsum phyag bzhi ma mdog dmar ser g.yas dmar ba g.yon ljang gu/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis mchog sbyin dang ut+pa la bum pas mtshan pa bsnams pa/ zhabs rol pas bzhugs pa/ sku la 'od 'phro brjo/ 'og ma gnyis na rnga yab dang ting shags ⑥bsnams pa/ 'bar ba'i 'od mnga' ba'i sgol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du a las byung ba'i lha mo mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas na mu tig gi phreng ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ g.yon na ut+pa la'i sdong bu mchog sbyin dang bcas pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rol pas bzhugs pa'o/ /40—1290

glog phreng ma zhes bya ba'i sgol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du hūṃ las byung ba'i lha mo mdog dmar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas mchog sbyin zhing g.yon pas rgyal mtshan rdo rje phyed pas mtshan pa bsnams pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/zhabs rol pas bzhugs pa'o/ /rgyal mtshan can zhes bya ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du a las byung ba'i lha mo mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas ral gri g.yon 'khor lo/ /rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rol pas bzhugs pa'o/ /ye shes can zhes bya ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du tai las byung ba'i lha mo mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma rgyan thams cad kyis yang dag par brgyan pa/ g.yas dang po mchog sbyin/ g.yon dang po ut+pa la 'og ma gnyis na mda' gzhu bsnams pa/zhabs skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /shes rab can zhes bya ba'i ①sgol ma'i sgrub thabs so //pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la yi las byung ba'i lha mo mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ rgyan thams cad kyis yang dag par brgyan pa/ g.yas mchog 40—1291

sbyin zhing ①g.yon chang gis gang ba'i bum pa'o/ /zhabs rol pas bzhugs pa'o//myos par byed pa'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs so/ //pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la re las byung ba'i lha mo mdog dkar mo zhal gcig pa ⑤phyag gnyis ma/ khro mo'i cha lugs sbrul gyi ①rgyan can/ g.yas rdo rje g.yon sdigs mdzub kyis bsdigs parjo/ zhabs rol pas rgya mtsho'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /rengs par byed pa'i sgol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ las byung ba'i lha mo ⑤nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas rdo rje gri gug g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba/ glang chen gyi pags pa'obu/ /phag gi zhal mnga' ba/ spyan gsum khro gnyer can sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rol pas bzhugs pa'o/ /nag mo chen mo zhes bya ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la hūṃ las byung ba'i lha mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas ④bzhugs pa/na bza' nag po gsol ba/ mdog dmar mo/ dbu skra gyen du badze+es pa/phyag g.yas dang po na 'khor lo/ gnyis pa na ral gri/ g.yon gyi dang po na srid pa'i 'khor lo/ gnyis pa na sdigs mdzub bo/ /mtshan mo nag mo zhes bya ba'i ⑧sgrub thabs so// //40—1292

pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du oṃ las byung ba'i lha mo sgrol ma mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma①/ phyag g.yas na 'khor lo g.yon khu tshur sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa bsnams pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rol pas bzhugs pa'o/ /srung bar byed pa'i sgol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du oṃ las byung ba'i lha mo sku mdog sngo skya zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ g.yas pa rlung gi ba dan dang / ri dang rgya mtsho'i gling brgya dang / g.yon na myos byed kyis ②gang ba'i snod dang zhags pa dang / rnga bo che rnams rim bzhin du bsnams pa/ zhal g.yas dmar ba g.yon dkar po/rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rol pas bzhugs pa'o/ /rmongs byed ma zhes bya ba'i sgol ma'i sgrub thabs so /pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du tram̐ las byung ba'i lha mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/g.yas rin po ches mtshan pa'i byed la ser po①/ g.yon skyabs sbyin par mdzad pa'i phyag gis byed la sngon po po tis mtshan pa/ mdog ser mo rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rol pas bzhugs pa'o/ /zhi ba mo zhes bya ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du a las byung ba'i lha mo mdog sngo ljang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas byed la rdo rjes mtshan pa/ g.yon chos 'chad pa'i phyag rgya can rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rol pas bzhugs pa'o/ /40—1293

mdzes ma chen mo zhes bya ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs so /pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du oṃ las byung ba'i lha mo mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma ut+pa la sngon po nyi ma dang zla bas mtshan pa bsnams shing / g.yas mchog sbyin spyod ba'i phyag gis rin po che bsnams pa/ g.yon thugs kar skyabs sbyin pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rol pas ngang mo'i khri la bzhugs pa'o/ /tshangs pa'i bu mo zhes bya ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du oṃ las byung ba'i lha mo zhal bzhi phyag brgyad ma/mdog sngon mo zhal g.yas dkar ba/ rgyab gnag ①pa g.yon dmar ba rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ phyag dang po gnyis ut+pa la po tis mtshan pa bsnams pa/ g.yas gnyis pa na gdugs/ gsum pa na mda'/ bzhi pa na dung / g.yon gnyis pa ②rgyal mtshan/ gsum pa na gzhu/ bzhi pa na ril ba spyi blugs bsnams pa/ rgyan dang na bza' sna tshogs can/ zhabs rol pas khri snyan sa la'i ①pags pa'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o/ /rig rjobyed ma zhes bya ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs so /pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du tai las byung ba'i lha mo sku mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma rus pa'i rgyan dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon pad+ma dmar po thugs kar bsnams pa'o/ /smad g.yogs ri dwags kyi pags pas byas pa/ zhabs rol pa dang brag phug tu bzhugs shing gsang ba'i drang srong dang 40—1294

bcas pa'o/ /gsang ba mo zhes bya ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng na rma las byung ba'i lha mo gser gyi mdog can zhal bzhi pa/ g.yas dkar ba rgyab sngo ba/ g.yon dmar ba/ zhabs rol pas bzhugs pa'o/ /phyag g.yas dang pos nor bus mtshan pa'i rgyal mtshan bsnams pa—/ gnyis pa na 'khor lo/ gsum pa na pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa yu ba dang bcas pa/ bzhi pa na dung ngo / /g.yon dang po na bum pa/gnyis pa na dpal gyi be+e'u/ gsum pa na nya/ bzhi pa na gdugs bsnams shing bkra shis par mdzad pa'o/ /rgyan dang na bza' sna tshogs pas bklubs ①pa'o—/ /bkra shis don grub par byed pa'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du oṃ las byung ba'i lha mo mdog dkar mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ phyag g.yas thugs kar phreng ba bsnams pa/ g.yon ④mchog sbyin zhing pad+ma dkar po bsnams pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/zhabs skyil krung du bzhugs pa'o/ /zhi ba chen mo zhes bya ba'i sgol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du swa las byung ba'i lha mo mdog dmar ser/ zhal bzhi phyag bcu yis g.yas na mdung rtse gsum pa/ rnga yab dang / dgra sta dang /me long dang / rdo rje'o/ /g.yon gyi rim pa bzhin du dril bu dang / ut+pa la dang / gtun shing dang / bum pa dang / 'khor lo'o/ /rgyan thams cad 40—1295

kyis brgyan pa'o/ /rol pas bzhugs pa'o/ /rig byed ma zhes bya ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ las byung ba'i lha mo mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ phyag g.yas g.yon thugs kar bkan te/ byang chub mchog dang ldan pa la rdo rjes mtshan pa'o/ /rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing /zhabs skyil krung gis bum pa'i khri la bzhugs pa'o/ /yid mgyogs ma zhes bya ba'i sgol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ las byung ba'i lha mo mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma⑫/ g.yas gri gug /g.yon ban+ta bsnams pas zhag dang khrag la dgyes pa/ stag gi g.yang gzhi gsol ba/ zhal 'dzum pa mdzad cing rkan sgra 'byin pa/ 'jig rten gsum g.yo bar mdzad pa④/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bar mdzad pa'o/ /thod pa can zhes bya ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs so/ //pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du t+t+waṃ ④las byung ba'i lha mo mdog sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma phyag g.yas na bum pa/ g.yon na ce spyang bsnams pa'o/ /na bza' dkar po gsol ba/ zhabs sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o/ /shugs can ma zhes bya ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //40—1296

pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du a las byung ba'i lha mo mdog dkar mo zhal bzhi phyag brgyad ma/ phyag g.yas dang pos phreng ba bsnams pa/ gnyis pa na bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa/ gsum pa na srid pa'i phyag ①shing / bzhi pa na skebum pa dang bcas pa'i mya ngan med pa'i shing / g.yon dang pos nyi zla/gnyis pas ri rab/ gsum pas pad+ma'i nang nas byung ba'i skyes bu/ bzhi pa/ na chos 'chad pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /zhabs skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /tshangs pa mo zhes bya ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs so/ //pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la a las byung ba'i lha mo mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ na bza' ri dwags kyi pags pa'i smad g.yogs ④mnga' ba/ phyag g.yas pa brkyang nas pus mo la reg pa—/ g.yon pa'ang rjode bzhin du mdzad pa/ byed la dang byed la la ⑤ral gris mtshan pa'o/ /zhabs rol pas seng ge'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o du /bden par smra ba mo zhes bya ba'i sgol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du ⑦oṃ las byung ba'i lha mo mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ g.yas na rtse gsum ba dan dang bcas pa bsnams pa/ g.yon na byed la bum pas mtshan pa'o/ /zhabs rol pas bzhugs pa'o/ /pha rol las rgyal bar byed pa ④zhes bya ba'i sgol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //40—1297

pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la haṃ las byung ba'i sgrol ma mdog dkar dmar zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma rgyan thams cad kyis rab tu brgyan pa phyag g.yas ut+pa la dang seng ge g.yon lcags kyu bsnams pa/ zhabs rol pas bzhugs pa'osde/ /ded dpon chen mo zhes bya ba'i sgol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du saṃ las skyes pa'i lha mo mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi rngum/ g.yas pas lcags kyu dang zhags pa/ g.yon pas lcags sgrog dang dril bu'o/ /rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ phyag rgya chen po ut+pa la la gnas pa'o/ /zhabs rol pas bzhugs pa'o/ /snying rje gnas par byed pa zhes bya ba'i ④sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs so /pad+ma dang rjonyi ma'i steng du rjo.a las byung ba'i lha mo mdog ljang gu/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas rjo.ut+pa la la ⑦rta mchog gis mtshan pa'o/ /g.yon pa na /sa༄nor bu'i za ma tog bsnams pa/ skyil krung du bzhugs pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /chud mi za bar byed pa ⑨zhes bya ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du paṃ las byung ba'i lha mo mdog dkar dmar zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas na ral gri bsnams pa/ g.yon na ut+pa la mar mes mtshan pa bsnams pa/ zhabs rol pas bzhugs pa'o/ /lam rab tu 40—1298

ston par byed pa'i sgrol ma zhes bya ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs so //pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la bye ①las byung ba'i lha mo mdog ser mo zhal gsum phyag bzhi g.yas sngo ba g.yon dmar ba/ g.yas rin po che dang bcas pa'i mchog sbyin pa/ g.yon bum pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ tha ma gnyis na mda' gzhu'o/ /rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing rol pas bzhugs pa'o/ /mchog ster bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i sgol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du a las byung ba'i lha mo mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ phyag g.yas pa na bum pa/ g.yon pa na lde mig bsnams pa/rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rol pas bzhugs pa'o/ /dngos grub ster bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du a las byung ba'i lha mo mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ g.yas bum pa la snying pos mtshan pa/ g.yon rin po ches mtshan pa'i khang pa bsnams pa ④zhabs rol pas bzhugs pa'o/ /dngos grub ston par byed pa zhes bya ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs so—/ / //pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la t+t+waṃ ④las byung ba'i lha mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma mdog dmar ser phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon mya ngan med pa'i shing lo bsnams 40—1299

pa'ohu / /rgyan dang na bza' bcas pa zhabs skyil krung du bzhugs pa/ lang tsho dang ldan pa'o/ /bud med gzugs can so so ④'brang ma zhes bya ba'i sgol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du baṃ las byung ba'i lha mo dmar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas mya ngan med pa'i shing la phyag gis 'khyud snepar brten pa'o/ /g.yon ④/a la dmar po kha bye ba'i nang du ⑤glang po che 'dzin pa/ rgyan dang na bza' dang kye bcas pa/ zhabs shing rta'i steng du bzhugs pa'o⑦/ /dpag med gnon par byed pa'i 'od zer can zhes bya ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du hūṃ las byung ba'i lha mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma mdog ser mo/ g.yas dgra sta dang g.yon zhags pa bsnams pa/ rgyan thams cad dang shing lo'i na bza' gyon pa/ zhabs rol pas bzhugs pa'o/ /ri khrod ma zhes bya ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du tweḥ④las byung ba'i lha mo mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas pa gri gug /g.yon pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang thod pa'o/ /rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa na bza' dang bcas pa ④zhabs rol pas bzhugs pa'o—/ /rnal 'byor ma zhes bya ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du byā⑩ཿlas byung ba'i lha mo mdog dkar mo ⑩zhal 40—1300

gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas na zhags pa①/ g.yon na lcags kyu dang bum pa'o—/ /rgyan dang na bza' ser mo bsnams shing rol pas bzhugs pa'o/ /grub ma zhes bya ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du hūṃ las byung ba'i lha mo sdezhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/g.yas ral gri dang g.yon sdogs mdzub/ zhags pa dang bcas pa'o/ /rgyan dang na bza' dang bcas pa/ zhabs phyed krung du bzhugs pa'o/ /gtum mo zhes bya ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du byā①ཿlas byung ba'i lha mo mdog dkar mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa dugayas dpag bsam gyi shing dang / g.yon bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa bsnams pa/ zhabs rol pas bzhugs pa⑤/ rgyan dang na bza' dang bcas pa'o/ /bdud rtsi mo zhes bya ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du sum̐ las byung ba'i lha mo mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ rjogayas na sangs rgyas kyis ⑦sprul pa'i gzhal yas khang bsnams pa/ g.yon na ut+pa la sngon po bsnams pa/ rgyan dang na bza' dang ldan pa ④zhabs rol pas bzhugs pa'o/ /skal ba sbyin pa zhes bya ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la oṃ las byung ba'i lha mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/40—1301

phyag g.yas na rin po che/ g.yon na byed la sngon po bsnams pa/ rgyan dang na bza' dang bcas pa zhabs rol pa dang bcas pas bzhugs pa'o/ /skal bzang ma zhes bya ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang nyi ma la swa las byung ba'i lha mo mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ phyag g.yas na ri dwags ru ru'i ①ri mo can bsnams pa/ g.yon na ut+pa la sngon po bsnams pa/ rgyan dang na bza' dang bcas pa zhabs rol pa dang bcas pas rma bya dang / cang shes kyi khri la bzhugs pa'o/ /mdzes par byed pa'i sdesgol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la haṃ las byung ba'i lha mo mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma ①g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon na du.ut+pa la bsnams pa/ rgyan dang na bza' dang bubacas pa/ zhabs phyed krung du bzhugs pa'o/ /'dod pa grub par byed pa zhes bya ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du a las byung ba'i lha mo mdog dmar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas rin po che'i mdzod nas/ g.yon lcags kyus 'dren par mdzad ma/ zhal rnam par rgyas pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/zhabs rol pas bzhugs par bsgom par bya'o/ /dngos grub thams cad ster bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i sgol ma'i sgrub thabs so //40—1302

pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la hūṃ las byung ba'i lha mo dud ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma phyag g.yas na bya khā ta bsnams shing / g.yon na dbyug tho bsnams pa/rgyan rnams kun rdzogs pa/ zhabs kyis ri ma dha ra brdzi zhing zhabs rol pas bzhugs pa'o/ /mthar byed ma zhes bya ba'i ①sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ las byung ba'i lha mo nag mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas g.yon gnyis be+e con dang sdigs mdzub 'dzin par mdzad ma/rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing zhabs rol pas glang po che la bzhugs pa'o/ /drag cing khro ba'i dbang du gyur pas zhal gdangs pa 'jigs su rung bar blta'o/ /skrag par byed pa zhes bya ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du tai las byung ba'i lha mo mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma g.yas gnyis na mchog sbyin dang bgrang phreng / g.yon gnyis na glegs bam dang / ut+pa la bsnams pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/sems dpa'i skyil krung du bzhugs pa'o/ /rab tu sdud par byed pa zhes bya ba'i sgol ma'i sgrub thabs so// // pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ las byung ba'i lha mo mdog nag mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas gri gug g.yon zhags pa bsnams pa 'jigs par byed pa skra dang smin ma dmar ser mche ba cung zad gatshigs pa zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas shing khro mo'i lus can zhabs rol pas bzhugs pa'o/ /'jigs par byed 40—1303

pa zhes bya ba'i sgol ma'i sgrub thabs so ①pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du twesdeḥlas byung ba'i lha mo mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas g.yon gyi dang po gnyis kyis nyi ma dang ut+pa la dmar po kha bye ba/ tha ma gnyis na mda' gzhu bsnams pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rol pas bzhugs pa'o/ /dran byed ma zhes bya ba'i ④sgol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la a las byung ba'i lha mo mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas na rtse gsum g.yon na ril ba bsnams pa/rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing / mya ngan med pa'i shing la brten rjopa/rol pa'i zhabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /brtul zhugs chen mo zhes bya ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la oṃ las byung ba'i lha mo mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ g.yas na nor bu rin po che/ g.yon na bum pa bsnams pa/ byang chub kyi shing la rgyab brten pa/zhabs rol pas bzhugs pa'o/ /phan par brtson pa zhes bya ba'i sgol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du ⑤rma las byung ba'i lha mo mdog ljang gu zhal gcig 40—1304

phyag bzhi ma/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos skyabs sbyin pa/ 'og ma mda'/ g.yon dang po ut+pa la/ 'og mas gzhu bsnams pa/ zhabs rol pas bzhugs pa'o/ /skyob par byed pa zhes bya ba'i ①sgol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la tai las byung ba'i lha mo mdog sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas na po ti dang / ut+pa la dang ④bcas pa/ g.yon skyabs sbyin dang ut+pa la dang ①bcas pa'o/ /rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing zhabs skyis krung dang bcas pa'o/ /gus byed ma zhes bya ba'i sgol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la r+ghaṃ las byung ba'i lha mo mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas kyis skyabs sbyin zhing / g.yon na bu.ut+pa la'i steng na snyan par smra ba'i rjosgra dang bcas pa bsnams pa/ kṛṣ+ṭa sa ra'i ④pags pa phrag pa la bkal ba'o/ /bde ba mo zhes bya ba'i sgol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la byā⑦ཿlas byung ba'i lha mo mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas na ral gri/g.yon na seng ge kha nang du blta ba'o⑧/ /zhabs rol pas bzhugs pa'o/ /ngag gi dbang phyug ma zhes bya ba'i sgol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //40—1305

pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la tai las byung ba'i lha mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/phyag g.yas a shwa ①ka'i sdong po la 'khyud pa⑤/ g.yon na bum pa bsnams pasne/rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan padu/ zhabs rol pas bzhugs pa'o/ /zhi bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i ⑤sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la hūṃ las byung ba'i lha mo sngo ljang zhal gsum phyag drug ma g.yas dkar g.yon dmar ba/ g.yas g.yon gyi dang po gnyis kyis ral gri dang po ti/ bar ma gnyis ting nge 'dzin du bsnol ba/ tha ma gnyis na mda' gzhu'o/ /rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rol pas bzhugs pa'o—/ /zhi zhing phra ba zhes bya ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du oṃ las byung ba'i lha mo mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas 'khor lo g.yon ting nge 'dzin du bzhugs pa'o/ /rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung du bzhugs pa'o/ /rtag pa ma zhes bya ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs so /pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du saṃ las byung ba'i lha mo mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas rdo rje rjorgya gram/ g.yon rgo'u le'i rkyal bu bsnams pa/rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rol pas bzhugs pa'o/ /kun 'gro ma zhes bya ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //40—1306

pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la twe①ཿlas byung ba'i lha mo mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas rin po che g.yon dar 'phan lce ②gnyis pa bsnams pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang bas bzhugs pa'o/ /rjes 'gro ma zhes bya ba'i sgol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du tai las byung ba'i lha mo mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas na gsil gabyed bsnams pa/ g.yon na pad+ma la gnas pa'i rgya gram bsnams pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rol pas bzhugs pa'o/ /don kun grub par byed pa zhes bya ba'i ④sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs so—/ / //pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la hūṃ las byung ba'i lha mo mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas bum pa g.yon lcags kyu bsnams pa'o/ /rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rol pas bzhugs pa'o/ /bzang po ma zhes bya ba'i sgol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la a las byung ba'i lha mo rgyan thams cad dang ldan ma zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas na mya ngan med pa'i shing / g.yon mchog sbyin no/ /mdog ser mo zhabs skyil krung du bzhugs pa'o/ /gsang byed ma zhes bya ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //40—1307

pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la swa las byung ba'i lha mo mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas na rin po che brtsigs ①pa bsnams pa/ g.yon ut+pa la ②mchog sbyin dang bcas pa'o/ /rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rol pas bzhugs pa'o/ /gso byed ma zhes bya ba'i sgol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la lcu las byung ba'i lha mo mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas rin po che dang bcas pa'i mchog sbyin/ g.yon rin po ches gang ba'i nor bu'i rkyal pa bsnams pa①/ zhabs rol pas bzhugs pa'o//nor ster ma zhes bya ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la hūṃ las byung ba'i lha mo mdog sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ g.yas dang po skyabs sbyin pa/g.yon chos 'chad pa'i phyag rgya can zhabs rol pas bzhugs pa'o/ /mi 'jigs pa zhes bya ba'i sgol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la baṃ las byung ba'i lha mo mdog sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas na ut+pa la sngon po/ g.yon shel gyi phreng ba bsnams pa/rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rol pas bzhugs pa'o/ /bsod nams can zhes bya ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la tram̐ las byung ba'i lha mo mdog ser mo zhal gcig

phyag bzhi pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas g.yon dang po gnyis kyis spyi bor rab tu dga' ba'i phyag rgya bcings pa/ g.yas kyi 'og ma na ral gri /g.yon gyi 'og ma na shing mya ngan med pa'i yal ga bzung ba'o/ /gi ①ta ma zhes bya ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la hri dze+elas byung ba'i lha mo mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas ril ba spyi blugs dang bcas pa'i mchog sbyin pa/g.yon ut+pa la sngon po dang bcas pa'i skyabs sbyin pa/ rgyan thams cad dang ldan pa'i na bza' bsnams pa'o/ /zhabs rol pas bzhugs pa'o/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug las skyes pa zhes bya ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la hūṃ las byung ba'i lha mo mdog dkar mo/g.yas na phreng ba dang dpal be+e'u/ g.yon pad+ma dang bum pa bsnams pa/zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rol pas bum pa'i steng na bzhugs pa'o/ /mi 'jigs pa sred len ma zhes bya ba'i ④sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la a las byung ba'i lha mo mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas na 'bras kyi snye ma/ g.yon na me long phreng ba dang bcas pa bsnams pa'o/ /rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rol pas bzhugs pa'o/ /dka' thub chen mo zhes bya ba'i sgol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //40—1309

pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la tai las byung ba'i lha mo mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma ①g.yas skyabs sbyin ⑤g.yon ut+pa la bsnams pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing zhabs rol pas bzhugs pa/ rkun po dang ①chom rkun las rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i sgol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la dze+e las byung ba'i lha mo mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas na rma bya'i sgro bsnams pa/ g.yon skyabs sbyin pa'i phyag gis ut+pa la bsnams pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rol pas bzhugs pa'o/ /sbrul las skyob par byed pa zhes bya ba'i rjosgrol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du hūṃ las byung ba'i lha mo mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas skyabs sbyin pa/ g.yon da la dang bcas pa'i skyabs sbyin pa—/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rol pas bzhugs pa'o/ /seng ge'i 'jigs pa las skyob par byed pa zhes bya ba'i dusgrol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du a las byung ba'i lha mo mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ rgyan thams cad dang ldan pa phyag g.yas rjon zla ba bsnams shing skyabs sbyin par mdzad pa/ g.yon byed la bsnams shing skyabs sbyin par mdzad pa/ zhabs rol pas me'i sa bon las gzhal ⑦bar mdzad pa'o/ /me 40—1310

las skyob par byed pa zhes bya ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du oṃ las byung ba'i lha mo mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ rgyan thams cad dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas skyabs sbyin pa/g.yon byed la dang bcas pa'i skyabs sbyin pa/ zhabs rol pa dang bcas pas glang po che ①mnan pa'o/ /glang po che las skyob pa zhes bya ba'i sgol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du hūṃ las byung ba'i lha mo mdog dkar ljang zhal gcig phyag gnyis paske/ g.yas skyabs sbyin pa'i phyag rgyas srin lag mthe bong gis mnan pa'o/ /g.yon ut+pa la dang bcas pa'i skyabs ④sbyin pa'o/ /rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing zhabs rol pas stag la bcibs pa'o/ /stag las skyob pa zhes bya ba'i sgol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la lo las byung ba'i lha mo mdog sngo ljang / zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas skyabs sbyin zhing / g.yon da la thugs kar skyabs sbyin dang bcas pas bzung ba'o/ /rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing zhabs 7rol pas chu'i steng du bzhugs pa'o/ /chu las skyob par byed pa zhes bya ba'i ⑤sgol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //pad+ma dang zla ba dang bunyi ma'i steng du hriḥ⑦las byung ba'i lha mo mdog dmar 40—1311

mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ rgyan thams cad dang ldan pa/ g.yas skyabs sbyin pa/ g.yon ut+pa la'i steng du lcags kyus mtshan pa bsnams pa'o① /zhabs rol pas mi'i dbang po mnan pa'o/ /rang gi lus kyi 'od zer dmar pos de'i lus bkang la rang gi gnas su bzhag go/ /zhi mdzad ma zhes bya ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs so// //de nas thub pa'i lha mo zhes bya ba'i sgrol ma ni/ sngar bstan pa'i cho ga las bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor du sa bon lnga pa'i ④sde tshan gyi dang po la dang po gnyis pas mnan la zla ①tshes phyed pa'i thig les brgyan pa'o/ /de las grub pa'i sgrol ma bsgom par bya'o/ /mchog tu rnam par mdzes ma/ zhal gcig pa yid du 'ong ba mo ljang gu phyag gnyis marjo/ g.yas mchog sbyin pa g.yon ⑤ut+pa la 'dzin pa'o/ /pad+ma dang zla ba la gnas pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan par bsam mo/ /lag pa gnyis thal mo sbyar la mdzub mo gnyis kyis gung mo'i sen mo bkab la srin lag nang du bcug ⑥ste mthe bong mnan pa ni ut+pa la kha bye ba'i phyag rgya'o—/ /oṃ tā re turtswa re tu re swā hā/ de nas snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer bhu'aphros pas dzaḥ④dang hūṃ la sogs pas ⑨ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor spyan drangs la gzhug cing dbang du bya'o/ /gnas gsum la ⑩ni rdo rje gsum/ /byin gyis brlabs la sku la sogs/ /'khor lo pad+ma rdo rje dang / /oṃ ābyuhūṃ las rtag pa dang / /'od dpag med dang mi bskyod pa/ /de nas thugs ka'i sa bon las/ /'od 'phros ye shes sems dpa' ni/ /snga ma'i tshul can spyan drangs te⑪/ /dbang bskur rigs kyi bdag po ni/ /'od dpag med kyis ⑫spyi bor brgyan/ /40—1312

de nas sa bon las byung ba'i/ /'od kyi lha yi spro bsdu las/ /skyo na thugs ka'i sa bon las/ /'od 'phros snod bcud ma lus zhu/ /bdag kyang sa bon de dag las/ /shin tu phra ①bar bsam mi khyab/ /rnam par mi rtog de dmigs shing / /nam mkha'i dkyil ltar rab dben pa/ /bde bar gshegs pa kun gyi gnas—/ /de nas skyo na bzlas pa ni/ /'bum phrag bzhi'am 'on te drug /'bum phrag bcu yis las rnams 'grub/ /rnal 'byor pa ni gang zhig gis/ /'di don nyams su gang len pa/ /thog ma tha ma med zhi ba'i/ /sgol ma yum mchog nyid gyur sdenas/ /dngos grub gnyis sogs 'thob 'gyur te/ /yon tan dpag med 'byung bar gsungs/ /de ltar stong dang snying rje'i bdag nyid gasrid pa gsum skyes zad nges shes dang ni/ /shes bya gnyis su med sku kun du bzang po'i rjospyod pa'i bdag nyid sna tshogs yum/ /bcom ldan 'das ma'i sgrub thabs rgyud 'dzin legs ⑤bkod pa las bsod nams dri ma med/ /bdag gis gang thob des ni 'gro ba ma lus rtag bde mya ngan 'das thob shog /lha mo sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs brgya rtsa brgyad pa zhes bya ba/ slob dpon chen po tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ kā ra shrī rjodzñā na dang / lo tsā ⑦ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur ba'o/ /slad kyis rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta dā na shī la ⑧dang / bod kyi lo tsā ⑨ba blo gros grags pas bcos te gtan la phab pa'o// //40—1313

rag /tshe 'phel ba'i cho ga①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ā yurlusnya ni bi dhiḥ/ bod skad du/ tshe 'phel ba'i cho ga /rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngon du gsungs pa'i rim pas sgol ma dkar mo zhal gcig pa phyag gnyis pa/ skyil mo krung du bzhugs par bsgoms te/ thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du sa bon gyi yi ge blta'o/ /de la 'od 'phros pas mdun gyi nam mkha' la mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa sku mdog dkar po mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya can yum dang bcas pa/ phyag gi steng na rin po che'i bum pa can gyi mdun du mi bskyod pa sngon po g.yas pa sa gnon/ g.yon rin po che'i bum pa can gyis yum la 'khyud pa/ g.yas su rin 'byung gser btso ma'i mdog can phyag g.yas mchog sbyin—/ g.yon ni snga ma'i tshul dang mtshungs so/ /rgyab tu rnam snang dmar po/g.yas byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can/ g.yon du don yod grub pa ljang gu 40—1317

skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya can te rigs lnga dang / yum thams cad ni rang snang gi yum mo/ /de dag la byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor bar dmigs te/ skyabs 'go la sogs pa tshul bzhin du bya'o/ /tshe 'phel bar gsol ba gdab pa ni/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te a mi tā bhā wa ti ta thā ga ta/sarba budha bo bye satwa l+ya a haṃ ā yurlusnya ni/ s+thā ṇa warnya ni/ dz+re ba wasnya ni/ a dhijo na a dhiṣ+ṭṛ te swā hā/ zhes pa dang / snang ba mtha' yas la sogs pa yab rnams kyis so so'i yum la bskul te tshe'i dngos grub brtan par byas nas/bdag nyid la dbang bskur ba'i sbyor ba la zhugs te 'dug par bsam/ bdag nyid kyang spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga kha phye ste snying ga'i chu skyes la gnas pa'i 'byung ba bzhi'i rtsa kha phye ste/ rtsa thams cad so sor kha phye bar bsam/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la 'chi med kyi dbang bskur te/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun tshangs pa'i bu ga nas blugs pas rtsa thams cad khengs pa dang / khyad par du chu skyes kyi rtsa lnga gang bas srog 'dzin pa rnal du tshud de 'chi ba med par bsam zhing sngags 'di nyer gcig bzlas so/ /oṃ tā re tut+ta re tu re ā yurlur+bha ka dha bh+yaḥswā hā/ zhes pas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams snang ba mtha' yas hu)la 'dus te/ de dbu rgyan gyi tshul du bdag gi spyi bor byon pas tshe brtan par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan rnams gshegs su gsol/ des skyo nas ldang bar 'dod na mi dmigs pas zin pa'i dge ba bsngo'o/ /snga ma ltar thun bzhi la sogs pa bsgoms na zla ba drug gis 'chi ba med pa'i dngos grub tu 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang ci rigs pas kyang 'phel lo/ /sgrol ma tshe spel ba zhes bya ba'i rig pa/slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //40—1318

ma hā paṇ+ḍi ②ta rat+na rak+ṣi ta'i zhal snga nas/ lo tsā ba zhang grub pa dpal bzang pos bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/1317 lamatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / chos tshan 'di 〈〈pe 〉sngasnar 〉〉la mi bzhugs pas 〈〈co 〉〉dang dpe bsdur byas yod/1318 ①〈〈co 〉mi yas/1319 ①〈〈co 〉〉sgartsi/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2291)40wa 1319

༄ga /dpal chen mo sgol ma'i bstod pa zhes bya ba/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī ma hā tā rā sdesto tra na ma④/ bod skad du/dpal chen mo sgrol ma'i bstod pa zhes bya ba/ dpal chen mo sgol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhi ba'i gong khyer 'jug la grong sgo'i mi mo bzod byas 'dra ba dang //rgyal ba'i lam du 'jug la dbyibs can mdun na gnas pa'i gzhung lam lta bu dang / /shin tu bzlog par dka' ba'i bdud kyi rgyu las thar mdzad yang na gsang sngags lha/ /kho bo blo gros blun po 'dis ni dpal chen mo bstod bgyi ba ji lta lags/ /gang yang rgyal sras bde bar gshegs pa'i rigs 'dzin sa bcu'i pha rol phyin rnams kyi/ /khyod kyi yon tan rin chen tshogs ni gsal mdzad lha rnams kyis kyang gru len te/ /de lta na yang gus pa 'ba' zhig gis bstod lha mo bdag la bzod mdzod kye/ /mi shes byis pa yis ni rang gi ma la thal kyis 'thor ba min nam rjoci/ /mtha' dag mi dbang 'dus pa'i gtsug gi 40—1320

nor bu rnams kyis btud byas 'dam skyes zhabs/ /gdugs dkar thig le gyen du 'bar zhing sa bdag sa kyi 'dod pa yis ni 'gyur/ /rnam rgyas rdzing bur skyes pa'i 'od 'phrog spyan ①gyis gang la gzigs gyur de la ni/ /bcom ldan glang chen seng ge'i gdan rta shing rta khyerkang thang mchog rnams rjes su 'gro/ /rang gi phyag gi stobs kyis nyer skyes rnam grangs pha rol gnon pas dgra rnams thul / /'bar ba chen po dkyil 'khor mchog gi phun sum tshogs gyur mi bdag rnams la ni/ /ster bar bsngags shing nges 'byed sngags kyi yul la mi dbang blon po'i blor gyur la/ /ri skyibs zab mor sa phug zab mo'i gzhi la rnal 'byor rnams kyis 'dzin par 'gyur/ /rab tu myos pa ①pad+ma'i tshal la ma la yar rjorlung dal bus g.yo zhing bskyod/ /'dab ma rnams la phul byung bung ba'i tshogs kyis nye bar glu len me tog gi/ /'byung gnas ya mtshan mdzes ma byed yin lha mo byed kyi bsngags pa rnams kyis ni/ /rgyal srid 'bras bu 'grub mdzad 'gram rgyas rtsi logs myos chu'i mtshan la 'gro/ /byed zhabs bka' drin gyis ni rang dbang khang pa'i skyed mos tshal la yun ring du/ /rtsed mos ⑤spro la spyan mig drag tu g.yo zhing dga' mchog rnams kyis ni/ /zhal gyi pad+ma'i dbugs rlung gis bskyod rjobud med rnams dang nye bar longs spyad nas/ /de ni a phra ⑦sar pas bran las dri zhim sbrang rtsi rnams la 'thung bar 'gyur/ /rab dga'i nags la me tog khur 'phyang myos pa'i skad snyan khu byug gis khyab cing / /sbrang rtsis myos pa'i bung ba ⑧tshogs pa'i dar dir ldan la so ga'i dpal yin te/ /'o ma'i rgya mtsho rlabs phreng g.yo bar bzhad gad ku mu da yi 'byung gnas dang / /shel kyi sa gzhi bla gab med par phul byung zla ba'i cha shas byed nyid ⑨lags/ /bzo bos 40—1321

byas pa'i rtsed mo'i ri ①rtser bkod pa zla ba snenor bu'i chu rgyun ni/ /bsrubs pa 1'khrul 'khor chu srin kha nas 'thon cing rnyog bral lhung lhung sgrogs rjopa'i chu/ /dpyid dus chang gis myos zhing tshim pa'i dukhu byug skad snyan sgogs bupa'i nam mkha' la/ /sa skyong gis sprul khang pa dpe med pa la rab tu gnas mdzad byed nyid lags/ /glang chen mche ba mnyen ⑦la bzo bos skar khung dra mig las 'thon bya 'dab la/ /gnas shing rnam par sgeg bcas stsos pa'i phug ron sgra snyan mgrin pa nas grag ste/ /nor bu'i rkang gdub mchog tu 'jam zhing sil khrol bskyod pa btsun mo'i dkyil 'khor du/ /sa skyong dag gi khyim la ti se'i gangs mtshungs phun sum tshogs pa byed nyid las⑧/ /nu mar nyer bzhag lag pa gcig ④gis smad gos gsher ⑩ba g.yo ba'i mtha' bzung ste/ /rkyal zhing rtsed mo'i bde ba yun ring myos nas khang pa'i rdzing bu nas 'thon cing / /skye bo ⑪ 'dris pas skra rtse zlum shing cung zad zur mig lta ba tsha ba'i dus/ /ri mo bris 'dra'i yan lag mchog ma rnams dang nyams dga' byed kyi mthu yis su/ /zla ba'i chos las brdungs shing 'khrul 'khor khang khyim rtsed mo'i ri las bab/ /rab tu myos pa'i nags kyi nye ⑫logs pad+ma'i ljon shing khang par sa bdag rnams//rgyun chad med par rlung yab dal bus g.yabs pa yis ni dbu skra g.yo zhing bskyod//nyi ma tsha ba'i dus la byed kyi bka' drin las ⑫ni nyin zhag 'da' bar 'gyur/ /chu 'bab sprin tshogs 'brug sgra sgrogs shing rma bya'i dkyil 'khor kun nas skad ⑫ snyan 'don/ /'dam skyes me thon la ni 'jam rlung rab tu g.yo zhing glu dbyangs chu gter dus/ /snyan dngags ⑫mkhas pa'i dri zas bskor zhing 'jam ⑩pos bsnun pa'i gting ring ⑩rnga skad kyis/ /khang pa'i nang rnams yongs su gang ba 40—1322

spyod 'dod pas ni rgyun du thos par 'gyur/ /sbrang rtsi'i chang gis myos shing rig ①'dzin grub pa'i chung ma'i chu skyes zhal la btud byas las/ /lhung ba'i marnya ra yi rdul kyis kun nas mdog ser ma pang mtsho las rgyal/ /lha yi grong khyer gzhal med khang gi lha mo'i skye bo dam 'khyud spro ba ⑤la/ /khyed kyi mchog la sgrub pa po rnams bde nyid nyin rer rjes su myong bar 'gyur/ /sna tshogs 'gugs sngags phyag rgya'i tshogs sprul rdo rje'i gur kyis me stag 'bar ba la/ /bgegs kyi gtso bo rnams ni skrag cing 'jigs pas rgya mtsho dag tu 'bros 'gyur te/ /myur bar bskyod pa gtum po'i hūṃ yig sgra yis bsnun pas sgra ldan lcags sgog gtor/ /lha mo khyed kyi gsang sngags zlos ④pa'i khang par rang nyid 'du zhing 'ong bar 'gyur/ /gar gnas khang sa'i skyor la glu dbyangs 'du sar rab brdungs gting rjoring rnga skad kyis/ /'dris shing yid 'ong gling bu'i rjes 'gro'i sgra dbyangs nye bar longs ⑤spyod mdzad nas ni/ /de rjes gya tshom rjobung ba me tog snyim par gar kyi cho ga yid 'phrog la/ /rab tu myos ma rnams kyis khyed nyid gar gyi dpon por nges par gar gyi lha/ /rgyun chad med par lag pa'i rtsol ba'i bya bas bsnun pa'i yid 'ong rdza rnga'i bzhin/ /g.yer ka'i ④sgra yis myur bar rnam rol 'degs shing rma bya'i mjug sgro rna bar btsugs⑧/ /rnam pa sna tshogs mkhas shing yid 'ong snod ldan skye bos yongs gang khang khyim la/ /khyed la brten pas bde ldan ⑨ glu dbyangs bde ba nyin rer bde la longs spyod 'gyur/ /rgyal mtshan dang ni gdugs dkar seng ge'i gdan dang gser gyi bum pa rnga yab dang / /zla zer dkar ba'i bsil khang mgyogs 'gro'i phreng ba dri zhim chang ldan glang chen rnams/ /r+ṣa kyi gzugs brnyan rtag tu dran byed bud med de yi ⑩rna lung rin chen 'od/ /40—1323

lha mo cung zad bzhad pa'i rnam pas rnam par rgyal ba ①de ma thag tu 'gyur/ /skad snyan ngang pa'i dbyangs ni mchog tu 'gying 'gro nor bu'i rkang gdub sgra yis pham—/ /'gram logs dkyil 'khor 'jam rlung gis bdar ⑧g.yo zhing 'khyil pa'i sgra yis mdud pa 'byed/ /rked smad mdoms kyi cha ni 'od 'phro'i do shal nu ma'i khung bu'i ljid kyis dud/ /lha mos gang la gzigs pa de la rnga yab dkar 'dzin bud med 'du bar 'gyur/ /rgyun mi 'chad par lha mo khyod kyi yon tan rjes dran mi skyo gang yin de/ /nor bu'i rang bzhin zhal ba'i gzhi mar zla zer lo 'dab rnams la ①'gying ba yis/ /nu mar lag gcig nyer gzhag rjobud med skye bo dag gis bzung ④ba'i ga bur chu/ /kha 'bus ut+pal sngon po dri ldan sbrang rtsi 'thungs 'gyur mi 'jigs sbyin pa kyerjo/ /mo btsun rnams kyi 'gram pa'i logs la rna rgyan mchog tu 'gying zhing rgod/ /spyan mig la yang khro ba so mas bskyed pa'i mchi ma'i chu yis dba' rlabs g.yo/ /mkhregs ⑦shing 'bur ba nu ma so ma'i tshogs la gur gum 'dam gyis ⑧kha dog ser/ /rab rib sngon po dbu skra me tog kha 'bus tshogs la'ang mchog tu dga' bar 'gyur/ /sprul byas pad+ma rā ⑨ga'i stegs la 'gre ldog 'gyur ba lha mo'i skye bo las/ /sprul te gcal bkram mu tig do shal gyis khyab rin chen ljon shing khang pa'i nang / /des lhung me tog rdul gyis kun nas yongs bsgos ⑩dga' ba'i sa yi dkyil 'khor la/ /bcom ldan 'das ma ༷༷ kyi zhabs zung mchod byed gang de yun ring gnas par 'gyur/ /skad cig re rer rnga ring rdza rnga mtha' dag brdungs pa'i sgra yis rkang pa 'gying / /glang po mdzangs pa'i spyi la lag pa'i rna lcag ⑪rab 'god phyed btsugs ⑫mig /a phra sar bran dri zhim 'bab cing 'gram pa'i dkyil 'khor dri ldan glang chen 40—1324

rnams—/ /bcom ldan 'das ma mi gang yud tsam dran byed de la 'du bar 'gyur//spyi bo phug pas steng du 'bur te rna ba'i rnga yab dang ni be+egs kyu g.yo/ /rkang pa srung byed rnams kyi rnam mang ca co'i bde bas chu thigs zer ①ma 'thor rab tu rgol ba'i glang chen chang gis khong 'khrugs ②khyed mtshan grags pa las/ /glang po ①mi rnams g.yul 'gyed rjopa na dgra bo'i sgrib pa rnams kyis rjosgrib par 'gyur—/ /gser gyi rang bzhin ri yi duskyibs dang lha yi skyed dze+emos tshal gyi khang pa dang / /mjug sgo rnam par rgyas pa'i rma bya rtsed mor gnas pa sa bdag khang pa dang / /nam mkha' chu bo'i rlabs kyis byas pa dri med rin chen ljon shing khang pa dang / /bud med skye bo'i zhal gyi pad+ma'i 'byung gnas la yang gnas mdzad spyod nyid do/ /pad+ma'i skyo ma sbrang rtsi'i khu ba'i chang gi btung bas sred cing bskoraske—/ /sbrang bu'i tshogs pas dar dir mang ldan me tog tshogs pa'i dri zhim ldan—/ /ngang pa'i rgyal po rab dga'i tshogs kyis zos te pad+ma gzhon nus mche ba gcigs/ / pad+ma'i lha mo'i ⑨ze 'bru'i rdul gyi mdog ser rlabs ldan ⑩yun ring gnas par 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das ma rgyal ba dkon mchog cod ⑪pan spyi bor ldan pa pad+ma'i rigs/ /khyod nyid kun don mdzad par lha rnams kyis kyang bstod de mang po smra ⑫mod kyi/ /de slad lha mo khyod kyis bstod pa 'di yis mchog tu dge ba bdag gis kyang / /gang thob de yis 'gro ba khyad gsod dbul ba'i 'jigs pa zhi bar shog /paṇ+ḍi ta chen po tsan+t+ra go mis mdzad pa'i dpal chen mo sgrol ma'i bstod pa rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta chen po rgyal ba'i snyan gyi zhal snga nas/ lo tsā ⑫ba shākya'i dge slong nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyis lo tsā ④ba blo gros rgyal pos bsgyur ba las cung zad 40—1325
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2292)40wa 1327

༄ga /'phags ma sgol ma la bstod pa tshigs su bcad pa babyu gnyis pa/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya tā rā ⑤sto tra da sha dwo ①gā thā/ bod skad du/ 'phags ma sgrol ma la bstod pa tshigs su bcad pa bcu gnyis pa/rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bzlog dka'i srid pa'i mun pa ni/ /'joms byed nyi ma'i 'od dang mtshungs/ /thugs rjes brlan pa'i thugs mnga' ba'i/ /sgol ma la ni rtag tu 'dud/ /shin tu rmongs pa'i sems can gyis/ /glang po che rnams gsod byed ma/ /lha mo seng ge khros pa yang / /khyod 'dud pa las 'jigs shing bros/ /mche ba'i mdung ④rtse rtse mo yis/ /brag 'joms shing drung rtsa ba 'don/ /khyod kyi sngags kyis ⑤bzlas pa las/ /'jigs shing glang po 'bros par 'gyur/ /phyogs dang nam mkha' ma lus pa'i/ /du bas khyab cing bzod par dka'/ /'bar ba yis ni khro tshig pa/ /khyod bstod rjochar pa me zhir 'gyur/ /ma rungs dze+egadengs ka las byung ba'i/ /phuṭa ⑧40—1328

sgra sgogs shing ①dug mig can/ /sbrul ni lha mo khyod bstod pas/ /nam mkha' lding ni bzhin du 'joms/ /ral gris gcod pa'i 'gro ba rnams/ /khrag gis yan lag bskus pa ste/ /khyod kyi ming tsam dran pa yis/ /chom rkun nus pa med par 'gyur/ /rgyal po khros pa'i bran rnams kyis/ /skra nas bzung nas zhags pas bcings/ /btson ra spangs nas lha mo kye/ /khyod la bstod byed 'jigs med 'gyur/ /dba' rlabs tshogs ni nam mkha' dang / /phyogs bcur yang ni khyab byed pa/ /gru log na yang rgya mtsho las/ /khyod kyis 'phangs nas pha rol phyin/ /khrag dang glad pa'i 'dam gyis byugs/ /de dag bza' ba la chags pa/ /lha mo khyod kyi sngags bzlas pas/ /sha za de dag 'jigs par 'gyur/ /yan lag chad cing dri ngan pa'i/ /khrag dang zhag ni sna la 'dzag /khyod ni dran pa tsam gyis ni/ /mdze can 'dod pa'i lha ②'drar 'gyurarka/ /bkres skom gyis gdungs gcer bu dang / /slong ba'i yi dwags 'gro ba la/ /khyod la 'dud pa tsam gyis ni/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur—/ /'jigs pa chen po 'jigs med pa/ /de ltar dad pas khyod bstod pas/ /dge ba gang bsags de yis ni/ /'jig rten bde ba can thob shog /rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la bstod pa slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa/ tshigs su bcad pa bcu gnyis pa rdzogs so// //40—1329

bsdur mchan/1328 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉spo〈snar 〉ring/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉8/ kwa〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉padungs/ rjo〈'dir 〉stekyi/ rjo〈〈pe 〉sko'adir 〉〉stod/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉lus/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉paṭa/1329 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉cing / ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉lhar/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2293)40wa 1330

༄ga /'phags ma sgol ma'i bstod pa chun las sgrub pa zhes bya ba/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya tā rā ②sto tram̐ bhi ①sa karmā sā dha nā ma/bod skad du/ 'phags ma sgrol ma'i bstod pa phrin las sgrub pa zhes bya ba/bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /t+t+waṃ yig ljang gu ut+pal las byung ba'i—/ / sgrol ma ④sku mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ /phyag gnyis sku la rin chen sna tshogs spras/ /yi dam sgol ma lha la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /don grub la sogs rigs lngas dbu brgyan cing / /bcu drug lo lon 'dzum pa'i ⑤bzhin dang ldan/ /gzi brjid bzod dka' sna tshogs lhag par 'dud/ /yi dam sgol ma lha la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phyag g.yas mchog sbyin phyag g.yon ut+pal 'dzin/ /sna tshogs pad+ma zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum tshul gyis rab tu bzhugs/ /yi dam sgrol ma lha la phyag 'tshal bstod—/ /thugs rje'i spyan kyis 'gro la rtag tu gzigs/ /sku la 'jigs pa 40—1331

brgyad skyob ①sgrol ma 'phro/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal kun las sgol byed pa'i/ /yi dam sgol ma lha la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang drag po dang / /las tshogs thams cad myur du grub mdzad ma/ /phrin las thams cad yongs su grub byed pa'i/ /yi dam sgrol ma lha la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /seng ge glang chen me sbrul chom rkun dang / /lcags sgog chu dang bgegs dang 'jigs pa brgyad—/ /'jigs pa kun las yongs su sgrol byed pa'i/ /yi dam sgrol ma lha la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gdon dang rims dang sbyo 'bog la sogs dang / /gnod byed la sogs dus min 'chi bas skrag /sdug bsngal thams cad rab tu zhi byed pa'i/ /yi dam sgol ma lha la phyag 'tshal bstod①/ /skye bo sngon bsags las dang nyon mongs kyi/ /mtshams med lnga dang mi dge bcu sogs sdig /sdig pa'i las rnams bdag gis ci bsags pa/ /de dag thams cad ma lus byang bar shog /bdag ni da ltar skye ba 'di la yang / /rmi ngan mtshan ngan 'chi ltas dus min skrag /bkra mi shis pa thams cad dag gyur nas/ /tshe dang bsod nams longs spyod rgyas par shog /bdag ni ma 'ongs skye ba thams cad du//yi dam sgrol ma rjes su dran gyur nas/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub la sogs pa/ /las tshogs thams cad yid bzhin grub par shog /yi dam sgrol ma thugs rje che ldan pa/ /bdag gis rab tu brtse ba'i gdung sems kyis/ /bstod pa bgyis pa'i bsod nams gang bsags des/ /yi dam sgol ma lha dang mi 'bral shog /'phags ma sgol ma'i bstod pa phrin las thams cad sgrub pa zhes bya ba/ slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //40—1332

bsdur mchan/1331 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/②〈〈pe 〉snga'adir 〉〉ta ra/②〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉༅/ ④〈〈pe〉sko'ar 〉bosgrolam/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉sngasnar 〉bo'adzumapa'i/1322 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉skyabs/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pho/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2294)40wa 1333

das /'phags ma lha mo sgol ma la bstod pa me tog zeng ba zhes bya ba/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya tā rā de bī ④sto tra put+pa mā ④li nā ma/bod skad du/ 'phags ma lha mo sgrol ma la bstod pa me tog phreng ba zhes bya ba/mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rje'i spyan gyis 'gro la gzigs pa'i/ /zhabs kyi pad+mo ngal ni btud de/ /tshogs gnyis rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir du/ /lhag pa'i lha la bstod par bya'o/ /phyag 'tshal sgol ma lha yi lha khyod/ /dngos grub ma lus kun kyi 'byung gnas/ /yid bzhin nor bu rin po che ltar/ /'dod pa'i 'bras bu ster bar mdzad ma/ /phyag 'tshal ngo mtshar khyad du 'phags pa'i/ /yon tan thams cad sdogs pa'i sku la/ /ye shes lnga yi rang mdangs rgyas pas/ /thugs rje'i 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro ma/ /phyag 'tshal chu bzhi'i pha rol legs gnas/ /las dang nyon mongs srid las rnam grol/ /sangs rgyas yon 40—1334

tan phyir mi ①ldog pa'i/ /sa lam ma lus mtha' ru phyin ma/ /phyag 'tshal srid pa'i dra ba 'joms mdzad/ /thugs kyi snying po yi ge bcu pas/ /zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang mngon spyod/ /phrin ②las 'od kyis nam mkha' gang ma/ /phyag 'tshal 'gro ba'i skyabs mchog sgol ma/ /bud med gzugs kyis 'gro ba 'dul mdzad/ /dpal ldan 'jig rten dbang phyug sras mo/ /'phags pa'i spyan chab las ni 'khrungs ma/ /phyag 'tshal 'gran zla med pa'i sku mchog /zag med bde rgyas ①zla ba'i gdan la/ /bzhugs pa'i zhabs kyi pad+mo la ni/ /lha dang lha min cod pan gtugs ma/ /phyag 'tshal che ba'i nang na che mchog /'byung po ro langs ma rungs rjotshogs 'joms/ /gzhan gyis mi thub drag rtsal chen mo/ /stobs chen pha rol gnon par mdzad ma/ /phyag 'tshal sgol ma 'khor ba sgrol mdzad/ /bcom ldan 'das ma khyod kyi zhabs la/ /skyabs pa'i mi de mya ngan 'das thob/ /mchog gi don chen 'grub par mdzad ma/ /phyag 'tshal seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma/ /rigs drug bur 'dzin brtse ba'i thugs kyi④//snying rje chen po'i gru gzings kyis ni/ /srid gsum 'khor ba'i mtsho las sgol ma//phyag 'tshal phongs pa kun las skyob mdzad/ /'tsho dhibs mnar te mchu mgul skams nas/ /bkres pas khyod la gsol ba btab pas/ /longs spyod mi zad char rgyun 'be+ebs ma/ /phyag 'tshal dpa' mo rdo rje sgrol ma/ /'dzam bu chu bo'i gser gyi mdog can/ /rdo rje la sogs phyag mtshan brgyad kyis⑦/ /phrin las rnams kyi 'gro don mdzad ma/ /phyag 'tshal skye 'gro rnams la dbang bsgyurarjo//'jig rten gsum na mthu ⑨rtsal ldan pa'i/ /dregs pas stsos pa rnams kyi cod pan—/ /khyod kyi zhabs kyi mthil gyis brdzis ma/ /phyag 'tshal thub dbang 40—1335

stobs bcu'i rtsal ldan/ /sku lnga'i rang bzhin khyab bdag chen mo/ /bsrung med gsum dang ma 'dres dran gsum/ /yongs su dag pa bzhi pa mnga' ma /phyag 'tshal srid pa'i 'ching ba las gol/ /ye shes sku la rdzu 'phrul thogs med/ /thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes/ /sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i dri ma dag maske/ /phyag 'tshal mthu stobs bdag mo'i snying po/ /yi ge bcu pa spyi bor btags nas/ /dpung tshogs sde ①bzhi'i nang du phyin pas/ /pha rol dmag gi g.yul ngo bzlog ma/ /phyag 'tshal mdon dang brtse ba'i bdag nyid/ /bsam gtan ting 'dzin rnam thar mang pos/ /brgyan pa'i gter mdzad dpal gyi be+e'ur/ /shes bya'i dkyil mtha' rtag tu chud ma/ /phyag 'tshal nyi ma 'bum gyi mdangs can/ /shes rab chen po'i 'od zer 'bar bas/ /khams gsum sems can rnams kyi rgyud la/ /ma rig sgo nga'i mun rum sel ma/ /phyag 'tshal ye shes lnga yi bdag nyid/ /dpal ldan dri ma med pa'i sku la/ /mtshan mchog sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis brgyan/ /dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus spras ma/ /phyag 'tshal khams gsum dbang du sdud ma/ /tshangs pa khyab 'jug ma hā de ba/ /lha chen rnams kyi dbu yi cod pan/ /byed kyi zhabs la rab tu btud ma/ /phyag 'tshal 'jigs ②pa kun las skyob mdzad/ /me dang chu dang rgyal po'i chad pa—/ /stag dang seng ge sbrul dang srin po/ /glang po che yi bred dngangs ①sel ma—/ /phyag 'tshal byin rlabs rjormad du gyur ma⑤/ /'byung ba 'khrugs dang gdon gyis bskyed pa'i/ /srog 'phrog nad kyi bye brag ma lus/ /khyod la gsol btab gdung ba sel ma/ /phyag 'tshal btsun mo rin chen cha byad/ /smin ma'i bar nas mdzod sru 'od 'bar/ /spyan dkyus byedal 'dab rjo'adra'i 'dzum 40—1336

mdangs—/ /thugs rje chags pas 'gro la gzigs ma/ /phyag 'tshal stong nyid snying rje'i lcags kyus①/ /'khor ba'i 'dam nas ①'gro ba 'dren mdzad/ /shul nor 'phrang la thugs rjes bzung nas/ /thar pa'i lam la khrid par mdzad pa④—/ /phyag 'tshal bdud bzhi 'joms par mdzad ma/ /sangs rgyas kun dngos rje btsun ma khyod/ /phung po lnga spangs lnga yi bdag nyid/ /ye shes lnga rdzogs nyon mongs spangs ma/ /phyag 'tshal dge legs gzi brjid chen mo/ /zhal bzangs bcu drug zla ba rgyas 'dra'i/ /'od kyis skye 'gro rnams kyi rgyud laX/shes rab dpal dang blo gros spel ma/ /phyag 'tshal bud med sgyu 'phrul khyod la/ /mā ma kri dang spyan ma gos dkar/ /lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin rnams kyisarjo/ /che ba'i che mchog rnams kyis bstod ma/ /phyag 'tshal hūṃ gi sbyor ba dang ldan/ /gnas gsum du ni de nyid bkod pas/ /nus pa'i rdzu 'phrul mtha' la rgyas dhinas—/ /phrin las bzhi yi rtsal dang ldan ma/ /phyag 'tshal dge ba rgyas par mdzad ma/ /ji ltar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor shar bas/ /mun pa rang sar dag pa bzhin du/ /khyod bsgoms ⑦sgrib pa spong bar ⑧byed ma/ /phyag 'tshal phrin las du ma'i bdag mo/ /byed sku sna tshogs ngo bo shel bzhin/ /sku mdog phyag mtshan gcig tu ma nges/ /gang la nye bar tha dad 'char ma/ /phyag 'tshal don dam rgyal ba'i yum las/ /ma g.yos kun rdzob lha mo'i gzugs can/ /sku mdog sngo ljang gar gyi nyams dgus/ /bde gsal mi rtog pa yis 'gying ma/ /phyag 'tshal 'khor ba'i g.yul ngo bzlog ⑨ma/ /nga bdag dngos por zhen pa'i snying la/ /spros bral ye shes ral gri bsnun nas/ /gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa'i dpa' bo gsod ma/ /phyag 'tshal tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i dbu skra/ /mthon 40—1337

mthing lcang lo 'khyil pa'i dbus na/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med las—/ /thugs rje'i 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro mdzad/ /gang gis me tog phreng ba'i bstod pa/ klog gam kha don 'don par byed pa/ /de yis bsod nams dpag med 'thob cing / /sdig sgrib stobs chen ma lus dag 'gyur/ /gang zhig skye bo tha mal rnams kyis/ /'di 'don pa de dge sbyong du 'gyur/ /gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis byin gyis rlob 'gyur/ /su yis ①blo la bstod pa 'di 'dzin/ /'dul khrims sdom pa dam tshig rnams kyi// nyes byas sbom ④pa rtsa rtsang dri ma/ /ma lus dag nas dngos grub thob 'gyur/ /'di 'don blo yi pad+ma kha 'byed/ /rgol ba ngan pa'i lung rigs tshar gcod/ /rig pa'i gnas la shes rab chen po/ /zla ba yar ngo bzhin du 'phel 'gyur/ /e ma bstod pa'i rgyal po 'di ni/ /lan cig yid la dran pa tsam gyis/ /zhing mchog dam pa bde ba can der/ /the tshom med par nges par skye 'gyur/ /'gro ba'i skyabs mchog rje btsun ma la/ /bdag gis ①me tog phreng bas bstod pa'i / /dge ba gru gzings lta bu des ni/ /srid gsum 'khor ba'i mtsho las sgrol 'gyur/ /me tog phreng ba'i bstod pa 'di ni/ rje btsun ma la lnga brgya pa rnams kyi thuthams cad mkhyen pa'i khur che ba'i yon tan du ma dang ldan pa/ slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mi zhes bya bas bstod pa rdzogs so// //40—1338

bsdur mchan/1334 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉ring de bi/①〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉mthu shā ma/ 0〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉thed+ma/1335 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ni/ ②〈〈snar 〉toraphrin/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉can/ bya〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉mthus/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉4)sa/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉patsho/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉kyi/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bskur/ ⑨〈〈snar 〉〉thu/1336 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bde/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉zorajig ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanangang / 0〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉brlab/⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stanas/ du〈〈pe 〉〉dgu ut+pal me tog 〈〈snar 〉〉dgu udrul mdog1337 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stanapa' mo bdud kyi dpung 'joms/ ②〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉pas/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/bu〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉skabams gsum mun pa 'joms mdzad/ du〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉skyul/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsgom/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉spangs par/ ⑨〈〈snar 〉〉zlog1338 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉7pe/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉nyes byas bsam/ 〈〈snar 〉〉ter byas bsam/ ③〈〈snar 〉nyan/ ④〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyis/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2295)40wa 1339

༄ga /'phags ma lha mo sgol ma la bstod pa zhes bya ba/①༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya tā re de bī sto tra ④nā ma①/ bod skad du—/ 'phags ma lha mo sgol ma la bstod pa zhes bya ba/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la ④ phyag 'tshal lo/ /bzlog dka' srid pa'i mun pa ni/ /'joms byed nyi ma'i 'od dang mtshungs/ /thugs rjes brlan pa'i thugs mnga' ba/ /sgol ma la ni rtag tu 'dud/ /shin tu rno ba'i sems rnams kyis/ /glang po che rnams gsol byed pa/ /lha mo seng ge khros pa yang / /khyed bstod pa las 'jigs shing 'bros/ /mche ba'i mdung rtse rnon po yis/ /brag 'joms shing gi rtsa ba 'don/ /khyod kyi sngags ni bzlas pa bulas/ /'jigs shing glang chen 'bros par 'gyur/ /phyogs dang nam 'kha' ma lus pa/ /du bas khyab cing bzod par dka'/ /'bar ba yis ni khro butshig pa/ /khyod bstod char pas me zhir ④'gyur/ /ma rungs gdengs ka las byung ba'i/ / phuṭa sgra sgrogs ⑧shing 40byed1340

dug mang can/ /sbrul ni lha mo khyod bstod pas/ /nam mkha' lding ni bzhin ①du 'jigs/ /ral gris ②gcod cing 'dral ba rnams/ /khrag gis yan lag bskus pa ste/ /khyod kyi ming tsam dran pa yis/ /chom rkun nus pa med par 'gyur—/ /rgyal po khros pas ①bran rnams kyi/ /skra nas bzung zhing zhags pas bcings—/ /btson ra spangs te lha mo kye/ /khyod la bstod byed 'jigs med 'gyur—/ /dba' rlabs tshogs kyis phyogs bcu dang / /nam mkha' yang dag khyab byed pa/ /gru log na yang rgya mtsho las/ /khyod kyi 'phangs ni pha rol phyin//khrag dang klad pa'i 'dam gyis byugs/ /de dag bza' ba la chags pa/ /khyod la bstod pa tsam gyis ni/ /sha za de ltar 'jigs par 'gyur/ /yan lag chad cing dri nga ba/ /khrag dang rnag rjoni sna nas 'dzag /khyod la bstod pa tsam gyis ni/ /mdze can 'dod pa'i lha 'drar 'gyur/ /bkres skom kyis gdungs gcer bu dang / /slong ba yi dwags dang 'dra ba/ /khyod la bstod pa tsam kyis ni—/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur/ /'jigs pa chen po 'jigs byed pa/ /de ltar sems nas khyod bstod pas/ /dge ba gang bsags de yis ni—/ /'jig rten bde ba can thob shog /'phags ma sgol ma'i bstod pa slob dpon chen po tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //seng ge glang chen me sbrul chom rkun dang / /lcags sgrog chu dang sha za'i 'jigs pa ni/ /'joms mdzad zla 'od phung po ltar 'dzin ma/ /sgrol ma bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal 'dud// //40—1341
