dga' bde des rang rgyud rnyog pa dang bral nas/ rang gi yi dam gyi lha rje btsun ma sgrol ma mngon sum du mthong bar gyur cig /mthong nas kyang de'i gdams pa dri ma med pa bdud rtsi'i mchog la spyod pa dang / lus sems tshim par gyur cig /shi ma thag tu skye ba gzhan gyis bar ma chod pa g.yu lo brgyan pa'i zhing khams su pad+ma'i sdong po la rdzus ①te skyes nas sems can gyi khams dpag tu med pa sgol nas dpal mgon du gyur cig /dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa'i byin gyi rlabs ⑪kyis de bzhin du gyur cig /de nas rin po che la sogs pa'i snod shin tu mdzes pa'i nang du ①'bras la sogs pa'i kha zas sna tshogs pa la me tog dang 'bras bu la sogs pas brgyan pa la cha gnyis par byas/ sku gsung thugs kyi snying po lan bdun bsngags nas/ byin gyis brlabs rjopa la pad+ma kha phye ba'i phyag rgya byas la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs ma lus pa la dbul ba'i sngags 'di lan bdun bzlas te/ kha dog dang / dri ro phun sum tshogs pa la dmigs la dbul bar rjobya'o/ /oṃ na mo budha bo rjodhi satā māṃ a pra ti ha ta shā sa ṭ+wāṃ he te bha ga ba ti ma hā satā budha a ba lo ki te i rda ba dzi kṛṇ+ḍi kṛṇ+ḍa/ a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi khā nyi tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ de nas 'byung po thams cad la dbul ba ni/ oṃ a ⑦kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dhadrwa hūṃ ār+ya nuta pan+da tāta oṃ 26hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ ban+ta brnya/ ha na ha na/ gadz+dza ya galja ⑧ya/ bi sgo ṭa ya bi ⑨sgo ṭa ya sarba bispyon ⑩bi na ya ka ma hā ga na pa ti/ dzi bi tān+ta ka rā ⑩ya hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/⑫ dang po ni de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang bcas pa rnams la dbul bar bya⑫/gnyis pa ni phyogs skyong ba la sogs pa rnams la phul la phrin las su spyo 40—1398

gsol ba ni/ deng rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams la sku gsung thugs kyi 'khrul ba mi mnga' ba ltar che ge mo la sogs pa mnga' ris kyi 'bangs su mchis pa rnams la lus ngag yid gsum kyi 'khrul ba spang ba'i phyir brtse bas gzigs par mdzod cig① /rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa la rjes su chags pa dang khong khro ba med pa ltar che ge mo la sogs pa'i 'gro ba ma lus pa la ca co med pa'i chos ston par gyur cig /rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa la rmongs pa dang bsnyel ba med pas bsam gtan dang / rnam par thar pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang snyoms par 'jug pa la thogs pa med pa ltar che ge mo la sogs pa'i 'gro ba ma lus pa la brjed ngas par mi 'gyur bar bya ba'i phyir/ rjes su gzung du gsol lo—/ /rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams la chags ④pa'am/ bzhengs pa'am/bzhugs pa'am/ chos gsungs pa la sogs pa gang la yang bsam gtan dang ldan pa ltar/ che ge mo la sogs pa'i sems can thams cad la ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo du ma la 'jug pa'i byen kyi rlabs ④su gzigs par mdzod cig /de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang bcas pa la tha dad rjomed pa'i thugs chos kyi dbyings dbyer med cing mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyis 'dod chags la sogs pa dang bral ba'i phyir—/ che ge mo la sogs pa'i 'gro ba rnams la khong khro ba med pa dang /log par nges pa'i sems med pa dang / tha dad pa'i 'du shes spangs pa'i phyir rjes su 'dul bar mdzod cig /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la gti mug med pa'i phyir ye shes dang ldan pa dang / rnam par lhang ba med pa'i phyir/ 'jig rten las 'das pa dang / 'phags pa ma yin pas nges par mi 'byung ba'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i btang snyoms 'phags pa'i 40—1399

sems can gyi phung ①po la 'jug pa dang / phung po gsum du rnam par gzhag pa dang / sems can gyi bsam pa la 'jug pa dang / spyod pa la rnam par lta bas dran pa nyams pa med pa ltar④/ che ge mo la sogs pa'i 'gro ba rnams la yang dran par bya ba dang / bsam par bya ba dang / brtag par bya ba dang /mi brjed pa'i gzungs snekyi mthu thob pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod cig /deng rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa de bzhin nyid gang dang mnyam pa nyid dang / ting 'dzin la zhugs pas mtha' dang dbus mi dmigs pa ltar sems can thams cad kyang rjode lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin rnyed par mkhyen pas gzigs shig /gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog pa dang / sems can gzhan dang / gang zag gzhan la chos go bar byed pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa mi zad pa la mkhas pa dang /tshig thams cad rab tu dbye ba dang / tshig gcig la bskal pa brgya stong gi bar du ston shes pa dang / dri ba ji lta ba bzhin du the tshom gcod pa dang / thams cad du thogs pa med pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi khams dang spyod pa shes pa dang / chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong ci rigs pa la yang dag bupar ston par gyur cig /de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang bcas pa rnams kyi thugs kyis dgongs nas/ che ge mo la sogs pa'i 'gro ba ma lus pa rnams la chags pa dang / gnyis su 'dzin pa thams cad dang bral ba'i rnam par grol ba bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par mdzod cig /gzhan yang bdag cag la sogs pa'i mnga' ris rnams kyang / ming dang gzugs dang longs spyod dang / spyod lam dang rigs la sogs pa gang gis sems can ma lus pa 'dul bar byed pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin du brtse bas yongs su khyab par 40byed1401

mdzod cig /che ge mo la sogs pa'i 'gro ba ma lus pa rnams kyang shin tu nges pa'i tshig dang ldan te/ 'bras bu rgya chen po ston pa'i chos 'chad pa dang ldan par gyur cig /ngag rnam par dag pas kun nas shes par byed pa/ gya gyu med pa/ mi rtsub pa/ mnyen zhing ①yid du 'ong ba/ mi 'chab pa mi 'tshe ba/ shin tu snyan pa'i dbyangs rab tu gsal ba/ nges pa/ 'jam pa/phan pa/ dga' ba/ bskyed pa/ mdzes pa/ thogs pa med pa/ lus sems ④tshim par byed pa 'dod chags la sogs pa zhi bar byed pa'i rang bzhin du gyur cig /rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i byin gyi rlabs ④kyis che ge mo la sogs pa'i 'gro ba ma lus pa rnams kyi sems kyi rgyud yongs su dag pas dmigs pa las 'das pa nam mkha' dang mtshungs shing chos kyi dbyings dang dbyer med pa ste/ ye shes kyi rang bzhin du gyur par mdzod cig /dbang po la sogs pa'i phyogs skyong ba rnams kyis che ge mo la sogs pa'i 'gro ba ma lus pa rnams kyi bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi bar bya ba'i phyir/ bsam pa thams cad yongs su grub ④pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig /dam pa'i chos mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan phyogs bcur tshugs shig /dkyil 'khor chen po la 'jug pa rnams kyi phyi dang nang gi bar du gcod pa thams cad sol zhig/lam dang sgrub pa'i mi mthun pa'i rkyen thams cad phyir phyogs par mdzod cig /'jig rten pa la bde ba dang / lo legs pa dang / nor dang / phyugs dang / bang mdzod 'phel bar mdzod cig /gnas dang bdag dang rnal 'byor bsrung ba la brtson par mdzod cig /sangs rgyas rnams kyi bka' drin dran pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gsung nyan pa dang / sgrub pa po'i 40—1402

dam la gnas par mdzod cig /dkon mchog gsum kyi bden pa'i byin kyi rlabs ①kyis de bzhin du phrin las rgyas par mdzod cig /snede nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang / 'jig rten skyong ba la sogs pa rnams la rdzas ma tshogs pa dang / cho ga lhag chad la sogs pa'i nyes pa thams cad bshags par bya'o//ci 'dod pa'i dngos grub zhus la 'khor lo'i dbang phyug la me tog gi phreng ba dbul lo/ /cho ga 'di ni rab gnas dang / sbyin sreg ⑦dang / dbang bskur ba la sogs pa'i bya ba la slob dpon dang slob mar bcas pa'i rgyud yongs su dag par byed pa'o/ /dgos pa'i dbang gis mchod pa dang / dkyil 'khor mngon par 'byung ba'am bya ba la ni sngon du mtshan gyis bstod pa'i dngos gzhi stong phrag brgyad sgogs par bya'o/ /cho ga dngos la zhugs pa na yan lag gi khyad par re re la yang ci nus pa'i phyag bya'o/ /shin tu rgyas pa bstan duzin to / /bumador bsdus pa la rjodaga' ba rnams la ⑦phyag la sogs pa bya ba dang /sngon ⑧gyi tshig le'ur byas pa/ phyogs rnams gtsang zhing mnyen ⑨pa dang / /kun du dri dang ldan gyur pa/ /bde ba can gyi zhing khams ltar/ /sa gzhi byin gyis brlab par bgyi'o/ /phyi nang ma bsgribs gsal ba dang / /rin chen rnams las grub pa yi/ /thub pa'i ⑩dbang po sras bcas kyi/ /gzhal yas khang du byin brlab bo/ /bla ma dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dang / /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas sras/ /bka' sdod phyogs skyong ma lus pa/ /de ring sbyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /gtsang zhing dri zhim bsil ba yi/ /dri chab bdud rtsi'i rgyun lta bus/ /rgyal ba sras bcas ma lus pa/ /chu gsum kyis ni 40—1403

mnyes par bkyi'o/ /dus gsum bzhugs pa'i bla ma dang ①/ /rin chen gsum ni ④nam mkha' la/ /til gyi gong bu ltar dmigs nas/ /sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /me tog la sogs nyer spyod dang / /rgyal srid bdun dang grub pa'i rdzas/ /mchod sprin nam mkha' gang dmigs teg/ /'gro ba bsgral phyir dbul bar bgyi'o/ /bdag dang sems can mkha' mnyam gyis/ /thog med dus nas da lta'i bar/ /ma lus sdig pa ci bgyis pa/ /shin tu 'gyod pas bshags par bgyi'o/ /mngon mtho nges legs rgyur gyur pa'i/ /skye bos rjodage ba gang bgyis dang / /'phags pa'i tshogs kyis gang bgyis la⑤/ /lhag par spro bas rjoyi rang ngo / /sgo gsum bsdams shing mi dge bcom/ /ched du bya bas gzhan du ⑦brtson/ /lam bde tshogs ⑧chung 'jug pa zab/ /sdom pa gsum la gnas par bgyi/ / gtang bar ⑨dka' ba'i lus 'di ni/ /mgon dang bde gshegs sras bcas la/ /bran g.yog nyid du 'bul lags kyi/ /deng nas dzad kyi 'bangs su mchis/ /rgyal srid bu dang chung ma dang / /'bru dang rta glang bran du bcas/ /sa gzhi gser sogs rin po che/ /gus pas thub ⑫mchog rnams la mchod/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims sdom ⑪pa dang / /thos bsam ⑫tshogs gnyis ci bsags pa/ /dus gsum bsdus pa'i dge ba gang / /thub pa chos kyi spyan la dbul/ /sgeg 'dzum ldem zhing brjid pa dang / /rngam zhing khros pa ⑫khro bo'i gzugs/ /sras bcas sku yi dkyil 'khor la/ /dad pas mig mi 'dzums ④par blta'o/ /sangs rgyas byang chub ma lus pa'i/ /tshe dang yon tan mthu stobs dang / /sku gsum mdzad pa ma lus la/ /dbyangs snyan ngag gis bstod par bgyi'o/ /bla ma rdo rje slob dpon dang / /yi dam 40byed1404

dkyil 'khor lha tshogs te/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /rtag tu gus pas skyabs su mchi/ /rgyal ba ①byang chub mchog brnyes nas/ /cung zad snyoms par bzhugs ②pa la/ /tshangs pa lta bus ①gus pa yis/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /byang chub mdzad pa mthar phyin nas/ /bde gshegs mya ngan 'da' bzhed ⑦pa/ /ji srid 'khor ba mtha' yod pa/ /sems can don du bzhugs par gsol/ /ji ltar sngon kyi skyob pa yis/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed pa ltar/ /de bzhin bdag kyang sems can phyir/ /byang chub chen por sems bskyed do/ /rgyal sras 'jig rten skyong rnams la/ /sku gsum grub dang rig pa 'dzin/ /las tshogs phrin las rnam dbye sogs/ /las bcol de ni grub par mdzod/ /'dir ni nyes pa gang byas pa/ /gang yang lus can skyabs gyur pa/ /ma 'tshal ba rnams bshags par bgyi/ /gtso bos ci nas bka' gnang 'tshal/ /'bras bu mchog dang thun mong ste/ /ma nor tshig don shes rab dang / /spobs pa mthu rtsal phun tshogs pa'i/ /dngos grub de dag gnang bar rigs/ /dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba ni/ /tshogs gnyis bdud rtsi lta bu 'dis/ /sku gsum 'bras bu grub gyur nas/ /gzhan don 'bad med 'byung bar shog /de ltar bya ba ma lus rjomathar phyin nas dkyil 'khor la 'jug pa'am/ dkyil 'khor gshegs su gsol bar bya'o/ /yi ge brgya pa ci nus pa rjobazlas par bya'o/ /phongs pa rnams mgu ba dang / gzhi bdag la gtor ma sbyin par bya'o/ /lha thams cad la mchod pa lha grangs dang mnyam par byas pas mchod pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor la 'jug dri med cho ga 'dis//'gro rnams mun pa bsal nas dkyil 'khor du/ /ma lus zhugs nas bde chen 40—1405

don ①rtogs te/ /bde ba can gyi zhing du myur bgrod shog /rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i dkyil 'khor du ⑧'jug pa'i cho ga zhes bya ba/ dngos grub brnyes pa'i slob dpon chen po bha ba bha ṭas ①mdzad pa rdzogs so// //ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta shrī bi ma la tīrti'i zhal snga nas dang / lo tsā rjob shākya'i dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa zhang grub pa dpal bzang pos bal po'i grong khyer yam bu'i nub phyogs nyi ma'i gtsug lag khang du bsgyur cing zhus nas gtan la phab pa'o// //bsdur mchan/1356 ① mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉〉sngag /'phags ma sgrol ma'i dkyil 'khor du 'a ga pa'i bya ba la sogs pa bzhugs/ ①〈〈pe 〉skopo ra 〉〉nga maṇ+ḍa lnga/④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tsā/ rjo〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7ཿ/ pya〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉〉〈〈co 〉7/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉mi'i bya ba/④〈〈pe tshogs kyi rgyan dang ldan pa 'od 'phro ba dang bcas pa'i sangs rgyas lnga'i dbu rgyan can du bskyed par bya'o/ /bum pa yang mi dmigs pa las phyi bum pa la ①nang rin po che'i gzhal yas khang bcud ⑤bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho'i dbus su pad+ma'i pa dra'i snyesdong po la rang 'dra ba'i ④dam tshig sems dpa' bskyed/ de'i mdun na las kyi khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa dmar ser bzhengs pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i thal mo sbyar ba'i dbus na rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsi 'bab pa bsnams pa/zhi ma khro gtso mo la blta ba bsam mo/ de dag la ye shes pa gzhug dbang bskur rgyas gdab/ /de nas rdo rje gzungs thag dang bcas pa bum pa'i steng du bzhag khrurang dang bum pa'i lha gnyis ka'i thugs kar zla ba la sa bon dang bzlas rjopa'i sngags bsams te④/ rang gis ④gzungs thag bzung ④nas ngag tu/ oṃ tā re tut+tha re tu re ⑫a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/sarba pā paṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes brjod pas sngags gzungs thag la 'khril nas bum pa'i lha gnyis po'i thugs kar phog de las 'od 'phros de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs bskul/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs lha gnyis po'i bum pa la phog bdud rtsi lud ⑪ 'og gi bdud rtsi dang dbyer med du bsam mo/ /de ltar gso sbyong la gnas pa dus ni tshes brgyad nas pha rol gyi tshes brgyad kyi bar ram/grangs ni sum 'bum mo/ / 7rtags ni chu khol ba la sogs pa dang lha'i zhal mthong ba'o /rjes la ye shes pa gshegs te dam tshig pa rang la bsdus nas rang lha'i nga rgyal gyis rang gzhan chu des bkrus nas sdig pa la sogs te mi mthun pa thams 40—1416

༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ po sha ta bi dhiḥ②/ bod skad du/ gso sbyong gi cho ga /rje btsun ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das ma'i sku gzugs mdun du bzhugs la sems bskyed bya/ po ta la nas spyan drangs pa'i bcom ldan 'das ma dang sku gzugs gnyis su med par bsam/ yan lag smad lnga khrus byas la bcom ldan 'das ma 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhabs la gtugs pa'i phyag bya/ dngos sam yid kyis mchod pa 'bul④/ bstod pa gang yang rung ba tshar gsum bsgrags/ /sku gsung thugs mnyes par bya ba'i phyir/ rtsa ba'i snying po brgya rtsa brgyad bgrang / spyig pa la sogs bshags dupa'i yan lag gzhan yang byas la/ lus tsog tsog por ⑤'dug la me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar te/ cho ga 'di lan gsum brjod pas gso sbyong rang gis blangs par 'gyur te/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems 40—1418

dpa' thams cad dang / mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bcom ldan 'das ma ①sgrol ma bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang / sa chen po dang lam la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis sems can thams cad la phan par bya ba'i phyir dang / bde bar bya ba'i phyir dang /tshul khrims kyi phung po dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi phung po dang / shes rab kyi phung po dang / rnam par grol ba'i phung po dang / rnam par grol ba'i ye shes gzigs pa'i phung po yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir gso sbyong nges par bya ste/yang dag par blangs pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bya bas kyang /dus da nas bzung ④nas gdugs rtse shar gyi bar du/ sems can thams cad la phan par bya ba'i phyir dang / bde bar ①bya ba'i phyir dang / tshul khrims kyi phung po dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi phung po dang / shes rab kyi phung po dang /rnam par grol ba'i phung po dang / rnam par grol ba'i ye shes gzigs pa'i phung po yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir gso sbyong nges par bya ste/ yang dag par blang bar rjobagyi'o/ /deng nas srog gcod mi bya zhing / /gzhan gyi nor yang blang mi bya/ /'khrig pa'i chos kyang mi spyad de/ /rdzun ⑤kyi tshig kyang mi smra'o/ /skyon ni mang po mnyam bsten pa'i⑦/ /chang ni yongs su spang bar bya/ /khri stan mthon ⑦po mi bya zhing / /de bzhin dus ma yin pa'i zas/ /dri dang phreng ba dang ni rgyan/ /gar dang glu sogs spang bar bya/ /ji ltar dgra bcom rtag tu ni/ /srog gcod la sogs mi byed pa/ /de ltar srog gcod la sogs spong ⑧/ /40—1419

bla med byang chub thob par shog /sdug bsngal mang dkrugs ①sems can rnams//srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol bar shog /ces brjod do/ /ba'i ②lci ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus su bcom ldan 'das ma la mchod cing smyung ④bar gnas pas bsgrub pa dang bstod pa la sogs pa byas na mtshams med pa lnga'i las byas pa yang nges par byang bar 'gyur ro/ /sku dngos su mthong ba la sogs pa'i yon tan mtha' med pa la sogs pa dhi'adzin par 'gyur ro/ /dus ni yar ngo'i tshes brgyad yin no—/ /dkar gsum dang dus cung zad thung ba la sogs pa ci rigs pas kyang btub bo/ /gso sbyong rang gis blang ba'i cho ga rdzogs so// //sgol ma'i dngos grub brnyes pa'i slob dpon bha wa bha ṭas mdzad pa'o/ /ma hā paṇ+ḍi ⑤ta shrī rat+na rak+ṣi ta ④dang / lo tsā dze+eb zhang grub pa dpal bzang pos bsgyur ba'o// //40—1420

༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ tā ra maṇ+ḍa la bi dhiḥ②/ bod skad du/sgrol ma'i maṇ+ḍal gyi cho ga /rje btsun ma ④sgol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngags yongs su dag pa dang / sgrib pa zad par 'gyur ba dang / dngos grub myur du thob par 'dod pas maṇ+ḍal gyi cho ga la mebartson par bya'o/ /sngags pas yan lag lnga bkrus te khyor bar chu cung zad blugs la ngag tu oṃ āḥsarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka sa ma ya shri ⑤ye hūṃ zhes brjod nas rang gi spyi bor blugs pas rang lha dang spyi gtsug gi dbang rtags dran par bya'o/ /de nas me tog la lag pa bkab ste ngag tu/ oṃ na mo bha ga ba te puṣ+pe ke tu rā dzā ya ta thā ga tā rjoya arta te samyashā bud+dhā ④ya/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ puṣ+pe puṣ+pe ma hā puṣ+pe/ su puṣ+pe pusgosgo be/ puṣ+pe bā kriṇ+ḍi swā hā/ zhes brjod pas me tog byin gyis brlab po/ /de nas chu cung zad blangs te ngag tu oṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa ces pas gnas dang bdag bsrung 40byed1422

bar bya'o/ /de nas oṃ ubadz+ra bhū ①me hūṃ 'dis maṇ+ḍal bsrung bar bya'o/ /oṃ s+dzabadz+ra re khe hūṃ 'dis maṇ+ḍal byug par bya'o/ /lag pa de'i rgyab tu me tog bzung ⑤ste maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su bzhag ①pas bsrung bar bya'o/ /de nas oṃ uhūṃ gis me tog dang bcas pa'i lag pas rang gi gnas gsum byin gyis brlab bo/ /de nas me tog gcig bzung rjoste oṃ sarba bispyo rjoso ra ya hūṃ swā hā/ zhes pa maṇ+ḍal la bskor zhing bor bas bgegs dang bral bar bya'o/ /de nas skad cig la maṇ+ḍal mi dmigs pa las rin po che'i gzhal yas khang du bsam pa'i nang du me tog bzung ste/ oṃ tsan+d+ra rjo.arka bi ma ṇi bh+ya swā hā/ zhes me tog maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su bzhag dze+epas skad cig la sgrol ma lha bcu gsum mam bco lnga la sogs pa bskyed par bya'o/ /de rnams la oṃ āsahūṃ zhes me tog blangs te gtor bas ye shes pa dbang du byas par bsgom/ de nas zhabs bsil dang /④ bsang chu gsum ni oṃ pra ba ra sad+ku ⑨ra pra tīts+tsha ye dang / oṃ añtsa mā rgo ⑩dang / oṃ brok+ṣa khaṃ ⑪swā hā/zhes pas rim pa ltar dbul de nas phyag bya'o/ /de nas lag pa gnyis kyis me tog bzung ⑫ste/ oṃ tā re tut+tha re tu re ⑫puṣ+pe swā hā/ zhes pas gtso mo'i dbu la dbul lo/ /oṃ badz+ra tā re puṣ+pe swā hā/ shar du'o/ /oṃ rat+na tā re puṣ+pe swā hā/lho ru'o/ /oṃ pad+ma tā re puṣ+pe swā hā/ nub tu'o④/ /oṃ karma tā re puṣ+pe swā hā/byang du'o/ /oṃ puste tā re puste swā hā/ shar lhor ro/ /oṃ dhū ⑫pa tā re puste swā hā—/ lho nub tu'o/ /oṃ dī pa ⑩tā re puṣ+pe swā hā/ nub byang du'o/ /oṃ garnya tā re puṣ+pe swā hā/ byang shar du'o/ /oṃ saṃ ⑫ku sha tā re puṣ+pe swā hā/ shar sgor ro/ /oṃ bā sha tā re puṣ+pe swā hā/ lho'i ⑫sgor ro/ /oṃ sgo ṭa tā re puṣ+pe swā hā / nub sgor ro/ /oṃ ghaṇ+ḍa tā re puste swā hā/ byang sgor ro/ /lha mo bco 40—1423

lngar byed na/ oṃ usnri ṣa tā re puṣ+pe swā hā/ shar sgo'i de'i rgyab tu'o/ /oṃ sum+bha tā re puṣ+pe swā hā/ nub sgo'i de'i ①rgyab tu'o/ /de bzhin du lha'i rigs gzhan yang shes par bya'o/ /de nas gong ma ltar rang rang gi sngags kyis bdug spos shangs la/ dri thugs kar mar me spyan la/ lha bshos ②ljags la/ rol mo snyan la dbul lo/ /gzhan yang nye bar mkho ba dang spyad pa'i dgos pa dbul bar bya ste/ bkur stes mchod pa la bstod pa ci rigs par bsgrags par bya'o—/ /de nas sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa'i yan lag gzhan rnams kyang byas la 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab ④ste/ lhag chad bskang rjob la yi ge brgya pa ci rigs par brjod do/ /de nas lha de rnams kyi ye shes pa gshegs te/dam tshig pa rang la bsdus nas ⑤dge ba bsngo bar bya'o/ /'di ni bya ba gzhan thams cad dang 'brel par shes par bya'o/ /sgol ma'i maṇ+ḍal gyi cho ga snyan dngags mkhan po snying rje chen pos rjomadzad pa rdzogs so// //40—1424

bsdur mchan/1422 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉༄ga /sgrol ma'i maṇ+ḍal gyi cho ga gnyis bzhugs/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉mi ཿ/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉mi ma/ du〈〈snar 〉〉wal/ du〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ta/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉jurtse/1423 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉spyo/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stanazung / ni〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉gzhag me〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉togazung /du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stanasne/ ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉tsaṇ+ḍa/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉sngagazhag ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 zhal bsil dang / ⑨〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉bad ka ⑫〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉〉/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉sprospruk+ṣa/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gzung / ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉watu re/ ④〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉du'o/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈'dir 〉〉chu/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rig/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉tshog ⑫〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉sto/1424 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wade'i/ ②〈〈snar 〉〉sgos/ ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉〉pa/ me〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stagang / me〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉wanas/ rjo〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉tshe bas/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (23༷4)40wa 1425

༄ga /sgrol ma mchog thob pa zhes bya ba/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ tā rā ske.a gā prabhi nā ①ma/ bod skad du—/ sgrol ma mchog thob pa zhes bya ba/ rje btsun sgol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngon du gsungs pa'i rim pas stong pa nyid kyi bar bsgoms te/ skad cig la rang sgol mar bsgoms pa'i thugs kar t+t+waṃ in+d+ra nī bula'i mdog lta bu blta bar bya'o//lus skyil krung la tshigs ⑤drang por bsrang ⑥ste mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya la sogs te lus gnad lnga dang ldan pas rlung rgyu ba spangs te lte ba las me rab tu sbar ⑦nas/spyi gtsug nas thig le phab ste t+t+waṃ la phog /t+t+waṃ las byang chub kyi sems zhun tshul du lus thams cad la khyab pas bde ba chen po'i ting nge 'dzin skyes par bsam zhing srog rtsol la 'bad na zhag bdun gyis ⑧dngos su skye bar 'gyur te/ byang sems 'dzag na gdams ngag dran par bya/ de nas t+t+waṃ las 'od 'phros ⑨te snod bcud thams cad rang la bsdus rang yang t+t+waṃ las ⑫bsdus te t+t+waṃ yang rim 40byed1426

gyis mi dmigs par byas la yod pa dang med pa'i rtog pa spangs la/ stong pa nyid kyi bde ba la rgyas gdab po/ /rtog pa la shes pa 'phro na snga ma ltar bde ba bsgom / bde ba shas che na phyi ma ltar stong pa bsgom/ rtog pa gzhan 'brel pa spang ste 7zla ba drug tu bsgoms na mchog thob par 'gyur ro/ /sgrol ma mchog sgrub pa zhes bya ba dngos grub brnyes pa'i slob dpon bsod snyoms pas mdzad pa rdzogs cas// //bsdur mchan/1426 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉ring/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra/ ①〈〈pe 〉posnar 〉rna/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉〉pa/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉tshosas/ 〈〈snar 〉tshosang / ⑦〈〈snar 〉〉sbyar / ⑧〈〈pe 〉lo〈snar 〉7)/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉gesgos/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉po/1427 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉gsungs te/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2304)40—1427

༄ga /'jigs pa brgyad las skyob pa'i sgol ma'i sgrub thabs/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ aṣ+ṭa bha ya tra shāsgyu rā ④sā dha dz+wa/ bod skad du / 'jigs pa brgyad las skyob pa'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ bcom ldan 'das lce/sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang po kho nar tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgoms nas/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang / byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa dang /lam la gnas par khas 'che ba dang / yongs su bsngo ba ste bsod nams kyi tshogs bsag go/ /de nas chos thams cad bdag med par lhag par mos la/oṃ swa bhā washudha ཿsarba dharmāḥ④swa bhā wa shurnyolha⑤haṃ dang / oṃ shu rjon+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma kophokluhaṃ zhes brjod pas stong pa nyid du bsgoms pas ye shes kyi tshogs bsag go/ /stong pa nyid kyi ngang las nam mkha'i dbyings de nyid du pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rang gi sems nyid t+t+waṃ gi ④rnam pa yongs su gyur pa las byung ba'i sgrol ma sku mdog ljang gu zhal gcig ma phyag brgyad ma/40—1428

phyag g.yas pa rnams kyis bgrang phreng ①dang mchog sbyin dang / mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa dang / rin po che 'dzin pa④/ g.yon pa rnams kyis ut+pa la dang /bum pa dang / skyabs sbyin pa'i dze+ephyag rgya dang / po ti 'dzin pa rab tu zhi zhing lang tsho rgyas pa'i lus shin tu mdzes pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis mngon par spras shing smad g.yogs kha dog sna tshogs can du bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas oṃ e bye hi bha ga ba tī pā sā sgo 0ku ru pū dza kṛṇ+ḍa a tra san+ni hi to bha wa zhes pa'i sngags kyis bcom ldan 'das ma spyan drangs pa mdun na gnas pa la mngon par mchod de/ oṃ bha ga wa tre+e rjos ma ye shwa ri sar+pā nudharmā te tā re a dhijo rjorgo me ku ru swā hā/ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis gsol ba btab pas bdag nyid la nye bar zhugs pas snying gar bdag ci 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' dang / de'i yang thugs kar t+t+waṃ gi ⑦rnam pa'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' gnas par blta zhing de nyid kyi tshe 'jigs pa brgyad las skyob par byed pa'i sgol ma rnams mngon par 'phros pa ni g.yas phyogs su seng ge'i 'jigs pa las skyob pa'i sgrol ma seng ge'i gdong pa can mche ba rnam par gcigs shing / lce glog ltar 'khyug paske/spyan ser mo/ phyag gnyis pa/ mdog dmar mo⑨/ skra ser po/ thugs kar mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i phyag rgya mdzad pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/sems can rnams seng ge'i 'jigs pa las sgol bar bsgom par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das ma'i g.yon phyogs su glang chen ⑩'jigs pa las skyob pa'i sgrol ma glang po che'i gdong pa can zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ shangs mtho zhing mche ba gatshiXs pa gsus pa 'phyang ba du ba'i mdog can/ mthe bong mngon par brkyang ba'i phyag gnyis kyis bsdigs par mdzad pa'i phyag rgya can/ sems can rnams 40—1429

glang po che'i 'jigs pa las sgrol bar mdzad par bsgom par bya'o/ /g.yas phyogs kyi 'og tu me'i 'jigs pa las skyob pa'i sgrol ma dmar mo 'bar ba'i gdong pa can/ zhal bdun ma/ ljags bdun ma/ skra gyen du 'bar ba phyag gnyis ma/ phyag gnyis kyis pad+ma'i phyag rgya mdzad cing / rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ sems can rnams me'i 'jigs pa las sgol bar bsgom par bya'o/ /g.yon phyogs kyi 'og gi char/ sbrul gyi 'jigs pa las skyob pa'i sgol ma zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ kha dog nag mo①/ sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka bcu dang ldan zhing skra grol ba rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i lus/ phyag gnyis kyis mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i phyag rgya mdzad cing / sems can rnams sbrul gyi 'jigs pa las sgrol ba bsgom par bya'o/ /g.yas phyogs kyi ④'og gi char chom ④rkun kyi 'jigs pa las skyob pa'i sgol ma zhal gasbug phyag gnyis ma/sku mdog ljang gu/ zhal khro gnyer bsdus pa/ skra gyen du mdzes parjo/ phyag g.yas pas ⑤ral gri 'phyar zhing g.yon pas sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i lus bzhengs pa sems can rnams chom rjorkun kyi 'jigs pa las sgrol ba klubasgom par bya'o/ /g.yon phyogs kyi 'og gi char lcags sgog gi 'jigs pa las skyob pa'i sgrol ma zhal gcig ⑧phyag gnyis ma sku mdog dmar mo/ g.yas pa dang g.yon pas lcags kyu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i lus bzhengs pa/ sems can rnams lcags sgog gi 'jigs pa las sgrol ba bsgom par bya'o/ /g.yas phyogs kyi 'og gi char chu'i 'jigs pa las skyob pa'i sgrol ma zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma sku mdog dkar mo g.yas lcags kyu ⑨dang g.yon pas sdigs mdzub mdzad pa zhi ba'i sku bzhengs pa/40—1430

sems can rnams chu'i 'jigs pa las sgrol ba bsgom par bya'o/ /g.yon phyogs kyi 'og gi char/ sha za'i 'jigs pa las skyob pa'i sgrol ma ①zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ kun+da dang zla ba'i mdog can rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i lus phyag g.yas pa dang g.yon pas mchog sbyin dang / mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i phyag rgya mdzad cing sems can rnams sha za'i 'jigs pa las sgrol ba bsgom ④par bya'o/ /yang snying ga'i t+t+waṃ gi ④'od zer gyis de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga spyan drangs pa la mngon par mchod pa ④nas gsol ba btab pas sangs rgyas rnams kyis dbang bskur nas thams cad la ④don yod grub pas dbu brgyan ④par bsgom par bya'o/ /sngags kyi tshig 'di dag yin te/ oṃ tā re tuṣ+ṭha re tu re sarba bha ya sha ma ni sarba durga ti tā re ṇi tu re swā hā/ gtso mo'i sngags so/ /oṃ dzi ha pa dā ⑦ni ma ha rda1⑧/ bi byu da dzi tī spru ⑨ga la/ ne+e tra⑩/ gardza gardza ya tā re tut+tha re tu re swā hā/ seng ge'i 'jigs pa las skyob pa'i sgol ma'i sngags so/ /oṃ dī ra rda ba dā ⑪ni/e ka rda1 ⑫ma hā na se lasbo dha ⑫ri karja kar+bha tā sa ya tā sa ya sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/tā re tut+ta re tu re swā hā/ glang po che'i 'jigs pa las skyob pa'i sgol ma'i sngags so/ /oṃ shi khi ba dā ⑫ne ma hā usku mu khi dz+wa lā mā lā skeni sabe+e dzi nyi/sap+ta mu kho — shā ⑩na re/ tā re tuṭ+wā re tu re swā hā/ me'i 'jigs pa las skyob pa'i sgrol ma'i sngags so/ /oṃ pha ṇi ma hā pha ṇi kṛṇ+ḍa ba dā ne+e kṛṣ+ṭa ba dā ne+e ⑩tre e kā da ⑫sha dzi he⑪/ kā re ṇa tsa lā ⑦ya/ tsa lā ya/ ma hā bhi ṣa bhak+ṣa ṇi/ tā re tuṭ+wā re tu re swā hā/ sbrul gyi 'jigs pa las skyob pa'i sgrol ma'i sngags so/ /oṃ kharga haste bhi ku ṭi ⑩mu khi udzha ke ṣa ma hā na dī kṛṇ+ḍa añdza na warte khyun+da stson+da3/40—1431

bhin+da bhin+da/ ut+na ra ya uṣ+ṭha ①ra ya/ tā re turtswa re tu re swā hā/ chos rkun kyi 'jigs pa las skyob pa'i sgrol ma'i sngags so/ /oṃ rak+ṣa waṇi pā sha slo ku sha haste ②ma hā ra wi ma hā ba la ①sa ra sa ra/ bi sa ra bi sa ra/ kṛṇ+ḍa kṛṇ+ḍa/ karnya kadha ma hā durga rjon/ spru tsa ya/ tā re tut+tha re tu re swā hā/ lcags sgrog gi 'jigs pa las skyob pa'i sgrol ma'i sngags so/ /oṃ dza le dza le ma hā dza le/ tā ra ya tā ra ya/ uṣ+ṭha ra ya/ shri kha ⑤la haste/ ma hā dza we e kā bī ri ma hā kā ru be+e ke tā re tut+ta re tu re swā hā/ chu'i 'jigs pa las skyob pa'i sgol ma'i sngags so/ /oṃ ma hā gaspyi rjobye ma hā kā ru ṇi ke bha ga wat+ma ⑦le/ ba ra dha ④a bha ya haste/ ma hā ku na in+d+ra ⑨da wa li pra hā si ta ba dā ⑫ne+e/ ma hā was+t+ra pra bṛt+ta ⑪sha rī re dh+ya nā/ wa sbri ti tā ra ya tā ra ya ma hā bha ⑫ya/ tā re tuṣ+ṭha re tu re swā hā/ sha za'i 'jigs pa las skyob pa'i sgrol ma'i sngags so/ /gang gi ⑫tshe bzlas pas yid skyo bar ⑫gyur pa de'i tshe ye shes pa mdun du phyung ba la mchod nas gshegs su gsol la/ rang nyid dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal gyis gnas par bya'o/ /'jigs pa brgyad las skyob pa'i sgol ma'i sgrub thabs/ slob dpon thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta ta thā ga ta bha dra dang / dge slong 'phags pas rgya'i yul cod to'i ⑫mkhar du bsgyur ba'o// //40—1432
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (23༷6)40wa 1434

༄ga /dpal sgol ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs/①༄ga /rgya gar skad du/ shrī sī ②ta tā ra sā dha rgo/ bod skad duske/ dpal sgol ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs/ dpal sgol ma dkar mo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'chi ba'i skyon gyis gos min la/ /zla ba drug gi mthar thug par/ /sgol ma'i thugs kyi 'khor lo ④ni/ /bsgrims bsgoms dngos grub thams cad rnyed—/ /ngag gi dbang phyug gis byas pa'i/ /'chi ba slu ba kun bsdus las/ /sgol ma dkar mo phyung 'di ni/ /bsgoms pas 'jigs pa spong bar byed/ /bzhi pa'i sde tshan gnyis pa lga /'od zer rnam 'phros menam mkha' ni/ /pad+ma dkar dang zla gdan la/ /mdun ⑤bltas gsum la skyabs 'gro brjod/ /yud tsam stong pa nyid bsgoms nas/ /so so skye bo'i 'khrul bcom ste/ /rdo rjes dusmon lam mthu nyid kyis/ /byang chub sems kyi yi ge bsgom/ /pad+ma dkar po'i dbus gnas pa/ /zla ba'i gzugs kyi gdan steng du/ /rdo rje skyil 40byed1435

krung rab bcings stishing / /mchog ④sbyin at+pal 'dzin pa mo/ /ston ka'i 'od ltar dkar ba'i mdog /rgyab tu zla ba yang dag brten④/ /rgyan rnams thams cad yongs su rdzogs/ /bcu drug lo lon sku mnga' ba'o/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas rnams de yi ④sras/ /yum gyur 'dod pa'i gzugs 'dzin ma/ /de yi snying dbus 'khor lo'i 'od/ /dkar mdangs 'phags ma sgol ma bsgom/ /brgyad kyi rtsibs can brgyad rnams kyis⑤/ /yi ges yongs su gang ba nyid/ /oṃ hā rjoyi ge'i dbus gnas pa/ /bsgrub bya'i ming ldan lte bar ro/ /zla ba drug tu nges brten ④par/ /mi bde med pa'i sems yin pas/ /rtse gcig sems kyis bsgom bya zhing / /yi ge bcu pa'i sngags 'di bzlas/ /oṃ yig thog mar byin byas nas/ /phyis ni ⑧tā re rab tu sbyar/ /tut+ta re 'dis tu re phyis—/ /swā hā mtha' yin las kun la'o/ /tshangs dbang khyab 'jug zla nyi dang / /drag po phyogs skyong 'dod pa'i lhas/ / spu yi ⑨rtse yang bskyod mi nus//'chi ba las rgyal sgol ma ⑩bzhin/ /gnyer ma skra dkar skal ngan dang / /nad dang dbul po nyams par byed/ /seng ge la sogs 'jigs chen brgyad/ /sdug bsngal tshogs rnams sel bar byed/ /bza' dang btung ba gos dang ni/ /khang bzangs ⑪rin chen ldan mi slong / /ral gri mig sman rkang byug dang / /bum pa bzang sogs dngos grub 'gyur/ /snyan dngags rtsod dang mi brjed dang //shes rab gcig tu dri ma med/ /'dod pa gzhan yang grub byed pa/ /'khor lo 'di las rab tu 'byung / /sgrol ma dkar mo sgrub ⑫pa'i thabs/ /'chi dang nad rnams 'joms byed pa/ /phyung ba'i dge ba gang thob des/ /'gro kun sgrol ma'i bdag nyid shog /sgrol ma dkar mo 'chi ba slu ba'i sgrub thabs/ slob 40—1436

dpon ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //dpal chos kyi rje sa'i steng na 'gran zla dang bral ba'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po shākya shrī bha dra dang / sgra bsgyur gyi lo tsā ①ba gnubs byams pa'i dpal gyis bsgyur pa'o / / //bsdur mchan/1435 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉༄ / /dpal sgrol ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉nyasi/ ni〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉tsho phro/du〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉thadun/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉rje/1436 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stanang bcas/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉toradod/ ni〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bsten/ du〈〈snar 〉stanas/⑤〈〈snar 〉4)/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉1/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉bstan/ 〈〈snar 〉〉brtan/ ⑧〈〈snar 〉stan/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ba spu'i/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉shesal rnams/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bzang / ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsgrub/1437 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉〉ra gyi lots+tsha/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2307)40wa 1437

༄ga /sgol ma'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/①༄7/ /lha mo sgol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngar bstan pa'i cho gas pyabadud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor du sa bon lnga pa'i sde tshan gyi dang po la/ dang po'i gnyis pas mnan pa/ zla tshes phyed pa'i thig les brgyan pa'o/ /de las grub pa'i sgrol ma bsgom par bya'o/ /ljang gu phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas mchog sbyin/g.yon ut+pa la 'dzin pa'o/ /pad+ma dang zla ba la gnas pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan par bsam mo/ /lag pa gnyis thal mo sbyar la/ mdzub mo gnyis kyis gung mo'i sen mo bkab la/ srin lag nang du bcug ste mtheb mos mnan pa ni/ ut+pa la kha phye ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /oṃ tā re tuṭ+wā re tu re swā hā/ 'phags ma sgol ma'i sgrub thabs rdzogs ③so// //40—1438
bsdur mchan/1438 ①mtshan byang 'di 〈〈sde 〉྾〈co 〉〉star bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉ga'i/ ②〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉wardzogs/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (23༷8)40wa 1439

ras /sgol ma'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/①༄yi/ /rgya gar skad du/ tā ra sru dha rna nā ma/ bod skad du/ sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ rje btsun ma ④sgol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de la dang por 'di bsgrub lcepar 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ dbe+en pa'i gnas su stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ mchod pa'i rnam pa tshad med pa bsham zhing thu /gtor ma gcig kyang bshams la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ a khyekā ro mu khaṃ sat+tha sgodharmā rde ār+ya nut+pan+da tāta 3oṃ āḥhūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes brjod la btang ngo / /de nas rang nyid sgrol mar mos par 1 byas la/ de'i snying gar pad+ma ⑨sna tshogs su yod pa/ dbus kyi lte ba la a las zla ba la t+t+waṃ ljang gu/de'i 'od kyis rang bzhin kyi gnas nas rdo rje'i sgol ma mdun kyi nam mkhar ⑫ spyan drangs lakye/ phyag 'tshal/ yon chab dbul/ de nas me tog la sogs pa lhortelnga dbul/ sdig pa bshags/ rjes su yi rang ba dang ⑫bsngo ba bya 40byed1440

gsum la skyabs su 'gro/ de nas bdag rje btsun ma sgrol ma dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig par bsam/ de nas slar gshegs su gsol/ sems can gye don bya snyam pa'i byams pa①/ 'khor ba nas sems can rang rang gi sdug bsngal yod pa la snying rje bsgom/ de rnams sdug bsngal las thar nas sangs rgyas kyi bar la dga' ba bsgom/ de yang sems can de dag kun ④stong pa dang rang bzhin med par btang snyoms bsgom/ /de nas oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā ba da kopho①haṃ/ zhes mi rtog pa cig rjobasgom/ de nas rtog pa 'phro ba'am dubying na stong pa mi rtog pa'i ngang las/ paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma de'i lte ba la a las zla ba de'i steng du t+t+waṃ ljang gu de las byedal/ de ltar byed la t+t+waṃ gis dhimatshan pa yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid ⑦sgrol ma sku mdog ljang gu pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la phyed krung gis skyil mo krung du bzhugs pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang ba/phyag g.yas mchog sbyin kyi phyag rgya/ g.yon ut+pa la snyan gyi thad kar bzung ba/dbu rgyan ⑧dang snyan cha dang mgul rgyan dang / phyag gdub dang / dpung rgyan dang / zhabs gdub dang / rin po ches brgyan pa/ bag tsam g.yas su 'gying ba 'od zer sngo ljang dang bcas par bsgoms la/ thugs ka'i t+t+waṃ las 'od zer 'phros te ⑨ye shes kyi sgrol ma spyan drangs lam ⑩du bzhugs pa la sngar bstan pa'i mchod pa rnams yid kyis phul/ de nas bdag la gzhug /yang t+t+waṃ gi ⑩'od kyis phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs/ mdun gyi nam mkha' la bzhugs su gsol la/ sngar gyi mchod pa yid kyis phul la/ de rnams bdag la dbang byed cig ⑫par bsgom/de yang bum pa lnga bcud dang bcas pa lha mo lngas dbang bskur nas/ bum pa'i 40byed1441

chu de mar blugs pas sgrib pa byang / yar 'khyil bas spyi bor don yod grub pa bzhugs par bsam/ de nas mi rtog pa cung zad bsgom/ shes pa 'phro ba'am bying ba na lha'i sku rim kyis ①bsam/ de nas snying pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad la—/ dbus kyi zla ba la oṃ/ shar gyi 'dab ma la tā/ lho'i 'dab ma la re/nub kyi 'dab ma la tuta/ byang gi 'dab ma la tā/ byang shar du re/ shar lhor tu/ lho nub tu re/ nub byang du swā hā bkod la rim pas bzlas so/ /lag pa ut+pa la'i phreng ba bgrang ngo / /brgya'am stong bzlas la 'phro gcod tsam na/ye shes pa ④nam mkha' la bton la/ bdag thal mo sbyar la/ bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis bdag mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas/ sems can thams cad kyi don byed par gyur cig /bdag sangs rgyas ma thob bar la theg pa chen po'i chos spyod cing / sems can gyi ①don byed par gyur cig ces brjod la/ gshegs su gsol lo/ /sgol ma'i sgrub thabs dha byang chub sems dpa'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi ta dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba rjorin chen grags pas bsgyur duba'o// //40—1442

༄ga /sgol ma'i sgrub thabs bathags/①༄ga /rje btsun ma ④sgol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de la dang por sngags pas gdong bkru ba la sogs pa byas te/ yid dang mthun par bsam gtan gyi gnas gtsang zhing dri zhim po gcal du bkram par stan gtsang ma la ①bde bar skyil mo krung gis 'dug ste 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma'i sngags kyis gtor ma byin kyis brlabs la/ oṃ ā bispyon+ta dukṛta hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bya ba'i sngags lan bcu'i bar du brjod de/ phyogs bcu na gnas pa'i bgegs thams cad bskrad par bya'o/ /de nas rang gi snying gar chos thams cad chos ⑤dbyings kyi rang bzhin skye ba med par ston par byed pa ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba 'od zer dkar po 'phro bas rang gi lus gsal bar byed pa shin tu 'phro ba bsams la/ de yongs su gyur pa'i 'od zer dkar po'i thig le shel sgong 0dag pa lta bu de rim kyis 'phel bar gyur pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi gzugs su 40byed1444

bsam zhing / de'i steng du yi ge t+t+waṃ 'od zer kyi tshogs 'phro ba'i rin po che'i sgon ①ma ltar dkar ba rnam par bsam mo/ /de nas yi ge t+t+waṃ de 'od zer shin tu dkar ba'i tshogs kyis 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad gsal bar byas pa sngon du 'gro bas lha mo sgol ma la sogs pa sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang bla ma rnams bskul te/ spyan drangs pa mdun ②kyi nam mkha'i phyogs la rnam par bsam par bya'o/ /de'i steng du yid kyis ⑦rang bzhin gyi mchod par bya ba yin la/ de la mchod pa'i cho ga'i rim pa ni 'di yin te/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūṃ zhes bya ba'i sngags brjod la yi ge t+t+waṃ las byung ba'i me tog gi mchod pa'i tshogs kyis mchod par bya'o/ /de nas oṃ badz+ra dhū ④pe hūṃ zhes bya ba'i sngags brjod la yi ge t+t+waṃ de nyid las yang dag par spros pa'i bdug pa'i ⑤mchod pa'i tshogs kyis mchod par bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu oṃ badz+ra dī pe hūṃ zhes bya ba'i sngags brjod la yi ge t+t+waṃ de nyid las rin po che'i sgron ma spros la mchod par bya'o/ /de nas oṃ badz+ra gadhe hūṃ zhes bya ba'i sngags brjod la yi ge t+t+waṃ de nyid las dhibyung ba'i dri'i ⑦mchod pa'i sprin yang dag par spros pas mchod par bya'o/ /de nas oṃ badz+ra ne+e bi bye hūṃ zhes bya ba'i sngags brjod la yi ge t+t+waṃ de nyid las rin po che sna tshogs ④bcug pa'i lha'i zhal zas ro mchog dang ldan pa'i mchod pa'i sprin rnam pa sna tshogs yang dag par spros pas mchod par bya'o/ /de nas oṃ sasba ⑨bi shiṣ+ṭa pū dza me gha pra sa ra sa mu ⑩dra āsahūṃ/ zhes bya ba'i sngags brjod la yi ge t+t+waṃ ⑪de nyid las rin po che sna bdun gyi gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / dril bu dang / ba dan dang / bla re la sogs pa dang / 'khor los sgyur ba'i rin po che sna bdun gyis mchod par bya'o/ /de ltar mchod pa ⑫byas nas/ de dag 40—1445

gi spyan sngar sdig pa bshags pa dang / bsod nams la rjes su yi rang ba dang bskul ba dang / gsol ba gdab pa dang / bsod nams yongs su bsngo ba dang / gsum la skyabs su 'go ba byas la/ byams pa dang snying rje dang dga' ba dang btang snyoms te tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgoms nas byang chub kyi sems brtan por bya'o/ /de nas oṃ swa bhā ba shudha ཿsaza ①dharmāḥswa bhā ②ba shurnyopho①haṃ—/ zhes bya ba'i sngags lan gsum brjod la/ 'gro ba thams cad rmi lam dang sgyu ma dang smig rgyu lta bur stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin du dmigs par bya'o—/ /de nas yi ge a yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du bsam/de'i steng du yi ge t+t+waṃ dkar po las rjo'od zer dkar po 'khrigs par bsam de yongs su gyur pa las ut+pa la sngon po/ de'i dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng na yi ge t+t+waṃ dkar po bsam/ de las 'od zer dkar po phyogs bcur 'phros pa ⑤des sems can thams cad sbyangs nas lha mo sgol ma'i skur gyur pa 'od zer de nyid kyis bkug /ung la dang yi ge t+t+waṃ la bstems rjopas pad+ma dkar po'i dze+edabus gnas pa'i/ /zla ba'i gzugs kyi gdan steng du/ /rdo rje skyil krung bcas nas ni/ /mchog sbyin ma ④dang at+pal bsnams/ /ston ka'i zla ba'i mdangs 'dra ba'i/ /zla ba la ni rgyab brten pa/ /rgyan rnams thams cad yongs su rdzogs/ /bcu drug lo lon lus dang ldan/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang de 'dra'i sras/ /kun gyi yum gyur 'dod dgu ⑨'chang / /'phags ma sgrol ma de'i snying gar zla ba'i steng gi t+t+waṃ dkar po yongs su gyur pa las/'khor lo 'od zer dkar po bsgom/ /rtsibs brgyad pa la yi ge ni/ /brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba la/ /lte bar oṃ tā'i yi ge pa'i/ /dbus gnas bsgrub 40byed1446

bya'i ming dang ldan/ /zla drug bsten stizhing nges pas ni/ /rtse gcig pa yi sems kyis bsgom/ /yi ge bcu po'i sngags 'di ni/ /skyo bar ma gyur sems kyis bzlas/ /dang por oṃ ni bzhag ④nas su/ /de 'og tā re rab tu sbyar/ /de 'og tā re tut+ta re/ /swā hā'i ④mtha' can las kun byed/ /thugs ka'i 'khor lo de las 'od zer dkar po 'phros pas dam tshig sems dpa' 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' rang bzhin gyis grub pa kun rjonas spyan drangs pa mdun kyi nam mkha' la rnam par bsams nasarjo/ snga ma bzhin du yang dag par mchod de/de nas dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcing bar bya ste/ thal mo khong stong du sbyar nas mdzub mo gnyis gung mo gnyis kyi rgyab tu sbyar la mthe bong gnyis nang du bkug pa ni—/ byed la'i phyag rgya'o/ /de'i dbus su yi ge t+t+waṃ dkar po bsams te/de las 'od zer dkar po 'phros pa des ye shes sems dpa' la bskor bar byas la—/ de nas dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥzhes bya ba'i yi ge bzhis spyan drangs nas dam tshig sems dpa' bdag nyid la gzhug pa dang bcing ba dang / dgyes pa byas la/oṃ dharma jo tu dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā ba byed kopho ④haṃ/ zhes nga rgyal bya'o/ /de'i rjes la 'khor lo yi ger bcas pa las 'od zer spro ba byas la/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga mdun gyi nam mkha' la rnam par bsams la/ dbang bskur ba'i tshigs su bcad pa 'dis don du gnyer bar bya ba ⑦ste/ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la//ji ltar mchog chen byed rjomadzad pa/ /bdag la bsrung ⑨ba'i don gyi phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag byed/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gi sku las byung ba'i lo tsā ⑩na dang / mā ma khri dang / gos dkar mo dang / tā ra rin po che'i bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis bkang ⑫ba phyag na bsnams pas/ rdo 40—1447

rje chen po'i dbang bskur ba/ /khams gsum po yis phyag byas pa/ /gsang ba gsum gyi gnas las byung / /sangs rgyas kun gyis sbyin par bya/ /zhes bya ba 'don cing dbang bskur bar bsam mo/ /dbang bskur ba rdzogs ma thag tu ①rin po che'i cod pan gyi steng du de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag du med pa sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya can bsam mo/ /lus dang ngag dang yid gsum byin kyis brlab ②par bya ba'i phyir/spyi bor yi ge oṃ dkar po zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa dang / skog mar yi ge s+dzadamar po zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa dang / snying gar yi ge hūṃ nag po zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa rnam par bkod do/ /yi ge bcu po las 'od zer dkar po spros pas 'gro ba kun sbyangs nas sangs rgyas su bsgrubs nas slar bkug ste/ 'khor lo dang yi ge la bstems te ①gsal bar bsgom zhing bzlas brjod bya'o/ /ji srid mi skyo ba'i bar du bsgom pa dang bzlas par byas nas de las ldang bar 'dod na cho ga nyams pa bskang bar bya ba'i phyir rdo rje sems dpa'i snying po/ yi ge brgya pa zhes bya ba bzlas nas ye shes sems dpa' yang dag par mchod tshubasod nams yongs su bsngos la gshegs su gsol lo/ /de la ye shes sems dpa' gshegs su gsol ba'i tshigs su bcad pa ni/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub spyod/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas ni/ /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /muḥzhes bya ba 'di yin no/ /de la bzlas pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ tā re tut+tha re tu re swā hā/ de la rdo rje sems dpa'i snying po yi ge brgya pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra satwa twe no pa/ tiṣ+ṭha dṛ ḍho me bha 40—1448

ba—/ su toṣ+yo me bha ba/ su poṣ+yo me bha ba/ a nu rak+to me bha ba/ sat+tha sirnyim+bi ①pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma ②su tsa me/ tsit+t+waṃ she ya④ཿku ru hūṃ/ ha ha ha ha hoḥbu/ bha ga wān sat+tha ta ⑤thā ga ta/ badz+ra mā me muñtsa/ badz+rī dhibha ba ma hā sa ma ya satwa 66—/ zhes bya ba ④'di yin no/ /bson nams 'di yis 'gro ba kun/ /rje btsun sgol ma 'dra bar shog /bdag kyang ting 'dzin 'di bsgrubs nas/ /'gro ba'i don du sangs rgyas shog /rje btsun sgol ma'i sgrub thabs slob dpon chen po dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang / bod kyi lo tsā sgeb dge slong dge ba'i blo gros kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //baspur mchan/1444 stimatshan byang 'di 〈〈sde 〉sko〈co 〉rdzar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7ma/ 1 〈〈pe 〉phro/ 〈〈snar 〉tha/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉wasnan/ rjo〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7)/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉shesang /1445 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉tsūl/ ②〈〈pe 〉thadun/ ①〈〈be+e 〉〉〈'ar 〉tha/ ④〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉〉sgro/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉spro ba'i bdag po'i/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉phro/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7dri'i/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7su/⑨〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ra rba/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉nga ma/ 〈〈snar 〉ngos/ ⑪〈〈snar 〉dza ṭī/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7ra/1446 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉༄rba/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉lha/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉7pho/ ④〈〈pe〉〉〈'ar 〉7las/h+ye〈〈snar 〉7sa/ rjo〈〈snar 〉ltem/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉༅/ phye 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7/ ⑪〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sku/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈po ra 〉stanas/1447 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7rtan/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈'ar 〉razhag ④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉wā/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉riskul/phye〈〈pe〉sko〈snar 〉tha/ rjo〈〈pe〉sko〈snar 〉7lha/ ⑦〈〈pe〉sko〈snar 〉7ba/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉rasol/⑪〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉zasang / ⑩〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉tsa/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉sngagang /1448 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7tu/ ⑤〈'ar 〉tharlabs/ ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thastem ste/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7de/40byed1449

ras /'phags ma lha mo sgol ma bsgom pa'i cho ga rgyas pa/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya tā ra de wī ②bha ba na bi dhista ra/ bod skad du/ 'phags ma lha mo sgrol ma bsgom pa'i cho ga rgyas pa/ lha mo sgol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /don med bdag la gnod pa ①srid pa'i bya ba rnams spangs te//rang bzhin brtan pas rnam par dbe+en pa'i sa phyogs song nas ni/ /gnas der bdag gi bsam gtan khang pa shin tu yid 'thad pa/ /shar du sgo btod ④yang na nub tu bkra shis sgo ldan pa/ /legs brtsigs de yang dum bu bzhi pas mdzes par byas pa ste/ /shin tu mnyam zhing logs dang steng 'og thams cad legs byugs shing / /rab 'jam gzugs brnyan 'char ba lta bur 'tsher ba'i rdzas rnams byugs/ /de rjes dri zhim ldan pa'i tshon rnams ljang gus khyab par byugs—/ /'di ni steng logs sa gzhi'i ⑤byi dor rgyud rnams las bsngags pa'o//'og gi phyogs duni rab tu 'thas par brdungs pa kho na la/ /sa la ma lhung ba yi 40—1451

lci ba dri bzangs rnams dang ni/ /bsres pa ①yang yang byugs pas gzugs brnyan 'char ba lta bur 'gyur/ /de la dri zhim me tog rnams kyis kun du gtor nas ni/ /ji ltar 'byor pa'i bla re la sogs rgyan rnams bri bar bya/ /de 'dra'i dbus sam shar gyi rtsig ngos cha la srad bu yis/ /bris sku yid 'ong mthong bas dga' bar 'gyur ba sbyar bar bya/ /de mdun me tog la sogs mchod pa 'byor tshad dgod par bya'osma/ /de bzhin de dbus stan bzang rab tu 'jam zhing bde ba ni/ /bris sku la bltas legs par bting bas yid dang mthun par bzhag /de yi sgo glegs rab tu sbyar ①bas rlung dang srog chags ni/ /shin tu phra ba'ang 'jug par mi nus 'di 'drar rab 'grig bya/ /de la rjologs kyi skar khung sgo dang bcas pa btod khyepa ste/ /che ba min zhing steng nas gdod rjodang dma' ba rab tu smad/ /'di ni bsam gtan khang pa mchod rten lta bur 'gro rnams kyis/ /mchod par bya ba lha mo'i bzhugs gnas lha tshogs 'du ba'i sa'o/ /de bzhin de la sgo bltas pa yi khang pa gnyis pa ni/ /srid du khru rnams bcu bdun zheng du de'i phyed yod pa zhig /sngags pa'i 'chag sa sngon du ⑦kho nar brtag cing byi dor snga ma bzhin/ /der ni 'ju sa'i thag gu chang par gzung ba 'tsham pa la/ /reg na bde ba'i sbu gu rnams dang ldan par gdags par bya/ /'og tu 'byor pas stan nam rtsa rnams snyoms par dgram par bya/ /'di ni khang pa dum bu gnyis pa 'chag sa ④bkra shis pa'o / /⑨de gnyis dbus ⑩su sgo btod khang pa phyogs snyoms yid 'ong ba/ /snga ma lta bur bye dor byas shing don dang ldan pa yi/ /khrus kyi khang pa sgo dang bcas pa dum bu gsum pa'o/ /der yang de la sgo bltas pa yi khang pa dum bu ni/ /bzhi pa brtsigs te der yang bkra 40—1452

shis sgo mchog gdod par bya/ /khang pa der ni bdag gi yo byad rnams dang mtshon cha'i tshogs/ /mi zad pa dang sngags g.yog blo gros ldan pa mkhas pas gzhag /zas kyi bya ba rnams ni khang pa der yang ni/ /byi dor ldan par brtag cing rtag tu nyi zla ldan par bcang / /de ①ltar dum bu bzhi pa'i khang pa kun nas gru bzhi par/ /bsgrubs nas rim pa mang por brtsegs pas shin tu mtho ba la/ /rdo leb lhag par snang ba yis dang phyi ra mtho sogs kyis/ /rgyal po chom ④rkun la sogs 'tshe ba phyir phyogs 'gyur bar bya/ /skye bo rnams dang 1brten pas sdug bsngal kho na 'byung 'gyur gyi/ /bde ba 'byung bar thub pas ma gsungs de phyir mkhas mchog gis/ /sngags g.yog dang ni sgrub pa'i gogs mchog gnyis las ma gtogs pa/ /skye bo 'ga' yang 'jug dang phrad dang sbyin pa 'du 'dzi spangs0/ /snying rjes mtshon cha'i tshogs rnams legs par bshams shing gzhag par bya/ /de bzhin sgo ni rjoshin tu gtan bcad rgya dhidang bcas par gzhag⑦ /'di ni gnas kyi rab tu dbye ba'o// //gnas der sngags pas mchod pa'i don phyir me tog dag dang ni/ /spos dang til mar dri zhim rnams ⑧dang de bzhin rol mo yi/ /nyer spyod rnams dang bgrang phreng yid du 'ong ba'i rnga yab dang / /me long sen mo'i bzo dang spu gri tha mal dri dang ni⑨/ /mchod dang gtor ma'i don du sha dang nya sha 'bru rnams dang / /bza' ba rnams dang sman rnams thams cad legs par gzhag par bya//mdor na gnas der gzhan gyi ngor blta ⑩mi 'gyur longs spyod rnams/ /mthun par gzhag bya 'on kyang chang gi sbyor ba ring du spang / /'byung po'i gdon dang 40—1453

sngags grub 'dod pas gzhan nas blang bar bya/ /dngos grub don du bkug pa ma yin bud med rnams dang ni/ /dkyil 'khor ma mthong mi rnams mthu yis rgyang grags nyid nas bzlog /sngags g.yog dang ni sgrub pa'i grogs mchog dkyil 'khor che mchog tu/ /dbang bskur thob cing snying rje che ①dang ldan la ①brtson 'grus can/ /shes rab dang ldan dpa' zhing 'jigs bral khro med nga rgyal bral/ /blo brtan dad par ①gnas shing bdag la dga' 'dzin gus par bcas—/ /bsgom dang dge la brtson pa 'di 'dra gnyis ni rtag par gzhagadu /'di ni rdzas dang g.yog gi rab tu dbye ba'o// //blo ldan gyis ni sngar bshad stan la ⑤rdo rje skyil krung gis/ /legs par gnas ⑥te bdag la myur du bskul pa'i bsam pa bskyed/ /bdag ni shin tu ring nas rang gis ⑦rnam par bslus pa ste/ /sngon chad don med spangs nas ting 'dzin bsgrubs na 'di 'dra ba'i/ /srid mtshor 'khyams par skemi 'gyur bde mtha' gcig pu nyid gang yin/ /'gro ba'i skyabs su bdag 'gyur 'di la 'khrul pa yod ma yin/ /da ni bdag gis rang la bslus pa spangs te brtson pa yis—/ /dam pa'i gnas 'dir nges par lha mo'i mchog gyur sgol ma gang / /phongs pa la byams ma 'dra de nyid nges par mthong bar bya/ /bdag ni bstod pas dga' bar ⑨mi bya smod pa gzhan mang gnas/ /smad pas mi dga' mi byar bye bstod pa'ang gzhan mang gnas pa'i phyir/ /de bzhin 'jig rten chos brgyad ma lus bdag gis ⑪mnan par bya/ /lus kyis ji ltar bzod pas skad cig tsam yang dman pa yi/ /bya ba rnams la gnas par mi bya ji srid bdag gis ni/ /40byed1454

lha mo mthong gyur de srid mnyam dang bsam dang 'dus par 'gro/ /de bzhin tshong dang dmag dang las kyi mtha' rnams spang bar bya/ /yang dag gdams ①ngag bdag gis lha mo mchog las blang bar bya/ /gzhan gyis nyer bstan mun pa'i 'dab ①'dras bdag la ci zhig dgos/ /ji srid lha mo mthong bar ma gyur de ①srid gnas 'di nas/ /'gro bar mi bya de phyir 'di la lha rnams mdon par mdzod—/ /de nas sngags g.yog dang ni sgrub pa'i grogs mchog blo can gnyis/ /sngags pas bos te 'di 'dra'i bsgo ba gsal bar brjod par bya/ /bdag gi ④'dod pa yongs su ma rdzogs bar du gnas 'di las/ /'gro bar mi bya lha rnams dpang btsugs byed kyis 'di shes byos/ /de srid bdag gi yid dang mthun pa'i bya ba byed kyis byos/ /dngos grub cha las byed la 'god 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /de nyid dukyis ni thal mo sbyar bas legs par smras pa gzung / /lha rnams dpang du gnas pas bdag cag byed kyis 'dod bzhin bgyid/ /dngos grub cha la bdag cag dran par mdzod la spang mi bya/ /de skad brjod de ji ltar 'dod pas rang gi bya ba brtsam/ /'di ni sgrub pa po dang g.yog dang grogs dang dhidam bca' ba'i rab tu dbye ba'o// //de nas sngags pas stan bde nyid la 'dug bzhin rab rgyas pa'i/ /gtor ma mdun du bzhag ste ⑦de bzhin mchod pa rnams kyang ngo / /de nas rang snying paṃ bskyed pad+ma'i dbus su zla 'dra ba'i/ /yi ge oṃ las byung ba'i zla ba rnam bsam de steng du/ /gsal bya'i bcu drug pa nyid dbyangs kyi yi ge gnyis pas brgyan—/ /zla ba'i dum bu'i steng na nam mkhas ⑧mnan cing mdog ljang gu/ /40—1455

stong phrag du ma'i snang ba ldan bsam de las byung ba'i 'od/ /mtshon cha'i dbyibs can 'phros pas bla ma dang ni rgyal sras bcas/ /sgrol ma bkug ste mdun bzhugs de dag mchod pa gnyis kyis mchod/ /yan lag bdun ldan bya ba tshobasgrubs nas slar yang gshegs par bya/ /de mthar chos kun stong zhing bdag med lta bas gsang sngags ni/ /theg chen mngon par rtogs byed lan gsum bar du bzla bar bya/ /slar yang mkhas pas ②sa bon mchog bsam de las byung ba'i 'od/ /sgol mar gyur pas 'gro rnams dag byas slar 'dus zhugs pa yi/ /yi ge yongs gyur sa la ljang gu snying po ④sa bon ldan/ /skad cig nyid gyur ④sa bon las byung lha mo ma lus bsdus/ /rang gi gnas su thim gyur de las legs byung lha mo ni/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog ljang gu spyan yangs rgyan kun 'dzin/ /phyag g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon pas yu ba dang bcas a la 'dzin/ /bcu drug lo lon rab sgeg gzi ldan pad+ma zla ba'i gdan/ /cung zad 'dzum bcas sgrub pa po la mngon dgyes thugs rje can/ /ma lus bud med rgyan dang cha lugs 'dzin pa 'di 'dra bsam/ /slar yang sa bon las byung ye shes lha mo spyan drangs te/ /'chad 'gyur phyag rgya'i steng gnas zla ba'i sa bon las byung ba'i/ /mchod pas legs mchod man ngag ji bzhin rang la bstem par bya/ /sku gsung thugs la gnas pa'i lha rnams legs par ⑤byin kyis brlabs( —/ /de bzhin blo ldan bu yis gus ⑦pas dbang bskur don gnyer bya/ /rtsod ne+epa mi mnga' ba'am ⑫dam tshig rdo rje spyi bor byung / /de ltar cho gas legs bsgrubs rang nyid ⑩pad+ma zla ba la/ /rnam bzhugs lha mo'i thugs kar sen zlum mnyam pa'i zla ba ni/ /rjes mthun pad+ma la gnas lha nyid mthe bong tshon ⑪dang 40—1456

mtshungs—/ /zla steng bcu yi ①yi ges yongs bskor dbus na sngar bshad nyid/ /lngang gu'i 'od zer dang bcas mgo rnams gyen phyogs gsal bsams te/ /dbus ma dang ni bcu pa'i bdag nyid 'od zer dang bcas byung / /snying ga nas song ⑤phyi rol lha mo nyid gyur 'gro rnams kyi/ /sdug bsngal zhi byas mthun gyur sgo de nyid nas slar bsdu ①bya/ /'di ni spro bsdu'i ting 'dzin nyon mongs g.yul las rgyal byed pa'o/ /de 'dra ting 'dzin mang du byas pas sngags pa'i yid skyo na//snying zla'i rnam 'phrul la dmigs gzhan sems rab tu spangs nas ni/ /dang por rnam par snang mdzad de rjes gsal bya'i bcu drug pa/ /'og tu dbyangs rjoyig gnyis pas legs dubasten pa ste de rjes surjo/ /nyi ma'i bu la ⑦steng du e yis mtshan cing gnas pa'o/ /de nas gsal bya'i bcu drug pa nyid u yis bcings pa la/ /phyed cha'i ta yis mtha' ⑧ma bsten pa'o de rjes sngar bzhin las—/ /slar yang bcu drug pa ni us bcings me bu e dang ldan/ /slar yang a 'i gsum pa ⑨mthar gnas pa yi gnyis par ldan/ /de nyid dbyangs yig gnyis pas brgyan byas rjes su a yi/ /bzhi pa nga ro gnyis pas spras byas 'di 'dra'i gsang sngags ni/ /shin tu gsal min de bzhin mi gsal ma yin sgra che dang / /shin tu chung min sems gzhan rnam par g.yengs pa spangs pa yis/ /brgya rtsa brgyad las lhag pa'am de bzhin nor bur bzung ⑩ste bzlas/ /gang tshe de yi yid ni ⑪bzlas pas skyo na sa bon las byung ba'i/ /'od zer tshogs kyis 'gro rnams bkug ste ⑫man ngag ji lta bar/ /sngags 'dis 'byung po rnams la gtor ma sbyin bya phyag rgya ni/ /lag ⑫gnyis thal sbyar mdzub mo dag gis ④gung mo 'khyud byas te/ /mthe bong gnyis kyis snying por byas pa 'di yi spyogasang 40—1457

sngags mchog /bzlas dang gtor ma sbyin dang bstem sogs phal cher sbyar bar bya/ /oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sat+tha dharmā ṇ+ḍaṃ ār+ya nut+pan+da tāta ①oṃ s+dzahūṃ phaṭa swā hā/gtor ma phul nas yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod nas ni/ /bzod par gsol zhing yongs bsngo mngon 'dod dngos grub gsol btab nas/ /de nyid gsum mthar muḥyis bskul bas lha rnams bzhud par bya/ /de nas ye shes sems dpa' mdun du rab gsal legs mchod nas/ /yi ge brgya pa rang gi phyag rgya 'dzin pas legs bzlas te/ /bzod mdzod bdag blo 'khrul bas ting 'dzin mchog las nyams pa dang / /mchod dang gtor ma dman zhing sngags dang phyag rgya 'khrugs 3pa dang / /brtson pa dman zhing sems ni dam pa ma lags gang skyes pa/ /thams cad byed kyis bzod mdzod grub par byin gyis brlab tu tsagasol/ /de bzhin byed 'drar bdag gyur 'gro rnams srid mtsho las sgol shog /myur du khyod kyis bdag la byams pa'i zhal bzang bstan du gsol/ /bdag la myur du thugs mchog rab tu brtse bar mdzad pa'i rigs/ /thugs rje'i lha mo byed kyis bdag la myur du dbang bskur dang / /dam pa'i gdams ngag bstan pas yang dag lam bstan rigs pa nyid/ /de rjes mchod dang bstod pa'i dam pa rab tu gus pas gdon/ /de nas rang sngags swā hā'i ④ gnas su muḥsbyar ba yis gshegs/ /bdag nyid lha mo'i nga rgyal ldan pas ci bder gnas par bya/ /'di 'dra thun mtshams bzhir ni rab mnyam gzhag pa'i sngags pa yis/ /nyin gcig bzhin du 'bad pas bsams na de yis nges par ni/ /zla drug de bzhin lo gcig nyid dang gsum gyi nang du ni/ /lha mo mthong 'gyur 'di la the tshom mi bya gzhan du na/ /cho ga nyams pas bskal 40byed1458

pa skar ma mnyam par ①mthong mi 'gyur/ /'di ni sgrub pa'i thabs kyi ⑤rnam par dbye ba'o// //shin tu khro bar 'dod cing 'dod chags che dang lhag par ni/ /gnyid 'byung ba dang de bzhin rab tu mi dga' ngu bar 'dod/ /bsam gtan khang pa spangs te gzhan du 'gro bar 'dod pa dang / /bsam gtan gnas su mi bzad sgra 'byung de bzhin sgo dag las/ /'jigs pa'i sgra 'byung cho nges 'debs pa'i sgra dag thos pa dang / /nang na gnas pa'i ming nas phyi zuphyir 'bod pa dang ni dgod④—/ /sgyugs pa dang ni glu len sgra dang se gol rdeb cing mkhunathu/ /shin tu mi bzad dri mi duzhim pa'i ngad ldang skyi bung zhes/ /'jigs dang gzugs mi sdug pa mthong dang brdeg dang 'phul bar byed/ /rtag tu rmi lam sdug bsngal mthong dang 'dre yis gnon pa dang / /shin tu dga' zhing mkha' la 'phur snyam byed dang rgyu med dgod⑦/ /glo bur du ni gzhan kyi sems shes 'dre smra rna bas thos—/ /'jigs par byed pa'i 'od zer khang par rab tu 'byung ba dang / /dman pa'i man ngag ston pa'i rang lha'i gzugs ni mthong ba dang / /mngon du steng nas shin tu gnon cing mthong bar byed pa ste/ /mdor na gang gis bzlas dang bsam gtan dag gi ④bar chad byed/ /de bzhin blo ni snga las nyams par byed pa de ni bgegs/ /yin phyir bla ma'i man ngag kho nas bzlog par bya ba ste//bla ma'i man ngag med par sgrub ⑨la brtson pa de ni 'dir/ /srog dang dngos grub gnyis ka ⑩gdon chen rnams kyis ⑩'phrog par 'gyur/ /bla ma'i man ngag can la bgegs rnams 'byung bar mi 'gyur zhing / /'byung yang blo can de ni 40byed1459

bzlog par bya ba tshegs dang bral/ /'di ni bgegs kyi mtshan ma dang de rab tu bzlog pa'i rab tu dbye ba'o// //shin tu dri zhim ngad ldang yid ni dge la mngon dga' dang / /lus ni rab yang gnyid ni mi 'byung khams rnams snyoms pa dang / /shin tu sgra snyan pa dang rol mo'i sgra rnams grag pa dang / /me tog char 'bab til mar bral bar mar me 'bar ba dang / /rmi lam na ni 'phags rnams mthong dang dge slong bram ze mthong / /rtag tu dge ba'i rmi lam mthong dang chags dang khro dang bral—/ /yid ni dga' bar byed pa'i 'od chen khang par 'byung ba ste/ /mdor na yid ni gang gis snga ①las dga' gyur bzlas pa dang / /sgom pa dag la bar du mi gcod ④'dir ni mtshan ma bzang / /'dir ①ni bzlas dang bsgom pa ji tsam gsal ba de nyid mchog /'di ni mtshan ma bzang po'i rab tu dbye ba'o// //sman mchog bza' ba ④ma legs ⑤nges par dug tu 'gyur ba ltar/ /dngos grub len mi mkhas pa rnams kyi rjodangos grub phyir phyogs pa'am/ /yang na srog gi bar chad dag tu'ang 'gyur bas de yi phyir/ /mkhas pas dngos grub blang ba 'khrul ba med par shes par bya/ /rgya mtshor rin chen len pa rnams la 'tshe ba rnam mang ⑦ 'byung / /de bzhin dngos grub rin chen len pa rnams la 'phrog pa mang / /'di ni gdon chen dngos grub 'phrog brtson rab tu mang ba ste//dngos grub rnams ni sgrub pa pos kyang bsrung bar ④rab tu dga'/ /de bas blo 40—1460

ldan 'jigs pa ma lus ring du spangs pa yis/ /mi bzad mtshan ma ngan pa thams cad rab tu gzhig par bya/ /'jigs par mi bya khro dang chags pa rnam par spang bar bya/ /mtshan bzangs ①rnams kyang sgyu ma 'dra bar blta bya ri rab 1 bzhin—/ /mtshan ma'i rlung gis nges par mi g.yo mnyam par gzhag ①par bya/ /de tshe de ④la lha mos ⑤yang dag zhal ston 'gyur ba ste/ /thun mong ma yin bde ba 'byung 'gyur gus pas mchod cing bstod/ /'dod pa'i dngos grub gsol gdab yang dag gdams ngag don du 'gyur/ /ji srid gsung ba mi mnga' 'bad pas rab tu bsgrub par bya/ /rjogang tshe gsung ba mnga' ba de tshe gzhan la ltos dang bral/ /de ni lha mo'i sras yin bsam gyis mi khyab dbang dang ldan/ /rgyal ba'i sras po sgrib pa kun dang bral ba dpal ldan yin/ /de yis dngos grub dang ni mtshan ma gnyis ka ji srid du/ /gnang bar ma gyur de srid gzhan la zur tsam smra mi bya/ /skad cig de nyid la ni dngos grub ring 'gyur dran par bya//grub par gyur nas sngags g.yog dang ni sgrub pa'i grogs mchog ⑦la/ /dngos grub cha la ser sna bral bas sbyin pas phan gdags bya/ /pha ma dang ni bla ma la yang dngos grub rdzas dag las/ /chos mchog skal ba bgo bar rgyud rnams las ni rnam par bshad/ /mdor na dngos grub dag ni ji ltar bgo ba blo ldan gyis/ /rgyud rnams nyid las ji ltar bshad pa'i rjes 'brangs shes par bya/ /'di ni dngos grub blang ba dang bgo ba'i rab tu dbye ba'o// //gang dag dkyil 'khor mchog tu dbang bskur ma thob skye bo dang / /sdom dang dam tshig mi srung bla ma'i bka' las 'das pa dang / /bla ma la ni mi gus 40—1461

yid kyis bla ma la ni 'phya/ /de bzhin sngon du bla ma dag la gus shing shog na spyod//blo ni the tshom dra bas khyab cing brtson 'grus zhan pa dang / /blo gros mi brtan nyin gcig bzhin du lha rnams gzhan 'dzin dang / /sdang zhing bud med ①bsnyen bkur bdag gir byed dang de bzhin du/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed ma byas gnyid la dga' ba dang / /shin tu blun zhing chags dang sdang ba dregs a+yoldan de bzhin du/ /sdug bsngal dag la bzod pa bskyed par mi nus sems stobs chung / /cung zad smod tshig thos na rab tu mi dga' de bzhin du/ /cung zad bstod pas rab dga' rnyed pa la ni brkam pa dang / /cung zad sngags kyi mthu snyems rmi lam tsam gyis dregs pa dang / /glegs bam 'dzin cing man ngag yod ces mi rnams la smra dang / /phrag dog dri mas sbags shing man ngag med la ser snas bcings/ /stong nyid ston pa'i chos la sdang zhing dngos por 'dzin la dam/ /nyan thos spyod pa la ni mngon zhen sngags tshul sun par byed/ /bdag gi phyogs la mngon zhen gzhan phyogs dag la rnam par sdang / /rta la sogs pa zhon zhing lcag gis gzhu dang glo rdebs byed/ /chang 'thung ba dang 'jig rten gtam la dga' zhing zas la brkam/ /'dus par 'gro dang dmag dang 'thab mo'i bya ba rnams la dga'/ /rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor du kha 'dzin phra mas 'tshe bar byed/ /rang gis dpyad pas sngags tshul zab mo rnams la sdeb 6spyor byed/ /bla ma'i lung thob med par sngags rnams 'chad par kun du rtsom/ /bsnyen bkur dman zhing bla ma rnams la myur du man ngag 'dod/ /'di 'dra'i mi yis gaṅgā'i bye ma mnyam par rab bsgrubs kyang / /dngos grub mi 'byung de dag phung po rnam par nyams par 'gyur/ /'di ni sgrub pa po'i skyon gyi rab tu 40—1462

dbye ba'o// //gang gis sngar bshad skyon spangs de ni dngos grub snod yin te/ /de la bla mas man ngag ma lus sbyin pas phan gdags bya/ /des ni dngos grub ma lus myur du 'grub par 'gyur ba'o/ /de ni blo ldan rgyal ba'i myu gu rig 'dzin rnams kyi grogs/ /'khor bar gnas kyang pad+ma bzhin du dri mas nyams mi 'gyur/ /'di ni dngos grub snod kyi rab tu dbye ba'o// //①gang tshe sgrol ma'i rnal 'byor pa ni na bar gyur pa na/ /phyi nang 'chi ba'i mtshan ma dag ni legs par brtag par bya/ /'chi ba'i mtshan ma byung gyur sgrol ma 'byung ba ④las gsungs pa'i/ /phyi nang slu bas 'chi bdag bsrung ④phyir rab tu brtson par bya/ /'chi ba'i mtshan ma snang min ④de tshe sman mchog dag la ni/ /rtsa ba'i gsang sngags nad zhi ba dang spel ba btab nas ni/ /bza' dang lus byug bya zhing lha mo sku mdog rnam dkar bas/ /bdud rtsis yongs bkang rin chen bum pas spyi bor dbang bskur bas/ /shin tu bde bas lus khyab nad rnams rab tu zhi bar bsam/ /sman pa'i dpyad rnams spang bar mi bya 'on kyang sngags mchog dang / /dbang bskur ba ni nad rnams rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i mchog /'di ni 'chi ba'i dus las slu ba dang nad gso ba'i rnam par dbye ba'o// //de nas sbyin sreg cho gas zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang ni/ /gsad budang 40—1463

dgug par 'dod dang ①rtsa ba'i rgyud la ④gsungs pa yi/ /cho gas sbyin sreg ①rab tu brtsam bya 'di ni rtogs rjopar sla/ /tshar bcad pa dang dbab dang de bzhin 'tshe ba thams cad ni/ /zhi bar bya ba rtsa ba'i rgyud las gsungs pa sngags pas dpyad—/ /'di ni las thams cad rab tu dbye ba'i rnam par dbye ba'o// //de ltar sgol ma la gus rnal 'byor pa'i/ /bsgom pa'i cho ga rnam par rgyas bshad pas/ /'gro rnams srid mtsho las brgal sgol ma yi/ /go 'phang la ni myur du gnas par shog /'phags ma lha mo sgrol ma bsgom pa'i cho ga rgyas pa slob dpon chen po mar me mdzad bzang po'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar kyi mkhan po chen po ⑤dul ba'i lha dang / bod kyi lo tsā rjob dge slong chos kyi shes rab kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //40byed1464

༄ga /'dzigs pa brgyad las skyob pa bzhugs/①༄7/ /bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnal 'byor pa'i dbang phyug bsam gtan gyi khang par zhugs te/ stan bde ba la 'dug cing / snying rje chen pos 'gro ba thams cad gdon par bya'o zhes dam bcas nas—/ lha mo sgrol ma bsgom par bya'o/ /de yang rim pa 'di ltar bya ste/rnal 'byor pa rang gi snying gar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yi ge t+t+waṃ bsams la1/ de las 'od zer lcags kyu 'dra ba spros pas/ lha mo dang rang gi bla ma dang yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams mdun kyi nam mkha' la gsal bar bltas te/ de la phyag 'tshal ba dang / sdig pa bshags pa dang /gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ba dang / lus dbul ba dang / smon lam gdab pa rnams byas la/ de nas don dam par bdag dang lha la sogs pa rang bzhin med cing gdod ma nas ma skyes par bsam zhing /40—1467

de brtan par bya ba'i phyir oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā ①na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma kopho⑤haṃ zhes pas stong pa nyid du bsgom mo/ /de nas paṃ las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus su/rang gi sems nyid sngon gyi smon lam gyi dbang gis yi ge t+t+waṃ las lha mo sgrol ma bskyed par bya ste/ de yang sku mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ phyag g.yas pa mchog sbyin kyi phyag rgyas gnas pa/ g.yon pa ①at+pa la bsnams pa/don yod grub pa'i dbu rgyan can/ skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs pa/ ji srid mi skyo ba'i bar du bsgoms la/ skyo na bzlas pa la 'jug par bya'o/ /oṃ tā re tut+ta re tu re swā hā/ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyi phreng ba rang gi snying ga nas phyung ste/yang rang gi zhal du zhugs yang rang gi ④kha nas 'byung ba'i rim pa sngags kyi kha dog dkar po dal bus 'khor bar bsam zhing bzlas par bya'o/ /bzlas pas kyang skyo na mchod pa dang gtor ma btang ste smon lam btab pa⑤/ lha mo'i nga rgyal gyis spyod lam thams cad la gnas par bya'o/ /nyal ba'i tshe stong pa nyid du zhugs te nyal bar bya'o/ /yang langs pa'i tshe skad cig tsam gyis lha mo'i nga rgyal gyis ⑥ldang bar bya'o/ /'jigs pa brgyad las skyob pa slob dpon mkhas pa dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //40—1468

bsdur mchan/1467 ①mtshan byang 'di 〈0sdo 〉྾〈co 〉〉star bkod/ ②〈〈snar 〉to/la/1468 ①〈〈snar 〉〉sto/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wa3/ ①〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉sgas/ du〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉〉snying / ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ rjo〈〈pe 〉྾po ra 〉〉walha mo'i nga rgyal gyis/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2312)40wa 1469

ras /'phags ma sgol ma la bstod pa/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya tā rā ④sto tra/ bod skad du/'phags ma sgrol ma la bstod pa/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma ④sgol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha dang lha min cod pan kyis/ /zhabs kyi pad+mo rjol btud de/ /phongs pa kun las sgrol mdzad cing / /sgol ma la ni phyag 'tshal lo/ /rab 'bar dra bas khyab pa yi/ /mnar med me yis gdungs pa la/ /thugs rjes bdud rtsi'i char 'be+ebs ma/ /sgrol ma la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro drug gnas su yun ring du④/ /yang dang yang du 'khor ba yisarjo/ /dub pa dag la bde chen gyi/ /bde ba mchog gi ngal so mdzad/ /gzhan don mdzad pa'i lha mo khyod/ /dran pa tsam gyis phongs sel ma/ /thugs rje brtse ldan khyod kyis ni/ /srid pa'i 'ching ba las grol mdzod/ /dus rnams rtag tu sems can la/ /bu bzhin snyoms pa'i lha mo khyod/ /'gro ba'i lo tog thams cad la/ /char rgyun 40byed1470

'be+ebs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyi ma zla ba ji bzhin du/ /'gro ba sems can thams cad kyi/ /mun pa'i gdung ba sel mdzad ma/ /lha mo mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /pad+ma zla ba ut+pa la/ /de bzhin dri med gdan stengs su/ /sku mdog sngo ljang 'gying bag can/ /ut+pal bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags shing / /bar du gcod pa'i sgrib pa kun spangs nas/ /bsdu ①dngos bzhi yis ②'gro rnams sdud mdzad ma/ /thugs rje dang ldan ④ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku yi skyon spangs mtshan dang dpe byad ldan/ /gsung gi skyon spangs ka la ping ka'i dbyangs/ /thugs kyi skyon spangs shes bya mtha' dag mkhyen/ /bkra shis dpal 'bar ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji ltar nor bu chu 'dang rjoltar/ /lha mo khyod kyis dhirtag par ni/ /'gro ba'i sems rnyog sel mdzad cing / /'gro don brtson la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gis khyod kyi mtshan bzung ༷cing / /bstod dang bsgrub pa byas pa rnams/ /rtag tu 'bras bu yod par mdzad/ /mi bsnyel khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rje btsun ma sgol dze+em la bstod pa dī paṃ kā sker shrī dzñā nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po de nyid dang / bod kyi lo tsā ⑨ba tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur ba'o// //40—1471

bsdur mchan/147༷ ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉༄ / /'phags ma sgrol ma la bstod pa bzhugs/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉ring/ ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wa'aphags ma/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉〈d+ma/du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar snastanangs su/ ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉sten/1471 ①〈〈snar 〉〉bsdus/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉staspri/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉can/ 〈〈snar 〉〉bcan/ rjo〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉dngas/⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stekyi/ ༅〈〈pe 〉ston khyod kyi mtshan gzung / 〈〈snar 〉stan khyod kyis mtshan gzung / ⑦〈〈snar 〉〉wam sgrol/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ka ⑨〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉thats+tsha/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2313)40wa 1472

༄ga /'phags ma sgol ma'i sgrub thabs/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya tā rā ②sā dha rna/ bod skad du/'phags ma sgol ma'i sgrub thabs/ 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten gsum mgon yum gyur spyan yangs ma/ /sgrol ma'i zhabs kyi pad+mor 1rab btud nas/ /yun rings bla ma bsten las gang 'ongs pa'i/ /sgrub thabs cho ga bsdus pa bshad par bya/ /yid 'ong gnas ni gang yang rung ④/ /me tog dri zhim gcal bkram sterjo/ /spos kyis rjonyams dgar byas nas ni/ /de dbus stan bzang bde ba la/ /srid pa'i bde ba yongs spangs pa'i/ /rnal 'byor can gyis ⑦nyer 'dug nas/ /snying ga'i sa bon las byung ba'i/ /'od zer tshogs kyis ⑧bla ma dang / /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /sbyan drangs de bdag ⑨mdun nyid du/ /mchod pas yang dag rab mchod nas/ /dkon mchog gsum sogs rjes dran bya/ /oṃ swa bhā ba shurnya ཿsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba 40—1473

shurnyolhahaṃ①—/ oṃ shu n+ya tādzñā na badz+ra swa bhā ba da kopho②haṃ/ de nas brtan pa dang g.yo ba thams cad stong pa nyid du rnam par bsam mo/ /de nas paṃ las byung ba'i pad+ma tshad ①chen po'i dbus su rab tu rdzogs pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la yi ge t+t+waṃ ljang gu bsams te/ de yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid yi dam sgol ma gesku mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pa mchog sbyin pa/g.yon pa byed la 'dzin pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ lo bcu drug lon pa lta bu/ gzi brjid bzod par dka' ba dang ldan pa/ zhal cung zad 'dzum pa dang ldan pa/ skra'i tshogs lhag par bcings shing zla ba'i 'od can/rdo rje skyil mo krung gis zla ba'i dkyil 'khor mnan pa/ spyan pad+ma gzhon nu'i 'dab ma lta bu/ cung zad 'dzum pa mdun nyid du gzigs pa'i 'phags ma sgrol ma nu ma'i dkyil 'khor mkhregs pa sdedang ldan pa rnam par bsam mo de nas rang gi snying ga'i t+t+waṃ las 'od zer byung ba rnams kyis rje btsun ma yang dag par bskul la/ sa bon las byung ba'i mchod pa rnams kyis ⑦yang dag par mchod nas byed la'i phyag rgyas rang gi lus la bstem par bya'o/ /de nas gnas ji lta ba rnams su rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa rnams bsam zhing / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dbang bskur ba don du gnyer te/ bdag gi dbu rgyan la gsung rdo rjes rgyas gdab par bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu rang gi snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la yi ge t+t+waṃ la sogs pa rnam par bkod par byadze+e/ spro ba dang basbu ba'i rim pas bsgom par bya'o/ /gang gi tshe skyo ba na/ oṃ tā re tut+ta re tu re swā hā/ zhes bya ba'i sngags bzlas so/ /de nas gang gi tshe ldang bar 'dod pa na rang gi snying gar gnas pa'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros te/ des sems 40—1474

can thams cad la phog ①slar yang 'od zer spros pas de dag gi ②snying gar zhugs par blta ①zhing / de nyid kyis de dag thams cad lha mo'i skur gyur par lhag par mos par bya'o/ /de nas slang yang sa bon las byung ba'i 'od zer bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin rnams kyi ༷gtor ma'i snod yongs su bkang la/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā shā ār+ya rjonut+pan+da tāta oṃ uhūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bya bas byin gyis brlabs la phul la/ de nas ye shes sems dpa' mdun du bzhugs pa la dmigs pas yi ge brgya pa yongs su bzlas nas/ legs par mchod de/mngon par 'dod pa'i dngos grub gsol ba ⑥btab la/ oṃ tā ⑦re tuṣ+ṭha re tu re muḥzhes pas gshegs su gsol lo④/ /rim pa 'dis thun mtshams bzhir bsgoms na ⑨myur bar dngos grub thob ⑫par 'gyur ro/ /da ni bsrung 7ba'i sbyor ba cung zad bshad par bya ste/ sngar bshad pa'i tshul gyis rtsa ba'i sngags 'bum phrag bcu bzlas shing sgrol ma'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pas bzlas pa'i cho ga snga ma lta bu nyid las khyad par du bsgrub bya'i ming sngags kyi dbus na gnas par bsam la bzlas ⑫pa ji srid 'dod kyi bar du bya'o/ /de nas sa bon gyi yi ge las 'od zer byung bas bsgrub bya'i lus thams cad khyab par bltas te/ des lus rab tu tshim par gyur cing nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad dang bral bar mos par bya'o/ /'di ni zhi ba'i srung ⑩ba'o/ /de nas phyir bzlog pa'i srung ⑫ba bshad pa/ cho ga snga ma dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas rang gi snying gar t+t+waṃ ljang gu 'od zer gyi phreng ba 'khrugs par bsams la/ de las byung ba'i 'od zer gyi tshogs 'bar bas gdug pa'i lus gcer bu skra grol ba ⑫'dar zhing skyabs dang bral ba'i snying gar zhugs pas de rengs pa dang mnan pa dang /40—1475

rmongs pa dang / bcings par rnam par bsam mo/ /gang gi tshe de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyis skyo ba ①na sa bon gyi yi ge la dmigs pas gsang sngags bzlas pa bya ste/ na maḥ②āt+yā ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ tā re tuṣ+ṭha re tu re sarba duṣ+ṭhan①/ pra duṣ+ṭanarjo—/ ma ma kṛ te dze+e bha ya/ s+t+waṃ bha ya/ mo ha ⑤ya/ brnya ya/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ sat+tha duṣ+ṭan rjos+t+waṃ bha ni tā re swā hā/ srung ba 'di dag kyang thun mtshams bzhir bsgom par bya'o/ /de bzhin du lam du 'gro bas ting nge 'dzin dang bcas pas mdud pa dor ⑦nas sngags dran pa dang ⑧ldan par phyin na chom rkun ⑨dang / stag dang / dom dang / dred dang / sgrul dang / nags kyi ba ④men dang / chu la spyod pa rnams kyis brdzi bar mi nus te/gang gi tshe 'jigs pa dang bral ba na mdud pa slar dgrol bar bya'o/ /de ltar yun ring ⑪bla ma bsten las gang thob pa'i/ /sgrub thabs cho ga 'di ni legs bkod pas/ /sgol ma zhes grags sras bcas bzhugs pa'i gnas/ /gru 'dzin dpal du 'gro rnams myur 'gro shog /'phags ma sgol ma'i sgrub thabs dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so⑩// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po budha kā ra barma dang / bod kyi lo tsā ⑫ba dge slong chos kyi shes rab kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //40—1476

bsdur mchan/1473 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉༄ga /'phags ma sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉ring/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pad+mar/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉spa la ru/du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉te/ du〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉4)/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉4)/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉7kyi/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stanag1474 ①〈〈pe 〉〉barba dharma swā bha shu ha/ 〈〈snar 〉〉barba dharma swa bha ba shu haṃ/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wa3/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈'dir 〉〉watshad/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉to/yi dam sgrol ma/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉pakhreng ba/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ye shes sems dpa' bkug ste/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉de/1475 ①〈〈pe 〉〉drang la/ 〈〈snar 〉〉dungs la/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wagi/ ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉rto/ ④〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉7kyis/⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉snam bya/ rjo〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉mi ba/ ⑦〈〈snar 〉〉tu/ ⑤〈〈snar 〉mi lo/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉dze'adir 〉〉nas / ⑩〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉toragrub/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉srung / ⑫〈〈snar 〉〉ris/ ⑫⑫〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bsrung / ⑫〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bar/1476 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉wab/ ②〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉waḥ/ ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉〉 hā sarba duṣ+ṭan/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉duṣ+ṭan/ rjo〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa hā/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉barba duṣ+ṭan/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bor ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉pa/ 〈〈snar 〉〉sgar/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉〉pa/ ⑩〈〈snar 〉〉bar/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉rings ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈'dir 〉〉wapa'o/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉thats+tsha/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2314)40wa 1477

༄ga /chom rkun bcing ba ①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ tso rā ④brnya/ bod skad du/ chom rkun bcing ba/ rje btsun sgol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lam du 'gro ba la ④chos rkun mi 'ong bar bya ba'i phyir them pa nas gom pa bdun gzhal ba'i sa nas lag pa g.yas pas sa sbar ba gang blangs la/ de nas rang skad cig gis rje btsun mar bskyed la/ skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed tshul bzhin du dhibyas la/ lag pa g.yas pa'i sa de lo las ri rab ⑤tsam du bskyed de/ lag pa g.yon du baṃ las rgya mtsho chen por bskyed la/ dmigs pa rjode ring bdag la gnod par ⑦byed pa'i chom rkun thams cad mdun du bkug ste/ mi'i tshig gis bar ma chod par sngags 'di brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas te/ oṃ tā re tut+ta re tu re asma a ba ka ra sarba tso rā brnya ban+dha ④swā hā/ zhes bya'o/ /mdun gyi chom rkun pa thams cad rgya mtsho chen por blugs la/ g.yas kyi sa de g.yon du spos la ri rab kyis mnan par bsam mo/ /40—1478

de nas sa de thu ba g.yon par bcings te 'jigs pa dang bral ba'i gnas su ①dgrol bar bya'o/ /'gro ba'i dus su sgrol ma'i ②bstod pa la sogs pa sgrogs shing 'gro'o—/ /chom rkun bcing ba zhes bya ba'i rim ⑧pa rdzogs so// //ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta shrī rat+na rak+ṣi ta dang / lo tsā 0ba zhang grub pa dpal bzang pos bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/1478 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉skosnar 〉stami ra/ ③〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra/ 0〈〈pe 〉lopornor 〉to/du/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉thab/ 0〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉4sa ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉7/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉snga'ar 〉〉tso ra brnya/1479 ①〈〈pe 〉sko'adir 〉〉wasu/ ②〈〈pe 〉lo〈snar 〉to/sgrol ma'i/ ①〈〈pe 〉lotshornor 〉sgyurdog 0〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉sgots+tsha/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2315)40wa 1479
