༄ga /'phags ma sgol ma'i rjes su spyod pa'i gnod sbyin mo'i sgrub thabs/sti༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya tā rā nu ②tsar+ya yak+ṣi ṇi ma dru sā dha rna/bod skad du/ 'phags ma sgol ma'i rjes su spyod pa'i gnod sbyin mo'i sgrub thabs/'phags ma sgol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ dzo yak+ṣi bhā bi ra dze ①swā hā me lha'i bu mo gnod sbyin mo'i cho ga di 'di yin te/ dur khrod kyi spang ④leb la bris te/rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ gcer bu ras kyi gos bsnams pa⑤/ mgo skyes li ba/ gzhon nu ma/ rgyan gyis mjes pa/ shing mya ngan med pa dang bcas pa lag pa g.yon pas bzung rjob/ lag pa g.yas pas ras bsnams pa/spyan sa bon gyi grong khyer gyi 'bras bu la gzigs pa/ zhal cung zad dpangs mtho ba/ bzhad pa/ 'khrig pa la sred pa/ 'di 'dra ba spang leb la bris la/dbe+en pa'i gnas su rang gcig pur khrus byas shing ⑦bkug pas thun mtshams su mchod do/ /ba'i lci bas maṇ+ḍal byas la/ gtsang sbra thob pas ⑧dben par 40—1480

zas gtsang ma ①za zhing thun mtshams gsum du bha gar sor mo bcug la de'i mdun du stong phrag brgyad bzlas na nyi ma bdun na 'byon no/ /byon nas tsan+dan dkar po dang / me tog dri zhim pos spras pa'i mchod yon dbul lo/ /kho mos ⑤ci bgyi zhes smra bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas sgrub pa pos smras pa/ kho bo'i sring mo'am mar mdzod cig /de nas ④sring mo'am mar 'gyur ro/ /bdag nyid dang bcas pa'i skye bo bcu drug gi rjozas gos sbyor bar 'gyur ro/ /lus kyi khur gyis dpal gyi ri po ta lar khrid par byed do/ /der 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi zhal mthong nas chos nyan cing byang chub kyi sems ma rmongs pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin thob po/ /gal te 'dod na slar 'dzam bu rjogling nas 'ongs shing de dang rol par 'gyur ro/ /gal te dang po nyi ma bdun gyis ma grub na de'i tshe bdun phrag gnyis pa la tshangs pa bsad kyang 'grub porjo/ /de nas slar ma grub na khro bo'i rgyal po'i sngags bzlas te/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ya mān+ta ka hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dzo yak+ṣi bhā ④bi ra dze swā hā/ gnod sbyin mo'i sngags nang du bcug nas bzlas na 'grub bo⑧/ /de nas gal te des kyang ma grub na skams pa'am 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /sngon kyi bsnyen pa gong ⑪dang de ru gnas pa'am 'bum phrag gsum ⑩bzlas so/ /'phags ma sgrol ma'i rjes su spyod pa'i ⑪gnod sbyin mo'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po bai ro tsa na'i zhal snga nas kyi ⑫dang / bod kyi lo tsā ⑫ ba dar ma blo gros kyis bsgyur ba'o// //40—1481

bsdur mchan/148༷ ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉)gyi/ /'phags ma sgrol ma'i rjes su spyod pa'i gnod sbyin mo'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// ②〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ring/ ③〈〈pe 〉〉ṇi bi ra tse/ 〈〈snar 〉〉ṇi pa ri tse/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉gsangs/ ⑤〈〈snar 〉〉wapa/ 0〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉gzung /⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stan zhing / ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉tho ba/1481 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ba/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉mo/ ②〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉negazung ste/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stagos/⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉mdzasgru'i/ ⑥〈〈snar 〉stedza grub bo/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ṇi/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉wa'agrubabo/⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagang / ⑩〈〈snar 〉〉wagasum/ ⑫〈〈snar 〉ri grub sbyong ba'i/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wakyi/⑫〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉yots+tsha/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2316)40wa 1482

༄ga /me tog phreng 'dzin gyi sgrub pa bstod pa dang bcas pa ①༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ sra ga dhā ⑤ra sā dha dz+wa sastu ti/ bod skad du/me tog phreng 'dzin gyi sgrub pa bstod pa dang bcas pa/ bcom ldan 'das ma sgol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi shes pa rnams 'joms pa'i phyir/ /bcom ldan sgrol ma phreng 'dzin gyi/ /sgrub pa'i ③thabs kyi rim pa 'di/ /de nyid 'dod pas ④rgyun du bya/ /yid 'phrog gtsang ma'i gnas su 'dug /dngos sam sngags kyis ⑤rnal 'byor bkru/ /mthun rkyen mchod pa'i rdzas rnams ni/ /dngos sam yid kyis brten par bya/ /shar du kha bltas rnal 'byor pas/ /gzhan phan sems kyis lha mo bsgom/ /mdangs dudakar zla gnas bzhengs pa yi/ /dpag med yon tan rgyan gyis spras/ /ston ka'i dbang po lta bur dkar/ /rang bzhin gsar du shar bas brgyan/ /ut+pal 'dab ltar spyan mdzes shing / /dpral bar sin+tu ra yis bskus⑦/ /rna ba mgul rgyan phyag gdub dang / /do 40—1483

shal rked pa rkang pa la/ /g.yer kha sil sil rab tu mdzes/ /dgyes pa'i sku can sgeg par mdzad tu7/ /nu mar mu tig do shal ldan/ /sham thabs za 'og rgyan gyis brgyan/ /smin mas at+pal mdangs 'phrog pa/ /rin chen gyis spras cod pan ni/ /'dzam bu'i gser gyi steng na bcings/ /ral par 'od dpag med pas brgyan/ /'di nyid yid 'ong mdzes pa ste/ /mthong dang brjod dang dran pa yis/ /khams gsum sems can thams cad kyi/ /snying gi sdog pa thams cad 'joms/ /gang zhig bcom ldan 'das ma ru/ /skad cig ma yis ②rnal 'byor gyis/ /bcom ldan 'das ma'i nga rgyal du/ /rgyun du bskyed par bya ba'oske/ /mchod pa'i cho ga thams cad la/ /sngags kyi ①byin kyis brlab bupar byarka/ /las kun byed pa'i sngags kyis ni/ /rnal 'byor pas ni bya ba'o/ /rtag tu'am ni thun gsum du/ /'dir ni gtsang ma'i khrus bya'o/ /tshangs par spyod pa gzung bar bya/ /gos ni thun gyi dus su spodu/ /mi dge bcu po 'joms par bya/ /mi dge'i las ni thams cad la/ /yid ni sbyar bar mi bya'o//de bzhin sgrub pa po yis ni/ /bcom ldan 'das mar rang nyid ni/ / mngon sum bum byas bar du bsgom/ /de la sngon du byed pa yis/ /man ngag dam pa bshad par bya/ /srog 'dzin ma rig ling tog ni/ /'joms par byed pa kho na'o / /'di ltar ā li'i sbyor ba yis/ /gnyis med chu yi dkyil 'khor la/ /sgyu ma'i sa bon 'dzag pa yi/ /rgyun dang bcas pa blta bar bya/ /dag par mi byed de 'og tu/ /dkyil 'khor sprul pa'i rang bzhin la/ /kho na nyid kyi ⑦sa bon ni/ /nyi ma phyed pa'i 'od dang mtshungs/ /sgrol ma'i rnam pa thams cad kyis④ / /mi shes sreg par mdzad pa ste/ /phyogs bcu po yang sbyong bar mdzad/ /40—1484

steng gi sa bon 'dzag pa can/ /bdud rtsi'i rgyun du yid kyis ni/ /yun ring dus su bsgoms ①pa'o/ /de las skyo bar gyur pa na/ /lce ni chu skyes 'dab ma la—/ /bla ma'i man ngag bsam par bya/ /de nas sngags kyi phreng ba ni/ /rdza mkhan 'khor lo lta bur bskor/ /nor bu sngags kyi stobs kyis ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes dang / /bdud rtsi gzhan yang yon tan stobs/ /rdza ba khron par gzhug par bya/ /rgyun mi 'chad ④pa'i bsam gtan du/ /rnal 'byor pas ni bzlas pa nyid/ /gang zhig de ltar yid kyis ni/ /bya ba 'di ni goms pa na/ /bde ba chen po'i ting nge 'dzin/ /rgyun mi 'chad ①par skye bar 'gyur / /'dir ni 'di yi bsam gtan gyisadhi/ /nyi ma bdun du byas pa na/ /shes rab che dang ngag dbang rno/ /rkang drug tshogs kyi bdag por 'gyur/ /tshigs su bcad dang lhug pa dang / /'dres pa dang ni lha yi skad/ /tshegs med ngag gi dbang phyug ni/ /'bad pa med par 'grub pa ste/ /'di la the tshom ma byed cig /de nas bstod pa brjod pa yang / /me tog phreng ba nyid yin no/ /de dang de ni zhal las shes/ /shes rab pha rol phyin ma ni/ /dngos su grub par 'dod pa yis/ /rnal 'byor pas ni rig pa 'di/ /ri bong phyed la dus gsum du/ /gong du bshad pa'i cho ga yis/ /sngon gyi brtul zhugs spyad nas ni/ /dben pa'i gnas su sems gcig tu/ /bcom ldan 'das ma'i bstod pa ni/ /rgyun chad med par brjod par bya/ /de nas klog pa'i man ngag ni/ /brjod ma thag tu yid la ni/ /rtsa ba nas ni rtse mo'i bar/ /ji ltar rim pas rjes su ni/ /kho na nyid kyi sa bon dang / /nus pa'i sa bon byed par ldan/ /sgyu ma'i sa bon brjod pa nyid/ /rim pas bcom ldan 'das 40—1485

ma yi/ /yon tan brjod pa'i 'od zer gyis/ /g.yeng ba med par bdag nyid ni—/ /yid ni brtan par ①klog pa nyid/ /de nyid shar kha'i ②nyi ma ste/ /de yi gdan la bsam par bya/ /sgyu ma phyed pa'i nyi ma ste/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nyid du gnas/ /nus pa ston ka'i zla ba ste/ /pad+ma'i rtse la bsam pa nyid/ /bzlas pa'i dus su 'khor ba ste/ /klog pa'i dus su mchod pa nyid/ /rmongs dang 'jigs dang dug med dang / /mi mthun phyogs las rgyal bar 'gyur/ /'dod pa gzhan yang sgrub byed pa/ /'khor lo 'di la rab tu 'byung / /nor bus ④dgos 'dod 'byung ba ltar/ /'dir ni 'bad pa rjobasgrub par bya/ /sgol ma ske tog phreng 'dzin gyi/ /mngon par rab brtan cho ga bya⑤/ /dge bas mnyam par ⑥'gro ba kun/ /myur du sgrol ma nyid mtshungs shog /me tog phreng 'dzin sgrol ma'i bstod pa dang bcas pa'i sgrub ⑦pa rdzogs so// //ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta rat+na rak+ṣi ta pā da'i zhal snga nasaske/ zhang lo tsā ⑨ba grub pa dpal bzang pos bsgyur ba'o// //⑩40—1486

bsdur mchan/1483 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉khog /me tog phreng 'dzin gyi sgrub thabs bzhugs so// ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dha/ ②〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉pa/ dhi〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa/rjo〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉kyi/ rjo〈〈pe 〉toradam/ 〈〈snar 〉skaradas/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉kus/ 〈〈snar 〉〉bkus/1484 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉torab tu mdzes/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba yi/ ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉4)sa/ du〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉brlabs/ du〈〈pe 〉〉spro/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanangos su/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉nyams/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stakyi/1485 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bsgom/ ②③〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉cad/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉7)/1486 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pas/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ba'i/ ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉bu'i/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pas/rjo〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉byas/ dhi〈〈snar 〉〉pa'i/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pas bsgrub/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ri dang /⑨〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉thats+tsha/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉 rtag tu dpal gnas gyur// // 〈〈snar 〉〉 rtag tu dpal gnas gyur//bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2317)40wa 1487

༄༅/ /'phags ma sgol ma la bstod pa/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya tā rā ④sto tra/ bod skad du/'phags ma sgol ma la bstod pa/ bcom ldan 'das ngag gi dbang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dad pa'i lteng ka rab tu rgyas pa la/ /'dun pa pad+ma'i rtsa ba rab tu brtan/ /rtsol ba drag po pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs/ /rje btsun sgol ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro ba nyon mongs tshad pas gdungs pa la/ /thugs rjes bsil mdzad zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs/ /'gro ba nyam thag sgol ba'i snelha mo ste//rje btsun ④sgol ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshogs gnyis shing rta'i 'khor lo lta bu yis/ /sgrib gnyis bcom nas sa bcur rab gnas te/ /lha mo'i tshul du 'khor ba ma stongs bzhugs/ /rje btsun sgol ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyon mongs mi g.yo ri ltar brtan pa'i sku/ /yon tan rab rdzogs sha lus shin tu rgyas//byams pas thugs g.yos nu 'bur rjorgyas pa can/ /rje btsun sgrol ma khyod la 40byed1488

phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khor bas ma gos sku mdog 'gying bag can/ /sgeg pa'i cha lugs rin chen rgyan cha can/ 8bu skra sngo ljang rigs lnga'i cod pan can/ /rje btsun sgol ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zag med bde rgyas zhal ras 'dzum bag can/ /rnam snang las byung phrin las thugs rje can/ /bdud 'joms mda' gzhu thabs dang shes rab can/ /rje btsun sgol ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo//'jigs pa skyob mdzad phyag g.yas skyabs sbyin tshul/ /'gro ba'i yid 'phrog na tshod bcu drug tshul/ /las kyi rigs tshogs ut+pal sngon po'i tshul/ /rje btsun sgrol ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skye rgas na 'chi'i chu bo bzhi po las/ /sgol ba'i gnyen po ①mkhas pa khyod lags te/ /byams pa'i gru 'dzin snying rje'i skya ba 1 can—/ /rje btsun sgrol ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de ltar tshigs su bcad pa brgyad kyis ni/ /lha mo nyid la dad pas bstod pa las/ /des ni 'gro ba sems can thams cad kyis①/ /myur du sangs rgyas go 'phang thob par shog /rje btsun ma sgrol ma la bstod pa/ slob dpon ma ti tsi tras ④mdzad pa rdzogs so// //40—1489

ras /'phags ma sgol ma la bstod pa/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya tā re sto tra/ bod skad du/ 'phags ma sgol ma la bstod pa/ rje btsun thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'od dpag med kyi smon lam ma/ /me tog zla mdzes sems bskyed ma/ /'jig rten mgon gyi chu skyes ma/ /phyag gi mthil na bzhin bzangs ma/ /stod ②rgyas me tog phreng 'dzin ma/ / bgres mo bgying 1bag drang po ma/ /gshegs shing bzhugs pa ldem ldem ma/ /phrag rgyas sku ni yid 'ong ma/ /gsung gi dbang phyug dbyangs snyan ma/ /dran pa tsam gyis byin rlob ma/ /yum ni 'dod pa'i sgu mnga' ma/ /bde gshegs dbu yi gtsug tor ma/ /rgyal bas dbang bskur cod pan ma/ /pho nyas dus min 'chi slu ④ma/ /spyan nas thugs rje'i chu 'dzag ma—/ /dge slong sdom brtson dam tshig ma/ /bdag med brtse bas mthar phyin ma—/ /sa dgu 'das pa'i pha rol ma/ /ma byon snga dro gzhon nu ma/ /da lta 40—1491

nyin gung dar bab ma/ /'das so bgres mo dgongs ①ka ma/ /dus gsum 'gyur ba'i mi rtag ma/ /'jigs chen brgyad las skyob mdzad ma/ /phra mo chen mo sgrub 465 ma/ /mchog 'dod ma la mchod sbyin ma/ /sems can gso ba'i 'o rgyun ma/ /dug sel sman mchog ma gi ②ma/ /sdig spong dge ba'i bdud rtsi ma/ /sangs rgyas bskyed pa'i rgyal yum ma/ /bdag la thugs rjes zhal ston ma/ /rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la bstod pa ①chos kyi rje paṇ+ḍi ta 'bum phrag gsum pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/1491 lamatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉bstod/①〈〈pe 〉〉bgres mo 'gying / 〈〈snar 〉〉bgras mo 'gying / ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉bslu/1492 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉rgangs/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉8/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉bobastodapa/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2319)40wa 1492

dag /'phags ma lha mo sgol ma la bstod pa/①༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya tā rā de bī ④sto tra/ bod skad du/'phags ma lha mo sgol ma la bstod pa/ rje btsun 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha mo sgol ma lha yi lha/ /'jig rten gsum na mchog gyur pa/ /thugs rje chen po'i dbang gyur pas/ /khams gsum 'gro ba sgrol la mkhas/ /tshor ba btang snyoms ngo bo nyid/ /mi mthun tshor ba bde sdug ldan/ /phrag dog 'joms pa'i phrin las can/ /mkha' ltar dngas pa 3bla na med/ /gzung ba dang ni 'dzin pa yi/ /rnam rtog spangs pa'i bde ba can—/ /pad+ma chus mi chags pa bzhin④/ /'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos pa/ /rang bzhin gyis dag bla na med/ /rgol ba dag ni tshar gcod pa/ /'gro ba yid 'ong phun tshogs pa/ /sku mdog mtshan dang dpe byad ldan/ /sgol ma sna tshogs mdog can ni/ /'byung po las byung gdon chen dang / /'du ba las 40—1493

༄ga /'phags ma sgol ma sgrub pa'i thabs ①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya tā rā ⑤sā dha ne+e/ bod skad du/'phags ma sgol ma sgrub pa'i thabs/ dang po re zhig snesngags pas kha la sogs pa dag par byas nas/ sa phyogs dben par 'dug ste/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed la/ rang gi snying gar a las byung ba'i zla ba'i steng du yi ge t+t+waṃ ljang gu 'od zer dang ldan par bsams nas/ de'i 'od zer kyis ma rig pa'i mun pa bsal nas khams gsum du spros te/ 'gro ba'i don byas nas phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sgrol ma spyan drangs te/ mdun du bltas la/ phyag dang /mchod pa dang / sdig pa bshags pa dang / gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang /bsod nams la rjes su yi rang ba dang / bskul ma gdab pa dang / mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba gdab pa rjozhes bya ba bla na med pa'i yan lag bdun pa'i mchod pa byas nas byams pa la sogs pa tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom par 40byed1495

bya'o—/ /de nas oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā ba byed kolha①haṃ/ zhes bya ba'i byin gyis brlab pa'i sngags brjod cing thams cad stong pa nyid ④bsgom par bya'o//de nas pad+ma dang zla ba'i ④steng du t+t+waṃ yongs su gyur pa las/ byed la sngon po t+t+waṃ gis ④mtshan pa bsam de rnams yongs su gyur pa las⑤/ bcom ldan 'das ma sgol ma rjozhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ sku mdog ljang gu lang tsho dang ldan pa/stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs dang ldan pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/g.yas mchog sbyin dang / g.yon kyis da la bsnams pa pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du g.yon bskum pa'i phyed skyil gyis bzhugs par bdag nyid bsgoms ④la/de'i thugs ka'i zla ba la dam tshig sems ma ji lta ba'i ye shes sems ma dang /de'i thugs ka'i zla ba la yi ge t+t+waṃ ting nge 'dzin sems ma'i tshul du bsam/ de'i 'od zer byus ye shes sems ma spyan drangs pa la sogs pa dang / dbang bskur ba dang / bdud rtsi lhag mas don yod grub pas spyi gtsug tu rgyas btab ste/'od zer 'phros 'dus 'gro ba'i don mdzad par mi skyo'i bar du bsgom par bya'o//skyo na sngags bzlas par bya ste/ oṃ tā re tuṭ+wā re tu re swā hā/ zhes bya ba 'bum phrag bcu bzlas nas stong phrag bcus sbyin sreg ④bya'o/ /'gyur ba med par pha rol la/ /mi zad ⑨dga' bas bdud rtsi'i ros/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal 'joms mdzad ma/ /sgol ma khrod ⑩la phyag 'tshal lo/ /⑪zhes bya bas bzlas pa'i rjes la bstod nas/ yi ge brgya pa brjod de bsod nams bsngos la/ oṃ badz+ra muḥzhes pas gshegs su gsol⑫/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā hūṃ ār+ya nuṣ+pen+d+ra tāta—/ oṃ byedahūṃ phaṭa swā hā zhes bya bas gtor ma'i sngags so/ /zla ba drug gi bar du zhag re re zhing thun gsum du 'di dag bya'o/ /bla ma chen po shākya shrī bha 40byed1496

dras mdzad pa rje btsun sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //rgya gar shar phyogs dzā ①ga ta la'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po bi bhū ②ti tsan+d+ras rang 'gyur du mdzad pa'o// //bsdur mchan/1495 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉༄ga /'phags ma sgrol ma sgrub pa'i thabs bzhugs so// ②〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉tor/ ①〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉por re zhigs/ du〈〈snar 〉〉par/1496 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉to/྅/ ②〈〈pe〉྾〈snar 〉〉〉du/ ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉negadan/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉nya)sa/⑤〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉stanas/ du〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉wasgrol ma/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bsgom/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bsreg ⑨〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉bzad/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉〉sku/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉walo ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈'dir 〉〉skolo//1497 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉mdza/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉sgru/bsdur 'azas re'u migargyud/ (2321)40wa 1497

༄ga /dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ swa ra swa tī ②sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs/ lha mo dbyangs can ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang gi snying ga'i ④srog gi 'od zer gyis/ /dbyangs can ma yi 'khor lo mdun du dgug /me tog bdug pa mar me byug bupas mchod/ /'jug pa'i rlung gis snying gi srog rtsar gzhug /dbus su 1 gis rnam brgyan zla bas lte bar rnam par mdzes/ /mchog tu dkar zhing 'od gsal sgon me lta bu'i chas⑤/ /nyi ma'i rjozer gyis ze'u ④'bru'i mtshams nas shin tu rgyas pa yi/ /dri med 'jam zhing dkar ba'i 'dab ⑧ma re rer gnyis gnyis gnas/ /'od zer dkar po 'phro bas snying gi mun pa rnam par sel ba'o/ /sngon du rig pa 'bum phrag gcig /nyi khri lnga stong bsnyen pa byas⑨/ /de nas rtsod pa smra ba na/ /'khor lo lce la rnam par dgod/ /bsgrub ⑩bya'i dpral bar 'khor lo mchog /bkod nas dbang 40byed1498

du byed par bshad/ /dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs bram ze phur bus mdzad pa rdzogs cas// //bsdur mchan/1498 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉༄ga /dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stosto/ ③〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉ston/ rjo〈〈snar 〉〉byugs/ du〈〈snar 〉〉chags/ du〈〈pe 〉dze'adir 〉〉〉'od/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉dze'adir 〉〉ze/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉po〈snar 〉stabadangs/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bya/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉sko'adir 〉〉sgrub/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2322)40wa 1499

2396༄ga /tshangs pa'i bu tsho dbyangs can ma la bstod pas grub pa ngag gi 'od zer zhes bya ba/①༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ prah+ma bu ṭī ④swa ra sa bye sto tre ṇa sir+ghaṃ wāka pra bha rgyanā ma/ bod skad du/ tshangs pa'i bu mo dbyangs can ma la bstod pas grub ④pa ngag gi 'od zer zhes bya ba/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang zhal kyi mche ba'i rtse las mngon ④sprul zhing / /thugs rje'i rnam 'phrul mtha' yas pha rol rjes su gzung ba'i phyir/ /tshangs pa'i bu mo mdzes ma khyod sku gsal ba'i ⑥rnam 'gyur can/ /bisngu'i gzugs can tam+bu ra la dga' bskyed ④tshul 'dzin ma/ /rjes su chags bcas rol pa'i lo ni bcu drug lon pa'i nyams/ /chu gter 'gram ngogs lbu ba'i phreng bas rtse bar dga' ba can/ /dri za'i bu mo mngon bstod skenyid kyi rnam thar phul byung rnams//gang gis yid la dran byed de la ngag gi dbang phyug stsol/ /kho bos khyod dran ba spu shas cher g.yo ba'i lag pa gnyis/ /thal sbyar me tog gzhon nu kha 'bus lta 40byed1500

bu spyi bo'i steng / /rab bzhag snying nas rab tu gus pa lhur byed khyod kyi yon tan ni/ /mtha' dag rtogs min cung zad rnyed 'di sdeb legs phreng bas mchod//khyod sku 'o ma'i mtsho 'dra kun+da ①ku mud zla zer mtshungs/ /rab dkar 'od kyi phreng bas kun nas bskor ba'i gzi brjid kyis/ /lha dbang yid 'phrog dga' ba'i nga ros khyod la rtag tu bstod byed na/ /blo gros don gsal don gnyer lha la gus pa ②smos ci dgos/ /chu skyes dkar po dri med steng gnas ①ge sar g.yo ba'i rtser/ /ri bong 'dzin pa'i gdan steng rjotsog pu'i tshul bzhugs bgying bag can—/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis dri za'i pi wang bgrengs dhipa'i sgra dbyangs dang / /rjes mthun gsung gis sa rjogasum skye dgu'i bsam pa tshim mdzad ma/ /'jam mnyen ⑦'khril zhing ring ba bung ba lta ⑧bur gnag pa'i skra/ /g.yas g.yon rgyab tu 'phyang zhing cung zad li ba'i thor cog la/ /me tog dkar po'i phreng bas thod bcings spyi gtsug zla bas spud/ /gser gyi rna cha 'phyang zhing mkhur tshos mdzes pa 'dzum pa'i zhal/ /ka tsa lin+da'i smad g.yogs tshom bu'i spras pas sgeg pa'i nyams—/ / puṇ+ḍa rī ⑨ka'i phreng ba chun 'phyang mgul rgyan do shal can/ /phyag zhabs rin chen phreng ba sil sil sgra ldan brgyus pa yis/ /khyed sku lha dang rig 'dzin bu mo'i tshogs kun ngo mtshar gyur/ /lha mo gzhon sgeg lang tshor ldan pa skye dgu'i yid 'phrog ma/ /yid 'ong 'dzum pa'i bzhin can mig dkyus ring po'i zur gyis ni/ /smin ma g.yo ba'i gar can ⑩khyod sku rtag tu dran byed la/ /rab tu dgyes pa'i nyams kyis gzigs shing kho bo rjes su bzung / /mdzad spyod bags kyis dal zhing gsong por smra ba'i ngang tshul can/ /mā li sar pa'i dri ldan nu zho nu bar 'dod pa la/ /reg pas dga' ba'i nu zho stob ⑪byed khyed la rtag 40—1501

tu bstod pa'i bu/ /snying nas yus che shas cher ngu ba'i gdung ba tshim mdzad ma/ /de yi yid la bstod pa'i zol tshig ca cor ma nges pa yi sgra/ /smra ba'i ga zhas ①'dir spel nyid kyi thugs la bas ②gyur mod/ /'on kyang kho bo'i blo ni 'dir zad bu yi nyes pa rnams/ /ma yis bzod mdzod brtse bas slar yang bu ni rab tu skyongs/ /snying gi chu skyes 'dab brgyad dkar po ze'u ①'bru'i phreng ba can/ /dmar ser mdzes pa'i mtshams nas 'od kyi dra ba rab tu dgyerjo/ /ge sar 'jam pa'i rtse mor bsil zer can ni rab gnas pa'i/ /dbus su chu shel mdog 'dzin dz+rī gi phreng bas sgrib gnyis 'joms/ /'dab ma re rer gnyis gnyis bzhugs pa'i a ā la sogs dbyangs yig rnams/ /g.yas su bskor ba'i rim pas mar me'i phreng ba 'bar ba ltar/ /kun nas 'od zer 'phro ba'i rgyan ldan rtse mo'i ⑤rang bzhin kyis/ /yid rjokyi dri ma mun nag rnam bsal blo gos mchog spyod mdzod/ /srog gi 'od zer skra yi khyod ⑦tsam phra ba'i cha shas kyis/ /rtsol ba'i sgo nas myur bar lha mo'i thugs la reg gyur pas/ /'khor lo gnyis pa bskor bas rnam pa bdun pa'i mchod sprin can/ /'jug pa'i rlung zhon rang sems ye shes rgyas mdzad de la 'dud/ /de rjes 1 gi phreng ba mu tig do shal mgal me yi/ /'khor ba'i tshul du 'khor ba zhal gyi sgo nas 'thon gyur cing / /lte ba'i dkyil 'khor nas zhugs slar yang sa bon tsha zer rtser 'bar ba'i mod la dbyangs can ngag ster ④khyod zhabs spyi bos blang / /lha mo gtsang sbra la dga' brdzun spangs 'byung po'i zas dor zhing / /tshangs spyod brtul zhugs can gyis ⑨nyin re dran byas yum bos na/ /slar yang ngag gi dbang phyug ci bzhed gsungs pa'i ⑩gad mo yis/ /dkar gsum zas kyi ⑩dga' ston tshul 40—1502

gyis dngos grub stsol la 'dud/ /de ltar khyod bstod lhur len gang yin de ni yon tan gyis/ /dbul gyur sna tshogs rigs ①pa'i gzhung lugs rnams las nges pa'i don/ /myur rtogs sa gsum skye bo'i gzhung sgron gti mug mun pa rnamasarka/ /rab bsal rgyal ba'i dbang po 'od dpag med 'dra thob par shog /'dir ni 'phags dang mkhas pa'i skye bo phul byung tshogs rnams ston④/ /bdag 'dra khums shing ①mu cor sgogs dhipa dang tshul mi shes mod/ /khyod kyi rjes zhugs lan cig ma yin tshig don goms bya'i phyir/ /sdeb sbyor gtsor byas brag ca'i rjosgra mtshungs 'di ni bstod par rigs/ /tshig 'di gang gis mthong ngam thos sam rtag tu dran byed dam/ /klog dang kha don byed dang bsam don chub byed pa/ /yi ger bri'am gzhan la rgya cher rab tu ston kyang rung / /de yi sems dang ngag la dpal ldan lha mo dbyangs can myur 'jug rjoshog /tshangs pa'i bu mo dbyangs can ma la bstod pas grub ⑦pa ngag gi 'od zer zhes bya bske/ lha mo nyid kyis dngos su byin gyis brlabs pa'i ⑧bram ze phur bus mdzad pa rdzogs so// // sum pa lo tsā ba dar ma yon tan gyis bsgyur ba'o// //⑨40—1503

15༷༷ ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉sngag /tshangs pa'i bu mo dbyangs can la bstod pas 'grub pa ngag gi 'od zer zhes bya ba bzhugs/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉sku tri/①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ston+d+ra ṇa sidhi wāka sā dha/ du〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉sta thub/ ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉rdzon/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉padzes pa'i/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉pa dga' skyed/ 〈〈snar 〉〉pas dga' skyed/ ⑧〈〈snar 〉ri pa/15༷1 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉kun ta/ 〈〈co 〉〉kun dra/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pas/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanas/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉stengs/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgrongs/ du〈〈pe〉྾〈snar 〉〉was/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉sngaganyen/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉blta/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉sngagan da ri/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉)sa/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉stod/15༷2 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉྾〈co 〉smugs/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉nags/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉ze/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉'gyed / ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉rtse ba'i/ 〈〈snar 〉〉ldan rtse ba'i/ du〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉nya)/ /'od/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stan/⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉sngagater/ ⑨〈〈snar 〉nya)/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉sngagasung ba'i/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉kyis/15༷3 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉rig ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bstod/ ②〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉torakhun zhing / rjo〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉sgog⑤〈〈snar 〉snama'i/ ⑥〈〈snar 〉〉rgyag ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉sga thub/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉walhamo — brlabs pa'i/⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉to/sumapa — bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2323)40wa 1504

༄ga /dpal lha mo rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī badz+ra swa ra swa tī de wī ④/ no pi shaṃ/ bod skad du/ dpal lha mo rdo rje ①dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje dbyangs snyan ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gangs ri ltar dkar zla rgyas zhal mnga' dri med bsil zhing gsal ba'i 'od zer phreng ba can/ /sgeg chags 'gying dul 'dzum pa'i mdangs dkar lha yi lha mo kun nas mdzes pa'i gzi ldan ma/ /stong phrag drug cu'i yan lag dbyangs snyan rgyud mangs ④rol mo ut+pal ral gris ⑤phyag mtshan cing / /'jig rten gsum skyabs mkha' dang rgya mtsho'i rgyan gyur blo gros lha mo rgyal gyur cig /pha rol rgol ba tshar gcad dang / /mtha' yas spobs pa kun bskyed dang / /sna tshogs phrin las bde bsgrub ⑥phyir/ /dbyangs can lha mo bsgrub par bya/ /'phags ma de rtag ⑦mgon bzung nas/ /'gro skyabs don kun myur ④brtson pas/ /sman ljongs rab dgar brag rir ⑨ni/ /rnam 40—1505

g.yeng spangs te tshogs bsag dang ①/ /dus snyigs bar chad kun bsal phyir/ /sngon du sngags pas rdo rje 'dzin/ /mnyes byas de rjes snying rje'i yid/ /rab sbyangs rdo rje lha mo bsgom/ /sngags bdag nga rgyal la brtan ④srog /rtsa ba'i yi ge sgon 'dra yi/ /zer spros nas ④ni rgya mtsho nas/ /dbyangs can 'khor lo mdun du dgug /oṃ e bye hi badz+ra de wī rjom hā tsakra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ sa ma ya dzaḥ/gzhal med srog gi 'od zer gyis⑤/ /'khor lo sku dang thugs 'khor lo/ /sna tshogs 'od 'bar dri med mdzes/ /mkha' ltar rjozla rgyas ltar drangs te/ /rab dang kun dgas khrus sogs dbul/ /me tog bdug pa mar me dri/ /zhal zas rol mo rgyan phreng dag /pi wang lhan cig ⑦sngags bcas mchod/ /'bru gsum glu gar ldan byas bstod/ /phyag mchod la sogs rgyud kun gyis/ /mnyes bya gsol bya bstem par bya/ /gnas la gnas dang lus la ⑧sku/ /snying dkyil 'khor lo phyag rgyas gdab/ /shel dang bai ḍūr rā ⑨ga dang / /gser bzang las grub gzhal yas khang / /gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs mdzes sna tshogs rgyan rnams kun gyis spras/ /de dbus rdo rje lha mo ni/ /pad zla rdo rje skyil krung mnan/ /brgyad gnyis na tshod yid 'ong ma/ /'jig rten gsum na tsomatshungs med pa'o/ /de sku sdem sgeg zhal 'dzum phyag /bzhi ldan ral gri at+pal dang / /rgyud mangs pi wang bheng ⑪mdzad brtson/ /nyi shar gangs ri ltar dkar blta⑩/ /thugs kar rab dkar shes rab kyi/ /snying po dkar mdzes dz+rī yig gi/ /'od tshogs rab 'jam ⑫dkar skye bas/ /bum nang sgron ma 'bar ba bzhin/ /sprin med mkha' dkyil zla skar ltar/ /rnam dag 'khor lo 'od mdzad gzi/ /rim pas dbus nas mthar snang bya/ /nyi zer kha ⑫phye 40—1506

pad 'dab tshul/ /rtsa ba'i 'bru 'di snying 'dab kyi/ /dbus bzhugs bzhi gnyis kha phye nas/ /gnyis gnyis nga ro bcu drug rgyas ①/ /de spros ge sar ze'u ④'bru phye/ /'dab bcas ④yi ge 'od 'bar bas/ /slar yang bdud rtsi'i zil mngar rjoblang / /dkar 'jam snum mnyen mkhregs dang srab/ /yid 'ong dri mas ma gos pa'o/ /zil mngar ④snying gi mun sel la/ /snying 'dab snying pos slar yang de'i/ /zil mngar durgyas byed yang tshur 'od/ /rab spros phyi nang kun dag byed/ /ji srid ma yengs mi skyo bar/ /bdag gzhan mkha' khyab kun bkang la/ /sdog sdug ⑦yid kyi mun pa rnams/ /nyi mas mun bsal ji bzhin no/ /rtsa ba'i yi ge mchog gcig la/ /g.yeng med 'bum phrag bco lnga bzlas/ /dngos dang rmi lam brda gzugs kyi⑧/ /ltas gsum phyi rol mthong bar 'gyur/ /de 'og pad+ma 'khor lo sgyur/ /dbyangs yig ral gri phyed mtshan par/ /skad cig rnam pas bsgyur zhing bskor/ /gsang sngags 'bum phrag ⑨bzlas par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra de wī ⑩pi tsu pi tsu pradzñā badzha dz+rī hūṃ/ rang snying mun sel brtan pa dang / /gzhan yid mun sel g.yo ba yis⑩//'bum phrag gsum ni rtse gcig bzlas/ /lkugs pa'ang ngag gi dbang phyug 'gyur//nang skye zla rgyas pa wa sangs/ /gsung ba sgron ma 'bar ba mthong / /brda gsum gzugs sgra yid shes te/ mtshon cha'i ⑫'khor lo rtags gzhan yin/ /de la ⑫sbyin sreg sngon song bas/ /brgya rtsa brgyad mchod blo gros spel/ /de yis tshar gcad rjes gzung las④/ /lnga phrag gnyis 'grub the tshom med/ /rtsod dang dgra 'dul dug gzhil dang / /'chi bdag bzlog pa dang po ste/ /blo gros sngags rig snyan dngags ⑫dang / /klog dang sngags 'grub gnyis pa yin//40—1507

yang na thog ①ma gnyis rtse mos/ /lhag ma bzhi bzhi lha mo gzhan/ /'khor yin lnga gnyis dkyil 'khor mdzes/ /de bzhin gnyis gtso gzhan brgyad 'khor/ /rdo rje lha mo la gnas lce/ /'khor la dbyangs ldan ral gri bskor/ /pha rol srog dang lce bskum nas/ /gsal byed mgrin bkang rtsod ④las rgyal/ /mtshan ngan ①thod pa dgra bo'i gzugs/ /mā ④ra ya nan ⑤la 'bum bzlas/ /gri mtshon gyis gtubs ro ras dkris/ /'dre gnas sar mnan nges par 'chi/ /lhag pa'i lhas brgyan lha mo nyid/ /khro mo zhal brgya phrag stong can/ /lcags kyu zhags pa ral gri yis/ /bkug cing bsnun ⑥na shin tu 'joms/ /dam tshig lha mos ye shes kyi/ /lha drangs bum par bdud rtsi bsgrub/ /smin mtshams pad+mo'i ④dz+rī thig le/ /rgyun 'dzag dug gzhil 'byung bar bya/ /snying dkyil srog yig rin chen sgon/ /rdo rje 'bar ba'i me 'od gsal/ /a phreng ka phreng spel bskor gzigasadu/ /gur phub rgyun ⑨'be+ebs 'chi med 'gyur/ /ji skad sngar bshad lha mo nyid/ /de bzhin lha mo lnga lnga dgu/ /sna gsum bdag gi ⑩ snying la bsgom/ /blo gros rab 'phel gdon mi za/ /dpal mo'i ⑪mgrin par chu skyes dbus/ /dung dkar g.yas 'khyil sbubs ltar ba/ /nga ro bcu drug gsang bstod sgrogs/ /de myur tshangs dbyangs ngag thob 'gyur/ /gtsang zhing rab gtsang pad snying dbus/ /gzha' ⑩ris dpal be'u 'od ⑫zer gsal④/ /glog phreng rgyun 'dra rdo rje'i lce/ /rnam bskyod snyan dngags mkhan 'drar 'gyur/ /'dam skyes ri bong rdo rje yis⑫/ /sbyor bas ⑩lce rtser tshangs yid ⑩bskyed/ /lha mo'i ljags skyes rdo rje rtsang / /de blangs ⑫ka la ping ga mtshungs/ /rje btsun ljags pad zla steng du/ /dbyangs gsal rdo rje ral gris mtshan/ /bro 40—1508

gar 'gyu bklags ①ye shes bkug /de rgyun sus 'thungs 'grub par ④'gyur//thun mtshams gtsang zhing rab dkar zas/ /mngar bsel ①sna tshogs btung bar byas/ /'bru gsum rang sngags byin brlabs la/ /bdud rtsi'i sbyor bas gtor ma sbyin/ /oṃ yidabadz+ra dṛ shrī de wī ④sa pa ri wā ra a mṛ te ba lo ta khā hi khā hi / ma ma sarba sidhi hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ 'jam dbyangs lha mo dbyangs snyan ma/ /rab mjes tshangs dbyangs blo bzangs rjom/ /mtshungs med snying dbus mgrin skyong ma/ /'dod dgur bsgyur la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde ldan ngag gi dbang phyug ma/ /mi 'tshe mi slu tshe 'dzin ma/ /bag yod yid 'ong nor ster ma/ /tshangs spyod tshangs rigs ma khyod 'dud/ /dpal ldan dbyangs can brtag pa'i de nyid rgya mtsho mkha' dang gter ltar zab cing rgya che sbas pa las/ /rdo rje lha mo ri dbang phung po sangs rgyas khang rjobazangs lnga phrag gnyis sgrub ⑦nyes tshogs dri ma kun bsal ④'di/ /zla zer bsil bas ku mud ltar phye de yi lam nas ⑪dge 'od rin chen 'bar ba'i sgon mthus gang thob des/ /ma lus lus can rdo rje lha mo'i dbyangs snyan myur thob tshangs chen nga ros sa gsum rnam par rol bar shog /dpal rdo rje dbyangs snyan ma'i sgrub thabs snyan ngag ⑩mkhan chen po ⑪slob dpon zla ba gzhon nus mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rnam par bshad pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta mkhas pa chen po budha shrī dzñā na dang / lo tsā ba dge slong byams pa'i dpal gyis bsgyur ba'o// //40byed1509

༄ga /dpal nor rgyun ma'i sgrub thabs/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī ②ba su dha rā ④sā dha rna/ bod skad du/dpal nor rgyun ma'i sgrub thabs/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyogs bcu kun na bzhugs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /dbul ba kun las sgrol mdzad cing / /chos min sel bar mdzad pa mo/ /phun tshogs yang dag stsol gyemadzad ma/ /nor rgyun ma la rtag phyag 'tshal/ /sbyin bya dang (blu sbyin pa po ste gsum po mi dmigs pa bustong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin du dag pa chos rnams thams cad rang bzhin gyis ⑦dag pa nga nyid do/ /stong nyid ye shes rdo rje'i rang bzhin nga'o⑧/ /de las langs nas rang gi snying khar paṃ yig gis pad+ma dang de'i steng du a yig gis zla ba'i dkyil 'khor te⑨/ de'i steng du rja ⑪ gi yi ges ⑪bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das ma nor rgyun mar bsgom par bya ste/ phyag gnyis ma rin po che'i cod pan can/ sku mdog ser ⑩mo 40—1512

zhal gcig ma/ /rol pa'i stabs ①kyis bzhugs pa/ /phyag mchog sbyin dang /bum pa bzang po can no/ /oṃ shrī ba su dha ropho⑤haṃ/ a yig gis ④zla ba'i dkyil 'khor te/ ā rjoyig gis nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /oṃ badz+ra pad+ma ha ⑤s+t+waṃ haṃ/ oṃ s+dzahūṃ swā hā/ gsum mo/ /oṃ badzo pa me ṭa ṭha rjoke hūṃ swā hā/gsum mo/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣe hūṃ/ gsum mo/ /oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dhū ⑦pe hūṃ/ badz+ra dī pe hūṃ/ badz+ra gadhe hūṃ/ badz+ra ne+e bi bye hūṃ/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra hūṃ/badz+ra bhū ④me hūṃ/ badz+ra yak+ṣe hūṃ/ ba su dha re swā hā/ de nas rang gi snying gar gnas pa'i rja ⑨gi yi ge'i 'od zer steng phyogs yang dag par bkang ⑩nas 'og min gyi srid par gnas pa'i thog ma med pa nas ⑪grub pa'i bcom ldan 'das ma nor rgyun ma spyan drang bar ⑫bya ste/ oṃ shrī ka ri jo n+ya ⑫ka ri ā gats+tsha ā gats+tsha bye ④swā hā/ gsum mo/ /u ke byu ke war+ṣa ṇi pra war+ṣa ṇi/ nit+pa ⑫da ni ba su dha rā bhāṭ+wā ra kā ye pā bye pra tīts+tsha ⑩swā hā/ sngok+ṣa r+ṇa pra tīts+tsha ⑫swā hā/ añtsa mā ṇi pra tīts+tsha spyoswā hā/ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ⑪swā hā/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ⑫/ rang rang gi gdan la bzhugs ⑥par bsams nas me tog bkod par bya'o⑫/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ swā hā/ oṃ shrī ba su dha re swā hā/ oṃ ba ⑫su dha re ba su biji pā ta ④ya ba su dha re swā hā/ju rja ba ⑫su dha re swā hā/ lak+ṣi bhū ⑪ta la ni bā sa nī ⑫ye swā hā/ badz+ra dha ra sā ga ra ṇi gho ṣa tā 3ya swā hā/ āt+yā 0ba lo ki te shwa rā ⑩ya swā hā/ badz+ra pā ṇi yak+ṣa se nā dhi pa ta ⑫ye swā hā/ i la de wī ye swā hā/ rdza bha la dza len+d+ra ya swā hā/ pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa lī ⑫ne+e swā hā/ ki li mā lī ne+e ⑫swā hā/ mu kheṭ+wā ④ya swā hā/ tsa ren+d+ra ⑫ya swā hā/ gup+ta ⑩de wī ye swā hā/ su gup+ta de wī ⑩ye swā hā/ sha ra swas+t+ri de wī ⑫ye swā hā/ tsan+d+ra ⑫kan+d+ra de wī ⑩ye swā hā/ ma ṇi bha drwa ⑩ya swā hā/ pūr+ṇa bha 40—1513

dru ①ya swā hā/ dha na dā ya ②swā hā/ be+e shra ba ṇ+ḍa ya swā hāsne/ ba ru ⑦ṇa nā ga rā dzā ye swā hā/ in+d+ra ⑤ya swā hā/ ya mā ya rjoswā hā/ ba ru ṇa ⑦ya swā hā/ ku be+e rā ye swa hā/ asna ye swā hā/ ne+erje skeh+ye swā hā/ bā ya be+e ⑨swā hā/ ā+o sha nā dhi ⑩pa ta ⑫ye swā hā/ e te ṣ+pe zhum ma sarba satā māṃ sarba sā dha ṭ+wāṃ hi ⑫ra ṭu su baṇ+ḍi ni dha nā dzā de ti saṃ da dā pa ye ④swā hā/ ba su dha rī ye skeswā hā/ put+pa ba sun+ta rī ye ⑩swā hā/ dhū ⑩pa ba su dha rī ye ⑫swā hā/ dī pa ba su ma ti pri yā ⑪ye swā hā/ gan+dha ⑩ba su dhā ra dhā ra bhā ⑥ye swā hā/ ne+e bi bye ⑦badz+ra puṣ+pe swā hā/ badz+ra bā 3ye swā hā/ badz+ra dar+sha na pha lā ya swā hā/ badz+ra haṃ bu ma ④swā hā/ oṃ āḥhūṃ swā hā/ badz+ra satā ⑫saṃ gra ha⑩/ badz+ra rat+na ma nut+ta⑦ra/ badz+ra karma ka rasgo 3ba/ badz+ra dharma gā ya swā hā⑥/ badz+ra lā ⑫gye hūṃ/ badz+ra mā le t+t+waṃstso/badz+ra gī ti tweḥkhyebadz+ra dṛ bye aḥ⑫badz+ra puṣ+pe hūṃ/ badz+ra dhū pe ṭ+wāṃ④/ badz+ra ā lo ke byāḥ⑫—/ badz+ra gadhe āḥ/ na ma ste ⑪hūṃ/ na ma ཿmi ⑩hūṃ/ na mo na ma hūṃ swā hā/⑫ rtog par gsungs pa zhes bya ba ⑫la sogs pas bstod dezhu / dbang med bdag gis mi dge bgyis pa dang / /yang na bgyid stsal rjes su yi 0rang gang / /de dag thams cad byang chub mchog gi ni/ /spyan sngar da lta ⑫so sor bshags par bgyi/ /bde gshegs sras kyi tshogs gnyis zab pa dang / /rgya chen 'gro ba ma lus pa yi don/ /sgrub par byed dang de las gzhan pa la/ /rtag tu bdag ni rjes su yi rang ngo / /byams pa dang snying rje dang dga' ba dang btang ⑫ snyoms te byams pa ni bu gcig pa ltar mnyes ④gshin pa'i rnam pa can gyi mtshan nyid do/ /snying rje ni sdug bsngal lam sdug bsngal kyi rgyu las yang dag par 'don par 'dod pa nyid do/ /dga' ba ni sna tshogs rnams byakyi dge ba dang de 40—1514

rnams kyi longs spyod dang ①dbang phyug rnams la sems mgu ba ②nyid do/ /btang ①snyoms ni rnyed pa dang ma rnyed pa dang grags pa dang ma grags pa dang /bstod pa dang smad pa dang bde ba dang sdug bsngal zhes pa 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad la sogs pa las phyir phyogs pa nyid do/ /oṃ swa bhā rjowa shudhaḥ⑤sarba dharmā ཿswa bhā rjob shud sgolha⑦haṃ/ oṃ shu n+ya ⑧tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa a kolhahaṃ⑨/ de nas sngon gyi smon lam kyi ⑩nus pas yo gis ⑩rlung gi dkyil 'khor kha dog sngon po gzhu dang 'dra ba g.yo ba'i ⑫ba dan kyis mtshan par byas pa yi yig byin gyis brlab ⑫pa'o/ /de'i steng du ram̐ yig gis me'i dkyil 'khor zur gsum pa 'bar bas ⑫mtshan par byas pa ram̐ yig gis byin gyis brlab ⑫pa'o/ /baṃ yig gis chu'i dkyil 'khor rlum po kha dog dkar po bum pas mtshan pas baṃ yig gis byin gyis brlab pa'o⑩/ /lo yig gis sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa kha dog ser po rdo rjes mtshan pa ⑩lo yig gis ⑫byin gyis brlab ⑪pa'o/ /sum̐ yig gis ri rab gru bzhi pa rin po che bzhi'i rang bzhin rtse mo brgyad kyis nye bar mdzes pa'o④//hūṃ yig gis sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la gnas pa'i hūṃ spyoyig gis khang pa brtsegs pa bsgom par bya ste/ gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa rta babs bzhis ⑫mdzes pa dra ba dang dra ba ⑫phyed pas spras pa/ nor bu dang rdo rje phyed pa dang zla tshes dang / rdo rje rin po che rnams kyis ④sgo dang sgo khyud kyi ⑫mtshams rnams su spras pa/ bum pa dang ka ba dang rdo rje chen po dang / phyogs can gyi mda' yab can/ dril bu dang ba dan gyis mdzes pa/ rnga yab la sogs pas rnam par brgyan pa'o/ /de'i nang du paṃ yig ⑩'dab ma sna tshogs pa'i pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad dang / ze'u 'bru dang ge sar dang ldan pa'o/ /de'i steng du a ⑩yig gis zla ba'i dkyil 40—1515

'khor te/ de'i ①dbus su rja gi ①yi ges bum pa bzang po'o/ /bum pa bzang po yongs su gyur pas ①bcom ldan 'das ma nor rgyun ma sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig ma/ phyag drug ma/ rin po che'i cod pan can/ rol stabs dhikyis bzhugs pa/ g.yas pa'i phyag dang po rjogater ston pa/ phyag gnyis pas rin po che'i char 'be+ebs pa/ phyag gsum pas de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje 'chang rgya mtsho'i dbyangs la phyag mdzad parjo/ g.yon pa'i phyag dang pos bum pa bzang po④/ phyag gnyis pas 'bras kyi ①snye ma⑨/ phyag gsum pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i glegs bam ⑩'dzin pa/ rin po che'i ⑪rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa⑫/ de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje 'chang rgya mtsho'i dbyangs ni sku mdog ser po ⑫chos gos kyi grwa ⑫'dzin pa'o/ /'phags pa sbyan ras gzigs dbang phyug ni sku mdog dmar po phyag na rnga yab can no/ /gnod sbyin gyi sde'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje sku mdog ljang gu phyag na rnga yab can no/ /lha mo i dra li skemadog ser mo rin po che'i snye ma 'dzin pa'o/ /chu'i dbang po dze+e bha la sku mdog sngon po ne+e'u le dang / shing thog dzī ⑩dza pū ra ka 'dzin pa'o/ /tsi pi kuṇ+ḍa li mdog dmar po lag na me tog can no/ /ke li mā li ⑩mdog dmar po lag na bdug spos can no/ /sgo'i spyodabang po mdog ser po lag na mar me can no/ /spyod pa'i dbang po mdog dmar ⑩po lag na dri chab can no/ /sbas ma mdog sngo bsangs lag na rnga yab can no/ /legs sbas ma ⑥mdog dmar mo lag na gdugs can no/ /dbyangs can ma mdog ser mo lag na rgyal mtshan can no/ /zla tshes ⑫ma mdog dkar mo lag na ba dan can no/ /nor bu bzang po mdog dkar po ne+e'u le dang shing thog gi bī ⑫dza pū ra ka 'dzin pa'o/ /gang ba bzang 40—1516

po mdog sngon po rin po che'i snye ma dang / bī ①dza pū ra ka 'dzin pa'o/ /nor sbyin mdog dmar mo bum pa bzang po dang bī dza pū ①ra ka 'dzin pa'o/ /rnam thos sras mdog ser po rin po che'i myu ①gu dang bī dza pū ra ka ④'dzin pa'o/ /klu'i rgyal po chu lha mdog dkar po sbrul zhags 'dzin pa'o/ /oṃ snya⑤hūṃ rang gi snying gar gnas pa'i rja gi duyi ge'i 'od zer gyis ⑦steng yang dag par bkang nas 'og min gyi srid pa na bzhugs pa'i ye shes sems dpa' spyan drang bar ④bya zhing / sa ma ya sa ⑨mya sa ma yi ka ri ma hā sa ma ye swā hā/ lan gsum⑩/zhabs bsil la sogs pas mchod cing / dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ ⑪dam tshig sems dpa' dang ye shes sems dpa' ⑫dag ro gcig tu gyur par bsam par bya'o/ / oṃ a ⑫rnyi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ sarba ta thā ga ta/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ /khams gsum pa yis phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ④gsum gyi/ /gnas las ⑫byung ba sbyin par bya/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /mchod pa'i 'dren pa'i cod pan te/ /rigs lnga las ni byung ba'o/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi cod pan che/ /ma hā mu ku ṭa pra tīts+tsha ⑩swā hā/ ⑩ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yi⑫//de bzhin bdag gis khrus ⑪bgyi'o/ /oṃ 26a bhi ṣe ka sa ma ya shri ⑦ye hūṃ swā hā/slar yang zhabs bsil la sogs pas mchod do/ /be+er yang stsome tog dgod cing sgeg mo brgyad kyis so/ /bcom ldan 'das ma nor rgyun ma ye shes kyi sku can la bdag phyag 'tshal lo/ /nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i yon tan yid kyi 3 shing rta gsang ba mo sngags sgogs pa dang ldan pa ⑫la'o/ /'di'i yon tan gyi gter dang gser ④rin po che'i char pa dang skye sdebo mang po'i nor 'phel ba dang 40—1517

rgya mtsho'i rin po che'i phung po dkyil 'khor ①dang bcas pa rang gi ②lus la rab tu gzhug par bya'o④/ /oṃ lja thru swā hā/ sna la nor bu bzang po'o/ /dpral ba la gang ba ④bzang po'o/ /kha la nor sbyin no/ /brla zung dag la rnam thos sras so/ /rkang pa gnyis la tsi pi kuṇ+ḍa li'o/ /gsang ba la ke li mā li rjoni'o/ /snying gar zhal gyi sdedabang po'o/ /yan lag thams cad la ⑦spyod pa'i dbang po'o//zhabs bsil la sogs pas mchod pa dang / me tog dgod pa dang sgeg mo brgyad do/ /bsam gyis ⑧mi khyab rdzas ni ⑨'phel ched dang / /rin chen ⑩ du ma gser ni 'phel ched du/ /khang pa 'dir ni dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs la skye / /dpal ldan nor rgyun ma la rtag phyag 'tshal/ /bzlas pa dang gtor ma'o—/ /oṃ ba su dha re sarba ⑫bha ya ha re bispyon shārnyi spyoka re pra kṛ ④ti pra bhā swā ⑫ re i oṃ ba lo kṛṇ+ḍi kṛṇ+ḍa⑩/ oṃ a kā ⑩ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇ+ḍaṃ ār+ya nut+pan+da tāta spyo.oṃ āḥhūṃ—/ añtsa ma r+ṇa pra t+t+waṃts+tsha ⑩swā hā/ me tog la sogs pa rjomachod par bya'o/ /rdzogs so⑪// //40—1518

sngag /nor rgyun ma'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad bzhugs/4༄spro/ /'phags ma nor rgyun ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzugs bzang gzugs mdzes mchog ster ④ma/ /nor 'dzin byed ma nor rgyun ma/ /nor dpal dpal mdzad mchog gyur ma/ /'dzin ma 'dzin byed skyong ①byed ma/ /skyabs gyur gus la mnyes ④gshin pa/ /lha mo shes rab pha rol phyin/ /shes rab dpal dang blo 'phel ma/ /rig 'dzin zhi ba phra mo ste/ /zhi ba kun 'gro rjes 'gro ma/ /sgrol ma sgol 'jug lha mo ste/ /rigs sbyin dbang phyug dbang phyug ma/ /rgyan ④ma 'byung po'i rjoyum gyur ma/ /rgyan rnams kun kyis brgyan byed ma/ /gdul dka' sgrub ⑦mdzad 'jigs byed ma/ /drag mo drag po mchog tu gnon/ /lha mo sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin/ /char 'bebs bzang po'i gzugs can ma/ /gter dang bkra shis thams cad dang / /grags dang dpal dang snyan mdzad dge/ /sreg ma gsod ma gtum mo ste/ /'tshe byed ma 40—1522

mo thams cad ma/ /gshin rje skrag mdzad drag nyid ma/ /gzhon nu ma dang sna tshogs gzugs/ /lha mo brtson 'grus pha rol phyin/ /'gro ba dga' mdzad can ma ste/ /dka' thub ma dang drag gzugs ma/ /rdzu 'phrul grub pa mchog ster ma/ /skal bzang bsod nams skal ba che①/ /mi thub thub pa pha rol gnon—/ /'gro la gcig tu phan brtson ma/ / g.yul las sgol ②byed dge ba mo/ /lha mo bzod pa'i pha rol phyin/ /tshul khrims bsam gtan sgom mdzad ma / /pad+ma can dang pad+ma 'dzin/ /pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa mo/ /dag pa'i gzugs can gzi brjid che/ /gser kyi mdog can 'od mdzad ma/ /yid bzhin nor bu 'dzin lha mo/ /shes rab glegs bam 'dzin pa mo/ /gter gyi phung por bzhugs mdzad ma/ /nor dang ldan mdzad ①nor dga' ma/ /khams gsum dbang phyug chen mo ste/ /lha yi rgyan rjogyis brgyan pa morjo/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi yum dugyur ma/ /rin chen khams kyi dbang phyug ma/ /dngos po stong nyid bsgom lha mo/ /dngos dang dngos med rnam spang mo④/ /gdul bar bya ba 'dul mdzad ma/ /sgol ma nyon mongs spyod ⑧pa mo/ /bdud rnams thams cad 'joms pa mo/ /sa 'og bdun po skyong ⑨mdzad ma/ /bram ze ma dang rigs byed yum/ /sbas ma phug tu gnas pa mo/ /dbyangs can ma dang spyan yangs ma/ /tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi ⑫ldan pa mo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgyes chen ma/ /rdo rje can ma rdo rje 'chang / /las 'dzin 'jug cing las 'dzin ma/ /sna tshogs dbang phyug sna tshogs 'bar/ /sprin gyi dkyil 'khor ldan pa mo/ /sems can kun gyis ⑪rtogs mdzad ma/ /byang chub yang dag thob mdzad ma/ /bsam gtan mos pa phun tshogs ma/ /40—1523

gnyis med gnyis med sgom mdzad ma/ /don kun sgrub mdzad bzang mo ste/ /bud med gzugs can dkar mo gnon①/ /sangs rgyas las ④rnams ston mdzad ma/ /ngag gi dbang mo ston ma che/ /srung mdzad 'dzin mdzod ①nor ster ma/ /bud med gzugs 'dzin grub pa mo/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug rnal 'byor ma/ /yid 'phrog ma dang gzugs mdzes ma/ /skal bzang rjodaga' ba ston pa mo/ /ded dpon ma dang brtse ldan ma/ /de bzhin gshegs kun bdag nyid ma/ / nor rgyun lha mo rjokhyod la 'dud/ / sems can kun gyi don ster ma/ /bzang po'i gzugs can khyod la 'dud/ /rjonor rgyun ma khyod la phyag 'tshal/ /mtshan ni brgyad lhag brgya pa ni⑦/ /gang zhig dus gsum klog byed pa/ /yid kyi shing rtas 'dod byed ④pa/ /thams cad nges par thob par 'gyur/ /mtshalas med pa dang cha mthun gang / /shin tu mi bzad las rnams ni/ /de rnams thams cad mtshan bzang ⑨po/ /rjes su dran las zad par 'gyur/ /yang na tshul khrims phun sum tshogs/ /skye ba bdun ni dran pa dang / /dga' dang tshig btsun gzugs ⑩bzang ldan/ /mthong dga' bram ze rgyal rigs kyi/ /rigs ni phyug por skye bar ⑪'gyur/ /mthar ni sa yi dbang thob nas/ /bde ba can du 'gro bar 'gyur/ /ming brgya rtsa brgyad bklags ⑫pa yis/ /lha mo myur du 'gugs par 'gyur/ /'phags ma nor rgyun ma'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa rdzogs so⑫// //40—1524

༄ga /nor rgyun ma'i smon lam bathags/①༄4/ /sangs rgyas la gus rang bzhin g.yo sgyu med/ /sems can kun la byams shing stong par goms/ /rnam grol 'bras bur ldan la kun nas skechags//byang chub sems dpa'i shes rab rno ba can/ /shin tu che ba'i rigs skyes gzugs mdzes pa/ /bdag ni skye ba skye bar bde gshegs kyi/ /snyan dngags mkhan po mnyam med rgya chen dang / /tshe ring rigs skye skyes bu blo gros gsal/ /mkhas shing blo gros mi dman ①bcom ldan kyi/ /gsung rab la mkhas bde ldan snying rje can/ /rab tu dang ④'gyur snyan dngags mkhan po dang / /mar shes pha ma rjol gus bunyid dang ni/ / rtag tu ⑦skye ba dran zhing tshul khrims ldan/ /chos kyi bdag nyid nor ldan rab ster ④dang / /bla med mkhas pa'i grogs dang ldan pa dang / /spro ldan ⑨stobs ldan dga' zhing mang pos bkur/ /nad rnams ⑩spangs shing sems can thams cad ⑪la/ /rjes su 'dzin ⑫zhing thos pa 40—1526

'dzin pa dang / /bsam pa dag cing bzod pa ldan pa de①/ /ji srid 'jig rten phan pa 'byung ched du/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan go 'phang ②bgrod gyur pa/ /de srid rtag tu ④yon tan 'di rnams ni/ /kun gyis brgyan pa bdag 0gis thob gyur cig /bcom ldan 'das ma 'phags ma nor rgyun ma la rjophyag 'tshal lo//rtog par gsungs pa'i cho gas yongs su bklags byas shing / /'dzin na rjornam pa sna tshogs rin chen gser gyi rang bzhin ⑦gyis/ /khang pa stong phrag thams cad gang ba nyid du mdzad pa yi/ /'jig rten kun ⑧gyi yum gyur de la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha mo khyod ni yon tan rin chen kun kyi gter chen te/ /sems can don mdzad nor dang 'bru rnams phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu/ /⑨do shal cod pan ldan zhing nor bu dpag bsam shing rnams kyis ⑩/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon mdzad nor 'dzin nor rgyun ma la 'dud/ /nad dang 'jigs pa'i 'chi ba'i skyon mang sgrol/ /dbul ba'i sdug bsngal rma yi 'tsho byed sman/ /skal ⑪bzang gzugs kyi yon tan rigs dang rus/ /thams cad sbyin mdzad byed kyi zhabs la 'dud/ /gang zhig ⑩yang dag bla ma'i cho gas yongs su klog byed na/ /phun tshogs yangs pa bde 'gro ⑫nye bar ④ster byed pa/ /nor rgyun zhes pa'i ming can gzugs de la ni dus rtag tu/ /mtha' dag sems can phan par sems pas gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig yang dag dran las spyomi rnams longs spyod yun ring du/ /rab tu 'phel zhing dbul dang nad dang sdig pa sel mdzad cing / /dpag bsam shing dang mtshungs pa nor rgyun ming can de la'o⑩/ /'gro la phan pa'i ched du gus pas spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo /bcom ldan 'das ma nor rgyun ma'i sgrub ⑩thabs dang mdon brgya rtsa brgyad pa dang /40—1527

sngag /mkha' lding grub pa'i bstan bcos/ ① ༄spro/ /rgya gar skad du/ sidha ga ru ḍa shās+t+ra④/ bod skad du/mkha' lding grub pa'i bstan bcos/ dpal rdo rje mkha' lding la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kha sbyar mchu bar sbrul ni bsdams pa yis④/ /gdengs ka'i nor bu mkha' lding se long ste/ / rang bzhin 'od gsal ④gnyug ma'i gzugs mthong ngo phye khro ba spangs pa de ni rgyal gyur cig /mkha' lding bstan bcos skyed mos ⑥ tshal nas ni/ /me tog rtsi yi sbrang rtsi de nyid ni/ /sems can don du sbrang rtsi byed pa yi/ / dpal ldan shang ④ku bdag gis 'dir de bsdu/ /gang zhig brtan gyepa'i sems kyis bla ma yi⑨/ /rjes 'jug dag pa'i lam la yang dag gnas/ /mi de phrin las ma lus pa yi ni/ /dngos grub thams cad kyi ni snod du 'gyur/ /bzod dka'i dug las byung ba'i tshor ba yis/ /'khrugs pa'i 'gro ba'i srog ni 'dzin byed cing / /chos dang nor dang 'dod dang thar pa ni/ /bsod nams 40byed1529

byas pa'i 'go ba de yis 'thob①/ /'gro ba'i don phyir mkha' lding bstan bcos ni/ /dam pa'i skye bo de yis bsngags par byed/ /'dod pa can ni nor gyis dga' ba ltar/ /sngags pas sbrul gdug mi bzad pa ④yis so/ /de nas gdengs ka can dang tsi ①ti rnams/ /rā yi dkyil 'khor can dang 'dren gzugs sogs/ /rlung gi yon tan dus dang dus min dang / /a ma rat+ta sbyor rlung bus pa'o/ /mkha' lding gis bshad sman gyi nus pa dang / /ji ltar dug 'joms pa yi rim pa dag /gus pas de rjoni rtse gcig sems kyis nyon/ /gzhan dag kyang ni thos pa las byung ba'i/ /mtshon pas so/ /tri na in+d+ra — la lta bu'i lus/ /'dab brgya rgyas 'dra'i rjomatshan pa lhag ma can—/ /nor rgyas lus ni kha dog dkar po la/ /mtshan pa pad+ma rgyas 'dra sngon po yin/ /shar thogs bunyi ma'i 'od zer lta bu la/ /mgo la g.yung drung dung chen 'jog pa'o/ /karko ṭa ④ni mun pa lta bu yi/ /ri mo gsum ni mgrin par yod pa yin/ /pad+ma'i lus ni kha dog ljang gu la/ /skar tshogs lta bu'i thig les gdengs ka mdzes/ /pad chen zla 'od bskus pa lta bu la/ /mdung rtse gsum pa lta bu gdengs ka yin/ /dung skyong ka ni ya ra'i me tog 'dra/ /mgrin par zla ba'i cha yis mtshan pa yin/ /rigs ldan gyi ni spyi bo'i gdengs ka dag /du ba ④lta bu'i zla ba phyed pa yin/ /dbyig pa yis ni brdegs ⑨pa mchog yin te/ /klu rnams bzung ⑩nas sgod pa de ltar min/ /sdang bas glags ni tshol bar byed pa na/ /sngags pa dag ni gang gis thar bar byed/ /sa 'og gnas na yongs su gnas pa yi/ /dbang chen 'og ni klu rnams shin tu dkon—/ /gdengs ka'i nor bus mjes par byas pa yi/ /khol po yang ni 40—1530

glog gi zer ma 'dra/ /lce gnyis gdengs can phud ①ces 'jigs pa'i sgra/ /rin po che ni med par gyur pa ste/ /khol po yi yang khol po'i gnas su ni/ /gus pa med pa'i lto 'phye dag yin no/ /a ku ba saṃ gnyis gnyis bram ze rgyal/ /me tog dang ni sā ④la'i dri yin no/ /de bzhin sta ma ④ka pa rje'u dang dmangs/ /mar dang nya yi dri ni bro ba yin/ /dung dhi'achang mche ba'i rtsa na legs gnas pa/ /sbrang rtsi'i me tog phreng ba lta bu yin/ /de ni 'gro ba rnams kyi rmongs byed kyi/ /dug ste ⑤yongs su 'dzag par gyur pas so/ /gdengs ka can ni rang gi ngo bo'o//gan+da rjoya na'i yin par gyur na ni/ /mgo mjug ⑦lus la ri mo kyog po yod/ /gdengs kas dman no 'jig rten gan+da ya/ /tsi ti zhes ni yongs su grags pa yin—/ /de yis bzung na g.yo med skad cig gis/ /de ni 'gyur ba med pa'i rang bzhin yin/ /de nyid grub pa thob pas gal te na/ /sad par byed na dran pa 'byung bar 'gyur/ /tsi ti'i rang bzhin no/ /thig btab lta bu'i ri mo ring mo can/ /ban+da ya ru rnam par shes par bya /shing dang lcug 'khyil rtsas gtugs yod par ni/ /nges par shin tu legs gnas rā yil la/ /kha skom mig dmar zas dang stan mi 'dod/ /tsha dang 'khru ba ④yi ni rjes la brgyal⑨/ /dkar dang dmar dang nag dang ljang gu yi/ /ri mo med pa yin no rā yil la/ /btso ma'i gser 'dra'i lus ldan de yis ni/ /'gro ba rnams kyi srog ni 'phrog byed yin/ /rā yil kyis ni bzung na nges par ni//ril gyis khyab par skrangs pa kho nar 'gyur/ /gser mdog lus de rgyu ba'i tshe na ni—/ /'bar ba'i me lce chad pas 'od ma bsreg /'od ma'i rang bzhin yang ni des bsreg ⑩na/ /de yis bzung ⑪na ji ltar 'tsho bar 'gyur/ /rā yil 40—1531

la'i rang bzhin no // //①chu dang rlung me sa yi rang bzhin gyi/ /ko ṭa rnams kyi gang zhig mtshan pa ni—/ /go med sa rnams su ni shes par bya/ /dug chen skrangs 'bur yang dag skyed ④pa po/ /chu yi dkyil 'khor can ni dug 'dzin gyis/ /zin pa'i mtshan nyid lus ni 'drul ba yin/ /tsha dang 'dar dang skam dang skrang ba ni/ /rlung gi lus can gyis ni skyed par byed/ /lus kun gyi ni sru yi ①rtsa ba nas/ /se ba gnag 'dra'i brag gi thigs pa 'byung / /me yis reg pas kun nas skyed rjopa ni/ /thos dang gzugs dang mthong bas rjonyams pa yin/ /sa yi dkyil 'khor can gyis smras pa na/ /skrang budang tsha ba'i reg pas gdungs pa yin/ /gnyid dang stan dag la ni sdang bar 'gyur/ /skyes bu sems la zug gzer ⑦dag gis nyen//phung po la ni myur du snang gyur pa⑧/ /⑨ring po yi ni ring por skrang ⑩pa ste/ /nges pa nyid du mang pos mang po'o/ /thal ba dang ni rus pa bshang ba 'am/ /gzhan yang lus las gang zhig byung ba yis/ /go med sa rnams kyis ni myur nyid du—/ /'gro ba rnams kyi ⑪lus ni nyams par byed/ /gang zhig stobs can yang ni la la dag /mgo mjug tu yang mes mtshan med pa ⑩dang / /yud tsam kyis ⑫ni 'chi ba de yis 'dzin/ /des ni 'gro ba 'chi bar ④the tshom med/ /'dir ni mang du smras pa ci zhig dgosaspyo/ /des na snying po dang du blang bar bgyi//sngags dang sman dang sbyor ba gang yin pa/ /ji srid dbugs rgyu'i bar du bya ba yin—/ /dkyil 'khor can gyi rang bzhin no // //⑩gang zhig dran pa'i dug gis phye ba na/ /bram ze yin par gyur na de ni dkaraske/ /dmar po rgyal rigs ser po rje'u rigs yin/ /dmangs rigs 40—1532

nag po 'di de rnams la'o/ /gang zhig bya rog rkang 'dra'i mdud pa dang ①/ /phye na ri mo 'khyog po snang ba la②/ /mi mnyam thig les rnam par spras pa ni/ /nges par nag po brtsegs pa dag dang ①mtshungs/ /gzhan du bcud kyis len ni bsgrub pa la/ /bram ze 'am ni de bzhin rgyal rigs kyis/ /rje'u rigs kyi ni mdze nad gzhom pa la/ /gsod pa la ni dmangs rigs rung bar bya/ /'dren pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /smad 'tshong sems kyis dor thabs kyis sems bzhin/ /bdag rgyun mi 'chad rjornal 'byor yang dag 'grub/ /mkhas pas de bzhin rlung gi yon tan gyis—/ /dus ni nges par shes pa kho na yin/ /srog chags rnams ni gang gis 'tsho ba dang / /khyad can gang zhig nyams pas srog 'gro'o/ /don dam zhing brtson de la sems dang ni/ /bdag dang mchog dang de nyid du ni 'dod/ /'jug pa'i rang bzhin srog ni kha ba yi/ /'od la brten rjopas gsal por skyed par byedabu/ /bdag dang skyes bu'i rang bzhin de nyid ni/ /nyi ma'i zhing la brten na ④snyud par byed/ /snying stobs rdul dang mun par babs pa na/ /dug brgyal ④dge dang the tshom mi dge yi/ /ston par byed de rlung gi dbye ba dag/'jug dang gnas dang 'byung ⑨ba nyid na'o/ /gtso bor chos sems pa na snying stobs te/ /yul la chags na de bzhin rdul la srog /rmongs pa la zhen ⑫ mun pas 'gog pa yis⑪/ /gsal por cha ni shes par gyur pa yin/ /'byung ba na ni 'byung ba kho na ste/ /'jug pa na ni 'jug pa ston par byed/ /rang gi gnyug ma'i lus la de bzhin du/ /kun du grong khyer gzhan la'ang de bzhin no//zla ba dang ni nyi ma'i zhing du rlung / /rgyu ba'i phyogs su pho nya gnas na ni/ /40—1533

dug gis brgyal ba de ni 'tsho bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin stong pa'i khyim la 'chi bar 'gyur—/ /nyi ma'i zhing la rlung ni gnas pa na/ /gsal por pho nyas thad kar bltas pa dang / /skyes bu rgyab nas 'dug ste yin na ni/ /nges par zla ba'i khyim la bzang por gzung / /dug zhir 'gro dang bya ba gang la yang / /zla ba'i srog gi zas 'khrig 'thab mo la/ /nyi ma'i srog ni mdzes so bi su la/ /bab na rdul gyis char ni gzung ①bar bya/ /grub pa gzhan dag gsungs pa ④gnyis ka yang / /zhing du srog gi rlung ni legs par gnas/ /dbye ba rnam pa bzhir ni yod pa la/ /de la sems can ngo mtshar ①yod pa larjo/ /khyab dang steng 'og dbus su rlung dang ni/ /yon tan zhi dang lha yi bdag po na/ /don med 'khyam dang ⑤'thab dang 'chi ba ni/ /dri khur de yis de rnams byed pa yin/ /skom dang bkres dang skyo ba dag dang ni/ /'dod pa'i dgos pa nyams pa rtse rjogasum gyi/ /'gro ba rnams la rgyal ba'i dge bskyed pa/ /mi 'chi med na de byed yin ma yin/ /gzhan don byed na ⑦dka' ba med par ni/ /bder gnas bde skyed ④yid ni tshim par byed/ /dri med dri zhim la ni mngon 'dod bzhin/ /gzugs bzang lha yi bdag po de yis byed/ /yi dwags mi dang rig 'dzin sgo dang ni/ /gnod sbyin sgo gang lag pa gnyis kyis sdom—/ /don dam thig le gang yin de dag ni/ / zla cha rtse ⑨sprod dbus gnas mtshon par byed/ /nag dang li khri dung dang gser sbyangs mdog /don gang yin pa de ⑩ni thob par 'gyur/ /gang dag brjod ⑪pas dri khur rab dbye las/ /mnyan pa de dag rab tu ⑫thob par byed/ /mig dang kha sbyor ji lta bzhin du smra/ /dbugs 'jug 'byung ba kun nas ma nyams na/ /snying 40—1534

stobs la ni bab pa'i mtshan nyid de/ /rnam 'gyur med pas 'tsho bar 'gyur ba yin—/ /mig gi sbubs ni cung zad phye ba dang / /rma can cung zad so ①yi phreng ba rnams/ /rmi lam bzhin du dug gi reg pa yis/ /g.yengs pas 'gags pa de ni rdul la yin/ /rma can gyi ni kha gdangs mig kyang bgrad/ /gsus ②pa 'jigs su rung ba sbos pa dang / /sen mo so dang mig ①rnams mdog 'gyur ba/ /gsar rjopo ra ti mi yi mdog gi rjonyal/ /gang dag la ni lag pas drangs tsam gyisadhi/ /rtsa nas bud do mgo la skyes pa'i dgra/ /'byung po'i pha ni gang yin de song la/ /de la the tshom yang ni dgos sam ci /'thungs pa de yi mod la ldog byed de/ /sman dang chu ni ming dag ⑦gang yin la//srog de'i mdun du rgyug ⑧par byed pa ste/ /g.yog 'khor gyi ni skyes bu ji bzhin no—/ /so rtsa'i bdud rtsi zhim po ma yin dang / /rna ba'i sgra med mig gi glog kyang med/ /skyes bu gang gi spyi bo'i du ba ni/ /mi mthong ba ni de nas bskyod pa yin/ /nyin mtshan mtshams kyi rtags ni go bya ba/ /tshis por byas nas bor ba de yi ni/ /dkar nag dang ni gser gyi mdog can te/ /rman ⑨can gyi ni zla dang nyi mig go/ /zla dang nyi ma'i mig gi snying por ni/ /go bu'i gzugs brnyan snang bar mi 'gyur zhing / /so rtsa'i ⑩bdud rtsi dag ni mi 'dzag ⑫na—/ /phung po'i zhing las rlung de bskyod pa yin/ /sna ni rang gi gnas nas g.yogs ⑩pa dang / /mig ni mchi mas dkrugs dang shes pa g.yengs/ /kha yi rlung ni chu la bab pa dang / /sna skad du ni smra ba gang yin pa'o/ /rlung gi yon tan kyi rab tu dbye ba'o/ /lus kyi cha ni gang la rma mthong ba/ /de 'dra de ru 'pho bar byed pa ste/ /40—1535

mi bzad dus kyi dbang du byas pa yin/ /rna ba'i rgyab tu ri mo dma' ba snang / /rmas pa'i sa ru sbal rgyab ltar mtho yis/ /dug gis zin pa de ni mi 'tsho'i/ /khrag ni sna tshogs mdog tu 'dzag byed cing / /de ni bya rog rkang 'dra'i gzugs su snang / /mgrin pa 'phongs tshos gsang ba dang ni gnad/ /mig dang rna ba lag sor rnams kyi rtse/ /lte ba bshang lam ①phrag pa rked par ni/ /zin pa bsod nams kyis ni 'tsho ba yin/ /rma'i mtshan nyid do/ /gang gi ⑤khyim gyi tha snyad ma te dang / /bong bu dang ni rnga mo zhon pa yi/ /pho nya ltas ngan yin zhes su zhig smra/ /su la'ang de yis ltas ngan bskyed ma yin//ltas ngan bden par brjod pa 'di dag ste/ /yun rings shugs ni 'byin zupar byed pa dang / /de bzhin du ni rdul dag 'byung ba dang / /pho nya rigs gzhan dag ni yin pa dag /phal cher bsngags rjopa ma yin kho na ste/ /yan lag nyams dang thod pa can gyi gzugs/ /gos nag ngur smrig gyon pa nye bar na//pho nya'i mgo la mar nag byugs pa 'am/ /yin na rdul gyi skabs la babs pa ⑤ yin—/ /rkang pa g.yas brkyang pa na 'tsho ba ste/ /phal cher bud med la ni mtshon pa'o/ /rkang pa g.yon pa brkyang bas skyes pa dag /srog ni 'gro ba yin par mtshon pa yin/ /rjes kyi dbyangs med de dang sbyar ba 'am/ /yi ge phan tshun sbyar dang dang po ka /dris tshe nyon mongs tshig ni brjod pa na/ /rma can de ni the tshom med par 'chi/ /nyi mas rang gi gnas zhig bsregs nas ni/ /'od zer rnon pos bsreg bubazhin pa yis ④gnas/ /de bzhin mdun na mo la dud par 'thul/ /ltag ma rnams ni dge ba'i rnam pa yin/ /dgos pa la ni 'gro ched nyams pa dang / /nyams bzhin pa dang nyams par 'gyur ba char/ /40—1536

phyogs gsum ma yin phyogs gzhan rnams su 'grub/ /sprid pa bya rog kā rā yi dang ce ①spyang gnyis/ /zangs dung la sogs sgra yi dus dang 'dzom pa na/ /nyon mongs srog ni 'gro tshe phyogs nas sgogs/ /dri khur rjes 'brang ④rtog mkhas pho nya yi/ /gnyis sgeni bzang ngan dge dang mi dge dag /dug 'joms the tshom nyon mongs 'gro ba yi/ /bden pa 'di ni nges par mkhyen pa yinaske/ /pho nya'i mtshan nyid do/ /ma mo'i khyim mam pad+ma can gyi mtsho/ /shing 'dzeg phug pa grog mkhar dag nas sam/ /khang rul dur khrod kyi ni lto 'phye rnams/ /chu'am bzhi mdo yi ni gdug pa can/ /drag po'i gza' la lto 'phye'i rjodug gis ni/ /'dzin na bzhi'am bcu bzhi yin na 'jigadu /de bzhin cha ni rab nyams gnam stong dang //tshes brgyad la ni babs rjopar gyur na'o/ /karti ④ka dang mar+gha ske.a tra dang / /bā ⑨ra ṇi dang spru ⑩la bi sā kha/ /sle sha 'phur gsum ⑪gal te tshes dang gza'/ /rgyu skar la zin nges par brlag par 'gyur/ /bad mkhris rlung ni gtso bo mi dang ni—/ /lto 'bye'i khams ni 'dra bar gyur pa na/ /de ltar shes na chos mi mthun pa dang / /chos mthun pa yi ⑩dka' ba med la'ang yod/ /gnas dang tshes grangs dang gza' dang rgyu skar dang chos mthun pa dang mi mthun pa'o/ /nyin mtshan thun phyed dag la klu rnams ni/ /gza' yi dbang gyur dag ni longs spyod de/ /nyin mo gang la de yi dus nyid de/ /mtshan mo sgo ni rnam pa gzhan du 'gyur/ /'byung po phyogs dus me dang ri bo dang / /dus dang thar pa nyin mo'i dus su bsgreng / /ro dus mig dang thub pa dang ni mda'/ /me dang zla ba mtshan mo dag tu shes/ /spen pa'i dus phyed snga ma bla ma yi/ /dang po 'das 40—1537

par dgos pa'i sa yin te/ /nyin mtshan 'pho ba'i mtshalas ni gang yin pa/ /bcu drug po de rigs ldan dus yin no/ /gnyug ma'i lus la lta na nyi ①zla ste/ /lag pa rna ba la reg sa skyes yin/ /sna la lag pas reg na gza' lag go/ /mgrin pa la reg lha'i bla ma'o/ /dbugs ni drug tu 'byin na pa ba sangs/ /dgod pa na yang spen ⑤pa ru ni shes/ /sa la lta na sgra gcan nyid yin no/ /dus dang dgos nga 'i dbye ba dang rags pa dang stong pa ste/ dug zin gyi mtshon byed do/ /nyi zla sa sras gza' lag phur bu dang / /pa ba sangs dang spen pas bskyed pa na/ /tshogs ④mig rgya mtsho ro dang bcu drug dang / /sum cu gnyis dang lnga bcu tham pa ste/ /'gro bas rang dbang can gyi lto 'bye'o/ /the tshom med pa de yang shes par bya④/ /dgos pa dang ni bcas pa'i dug dag kyang / /stong dang stong pa ma yin dbus su yang / /srog rdul snying gi dbus su dal ba yis—/ /rnam par gsal ba yis ni legs gnas na/ /gnas na gnas pas de ma thag tu ni/ /yun ring brgyal ba la yang mtshon par bya/ /gnyis pa'i phyogs rtsa bstan pa'o/ /spyi bo dag ni nag po rlung yin te/ /mgrin pa lte bar me yi 'bar bas dkrigs—/ /de nas dbang chen sor mo ⑤mkha' lding gi/ /pus mo nas brtsams chu ni dkar po yin/ /brgya byin gyis ni bdud 0rtsi phrogs nas kyang / /rdo rje'i mtshon chas dgra med dga' ba yis/ /mkha' lding dgra ni reng bar 'gyur ba dang / /yid 'phrog thob pa de ni rgyal gyur cig /gar gyi dpal brjid gshog pas bskyod ⑦pa yi/ /rlung gi rigs kyi ri rnams bskyod byed pa/ /spu 40—1538

mkha' lding du ni yongs su bsgom bya ste/ /ma lus dug rnams zhi don gnyer bas so / /rlung du bstan pas sems ni phur bus 'debs/ /'bar ba yis ni spel bar byed pa yin/ /brgya byin gyis ni gsal por rengs par byed/ /chu zil 'bab pas dug ni brlag par byed/ /mkha' lding bye brag re re yis kyang ni//sel la nges par bsgom pa dang ldan na/ /bi ①med nga yi sa ⑤bzhin gnas su na//ma lus dug ni tshar gcod byed pa yin/ /a ste bi ṣi brjod na dug ①yod de/ /na ④a ste bi ṣe sa stengs kun na med/ /bsod nams yang dag bsags la mchog gi ni/ /de nyid 'di de skye ba kho nar 'gyur/ /lta byed mig gsum 'bar bas bstan pa yi/ /dug mchog thal ba ru ni brlag nas kyang / /la la dag la gal te 'di skad du/ /mgrin sngon khyod brjod byin par gyur na ni/ /skyes bu de yi lus la ji srid ni/ /'tsho ba'i bar du dug ni mi 'pho ste/ /ri bong mgo la rwa ni skye ba dag /nam du yang ni srid par 'gyur ram ci/ /gal te 'phrog byed kha sna rjobakag go myur bar ni/ /dga' ba'i mthar zhugs srog lung 0'gro bzhin pa/ /re zhig ⑦gsal bar 'gul bar gyur na ni/ /rmas pa de ni 'tsho bar shes par bya/ /'byung ba'i rlung ni nang du rngubs nas su//'phrog byed kyi ni kha drung ji bzhin lta⑧/ /skye bo'i dgra ni ⑨dbe+en pa'i gnas su ni—/ /sbas pa'i yul la yang ni shes par bya/ /the tshom mam ni dge dang mi dge ba/ /'dri mi 'dra lhag dug gis brgyal ba la/ /phyis na pho nya'i gos ni sbogs byed ni/ /khru yis bcal ⑩ba la ni snang bar 'gyur/ /mkha' lding gshog tshogs gar dang ldan pa yis⑪/ /klu gzugs de la rnam par gnon pa na//de ltar gang gson skad cig tsam kyis ni/ /gsal por smra ba dang ni bskyod par 40—1539

'gyur—/ /kha dang sna rlung rgyu ba bkag nas ni/ /skad cig tsam gyis de ni khyad par du/ /gdengs ka can gyis bzung ①nas brgyal ba ni/ /nges pa nyid du tshor ba dang bcas 'gyur/ /dug 'joms byed pa pad+ma rgyas par yang /srog gi rlung gis kyang ni byed pa ste/ /yang dag 'gag ④pa'i 'go ba'i snying po ni//slob dpon gyis ni sgom ①par byed pa yin/ /dug gi skyon ni med pa kho nar yang / /gang dag gis ni rgyu mtshan 'ga' zhig gis/ /brgyal bar byas la khyomakhas pas sen mtshams su/ /sen mo yis ni song bar byed pa yin/ /dug zin gyis ni bsod nams sbyor ba yi/ /gang la thig le dkar po byung gyur na/ /de la gang dang gang gis ⑤brjod byas pa/ /de dang de ni sngags su 'gyur ba yin//lus kyi yan lag dag duni dkar po la/ /gang gi ⑦gnas der me ni 'bar ba dag /drag po yi ni rlung gis bskyod pa na/ /rmas pa de ma thag tu 'gyel bar 'gyur/ /lhag ma ④nor bu'i gdengs ka'i 'dab ma'i rtsar/ /sred ⑨med bu bzhin rma can bde bar ⑩nyal/ /'o ma'i mtsho yi bdud rtsi dkar po yis/ /bsgos pas dug ni 'joms par 'gyur ba yin/ /gang gi lus ni dkar por sgyur ⑪byed pa'i/ /thig le dkar po dag ni lta byed na/ /stong pa de yi dug ni stong par ni/ /bsgom ⑫pas kyang ni zhi bar ⑫shes par bya/ /'phrog byed mig gi me ni 'bar ba dag /rang gis bskyod pa gang gi snying la ni/ /rab tu 'bar bas rma ni rnying pa la/ /yud tsam gyis ni de la rgyas par ④bskyed/ /rigs ldan nor gyis 'byor dang yon tan can/ /dka' thub snying stobs can dang rgan po dang / /bud med mngal ni rab tu rgyas pa dang / /bram ze dang ni byis la ⑫bskyed mi bya/ /mkha' lding ser pos dug zin dag la ni/ /thig 40—1540

le yis ni gal te mnan pa dang / /bum pa can gyi nyin zhag mang por yang / /ri rab kyis ①ni mnan bzhin g.yo ba med/ /dug gis ④zin pa nor rgyas dkar po yis/ /mjug mas mgul par bcings te mi lhung ba/ /de yi mgo las gal te bzung na ①ni/ /shang shang nam mkha' la ④ni 'go na yang / /zla ba'i zhing du son pa'i nus pa ni/ /snying ga'i ⑤pad+ma phug nas pad skud ⑦'dra'i/ /'dzag pa gang la zag med ⑦bltas nas ni/ /de yi lus la dug ni gang la ste/ /gang phyir ga ④ma'i lus las nus pa ni/ /'dzags ⑨pa yis ni rgyang ring gnas pa yis/ /ma lus dug kyang phig nas nges par ni/ /zhi bar byed pa kho na yin pa'o—/ /sbyor ba'o // //⑩'dab ma dkar po rab rgyas rab 'dzag pa'i/ /kha ba'i 'od 'dra chu shel nor bu'i gzugs/ /mi bzad dug kyang dang po'i ⑪dbyangs kyis ni/ /bsgoms pas yang dang yang du 'joms par byed pa yin/ /lag pa g.yon du dbang phyug spyi bo'i rgyan/ /dbus gnas drug pa la ni thig les brgyan/ /dbyangs ni dug rnams sdud par byed pa ste/ /'phrog byed dkar po'i khu tshur bcangs pas so/ /sa 'og spyi bor zla ba'i dum bu ni/ /thig le dang bcas skra yo ris bye nag stong / /u yig gi ni dbyangs la zhon pa ste/ /'phrog byed dkar po dug mthar byed pa yin/ /spong ba dang ni gos dag 'phrog pa dang / /dug bcings cho lo ston mo sa yi 'og /ji ltar nges par bsgoms pas byed pa na/ /de ltar dgod pa yang ni shes par gyis/ /'gro ba dug gis brgyal ba dag la yang / /snying gar yang ni mgo med dkar po ste/ /gzhan dag kyang ni brgyal bar byed pa na/ /drag po'i rlung gis bskyod ⑫me 'bar bas so/ /sa 'og gos 40—1541

gnas rlung gis drangs pa na/ /skad cig gis ni phyed tsam gyis kyang ni/ /myur du khros na 'phrog pa de la ni/ /gting ①bzhin 'brangs nas 'ded par byed pa yin/ /nyon mongs snying gar chud pa'i mi shigs ④pas/ /bkug pa'i dug gi gong bu nag po ni/ / kum pa dkar ①bcas gos ni bcings pa yis /nyin zhag mang por ④yang ni g.yo ba med/ /tshes bzhi sprin nag lha yi bla ma dang //zla nyi pa ba sangs ni chol shing ste/ /rtsis kyi ri mo glog ni 'gyu ba dang / /gang por cho lor ⑤skar ma'i tshogs su ste/ /chos skur lag pa dbang phyug bzhin pa'i mig /cho lo mkhan po gnyis skyes mchog gi tshogs/ /dug zin dug las yongs su thar nas ni/ /chol res la ni lag nas yongs su 'dzin/ /de yis dug gis bzung ba'i skyes bu ni/ /rnam par dag pas skad cig khyad par 'phags—/ /bza' ba zos pa'i lhag ma'i dus su ni/ /chu snod bzung nas chu ni ster bar byed/ /gang zhig mthong dang thos dang gang zhig ni/ /nyams su myong ba'ang yul byas spyod pa ni/ /de kun sems kyis byed do pyagus par gyis/ /srid pa'i dngos po ⑦med pa 'byung ba yis/ /de bzhin du ni na ra yas smras pa/ /nus pa gang gis myur du thar skyed dang / /des ni dug dang 'byung po 'joms byed de/ /zla ba dang ni nyi mar zhugs pa na'o/ /'dus pa'i skye bo kha yi spubs nas ni/ /nus pa ba mo lta bu bab pa yis/ /dgod ④pa'i sgra yis ⑨dug dag myur du ni/ /'joms par byed de bsgoms pa ⑩byas pas so/ /dug zin smra bas gal te yod pa na/ /rgyang ⑩ring na yang dug ni myur du sdud⑫/ /snying gar ngang pa dkar po bsgom pa ni/ /bdud rtsi'i snying pos yongs su rgyas pa'o/ /brtan ⑫pa'i dug ni khur bu stong phrag kyang / /rlung gis bsdus ④pas dug med 40—1542

par ni byed/ /ngang pa'i bdud rtsi 'bab par gyur pa ni/ /zla ba'i zhing nas byung bas der 'gyur ro/ /lto ba spyi bo spyi gtsug go cha ni/ /mig dang lag pa lag sor sgra ldan pas/ /re re bor ba'i ring po tsheg drag kyang / /drug po yang ni blang bar bya ba yin/ /nyi ma'i grangs kyi dbyangs ni sbyar bya ste/ /sa mchog srid pa dhidamigs pa med pas 'god/ /de ni drag po dang mnyam ②tshig btsan zhing / /dug 'joms mi byed pa ni ma yin no/ /sa mchog ra la bskyon pa gug rings dang / zla phyed thig le yis ni mdzes par byas/ /mar gyi nying khus mjes pa bsgoms nas ①ni/ /go na sa yi dug ni sel bar byed/ /gang zhig 'bum phrag bdun ni bzlas pa yis/ /bi ṇa ④ya yi bu bzhin sbrul dug dhibazod/ /mi bzlog rjosnyan dngags mkhan kyi rgyal por ni/ /dbyangs can gyi ni nus pa bsgom pa na'o/ /de nyid tsheg drag dang bcas 'char ka yi/ /'od kyis dkrigs pa'i skyes bu gang zhig gis/ /sgom par byed na dug dang mkha' 'gro ma//gdengs ka can yang khro zhing 'khrugs par byed/ /snying la bsgoms pa yis ni 'gugs pa ste/ /dpral ba'i mthil du gnas pa dbang du sdud/ /yan lag mchog la btsud pas ⑦chang gi rgyun/ /dzu ba ti la 'bab pa kho nar 'gyur/ /kha yi sbubs su 'bar bas dkrigs pa yi/ /sum sdom khrurab tu 'bar bas dug brgyal ba/ /'chi ba 'am ni 'tsho ba yang ni rung / /bde bar gsal po nyid du de yis smra/ /de nyid dha yi nang du chud gyur cing / /pad+ma'i lte bar gnas pa bsgoms na ni/ /bdud rtsi'i zil pa dal 'bab ⑨tsheg drag bcas/ /dug 'joms pa yi sa bon nyid yin no/ /de nyid me yi nang du bzhag nas ni/ /nyi ma 'char ka'i 'od 'dras mngon gsal dkrigs/ /nges par dug sel rims 40—1543

dang 'byung po dang / /dug gi khyad par yang ni sel bar byed/ /ka ṣa sbyar ba dkar po thig ler bcas/ /ri dwags mtshan ma'i ①dbus su chud pa ni/ /snying la chud par byas pas dug rnams ni/ /myur du 'joms par byed pa kho na yin—/ /dbyangs yig khru ring yang dag ldan pa yi/ /yi ge de nyid mi yi seng ge'i steng / /'jigs dang sgra dang sdig dang dug dang ni/ /'byung po nad dang dbul po brlag par byed/ /yi ge hūṃ phaṭa me yi rang bzhin can/ /'bar ba'i phreng bas dkrigs pas gsal byas pa/ /gang gis mgrin par bris pa yin na ni/ /de yis gsal por don grub byed par 'gyur/ /la yig mchog ni zlum po'i ④thig ler bcas/ /gos gnas bdud rtsi dkar po rgyun 'dzag pa/ /dug gis ④ zin la byab tu bcug na ni/ /nges par dug ni ④'joms par byed pa yin/ /dri khur nag po'i dbus chud tha yig ni/ /sngags 'dis dug zin la ni byin brlabs na/ /bskyod ⑤dang smra dang gzer ba'i sgra dang ni/ /langs nas kun du lta bar the tshom med/ /gsum pa nye bar bstan pa'ospyo/ / //dzha kā ⑥ ri ṇi ku ru kupre dang / /be+e ruṇ+ḍa dang gser ri sa bon dag /gang du dug gis brgyal la ④byed pa yi/ /dbye ba der ni legs par mnyan par gyis—/ /sasdo bā ma gho ra de skyes bu/ /lnga pa de ru yā rgo dbang ldan du/ /dkar ser dmar ljang ④nam mkha' sor mor gnas/ /rgan lcugs ⑨gung mo gsum la dzño kā ri/ /yi ge rnam par spras pa dag yin no/ /bzhi pa lha ni ṇi yig ces bya ba/ /ming med la ni gnas pa nyid yin no/ /mkhar gnas dha dang wa sbyar ⑫thig ler bcas/ /dug zin ming yig dang por bar du ste/ /40—1544

rgan po'i sngags dang sbyar ba dag gis ni/ /dbang ldan de ni mnyes na ma lus pa'i—/ /dug ni de yi mod la zhi bar 'gyur/ /de yi skyes bu dang ni sbyar ba na//'byung po'i gnod pa yod na mngon gsal 'gyur/ /'jigs pa'i sgo ri dang ni sbyar ba na/ /dgra sbrul dman pa yang ni mod la bskyod/ /g.yon pa mnan pas rengs pa phongs pa dang / /dgra dang ngag dang dug dang dpung dag go/ /lug g.yon zla ba'i dbus gnas tha yig chud/ /rdzu mnyes dkar po 'dzag par byas nas ni/ / 'od dang ①cha kun rdzogs pa de yis ni/ /dug dang lu ba rims 'bras mkha' 'gro ma/ /gdon dang 'byung po'i gnod dang tsha ba dang / /nges par zhi byed yongs su bzlas pa'i chus/ /sngags pas 'gro ba rnams la de byed do/ /kha la rdzu yig gog mar kā yin no④/ /lte bar ri yig gsang ni ①rkang gnyis t+t+waṃ/ /mda' dang nyungs rjokar rma bya'i sgro sogs kyis/ /'byung po la sogs gnod pa 'joms byed de/ /dung sogs sgra la'ang lan bdun bzlas pas so/ /'bum bzlas sbyin sreg ⑤khri yis mchod gtang dang rjo/ /tsan tis oṃ khri la ⑦la ku yin te/ /ru ni gog mar ku ni nu brag tu/ /l+le ni gsang bar rkang gnyis swā hā'o/ /stong bzlas skud par btab pa rna bar btags/ /de ni du nags su sbrul gyis ⑨mi 'jigs so⑩/ /sa gar sogs bris khyim gzhag de mi 'ong / /bi ri ma hā se na tsan ra dang / /tsan tis 'bum bdun re res dbang kun 'grub/ /oṃ su war+ṇa re khe kuklu ta bi kri ⑪ha rū pi ṇi swā hā/ lag mthil pad dkar 'dab brgyad dbus su ni/ /yi ge 'dren pa gzhan la gnyis gnyis brtsegs⑫/ /ba mo 'bab pas sman ma la bsangs na/ /ras bal 'dab ⑫ma rlung gis bskyod bzhin ldang / /o e ho mā ye⑫/ bhe ruṇ+ḍi ⑫ā yī khru 40—1545

bī dze①/ bha ri ya ka raṇ+ḍi/ tat+ta man+ta ā sgo ṣe/ hūṃ ka re bi ṣa na se thā ba ra dza ga ma a ④ga dza kit+ta ma hā ra ta ra hūṃ phaṭa swā hā // //①oṃ rjopaspyo swā hā/ ṣi sidha nā thā di bā ka ri adzñā rjoshrī shrīskaṣ+ṭha shrī nī la kaṣ+ṭha du/ṣ+pe bi ṣe kha la/ ri mi dz+re mi haṃ sa/ k+ṣ-i pi k+ṣi pi haṃ sa hūṃ haṃ sa/ dze+e ⑦haṃ sa nāt+t+waṃ bi ṣi/ tri bha ba ne/ sa ya le/ 'brum ⑨bu gnyis dang dug zin la sogs pa//gso dang sngar gsungs ⑩bla ma'i man ngag bzhin/ /sngags chab ji tsam ⑩'gro ba'i lam de ⑫na/ /dug sel byed par yid la gdon mi za/ /pad steng bum bca' sngags bdun bzlas klu mchod/ /oṃ paspyo ⑫swā hā/ zhes bya ba dang rig pa'i rgyal mo drug④ /sgra ris zla dkyil lag mthil bsam pas kyang / /dug sel bya rgod bshad pa mthong ba dang / /skye bo'i skyid sdug bde ba'i sgra yis kyang //tsha gsum po la'i sa bon sbrang rtsir sbyar/ /snar blugs lus skyes sogs kyi spyond 'joms byed/ /tsher can shing sha'i rnga la ni/ /kha gnyis pags pas rnga g.yogs byas/ /sbrul dgra'i rkang gis brdungs nas ni/ /ji srid sgras khyab de dug 'joms/ /pha ni dza dang su ⑫dar+ṣa na lus btags kyang / /ṣe te pu nar na ba'i khu blud pas/ /ma ning ka ko ti yi tsa/ /ba mar dang 'thungs dug gsum sel/ /kan+ta shir sha'i rtsa shun 'bras bkrus chur/ /sbyar ba a sha ra yi nya dag la/ /'thungs na lo gcig dug ni thub pa yin/ /shu dag shing kun nispa'i khu ba dag /snar blugs dug gis skra rtse slebs kyang sel/ /ka rañdza ⑫yi tsher can nispa'i 'dab/ /mar sbrang yungs kar go spyon sa yang sel kha gnyis lus che ⑪ne'u le yi mig /sbrul dgra'i mkhris pa'i cha mnyam pa/ /khyer du dugazhag pas kyang ni ⑥sbrul mgo 'gegs/ shrī ⑫bā sa/ bi raṅga/ u shi ra/40—1546

sardza ra sa/ rnam bha lā lā ta ka /kud tha/ tri pha la/ ardzu na/ ku su ma/'di dag cha mnyam du ba yis/ /lus skyes tsa ri sbrang ma sogs/ /sbrul yang 'bros zhes ①klu sgrub gsung / /me tog grong khyer zhes bya ba/ /brgya byin pho brang dang mnyam par/ /zla cha zhes bya'i ④bram ze me'i/ /lo rgyus kyang ni lnga pa yinaske/ /dpal mkha' lding grub pa'i bstan bcos ④bram ze shang kus mdzad pa rdzogs so// //gu ṇa sā ④ga ra/ 'dir ni bla ma dam pa'i rjes 'brangs te/ /dpal ldan shang ku bdag gis mdor bsdus bris/ /dge ba de yis srid gsum ma lus pa—/ /dug med bdud rtsi'i go 'phang bsten par shog /rgya gar gyi mkhan po dpal bram ze a ba dhū tī chen po dpe med kyi zhal sngar/ lo tsā ⑤ba ban+de pradzñā krirtis bsgyur ba'o// //dbang phyug chen pos dumakha' lding du sprul nas/ mkha' lding rgya mtsho ba 'bum phrag bzhi bshad/ de bram ze sang kus dbang bskur gyi tshe klu bdud kyi ⑦dug yod pa la/ 'jog po'i dug kham phor du mar dang sbrang rtsi byin pa ma yog /bdun po kun gyi bu mo nu thumo bkug nas chung mar byas/ 'jog po'i bu mo ⑨bkug pas mos phu byas ⑩dug gis zin nas shi la thug pas/ yul mi kun gyis ༷da grongs ⑪na nged kyi dug sus gso byas pas/ mchod sdong tshugs shig zer nas—/ nam mkha' lding gi mchod sdong rdo rings steng du btsugs/ steng nas rdo'i gdugs phub pa cig ⑫byas/ khos 'khyud nas sngags bzlas te/ kun dug zhi bar byed do/ /de lta bu'i shang kus mdzad do// //dus dang dus ma yin pa la lnga ste/ rma'i mtshan nyid dang / pho nya'i 40—1547

mtshan nyid dang / gnas dang / tshes grangs dang / gza' dang / rgyu skar dang / chos mthun pa dang / mi mthun pa ①dang / dus dang /dgos pa'i dbye ba dang / rags pa dang / stong pa ste dug zin gyi mtshan nyid dang / dus ma yin par ④mi 'chi ba bstan pa'o/ /nying dgos la gsum/ phrin las thams cad kyi snod du 'gyur ba'i dgos pa dang / sems kyi srog 'dzin pa ①dang / phyogs thams cad du grags pas khyab pa'o// //mchod brjod dang / dgos 'brel dang / gzhung bshad pa gsum mo/ /gzhung la gnyis/ lus rnam gzhag dang / yan lag rgyas bshad do/ /oṃ tsakra ra nyi tsakra bhi da ni gha ṇa ti kā ri haṃ/ sa gzhi lci bas maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi byug /dung dang bu tsha bkrus la thub ④pa dang kha byang du bstan/ rang yang kha byang du bltas la/ dung la gu gul bdug /g.yas g.yon gang du 'khor 'dod pa de ⑤ngos su dung bskor/ lag pa gnyis kyi bar du dung gzung / dung 0la kha gtad la sngags bzla/ bu tsha'i mgo la me tog gtor/ gtsang pa lo tsā ⑦ba'i phyag dpe las bris so// //⑤ 40—1548

ra /lha mo dbyangs can gyi bstod pa/①sngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ swa ra swa tī sto tra nā ②ma/ bod skad du/lha mo dbyangs can gyi bstod pa/ ston zla rab rgyas ku mud dung dang chu shel gangs ri ltar dkar ba/ /rab dkar dkar gsal gzi ldan yid 'phrog lha mo dbyangs can la ③phyag 'tshal / /bdag blo'i dumi shes gti mug rmongs pa'i tshogs ni kun nas 'joms pa dang ⑤/ /smra ngan sun 'byin thogs med kun gzigs spobs pa'i gter mchog rgyas par mdzod/ /sgrib gnyis sprin bral blo gros 'od zer stong ldan rab tu 'char ka yi/ /nyi ma'i zer kyis gdul dubya'i pad+mo rab dul kha 'byed rnam rgyas pas/ /rab tu dri zhim bsil ngad dang ldan 3 pad+mo'i ze'u 'bru'i ngos dag la/ /bdag blos gus pas 'thungs pas blo gros cher rgyas sbrang rtsis 'go rnams skyong / /gser gyi ri dang kun mkhyen chu gter lta bur kun nas lhun chags pa/ /rtsod pa'i phye ma leb dang bdud sde ⑧dus kyi rlung 40byed1552

gis bskyod ma yin/ /bcu drug na tshod lta bu'i bu mo rab mdzes sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan/ /lha yi rgyan rnams du mas khyod kyi lus dang yan lag mdzes pa yis/ /chu gter ①'gram gnas ①mgrin sngon dga' bskyed rgya mtsho'i lha mo dbyangs can ma—/ /khyod la phyag 'tshal brtse bas bdag blo'i mi shes mun pa myur du sol/ /rab tu snyan pa'i dbyangs ldan dri za'i bu mo rab mdzes ①yid 'phrog ma/ /lag gi 'du byed rab tu bsgyur bas tshangs pa'i gsung dbyangs rnam bu'abyung bas/ /sgra dang tshad ma snyan dngags mngon brjod sdeb sbyor legs bshad chos rnams kun//pha rol yid 'phrog 'dzin par nus pa ci dhiphyir bdag la mi stsol lags/ /khyod kyi thugs ni kun du mi g.yo rgya mtsho chen po lta bu ste/ /thugs rje'i rlabs shugs drag tu bskyed dupas 'gro ba'i gdung ba rab tu sol/ /dbang gi rgyal po'i 'byung gnas yid bzhin re skong dbyangs can rgya mtsho yis/ /rmongs pa'i gdung bas gdungs pa'i skye bo rings par skyong ba dang / /gti mug dag gis blo dman skye bo'i re ba myur du skongs/ /bdag blo'i ku mu ⑦da ni rab tu kha zums rnam par gnag pa la/ /bsil zer byed pa ⑧rab tu sprin bral dkyil 'khor rnam par rgyas pa yis/ /ku mud kha bye rab rgyas ze'u 'bru'i bsil dngar rnam par spel spubar mdzod/ /rab tu dri bral rkyen gyi dri mas ma phog ma 'gags khyod kyi sku//kun du tshangs pa'i dbyangs can ca co'i dri bral khyod kyi gsung / /shes bya kun la thogs pa med pa'i ye shes dang ldan khyod kyi thugs/ /bstod pa 'di yis bstod la dbyangs can ma yis blo gros mchog rab stsol/ /dbyangs can gyi bstod pa 'di ni/ lho phyogs kyi rgyud du byung ba'i mkhas pa chen po paṇ+ḍi ta nag mo'i khol gyis dbyangs can ma zhal gzigs pa'i dus su dgyes te bstod pa 40—1553

cardob/ba/ cas// //gang zhig 'di 'don pa la shes rab stsol bar khas blangs so/ /rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇ+ḍi ta dzñā na shī ①la dang / lo tsā ②ba dge slong chos 'bar gyis bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/1552 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉snga'ar 〉〉dbyangs can ma'i bstod pa paṇ+ḍi ta nag mo'i khol gyi mdzad pa paṇ+ḍi ta tshwa na shī la dang / dge slong chos 'bar gyi 'gyur bzhugs so// ②〈〈pe 〉〉ma ra sastos na/ 〈〈snar 〉nyasto ra swo stob na/ ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wal/ du〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉lo// ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wapa dang / du〈〈snar 〉75gled/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉sdun pa'i/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉dang /1553 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉wagater/ ②〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉khonas/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉warab mdzes/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉rnams / ⑤〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉the'i/ yi〈〈pe 〉sko'adir 〉〉bskyod/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tshogad/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pas/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sol/1554 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stan/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉thats+tsha/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2329)40wa 1554

deb bzhi bcu pa/krung bo'i bod kyi shes ris 'ib 'jus ste sanas kyi bsa' bsta na dpe sdur khang bis dpe snyur dang dpe sgrib zhus/krung bo'i bod kyi shes rig dpe skrun khang bis bskrun/'in hwa dpe tshong lang pe cin 'grem spel lang bis bkrams /bka' bsta na dpe sdur lang si glob rdul rtsis 'bor lang bis pa ra sazhi bsgrisas/krung ka'i glog brnyan dpe skrun lang pa ra lang bis dpa ra btab/spyi lo 99/ ma 9 zla pa ra pa ra —zi ngang pa bsgrisas spyi lo 99 lo 'i zla rnga ra pa ra thengar ngang ngo bcab/byedabyed byed byedabyedabyed byed 0/ci2ma byed8005— 3—8 3byed—2 / /
